declarations.docstring: A target-depth base-two step turns an old `1/16` band into the desired new `1/32` band whenever the appended correction fits inside the new edge.

declarations.name: baseTwoTargetResidue_central_of_envelope
declarations.signature: theorem baseTwoTargetResidue_central_of_envelope {m : ℕ} {d C B : ℤ} (hm : 5 ≤ m) (hC : |C| ≤ B) (hlo : 2 ^ (m - 5) + B ≤ 2 * d) (hhi : 2 * d + B ≤ 2 ^ m - 2 ^ (m - 5)) : (2 : ℤ) ^ (m - 5) ≤ (2 * d + C) % 2 ^ m ∧ (2 * d + C) % 2 ^ m ≤ 2 ^ m - 2 ^ (m - 5)
declarations.docstring: Sharp division-free sufficient interface for a target-depth base-two step. The old residue need only have enough doubled margin to absorb an absolute correction envelope `B`; no fixed stronger band is required.

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixResidue_central_of_penultimate_strongBand
declarations.signature: theorem canonicalAdjacentSuffixResidue_central_of_penultimate_strongBand {t : ℕ} (ht : 3 ≤ t) (hlo : 2 ^ (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t - 5) ≤ diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue t 0 (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t - 1)) (hhi : diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue t 0 (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t - 1) ≤ 2 ^ (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t - 1) - 2 ^ (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t - 5)) : (2 : ℤ) ^ (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t - 5) ≤ diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue t 0 (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t) ∧ diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue t 0 (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t) ≤
declarations.docstring: The exact parity-complete reduction at canonical depth. Centrality of the penultimate residue in its stronger `1/16` band forces canonical `1/32` centrality; the correction estimate is now automatic for every `t ≥ 3`.

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixResidue_central_of_penultimate_margin
declarations.signature: theorem canonicalAdjacentSuffixResidue_central_of_penultimate_margin {t : ℕ} (ht : 3 ≤ t) (hlo : 2 ^ (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t - 5) + (3 * periodLcm t + 2 * canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t + 1 : ℤ) ≤ 2 * diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue t 0 (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t - 1)) (hhi : 2 * diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue t 0 (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t - 1) + (3 * periodLcm t + 2 * canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t + 1 : ℤ) ≤ 2 ^ canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t -
declarations.docstring: Strongest elementary parity-complete reduction supplied by the uniform correction estimate. The two displayed inequalities are the exact doubled left and right margins needed to absorb the factorisation-free envelope.

declarations.name: DiagonalAdjacentSuffixGapSupply
declarations.docstring: The unresolved arithmetic input after the adjacent finite reduction. It uses the fixed first pair of cuts, so sliding is no longer an artificial waiting parameter.

declarations.name: CanonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSupply
declarations.docstring: The canonical producer throat after removing the automatic width budget. Only centrality of one exact modular observable at arbitrarily large LCM heights remains.

declarations.name: CanonicalAdjacentSuffixPenultimateExactSupply
declarations.docstring: Exact penultimate-coordinate form of the canonical producer. Unlike the envelope and strong-band interfaces below, this loses no information: the signed one-step correction is retained rather than replaced by an absolute upper bound.

declarations.name: CanonicalAdjacentSuffixPenultimateMarginSupply
declarations.docstring: Sharp parity-complete producer after eliminating the one-step correction. It asks only that the doubled penultimate residue absorb the explicit factorisation-free correction envelope on both edges.

declarations.name: CanonicalAdjacentSuffixPenultimateStrongBandSupply
declarations.docstring: Parity-complete producer left after the one-depth correction estimate. Only the penultimate residue must occupy the stronger `1/16` band; all transport to the canonical `1/32` consumer is automatic.

declarations.name: CanonicalAdjacentSuffixJumpCentralSupply
declarations.docstring: The prime-power-jump-aligned producer throat. Repeated LCM heights carry no new arithmetic state, so it is enough to establish canonical centrality at arbitrarily large strict jumps.

declarations.name: periodLcm_strict_jump_iff_succ_not_dvd
declarations.signature: theorem periodLcm_strict_jump_iff_succ_not_dvd (t : ℕ) : periodLcm t < periodLcm (t + 1) ↔ ¬ (t + 1) ∣ periodLcm t
declarations.docstring: Exact classification of a strict `periodLcm` step before the prime-power refinement: the height changes precisely when the new endpoint does not already divide the old height.

declarations.name: succ_eq_prime_pow_of_periodLcm_strict_jump
declarations.signature: theorem succ_eq_prime_pow_of_periodLcm_strict_jump {t : ℕ} (ht : 2 ≤ t) (hjump : periodLcm t < periodLcm (t + 1)) : ∃ p k : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ t + 1 = p ^ k
declarations.docstring: Beyond the two initial scales, every strict LCM jump occurs exactly when the new endpoint is a prime power. This packages the generic window classification for the adjacent endpoint used by the slack producer.

declarations.name: periodLcm_succ_eq_prime_mul_of_strict_jump
declarations.signature: theorem periodLcm_succ_eq_prime_mul_of_strict_jump {t : ℕ} (ht : 2 ≤ t) (hjump : periodLcm t < periodLcm (t + 1)) : ∃ p k : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ t + 1 = p ^ k ∧ periodLcm (t + 1) = p * periodLcm t
declarations.docstring: A strict prime-power endpoint inserts exactly one additional copy of its prime base into the LCM height.

declarations.name: periodLcm_factorization_two_lt_of_lt_pow_two
declarations.signature: theorem periodLcm_factorization_two_lt_of_lt_pow_two {a t : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (ht : t < 2 ^ a) : (periodLcm t).factorization 2 < a
declarations.docstring: Below `2^a`, every row and hence their LCM has 2-adic exponent strictly smaller than `a`. This supplies the missing converse needed to certify the cofinal power-of-two strict-jump subfamily.

declarations.name: periodLcm_pow_two_strict_jump
declarations.signature: theorem periodLcm_pow_two_strict_jump {a : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) : periodLcm (2 ^ a - 1) < periodLcm (2 ^ a)
declarations.docstring: Every endpoint `2^a`, `a ≥ 2`, is a strict LCM jump.

declarations.name: periodLcm_pow_two_eq_two_mul
declarations.signature: theorem periodLcm_pow_two_eq_two_mul {a : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) : periodLcm (2 ^ a) = 2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a - 1)
declarations.docstring: A power-of-two strict jump doubles the LCM height exactly.

declarations.name: diagonalWindowIncrement_powerTwoJump_even
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalWindowIncrement_powerTwoJump_even {a r : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hr : Even r) : diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * r) = 2 * diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a - 1) r
declarations.docstring: Concrete power-of-two jump form of the even seam.

declarations.name: diagonalWindowIncrement_powerTwoJump_odd
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalWindowIncrement_powerTwoJump_odd {a r : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hr : Odd r) : diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * r) = diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a - 1) r

declarations.name: powerTwoInheritedIncrement
declarations.docstring: The exact inherited contribution at a reduced offset across a power-of-two LCM jump. Even reduced offsets double; odd reduced offsets are copied unchanged.

declarations.name: powerTwoFreshOddIncrement
declarations.docstring: The odd post-jump offset not reconstructed by the even-offset seam. The name records its role in the cocycle, not an arithmetic independence claim.

declarations.name: powerTwoOddDepthCorrection
declarations.docstring: The signed correction in one odd-depth/base-four power-of-two step.

declarations.name: diagonalWindowIncrement_powerTwoJump_even_offset
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalWindowIncrement_powerTwoJump_even_offset {a r : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) : diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * r) = powerTwoInheritedIncrement a r
declarations.docstring: Every even post-jump offset is exactly the corresponding inherited increment.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock_powerTwo_oddDepth_step
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock_powerTwo_oddDepth_step {a n : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) : diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * (n + 1) + 1) = 4 * diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * n + 1) + powerTwoFreshOddIncrement a (n + 1) - 2 * powerTwoInheritedIncrement a (n + 1) + powerTwoInheritedIncrement a (n + 2)
declarations.docstring: At every odd-depth base-four step, the only post-jump increment outside the even inheritance seam is the single new odd terminal offset. This is the exact local arithmetic throat behind power-of-two centrality.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_powerTwo_oddDepth_step
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_powerTwo_oddDepth_step {a n : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) : diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * (n + 1) + 1) = (4 * diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * n + 1) + powerTwoOddDepthCorrection a n) % 2 ^ (2 * (n + 1) + 1)
declarations.docstring: Residue form of the odd-depth cocycle. The factor four lifts every discarded multiple of the old modulus to a multiple of the new modulus, so the step depends only on the old residue and the one exact correction.

declarations.name: baseFourResidue_central_of_correction_bounds
declarations.signature: theorem baseFourResidue_central_of_correction_bounds {m : ℕ} {d C : ℤ} (hm : 5 ≤ m) (hClower : -4 * (d - 2 ^ (m - 5)) ≤ C) (hCupper : C ≤ 4 * ((2 ^ m - 2 ^ (m - 5)) - d)) : (2 : ℤ) ^ (m + 2 - 5) ≤ (4 * d + C) % 2 ^ (m + 2) ∧ (4 * d + C) % 2 ^ (m + 2) ≤ 2 ^ (m + 2) - 2 ^ (m + 2 - 5)
declarations.docstring: A base-four step preserves the fixed central band whenever its correction fits between the exact left and right margin budgets. This isolates the remaining arithmetic obligation from all modular bookkeeping.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_powerTwo_oddDepth_central_of_correction_bounds
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_powerTwo_oddDepth_central_of_correction_bounds {a n : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hClower : -4 * (diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * n + 1) - 2 ^ (2 * n + 1 - 5)) ≤ powerTwoOddDepthCorrection a n) (hCupper : powerTwoOddDepthCorrection a n ≤ 4 * ((2 ^ (2 * n + 1) - 2 ^ (2 * n + 1 - 5)) - diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * n + 1))) : (2 : ℤ) ^ (2 * (n + 1) + 1 - 5) ≤ diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * (n + 1) + 1) ∧ diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * (n + 1) + 1) ≤ 2 ^ (2 * (n + 1) + 1) - 2 ^ (2 * (n + 1) + 1 - 5)
declarations.docstring: Power-of-two specialization of the margin lemma. A single exact bound on the odd-depth correction advances canonical centrality by two binary places; no further modular or LCM argument remains in the induction step.

declarations.name: exists_periodLcm_strict_jump_ge
declarations.signature: theorem exists_periodLcm_strict_jump_ge (t₀ : ℕ) : ∃ t, t₀ ≤ t ∧ periodLcm t < periodLcm (t + 1)
declarations.docstring: Strict LCM jumps occur beyond every prescribed index. A prime endpoint strictly above the index supplies a witness.

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSlack
declarations.docstring: Signed distance of the canonical adjacent residue from the nearer edge of the fixed central band. Nonnegative slack is exactly the two-sided centrality condition; this scalar is the proof-oriented cocycle to study at strict LCM jumps.

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSlack_eq_of_periodLcm_eq
declarations.signature: theorem canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSlack_eq_of_periodLcm_eq {t u : ℕ} (hH : periodLcm t = periodLcm u) : canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSlack t = canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSlack u
declarations.docstring: The canonical scalar depends only on the LCM height. In particular it is constant across every plateau between consecutive strict jumps.

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentral_iff_slack_nonneg
declarations.signature: theorem canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentral_iff_slack_nonneg (t : ℕ) : (2 ^ (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t - 5) ≤ diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue t 0 (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t) ∧ diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue t 0 (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t) ≤ 2 ^ canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t - 2 ^ (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth t - 5)) ↔ 0 ≤ canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSlack t
declarations.docstring: The two central-band inequalities collapse to one exact integer sign.

declarations.name: CanonicalAdjacentSuffixJumpSlackSupply
declarations.docstring: Scalar strict-jump producer. This is equivalent to the original two-sided producer but exposes a single integer observable for recurrence, congruence, and exact-computation arguments.

declarations.name: CanonicalAdjacentSuffixPostJumpSlackSupply
declarations.docstring: Fresh-factor-aligned producer: the successful scalar is evaluated after the displayed strict jump, at the new LCM height.

declarations.name: CanonicalAdjacentSuffixPowerTwoPostJumpSlackSupply
declarations.docstring: Cofinal power-of-two specialisation of the post-jump producer. The argument is the new endpoint `2^a`, not the pre-jump index `2^a - 1`.

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixPostJumpSlackSupply_of_powerTwo
declarations.docstring: Power-of-two post-jump centrality is already cofinal among strict LCM jumps, so it supplies the general post-jump producer.

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixJumpSlackSupply_of_postJump
declarations.docstring: Post-jump centrality transports across the following LCM plateau to its next strict-jump index. This is the unconditional reindexing bridge that lets arithmetic arguments use the newly inserted factor while preserving the existing pre-jump producer and consumer.

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSupply_iff_penultimateExact
declarations.docstring: The canonical central producer and its signed penultimate-coordinate form are logically equivalent. This pins the remaining cofinal arithmetic obligation exactly, without the loss introduced by an absolute correction envelope.

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSupply_of_penultimateMargin
declarations.docstring: The sharp penultimate margin producer feeds the canonical centrality interface directly.

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixPenultimateMarginSupply_of_strongBand
declarations.docstring: The cleaner penultimate `1/16` band is a sufficient corollary of the sharper doubled-margin producer because the canonical correction envelope is strictly smaller than one edge.

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSupply_of_penultimateStrongBand
declarations.docstring: The penultimate strong-band producer feeds canonical centrality without a parity restriction or any power-of-two LCM-jump hypothesis.

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSupply_of_jump
declarations.docstring: Restricting the producer to strict LCM jumps still supplies the canonical centrality interface.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixGapSupply_of_canonical
declarations.docstring: Canonical centrality supplies the existing adjacent-gap interface; the guard-bit and width obligations are discharged uniformly.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_diagonalAdjacentSuffixGapSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_diagonalAdjacentSuffixGapSupply (hsupply : DiagonalAdjacentSuffixGapSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: The adjacent integer-gap interface is already sufficient for the global irrationality consumer.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_canonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSupply (hsupply : CanonicalAdjacentSuffixCentralSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: Canonical adjacent-suffix centrality is sufficient for Erdős #249's irrationality target through the already-landed adjacent-gap consumer.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_canonicalAdjacentSuffixPenultimateExactSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_canonicalAdjacentSuffixPenultimateExactSupply (hsupply : CanonicalAdjacentSuffixPenultimateExactSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: The exact signed penultimate-coordinate supply implies irrationality of the totient series. The supply itself remains unproved.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_canonicalAdjacentSuffixPenultimateMarginSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_canonicalAdjacentSuffixPenultimateMarginSupply (hsupply : CanonicalAdjacentSuffixPenultimateMarginSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: The sharp penultimate-margin supply implies irrationality of the totient series through the canonical adjacent-suffix route. The supply itself remains unproved.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_canonicalAdjacentSuffixPenultimateStrongBandSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_canonicalAdjacentSuffixPenultimateStrongBandSupply (hsupply : CanonicalAdjacentSuffixPenultimateStrongBandSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: The parity-complete penultimate-band supply implies irrationality of the totient series through the canonical adjacent-suffix route. The supply itself remains unproved.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_canonicalAdjacentSuffixJumpCentralSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_canonicalAdjacentSuffixJumpCentralSupply (hsupply : CanonicalAdjacentSuffixJumpCentralSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: Centrality at arbitrarily large strict LCM jumps implies irrationality of the totient series. The centrality condition remains unproved.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_canonicalAdjacentSuffixJumpSlackSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_canonicalAdjacentSuffixJumpSlackSupply (hsupply : CanonicalAdjacentSuffixJumpSlackSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: Nonnegative canonical slack at arbitrarily large strict LCM jumps likewise implies irrationality of the totient series.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_canonicalAdjacentSuffixPostJumpSlackSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_canonicalAdjacentSuffixPostJumpSlackSupply (hsupply : CanonicalAdjacentSuffixPostJumpSlackSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: The post-jump supply implies irrationality of the totient series via plateau transport and the canonical adjacent-suffix route. The supply itself remains unproved.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_canonicalAdjacentSuffixPowerTwoPostJumpSlackSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_canonicalAdjacentSuffixPowerTwoPostJumpSlackSupply (hsupply : CanonicalAdjacentSuffixPowerTwoPostJumpSlackSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: The cofinal power-of-two producer is sufficient for Erdős #249.

declarations.name: diagonalFreshLossProjectionCell_seven
declarations.docstring: At `t = 7`, depth `13` gives the exact diagonal projection and its floor. This is a bridge fixture, not evidence for an unbounded supply.

declarations.name: foreignDiagonalDefect_misses_fullTarget_seven_via_projection
declarations.docstring: The existing `t = 7` full-target miss can be recovered through the new operational composition seam.

declarations.name: diagonalSuffixCell_seven
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalSuffixCell_seven : (periodLcm 7 + (1 + 12) + 2 : ℤ) < diagonalSuffixResidue 7 1 12 ∧ diagonalSuffixResidue 7 1 12 < 2 ^ 12 - (2 * periodLcm 7 + (1 + 12) + 2)
declarations.docstring: At `t = 7`, the cut `J = 1` with suffix length `m = 12` is centrally placed: the last twelve bits alone recover the landed `(7, 13)` projection. A bridge fixture, not evidence for an unbounded supply.

declarations.name: foreignDiagonalDefect_misses_fullTarget_seven_via_suffix
declarations.docstring: The `t = 7` full-target miss re-derived from suffix bits only, through the sliding-suffix transference theorem.

declarations.name: baseTwoTargetResidue_central_iff_topBit
declarations.docstring: Under the canonical small-correction hypothesis, target centrality has only one nonautomatic inequality: the side selected by the top bit of the penultimate residue.

declarations.name: baseTwoTargetResidue_noncentral_iff_carryEdgeAlignment
declarations.signature: theorem baseTwoTargetResidue_noncentral_iff_carryEdgeAlignment {m : ℕ} {d C : ℤ} (hm : 5 ≤ m) (hd0 : 0 ≤ d) (hdhi : d < (2 : ℤ) ^ (m - 1)) (hC : |C| < (2 : ℤ) ^ (m - 5)) : (¬ ((2 : ℤ) ^ (m - 5) ≤ (2 * d + C) % 2 ^ m ∧ (2 * d + C) % 2 ^ m ≤ 2 ^ m - 2 ^ (m - 5))) ↔ ((d < (2 : ℤ) ^ (m - 2) ∧ 2 * d + C < 2 ^ (m - 5)) ∨ ((2 : ℤ) ^ (m - 2) ≤ d ∧ 2 ^ m - 2 ^ (m - 5) < 2 * d + C))
declarations.docstring: Exact failure form: noncentrality is precisely alignment of the penultimate top bit with the corresponding signed edge excursion.

declarations.name: canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_powerTwo_jump
declarations.signature: theorem canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth_powerTwo_jump {a : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) : canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a) = canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a - 1) + 1
declarations.docstring: A power-of-two LCM jump adds exactly one canonical bit.

declarations.name: diagonalTargetDepthCorrection_powerTwo_of_even_predepth
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalTargetDepthCorrection_powerTwo_of_even_predepth {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hdepth : canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a - 1) = 2 * q) : diagonalTargetDepthCorrection (2 ^ a) (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a)) = powerTwoInheritedIncrement a (q + 1) - powerTwoFreshOddIncrement a q
declarations.docstring: If the pre-jump canonical depth is even, the target correction is the next inherited even increment minus the current fresh odd increment.

declarations.name: diagonalTargetDepthCorrection_powerTwo_of_odd_predepth
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalTargetDepthCorrection_powerTwo_of_odd_predepth {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hdepth : canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a - 1) = 2 * q + 1) : diagonalTargetDepthCorrection (2 ^ a) (canonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a)) = powerTwoFreshOddIncrement a (q + 1) - powerTwoInheritedIncrement a (q + 1)
declarations.docstring: If the pre-jump canonical depth is odd, the target correction is the next fresh odd increment minus the matching inherited even increment.

declarations.name: powerTwoOddCorrectionWord
declarations.docstring: The base-four word of all odd-depth corrections through step `q`.

declarations.name: powerTwoOddCorrectionWord_succ
declarations.signature: theorem powerTwoOddCorrectionWord_succ (a q : ℕ) : powerTwoOddCorrectionWord a (q + 1) = 4 * powerTwoOddCorrectionWord a q + powerTwoOddDepthCorrection a q
declarations.docstring: Appending one correction is the affine base-four recurrence.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock_powerTwo_oddDepth_closed
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock_powerTwo_oddDepth_closed {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) : diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * q + 1) = (4 : ℤ) ^ q * diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock (2 ^ a) 0 1 + powerTwoOddCorrectionWord a q
declarations.docstring: Closed raw odd-depth orbit at a power-of-two endpoint.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_powerTwo_oddDepth_closed
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_powerTwo_oddDepth_closed {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) : diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * q + 1) = ((4 : ℤ) ^ q * diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock (2 ^ a) 0 1 + powerTwoOddCorrectionWord a q) % 2 ^ (2 * q + 1)
declarations.docstring: Closed residue form of the odd-depth orbit.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_powerTwo_oddDepth_lowBits
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_powerTwo_oddDepth_lowBits {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) : diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * q + 1) % (4 : ℤ) ^ q = powerTwoOddCorrectionWord a q % (4 : ℤ) ^ q
declarations.docstring: The seed contributes only the top bit at odd depth: all lower `2q` bits are exactly the correction word modulo `4^q`.

declarations.name: diagonalWindowIncrement_even_of_two_le_periodLcm
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalWindowIncrement_even_of_two_le_periodLcm {t s : ℕ} (hH : 2 ≤ periodLcm t) (hs : 1 ≤ s) : Even (diagonalWindowIncrement t s)
declarations.docstring: Once the LCM height is at least two, every positive-offset diagonal increment is even: both totients are even before taking their difference.

declarations.name: diagonalWindowIncrement_even_of_two_le_offset
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalWindowIncrement_even_of_two_le_offset {t s : ℕ} (hs : 2 ≤ s) : Even (diagonalWindowIncrement t s)
declarations.docstring: Once the offset is at least two, both totient arguments exceed two, so the diagonal increment is even without any hypothesis on the LCM height.

declarations.name: powerTwoOddDepthCorrection_even
declarations.signature: theorem powerTwoOddDepthCorrection_even (a n : ℕ) : Even (powerTwoOddDepthCorrection a n)
declarations.docstring: Every odd-depth power-of-two correction is even. The fresh term is at offset at least three, the last inherited term is at reduced offset at least two, and the middle inherited term already carries a factor two.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixRawBlock_powerTwo_zero_one_even
declarations.docstring: The seed of the odd-depth power-of-two orbit is even.

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_powerTwo_oddDepth_eq_correctionWord
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_powerTwo_oddDepth_eq_correctionWord {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) : diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * q + 1) = powerTwoOddCorrectionWord a q % 2 ^ (2 * q + 1)
declarations.docstring: The even seed vanishes modulo the full odd-depth modulus, so the correction word determines every bit of the residue, including its top bit.

declarations.name: powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord
declarations.signature: def powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord (a : ℕ) : ℕ → ℤ | 0 => 0 | q + 1 => 4 * powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q + powerTwoOddDepthCorrection a q / 2 /-- Appending one half-correction is the integral base-four recurrence. -/ theorem powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord_succ (a q : ℕ) : powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a (q + 1) = 4 * powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q + powerTwoOddDepthCorrection a q / 2

declarations.name: powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord_succ
declarations.signature: theorem powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord_succ (a q : ℕ) : powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a (q + 1) = 4 * powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q + powerTwoOddDepthCorrection a q / 2
declarations.docstring: Appending one half-correction is the integral base-four recurrence.

declarations.name: powerTwoOddCorrectionWord_eq_two_mul_halfWord
declarations.signature: theorem powerTwoOddCorrectionWord_eq_two_mul_halfWord (a q : ℕ) : powerTwoOddCorrectionWord a q = 2 * powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_powerTwo_oddDepth_eq_two_mul_halfWord

declarations.name: diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_powerTwo_oddDepth_central_iff_halfWordBand
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue_powerTwo_oddDepth_central_iff_halfWordBand {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hq : 3 ≤ q) : ((2 : ℤ) ^ (2 * q + 1 - 5) ≤ diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * q + 1) ∧ diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue (2 ^ a) 0 (2 * q + 1) ≤ 2 ^ (2 * q + 1) - 2 ^ (2 * q + 1 - 5)) ↔ ((4 : ℤ) ^ q ≤ 32 * (powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q % (4 : ℤ) ^ q) ∧ 32 * (powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q % (4 : ℤ) ^ q) ≤ 31 * (4 : ℤ) ^ q)

declarations.name: SignedSplitSafe
declarations.signature: def SignedSplitSafe (x y M e : ℤ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: Sufficient signed-coordinate conditions for a central sum modulo `M`. The same-direction branch prevents a wrap into the opposite edge; the opposite-direction branch prevents cancellation into the edge about zero.

declarations.name: emod_central_of_abs_between

declarations.name: abs_add_between_of_signedSplitSafe
declarations.signature: theorem abs_add_between_of_signedSplitSafe {x y M e : ℤ} (h : SignedSplitSafe x y M e) : e ≤ |x + y| ∧ |x + y| ≤ M - e
declarations.docstring: The expanded phase condition puts the unwrapped sum between the two signed edge radii.

declarations.name: signedSplitSafe_emod_central

declarations.docstring: The signed old/foreign phase conditions exclude both width-`e` edge cylinders after recombination modulo `M`.

declarations.name: powerTwoOddHalfWordBand_of_signedSplit
declarations.signature: theorem powerTwoOddHalfWordBand_of_signedSplit {a q : ℕ} {x y : ℤ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hOldEven : Even (oldMobiusRawBlock (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) 0 (2 * q + 1))) (hx : Int.ModEq ((4 : ℤ) ^ q) (oldMobiusRawBlock (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) 0 (2 * q + 1) / 2) x) (hy : Int.ModEq ((4 : ℤ) ^ q) (finiteForeignChannelRawBlock (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) 0 (2 * q + 1) / 2) y) (hSafe : SignedSplitSafe x y ((4 : ℤ) ^ q) ((4 : ℤ) ^ q / 32)) : (4 : ℤ) ^ q ≤ 32 * (powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q % (4 : ℤ) ^ q) ∧ 32 * (powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q % (4 : ℤ) ^ q) ≤ 31 * (4 : ℤ) ^ q

declarations.name: NearMultiple

declarations.name: nearMultiple_correction_of_twoRank

declarations.name: abs_powerTwoOddDepthCorrection_le

declarations.name: one_le_factorization_centralBinom_of_prime_pow_window

The endpoint `2n` is supplied by `n ∣ periodLcm n` and the evenness of the positive central binomial.

declarations.name: periodLcm_two_mul_le_periodLcm_mul_centralBinom

declarations.name: actualOddHalfCorrection

This exposes the arithmetic content hidden by the inherited/fresh cocycle notation: the even initial letter occurs with coefficient `-2`, while the following odd and even letters occur with coefficient `1`.

declarations.name: actualOddHalf_affine_modEq_halfCorrectionWord_succ

declarations.name: abs_actualOddHalfCorrection_le_canonicalEnvelope

declarations.name: baseFour_actual_central_iff_affineExclusion

declarations.docstring: The foreign defect plus the non-selected explicit fibres, rescaled by the selected Mersenne modulus.

declarations.name: freshTarget
declarations.signature: noncomputable def freshTarget (t p : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: The additive target the residual must hit modulo the selected channel.

declarations.name: RenormalizedDefectHitsFreshTarget
declarations.docstring: Exact real-lattice formulation of a modular target hit.

declarations.name: IsIntegralValue
declarations.docstring: Predicate for a real quantity to be an integer.

declarations.name: diagonal_int_iff_hit_generic
declarations.signature: private theorem diagonal_int_iff_hit_generic {D E G C : ℝ} {m : ℕ} {u : ℤ} (hm : 0 < m) (hD : D = E + G) (hE : E = (u : ℝ) / (m : ℝ) + C) : IsIntegralValue D ↔ ∃ k : ℤ, (m : ℝ) * (G + C) = (-u : ℝ) + (m : ℝ) * (k : ℝ)

declarations.name: diagonal_int_iff_foreignDiagonalDefect_hits_fullTarget
declarations.signature: theorem diagonal_int_iff_foreignDiagonalDefect_hits_fullTarget (t : ℕ) : IsIntegralValue (diagonalTailDifference t) ↔ ForeignDiagonalDefectHitsFullTarget t
declarations.docstring: The primary complement-free pincer. Integrality of the actual diagonal is exactly a hit by `foreignDiagonalDefect` alone on the full reduced target `-a_t / d_t` modulo `ℤ`.

declarations.name: diagonal_int_iff_exists_fullTarget_lattice
declarations.signature: theorem diagonal_int_iff_exists_fullTarget_lattice (t : ℕ) : IsIntegralValue (diagonalTailDifference t) ↔ ∃ k : ℤ, (lcmShadowDenominator t : ℝ) * foreignDiagonalDefect t = (-lcmShadowNumerator t : ℝ) + (lcmShadowDenominator t : ℝ) * (k : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: Expanded form of the complement-free pincer, exposing the lattice witness without an intermediate predicate.

declarations.name: diagonal_int_iff_renormalizedDefect_hits_freshTarget
declarations.signature: theorem diagonal_int_iff_renormalizedDefect_hits_freshTarget {t p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : IsIntegralValue (diagonalTailDifference t) ↔ RenormalizedDefectHitsFreshTarget t p
declarations.docstring: The load-bearing channel-hit equivalence requested by the master development. For every prime channel, integrality of the actual diagonal is exactly a hit of the rescaled foreign-plus-complement residual on the negative T4 target.

declarations.name: diagonal_not_int_iff_renormalizedDefect_misses_freshTarget
declarations.signature: theorem diagonal_not_int_iff_renormalizedDefect_misses_freshTarget {t p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : ¬IsIntegralValue (diagonalTailDifference t) ↔ ¬RenormalizedDefectHitsFreshTarget t p

declarations.name: foreignDiagonalDefect_misses_fullTarget_seven
declarations.docstring: The existing kernel-checked diagonal certificate at `t = 7` misses the new full reduced target. This confirms that the complement-free pincer is connected to the established finite certificate lane.

declarations.name: FullTargetAvoidanceSupply
declarations.docstring: The complement-free analytic supply: at arbitrarily large LCM heights, the foreign defect misses the complete reduced shadow target.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_full_target_avoidance_supply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_full_target_avoidance_supply (hsupply : FullTargetAvoidanceSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: Full-target avoidance at arbitrarily large LCM heights closes the existing diagonal non-integrality socket and hence conditionally proves #249.

declarations.name: UpperHalfChannelAvoidanceSupply
declarations.docstring: The development's selectable upper-half-channel avoidance supply.

declarations.name: FreshPrimeChannelAvoidanceSupply
declarations.docstring: The minimal new-prime-scale avoidance supply, using `t=p`.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_upper_half_channel_avoidance_supply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_upper_half_channel_avoidance_supply (hsupply : UpperHalfChannelAvoidanceSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: A selectable upper-half miss at arbitrarily large LCM heights closes the existing diagonal non-integrality socket and hence conditionally proves the totient series irrational. The hypothesis is the unresolved analytic supply.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_fresh_prime_channel_avoidance_supply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_fresh_prime_channel_avoidance_supply (hsupply : FreshPrimeChannelAvoidanceSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: The one-new-prime-scale version of the same conditional closure.

declarations.name: dyadicResidualIntNumerator
declarations.signature: def dyadicResidualIntNumerator (p r : ℤ) (c D : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: Integer residual numerator. This is the algebraically natural core: unlike the interface natural specialization below, it needs no ordering hypothesis on the subtraction.

declarations.name: dyadicResidualIntRat
declarations.signature: def dyadicResidualIntRat (p r : ℤ) (c D : ℕ) : ℚ
declarations.docstring: Integer displayed residual normalized by `Rat.divInt`.

declarations.name: dyadicResidualIntNumerator_coprime_oddDenominator
declarations.signature: theorem dyadicResidualIntNumerator_coprime_oddDenominator (p r : ℤ) (c D : ℕ) (hDodd : Odd D) (hrD : r.natAbs.Coprime D) : (dyadicResidualIntNumerator p r c D).natAbs.Coprime D
declarations.docstring: The decisive congruence argument in `ℤ`: adding the multiple `pD` to `-2^c r` preserves coprimality with the odd modulus `D`.

declarations.name: dyadicResidualInt_denominator_sandwich
declarations.signature: theorem dyadicResidualInt_denominator_sandwich (p r : ℤ) (c D : ℕ) (hDpos : 0 < D) (hND : (dyadicResidualIntNumerator p r c D).natAbs.Coprime D) : D ∣ (dyadicResidualIntRat p r c D).den ∧ (dyadicResidualIntRat p r c D).den ∣ 2 ^ c * D
declarations.docstring: Integer form of the exact denominator sandwich. It works for positive, zero, or negative displayed residual numerators once coprimality with `D` is known.

declarations.name: dyadicResidualNumerator
declarations.signature: def dyadicResidualNumerator (p r c D : ℕ) : ℕ
declarations.docstring: Numerator left after subtracting a reduced finite prefix `r / D` from a dyadic rational `p / 2^c`. The transport theorem below assumes the subtraction is nonnegative, so natural subtraction is exact.

declarations.name: dyadicResidualRat
declarations.signature: def dyadicResidualRat (p r c D : ℕ) : ℚ
declarations.docstring: The displayed residual rational before its remaining power-of-two cancellation is normalized by `Rat`.

declarations.name: dyadicResidualNumerator_coprime_oddDenominator
declarations.signature: theorem dyadicResidualNumerator_coprime_oddDenominator (p r c D : ℕ) (hDodd : Odd D) (hrD : r.Coprime D) (hle : 2 ^ c * r ≤ p * D) : (dyadicResidualNumerator p r c D).Coprime D
declarations.docstring: Subtracting a reduced odd-denominator fraction from a dyadic fraction cannot cancel any factor of the odd denominator.

declarations.name: dyadicResidual_denominator_sandwich
declarations.signature: theorem dyadicResidual_denominator_sandwich (p r c D : ℕ) (hDpos : 0 < D) (hDodd : Odd D) (hrD : r.Coprime D) (hle : 2 ^ c * r ≤ p * D) : D ∣ (dyadicResidualRat p r c D).den ∧ (dyadicResidualRat p r c D).den ∣ 2 ^ c * D
declarations.docstring: Exact denominator sandwich. If `Q` is the normalized denominator of the residual, then `D ∣ Q ∣ 2^c D`. This is the division-free statement that the odd part inherited from the finite prefix is exactly `D`.

declarations.name: nextDyadicExcessIntNumerator
declarations.signature: def nextDyadicExcessIntNumerator (p : ℤ) (n L : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: For a displayed residual `p / (2L)`, the integer numerator of its excess above the next dyadic point `2^-(n+1)`. Indeed, `p/(2L) - 2^-(n+1) = E/(2^(n+1)L)`. Keeping `E` integral makes the unresolved skipped-branch comparison an exact Diophantine inequality rather than a real-valued phase estimate.

declarations.name: nextDyadicExcessIntNumerator_succ
declarations.signature: theorem nextDyadicExcessIntNumerator_succ (p : ℤ) (n L : ℕ) : nextDyadicExcessIntNumerator p (n + 1) L = 2 * nextDyadicExcessIntNumerator p n L + (L : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: With displayed numerator and denominator fixed across one skipped rank, the next dyadic excess doubles and receives one denominator increment.

declarations.name: nextDyadicExcessIntNumerator_add
declarations.signature: theorem nextDyadicExcessIntNumerator_add (p : ℤ) (n k L : ℕ) : nextDyadicExcessIntNumerator p (n + k) L = (((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℤ) * nextDyadicExcessIntNumerator p n L) + ((((2 ^ k : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) * (L : ℤ))
declarations.docstring: Closed form of the unchanged-denominator skip-run recurrence.

declarations.name: divInt_sub_nextDyadic_eq_excess_divInt
declarations.signature: theorem divInt_sub_nextDyadic_eq_excess_divInt (p : ℤ) (n L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) : Rat.divInt p ((2 * L : ℕ) : ℤ) - (1 / (2 : ℚ) ^ (n + 1)) = Rat.divInt (nextDyadicExcessIntNumerator p n L) (((2 ^ (n + 1) * L : ℕ) : ℤ))
declarations.docstring: Exact rational identity represented by `nextDyadicExcessIntNumerator`.

declarations.name: divInt_le_nextDyadic_iff_excess_nonpos
declarations.signature: theorem divInt_le_nextDyadic_iff_excess_nonpos (p : ℤ) (n L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) : Rat.divInt p ((2 * L : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ) ^ (n + 1) ↔ nextDyadicExcessIntNumerator p n L ≤ 0
declarations.docstring: The displayed residual is on the dyadic-safe side exactly when its integer excess numerator is nonpositive.

declarations.name: mersenneWeightRat_succ_le_divInt_iff_excess
declarations.signature: theorem mersenneWeightRat_succ_le_divInt_iff_excess (p : ℤ) (n L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) : mersenneWeightRat (n + 1) ≤ Rat.divInt p ((2 * L : ℕ) : ℤ) ↔ p ≤ 2 * nextDyadicExcessIntNumerator p n L
declarations.docstring: At the prospective rank `n+1`, selection of the Mersenne weight is the complementary exact inequality `p ≤ 2E`. Together with the dyadic sign test, this identifies the entire forbidden sliver using one integer numerator.

declarations.name: divInt_lt_mersenneWeightRat_succ_iff_excess
declarations.signature: theorem divInt_lt_mersenneWeightRat_succ_iff_excess (p : ℤ) (n L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) : Rat.divInt p ((2 * L : ℕ) : ℤ) < mersenneWeightRat (n + 1) ↔ 2 * nextDyadicExcessIntNumerator p n L < p
declarations.docstring: A skipped prospective rank is exactly the strict complementary excess inequality `2E < p`.

declarations.name: divInt_mem_nextMersenneDyadicSliver_iff_excess
declarations.signature: theorem divInt_mem_nextMersenneDyadicSliver_iff_excess (p : ℤ) (n L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) : (1 / (2 : ℚ) ^ (n + 1) < Rat.divInt p ((2 * L : ℕ) : ℤ) ∧ Rat.divInt p ((2 * L : ℕ) : ℤ) < mersenneWeightRat (n + 1)) ↔ (0 < nextDyadicExcessIntNumerator p n L ∧ 2 * nextDyadicExcessIntNumerator p n L < p)
declarations.docstring: Exact forbidden-sliver classifier for a displayed residual. A skipped rank is dyadically unsafe precisely in the finite integer window `0 < E` and `2E < p`.

declarations.name: nextMersenneDecisionDefect
declarations.signature: def nextMersenneDecisionDefect (p : ℤ) (n L : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: The cross-multiplied defect at prospective rank `n+1`.

declarations.name: nextMersenneDecisionDefect_eq_two_excess_sub
declarations.signature: theorem nextMersenneDecisionDefect_eq_two_excess_sub (p : ℤ) (n L : ℕ) : nextMersenneDecisionDefect p n L = 2 * nextDyadicExcessIntNumerator p n L - p
declarations.docstring: The decision defect is exactly `2E-p`.

declarations.name: nextMersenneDecisionDefect_le_neg_iff_excess_nonpos
declarations.signature: theorem nextMersenneDecisionDefect_le_neg_iff_excess_nonpos (p : ℤ) (n L : ℕ) : nextMersenneDecisionDefect p n L ≤ -p ↔ nextDyadicExcessIntNumerator p n L ≤ 0
declarations.docstring: A skipped decision is dyadically safe exactly when its raw defect is at least one full displayed numerator below zero.

declarations.name: le_nextMersenneDecisionDefect_iff_le_excess
declarations.signature: theorem le_nextMersenneDecisionDefect_iff_le_excess (p : ℤ) (n L : ℕ) : p ≤ nextMersenneDecisionDefect p n L ↔ p ≤ nextDyadicExcessIntNumerator p n L
declarations.docstring: The strengthened taken branch `E ≥ p` is the symmetric unit-margin condition on the positive raw defect.

declarations.name: nextMersenneDecisionDefect_mem_neg_unit_window_iff
declarations.signature: theorem nextMersenneDecisionDefect_mem_neg_unit_window_iff (p : ℤ) (n L : ℕ) : (-p < nextMersenneDecisionDefect p n L ∧ nextMersenneDecisionDefect p n L < 0) ↔ (0 < nextDyadicExcessIntNumerator p n L ∧ 2 * nextDyadicExcessIntNumerator p n L < p)
declarations.docstring: The unresolved unsafe-skip window is the open unit neighbourhood below the Mersenne threshold, expressed without division.

declarations.name: BlockTakeAt
declarations.signature: def BlockTakeAt (p D k : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: The Mersenne term at rank `k` is taken by the displayed residual `p/(2D)`, in cross-multiplied natural coordinates.

declarations.name: BlockDyadicSafeAt
declarations.signature: def BlockDyadicSafeAt (p D k : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: The displayed residual lies below the dyadic skeleton `2^-k`.

declarations.name: IsFirstBlockTakeAfter
declarations.signature: def IsFirstBlockTakeAfter (p D a b : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: `b` is the first taken rank strictly after `a`.

declarations.name: all_intermediate_BlockDyadicSafeAt_iff_last
declarations.signature: theorem all_intermediate_BlockDyadicSafeAt_iff_last (p D a b : ℕ) (hab : a < b) : (∀ k : ℕ, a < k → k < b → BlockDyadicSafeAt p D k) ↔ b = a + 1 ∨ BlockDyadicSafeAt p D (b - 1)
declarations.docstring: Over a constant-residual skip block, dyadic safety is monotone in the rank. Hence every intermediate skip is safe iff either the block is empty or its last rank is safe.

declarations.name: firstBlockTake_predecessor_open_bound
declarations.signature: theorem firstBlockTake_predecessor_open_bound {p D a b : ℕ} (hfirst : IsFirstBlockTakeAfter p D a b) (hgap : a + 1 < b) : p * (2 ^ (b - 1) - 1) < 2 * D
declarations.docstring: Minimality of a non-adjacent next take supplies only the open Mersenne predecessor bound. The missing skip-sign theorem must strengthen this by exactly one unit, from `2^(b-1)-1` to `2^(b-1)`.

declarations.name: firstBlockTake_all_skips_safe_iff_last_margin
declarations.signature: theorem firstBlockTake_all_skips_safe_iff_last_margin {p D a b : ℕ} (hfirst : IsFirstBlockTakeAfter p D a b) : (∀ k : ℕ, a < k → k < b → BlockDyadicSafeAt p D k) ↔ b = a + 1 ∨ p * 2 ^ (b - 1) ≤ 2 * D
declarations.docstring: Exact block compression under the first-take hypothesis.

declarations.name: rawTakenResidualNumerator
declarations.signature: def rawTakenResidualNumerator (p D b : ℕ) : ℕ
declarations.docstring: Raw positive numerator produced by taking rank `b`.

declarations.name: rawTakenResidualDenominator
declarations.docstring: Raw odd-denominator coordinate produced by taking rank `b`.

declarations.name: blockTakeAt_commonFactor_iff
declarations.signature: theorem blockTakeAt_commonFactor_iff {H B g p D k : ℕ} (hg : 0 < g) (hH : H = g * p) (hB : B = g * D) : BlockTakeAt p D k ↔ BlockTakeAt H B k
declarations.docstring: A common positive reduction factor cancels out of the next take test.

declarations.name: blockDyadicSafeAt_commonFactor_iff
declarations.signature: theorem blockDyadicSafeAt_commonFactor_iff {H B g p D k : ℕ} (hg : 0 < g) (hH : H = g * p) (hB : B = g * D) : BlockDyadicSafeAt p D k ↔ BlockDyadicSafeAt H B k
declarations.docstring: The same common factor cancels out of the dyadic-safe margin.

declarations.name: firstBlockTakeAfter_commonFactor_iff
declarations.signature: theorem firstBlockTakeAfter_commonFactor_iff {H B g p D a b : ℕ} (hg : 0 < g) (hH : H = g * p) (hB : B = g * D) : IsFirstBlockTakeAfter p D a b ↔ IsFirstBlockTakeAfter H B a b
declarations.docstring: A common reduction factor therefore also cancels out of the identity of the next taken rank.

declarations.name: reduced_nextBlock_all_skips_safe_iff_gcdFree
declarations.signature: theorem reduced_nextBlock_all_skips_safe_iff_gcdFree {b H B g p' D' c : ℕ} (hg : 0 < g) (hHred : H = g * p') (hBred : B = g * D') (hfirst : IsFirstBlockTakeAfter p' D' b c) : (∀ k : ℕ, b < k → k < c → BlockDyadicSafeAt p' D' k) ↔ c = b + 1 ∨ H * 2 ^ (c - 1) ≤ 2 * B
declarations.docstring: **GCD-free taken-block reduction.** Suppose taking rank `b` creates raw coordinates `(H,B)`, and reducing them by any positive common factor gives the next displayed state `(p',D')`. If `c` is its next taken rank, all intervening skips are dyadically safe iff either there are no intervening skips or the single raw inequality `H*2^(c-1) ≤ 2B` holds. No gcd or cancellation factor remains in the proof obligation.

declarations.name: reduced_nextBlock_gcdFree_margin_expanded
declarations.signature: theorem reduced_nextBlock_gcdFree_margin_expanded {p D b H B c : ℕ} (hHraw : H = rawTakenResidualNumerator p D b) (hBraw : B = rawTakenResidualDenominator D b) : (H * 2 ^ (c - 1) ≤ 2 * B) ↔ (p * (2 ^ b - 1) - 2 * D) * 2 ^ (c - 1) ≤ 2 * (D * (2 ^ b - 1))
declarations.docstring: Expanded form of the raw gcd-free margin after taking rank `b`.

declarations.name: takenBlock_all_next_skips_safe_iff_raw_margin
declarations.signature: theorem takenBlock_all_next_skips_safe_iff_raw_margin {p D b g p' D' c : ℕ} (hg : 0 < g) (hnum : rawTakenResidualNumerator p D b = g * p') (hden : rawTakenResidualDenominator D b = g * D') (hfirst : IsFirstBlockTakeAfter p' D' b c) : (∀ k : ℕ, b < k → k < c → BlockDyadicSafeAt p' D' k) ↔ c = b + 1 ∨ (p * (2 ^ b - 1) - 2 * D) * 2 ^ (c - 1) ≤ 2 * (D * (2 ^ b - 1))
declarations.docstring: Direct source-state form: the reduced next residual may have arbitrary positive cancellation, but the complete intervening-skip obligation is the single raw inequality displayed on the right.

declarations.name: rawTakenResidual_adjacent_margin_of_predecessor_safe
declarations.signature: theorem rawTakenResidual_adjacent_margin_of_predecessor_safe {p D b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hsafe : BlockDyadicSafeAt p D (b - 1)) (htake : BlockTakeAt p D b) : rawTakenResidualNumerator p D b * 2 ^ b ≤ 2 * rawTakenResidualDenominator D b
declarations.docstring: The block margin is automatically inductive across an adjacent pair of takes. If the state before taking `b` was safe at its predecessor dyadic scale, the raw state after the take is safe at scale `b`. Thus only nonadjacent successor blocks require new orbit arithmetic.

declarations.name: firstBlockTake_margin_iff_reciprocalFloor_ne_mersenne
declarations.signature: theorem firstBlockTake_margin_iff_reciprocalFloor_ne_mersenne {p D a b : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (hfirst : IsFirstBlockTakeAfter p D a b) (hgap : a + 1 < b) : BlockDyadicSafeAt p D (b - 1) ↔ (2 * D) / p ≠ 2 ^ (b - 1) - 1
declarations.docstring: At a nonadjacent first-take block, the missing dyadic margin is exactly avoidance of the lower Mersenne value by the integer part of the reciprocal residual.

declarations.name: takenBlock_rawMargin_iff_reciprocalFloor_ne_mersenne
declarations.signature: theorem takenBlock_rawMargin_iff_reciprocalFloor_ne_mersenne {p D b c : ℕ} (hpos : 0 < rawTakenResidualNumerator p D b) (hfirst : IsFirstBlockTakeAfter (rawTakenResidualNumerator p D b) (rawTakenResidualDenominator D b) b c) (hgap : b + 1 < c) : ((p * (2 ^ b - 1) - 2 * D) * 2 ^ (c - 1) ≤ 2 * (D * (2 ^ b - 1))) ↔ (2 * rawTakenResidualDenominator D b) / rawTakenResidualNumerator p D b ≠ 2 ^ (c - 1) - 1
declarations.docstring: Source-coordinate specialization of the same exact quotient obstruction. All cancellation is absent: only the raw post-take numerator and denominator enter the quotient.

declarations.name: takenBlock_rawMargin_iff_reducedReciprocalFloor_ne_mersenne
declarations.signature: theorem takenBlock_rawMargin_iff_reducedReciprocalFloor_ne_mersenne {p D b g p' D' c : ℕ} (hg : 0 < g) (hp' : 0 < p') (hnum : rawTakenResidualNumerator p D b = g * p') (hden : rawTakenResidualDenominator D b = g * D') (hfirst : IsFirstBlockTakeAfter p' D' b c) (hgap : b + 1 < c) : ((p * (2 ^ b - 1) - 2 * D) * 2 ^ (c - 1) ≤ 2 * (D * (2 ^ b - 1))) ↔ (2 * D') / p' ≠ 2 ^ (c - 1) - 1
declarations.docstring: Cancellation-aware form matching an actual taken block. The raw source margin is equivalent to Mersenne-floor avoidance in the reduced post-take state; the common reduction factor disappears from both sides.

declarations.name: safeBracket_and_numeratorMonotone_not_inductive_fixture
declarations.signature: theorem safeBracket_and_numeratorMonotone_not_inductive_fixture : BlockDyadicSafeAt 7 17 2 ∧ BlockTakeAt 7 17 3 ∧ rawTakenResidualNumerator 7 17 3 = 15 ∧ rawTakenResidualDenominator 17 3 = 119 ∧ 7 ≤ 15 ∧ ¬ BlockTakeAt 15 119 4 ∧ ¬ BlockDyadicSafeAt 15 119 4 ∧ nextDyadicExcessIntNumerator 15 3 119 = 1 ∧ BlockTakeAt 15 119 5
declarations.docstring: Safe bracketing plus nondecrease of the displayed numerator is not an inductive invariant. The state `7/(2*17)` takes rank `3`, producing `15/(2*119)`, but rank `4` is an unsafe skip with exact excess `1`.

declarations.name: mersenneLcm_through_seven_eq
declarations.docstring: The denominator in the second fixture is already saturated by every Mersenne denominator through rank `7`.

declarations.name: lcmSaturated_safeBracket_not_inductive_fixture
declarations.signature: theorem lcmSaturated_safeBracket_not_inductive_fixture : BlockDyadicSafeAt 12149 1240155 7 ∧ BlockTakeAt 12149 1240155 8 ∧ rawTakenResidualNumerator 12149 1240155 8 = 15 * 41179 ∧ rawTakenResidualDenominator 1240155 8 = 15 * 21082635 ∧ 12149 ≤ 41179 ∧ ¬ BlockTakeAt 41179 21082635 9 ∧ ¬ BlockTakeAt 41179 21082635 10 ∧ ¬ BlockDyadicSafeAt 41179 21082635 10 ∧ nextDyadicExcessIntNumerator 41179 9 21082635 = 1013 ∧ BlockTakeAt 41179 21082635 11
declarations.docstring: Even full initial-LCM denominator saturation, safe current bracketing, positive cancellation, and numerator increase do not make the block margin inductive. After the rank-`8` take, rank `10` is skipped but has exact positive excess `1013`.

declarations.name: divInt_le_nextTwoChannelCap_iff_excess
declarations.signature: theorem divInt_le_nextTwoChannelCap_iff_excess (p : ℤ) (n L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) : Rat.divInt p ((2 * L : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (1 / (2 : ℚ)) ^ (n + 1) + (1 / 3 : ℚ) * (1 / 4 : ℚ) ^ (n + 1) ↔ 3 * (((2 ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) * nextDyadicExcessIntNumerator p n L) ≤ (L : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: The two-channel cap at the next exponent is exactly one integer inequality. This is the division-free form `3 * 2^(n+1) * E ≤ L` for the displayed residual `p/(2L)`.

declarations.name: halfGreedyPrefixRat
declarations.docstring: The exact finite greedy prefix used to display the half residual.

declarations.name: halfGreedyPrefixDenominator
declarations.docstring: The inherited odd denominator of the exact finite greedy prefix.

declarations.name: halfGreedyResidualDisplayedNumerator
declarations.docstring: Displayed numerator `p_n` in `r_n = p_n / (2 * halfGreedyPrefixDenominator n)`.

declarations.name: halfGreedyNextDyadicExcessNumerator
declarations.docstring: The actual greedy half-orbit specialization of the integral excess numerator. At level `n`, it measures excess above `2^-(n+1)`.

declarations.name: greedyHalfRemainderRat_eq_displayed_divInt
declarations.signature: theorem greedyHalfRemainderRat_eq_displayed_divInt (n : ℕ) : greedyMersenneRemainderRat (1 / 2 : ℚ) n = Rat.divInt (halfGreedyResidualDisplayedNumerator n) ((2 * halfGreedyPrefixDenominator n : ℕ) : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: The rational greedy half residual has the exact displayed numerator and odd prefix denominator above.

declarations.name: greedyMersenneSecondChannelPhaseRat_eq_scaled_excess
declarations.signature: theorem greedyMersenneSecondChannelPhaseRat_eq_scaled_excess (n : ℕ) : greedyMersenneSecondChannelPhaseRat n = Rat.divInt (((2 ^ n : ℕ) : ℤ) * halfGreedyNextDyadicExcessNumerator n) (halfGreedyPrefixDenominator n : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: The rational second-channel phase is exactly the dyadically scaled integral excess divided by the inherited odd prefix denominator: `φ_n = 2^n E_n / D_n`. This is the missing coordinate bridge between the one-dimensional phase dynamics and the reduced prefix lattice.

declarations.name: secondChannelPhaseRat_outside_unit_iff_scaled_excess
declarations.signature: theorem secondChannelPhaseRat_outside_unit_iff_scaled_excess (n : ℕ) : (greedyMersenneSecondChannelPhaseRat n ≤ 0 ∨ 1 ≤ greedyMersenneSecondChannelPhaseRat n) ↔ (halfGreedyNextDyadicExcessNumerator n ≤ 0 ∨ (halfGreedyPrefixDenominator n : ℤ) ≤ ((2 ^ n : ℕ) : ℤ) * halfGreedyNextDyadicExcessNumerator n)
declarations.docstring: Consequently, avoiding the open unit interval is a division-free integer dichotomy. On the positive branch it asks exactly for `D_n ≤ 2^n E_n`; the nonpositive branch is simply `E_n ≤ 0`.

declarations.name: HalfGreedyScaledExcessOutsideUnit
declarations.docstring: Division-free producer socket for the second-channel route. It asks the actual reduced half-greedy prefix to avoid the single integer window `0 < 2^n E_n < D_n` from rank seven onward.

declarations.name: halfGreedy_scaledExcessOutsideUnit_of_le_twenty
declarations.signature: theorem halfGreedy_scaledExcessOutsideUnit_of_le_twenty (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ 20) : halfGreedyNextDyadicExcessNumerator n ≤ 0 ∨ (halfGreedyPrefixDenominator n : ℤ) ≤ ((2 ^ n : ℕ) : ℤ) * halfGreedyNextDyadicExcessNumerator n
declarations.docstring: The outside-unit dichotomy is unconditional through rank twenty. This includes the first transition at which the displayed residual numerator is not one, so the remaining producer is not concealing a unit-numerator base case.

declarations.name: HalfGreedyScaledExcessOutsideUnitFromTwentyOne
declarations.docstring: The genuinely infinite arithmetic producer after discharging every rank through the first non-unit transition.

declarations.name: half_mem_mersenneAchievementSet_of_scaledExcessOutsideUnit
declarations.docstring: End-to-end integer consumer for the rational-half counterexample route. The finite ranks are discharged by the existing exact certificate; a proof that the actual reduced excess never enters `0 < 2^n E_n < D_n` would place `1/2` in the Mersenne achievement set.

declarations.name: half_mem_mersenneAchievementSet_of_scaledExcessOutsideUnitFromTwentyOne
declarations.docstring: End-to-end form with the complete finite prefix removed from the hypothesis. Only ranks `n ≥ 21` remain.

declarations.name: greedyHalfRemainder_le_twoChannelCap_iff_excess
declarations.signature: theorem greedyHalfRemainder_le_twoChannelCap_iff_excess (n : ℕ) : greedyMersenneRemainder (1 / 2 : ℝ) n ≤ halfTwoChannelCap (n + 1) ↔ 3 * (((2 ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) * halfGreedyNextDyadicExcessNumerator n) ≤ (halfGreedyPrefixDenominator n : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: The exact actual-orbit cap socket: the real two-channel cap is equivalent to a single integer inequality in the greedy prefix numerator and its odd denominator.

declarations.name: greedyHalfRemainder_le_nextDyadic_iff_excess_nonpos
declarations.signature: theorem greedyHalfRemainder_le_nextDyadic_iff_excess_nonpos (n : ℕ) : greedyMersenneRemainder (1 / 2 : ℝ) n ≤ halfDyadicCap (n + 1) ↔ halfGreedyNextDyadicExcessNumerator n ≤ 0
declarations.docstring: The stronger dyadic-safe predicate is simply the sign of the same exact integer numerator.

declarations.name: nextDyadic_lt_greedyHalfRemainder_iff_excess_pos
declarations.signature: theorem nextDyadic_lt_greedyHalfRemainder_iff_excess_pos (n : ℕ) : halfDyadicCap (n + 1) < greedyMersenneRemainder (1 / 2 : ℝ) n ↔ 0 < halfGreedyNextDyadicExcessNumerator n
declarations.docstring: A genuine landing in the next Mersenne--dyadic sliver is detected by a positive integer numerator. The skipped-branch hypothesis supplies the independent strict upper bound by the next Mersenne weight.

declarations.name: greedyHalfRemainder_lt_mersenneWeight_iff_excess
declarations.signature: theorem greedyHalfRemainder_lt_mersenneWeight_iff_excess (n : ℕ) : greedyMersenneRemainder (1 / 2 : ℝ) n < mersenneWeight (n + 1) ↔ 2 * halfGreedyNextDyadicExcessNumerator n < halfGreedyResidualDisplayedNumerator n
declarations.docstring: The actual half orbit skips rank `n+1` exactly when its displayed excess satisfies `2E_n < p_n`.

declarations.name: greedyHalf_mem_nextMersenneDyadicSliver_iff_excess
declarations.signature: theorem greedyHalf_mem_nextMersenneDyadicSliver_iff_excess (n : ℕ) : (halfDyadicCap (n + 1) < greedyMersenneRemainder (1 / 2 : ℝ) n ∧ greedyMersenneRemainder (1 / 2 : ℝ) n < mersenneWeight (n + 1)) ↔ (0 < halfGreedyNextDyadicExcessNumerator n ∧ 2 * halfGreedyNextDyadicExcessNumerator n < halfGreedyResidualDisplayedNumerator n)
declarations.docstring: The actual forbidden Mersenne--dyadic sliver is the finite integer window `0 < E_n` and `2E_n < p_n`. This is the exact last-skip comparison that any run-compressed producer must exclude.

declarations.name: twoChannelCap_lt_greedyHalfRemainder_iff_excess
declarations.signature: theorem twoChannelCap_lt_greedyHalfRemainder_iff_excess (n : ℕ) : halfTwoChannelCap (n + 1) < greedyMersenneRemainder (1 / 2 : ℝ) n ↔ (halfGreedyPrefixDenominator n : ℤ) < 3 * (((2 ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) * halfGreedyNextDyadicExcessNumerator n)
declarations.docstring: Exact hard falsifier for the two-channel producer: a cap violation is the reverse strict integer inequality, with no numerical approximation.

declarations.name: HalfGreedySkippedExcessBound
declarations.docstring: Division-free producer for the only branch on which the greedy two-channel cap has arithmetic content.

declarations.name: half_mem_mersenneAchievementSet_of_skipped_excessBound
declarations.docstring: The integer skipped-rank producer plugs directly into the landed greedy membership consumer.

declarations.name: mersennePrefix_doubleDepth_lt_halfDyadicCap
declarations.signature: theorem mersennePrefix_doubleDepth_lt_halfDyadicCap {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) : (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), mersenneWeight (m + k + 1)) < halfDyadicCap m
declarations.docstring: The Mersenne mass through twice the current depth is already smaller than the current dyadic cap. This converts a dyadically unsafe skipped remainder into a long forced block of subsequent greedy selections.

declarations.name: greedyMersenne_forcedBlock_selected
declarations.signature: theorem greedyMersenne_forcedBlock_selected {x : ℝ} {m J : ℕ} (hblock : (∑ k ∈ Finset.range J, mersenneWeight (m + k + 1)) < greedyMersenneRemainder x m) : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range J, mersenneWeight (m + j + 1) ≤ greedyMersenneRemainder x (m + j)
declarations.docstring: If a finite block weighs less than the current remainder, greedy must select every term in that block.

declarations.name: forcedBlock_tailExcess_eq
declarations.signature: theorem forcedBlock_tailExcess_eq (m J : ℕ) (r : ℝ) : (r - (∑ k ∈ Finset.range J, mersenneWeight (m + k + 1))) - mersenneTail (m + J) = r - mersenneTail m
declarations.docstring: Consecutive selections preserve signed distance from the exact tail separatrix. This explains why a forced take block alone cannot produce a contradiction: both the remainder and the true tail lose the same prefix.

declarations.name: mersenneWeightRemainder_le_four_thirds
declarations.signature: theorem mersenneWeightRemainder_le_four_thirds {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) : mersenneWeightRemainder n ≤ (4 / 3 : ℝ) * ((1 : ℝ) / 8) ^ n
declarations.docstring: Starting at exponent at least two improves the crude factor-two envelope on each higher-channel term to `4/3`.

declarations.name: mersenneWeightRemainderTail_le_four_twentyone
declarations.signature: theorem mersenneWeightRemainderTail_le_four_twentyone {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) : mersenneWeightRemainderTail m ≤ (4 / 21 : ℝ) * ((1 : ℝ) / 8) ^ m
declarations.docstring: At positive starting depth, the accumulated channels of order at least three are bounded by `(4/21)·8⁻ᵐ`.

declarations.name: remainderTail_lt_tripleDyadic
declarations.signature: theorem remainderTail_lt_tripleDyadic {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) : mersenneWeightRemainderTail m < ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ (3 * m + 2)
declarations.docstring: The higher-channel tail at depth `m` is strictly smaller than the dyadic tail at depth `3m+2`.

declarations.name: mersennePrefix_threeDepth_add_two_lt_halfTwoChannelCap
declarations.signature: theorem mersennePrefix_threeDepth_add_two_lt_halfTwoChannelCap {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) : (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * m + 2), mersenneWeight (m + k + 1)) < halfTwoChannelCap m
declarations.docstring: The complete consecutive block through exponent `3m+2` is still strictly lighter than the two-channel cap at depth `m`.

declarations.name: capViolation_forces_threeDepthBlock
declarations.signature: theorem capViolation_forces_threeDepthBlock {x : ℝ} {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hcap : halfTwoChannelCap m < greedyMersenneRemainder x m) : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * m + 2), mersenneWeight (m + j + 1) ≤ greedyMersenneRemainder x (m + j)
declarations.docstring: A two-channel-cap violation forces the consecutive greedy take block through exponent `3m+2`.

declarations.name: tripleDepthTail_lt_thirdChannel
declarations.signature: theorem tripleDepthTail_lt_thirdChannel {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) : mersenneTail (3 * m + 3) < (1 / 7 : ℝ) * ((1 : ℝ) / 8) ^ m
declarations.docstring: At the first depth beyond the forced block, the full remaining tail is already smaller than the third-channel contribution at the starting depth.

declarations.name: halfTwoChannelCap_lt_mersennePrefix_threeDepth_add_three
declarations.signature: theorem halfTwoChannelCap_lt_mersennePrefix_threeDepth_add_three {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) : halfTwoChannelCap m < (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * m + 3), mersenneWeight (m + k + 1))
declarations.docstring: The two-channel cap lies strictly before the next (`2m+3`)-term prefix. Together with the preceding lower bracket, this pins its exact prefix cell.

declarations.name: exists_relaxed_capViolation_exact_block
declarations.signature: theorem exists_relaxed_capViolation_exact_block {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) : ∃ r : ℝ, halfTwoChannelCap m < r ∧ r < mersenneWeight m ∧ (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * m + 2), mersenneWeight (m + k + 1)) < r ∧ r - (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * m + 2), mersenneWeight (m + k + 1)) < mersenneWeight (3 * m + 3)
declarations.docstring: Hard local falsifier: there is an open relaxed-state cell above the two-channel cap which takes every exponent through `3m+2` and then skips `3m+3`. Hence skip-plus-forced-run geometry alone cannot close the producer; some arithmetic property of the actual greedy prefix is indispensable.

declarations.name: greedyHalf_unsafeSkip_forces_doubleBlock
declarations.signature: theorem greedyHalf_unsafeSkip_forces_doubleBlock (n : ℕ) (hskip : ¬ mersenneWeight (n + 1) ≤ greedyMersenneRemainder (1 / 2 : ℝ) n) (hunsafe : halfDyadicCap (n + 1) < greedyMersenneRemainder (1 / 2 : ℝ) n) : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 2), mersenneWeight (n + j + 2) ≤ greedyMersenneRemainder (1 / 2 : ℝ) (n + j + 1)
declarations.docstring: A skipped half-orbit rank above its dyadic cap forces selection of every one of the next `n + 2` exponents.

declarations.name: greedyHalf_capViolationSkip_forces_threeDepthBlock
declarations.signature: theorem greedyHalf_capViolationSkip_forces_threeDepthBlock (n : ℕ) (hskip : ¬ mersenneWeight (n + 1) ≤ greedyMersenneRemainder (1 / 2 : ℝ) n) (hcap : halfTwoChannelCap (n + 1) < greedyMersenneRemainder (1 / 2 : ℝ) n) : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * n + 4), mersenneWeight (n + j + 2) ≤ greedyMersenneRemainder (1 / 2 : ℝ) (n + j + 1)
declarations.docstring: On the actual half orbit, a skipped rank which violates the two-channel cap forces the maximal uniform block supplied by tail geometry: all following exponents through `3(n+1)+2`.

declarations.name: HalfGreedyThreeDepthTakeRunExcessBound
declarations.docstring: Strongest run-compressed arithmetic producer supplied by the uniform tail geometry. The exact excess inequality is required only when a skipped rank is followed by the entire forced take block through exponent `3n+5`.

declarations.name: halfGreedySkippedExcessBound_of_threeDepthTakeRun
declarations.docstring: The triple-depth run producer is sufficient for the original skipped-rank excess bound. If the displayed run fails, the cap violation itself is impossible by `greedyHalf_capViolationSkip_forces_threeDepthBlock`.

declarations.name: half_mem_mersenneAchievementSet_of_threeDepthTakeRunExcessBound
declarations.docstring: The strongest run-compressed producer feeds the half-membership consumer.

declarations.name: HalfGreedyLongTakeRunExcessBound
declarations.docstring: Earlier, weaker run-compressed producer retained for compatibility. It uses only the dyadic unsafe-skip block through twice the current depth; the triple-depth producer above has a strictly narrower exceptional branch.

declarations.name: half_mem_mersenneAchievementSet_of_longTakeRunExcessBound
declarations.docstring: The long-take-run producer feeds the existing exact half-membership consumer.

declarations.name: finiteErdosSum_den_odd
declarations.signature: theorem finiteErdosSum_den_odd (F : Finset ℕ) (h0 : 0 ∉ F) : Odd (finiteErdosSum F 2).den
declarations.docstring: At base two, the actual reduced denominator of every positive finite Erdős fragment is odd.

declarations.name: halfGreedyPrefixDenominator_odd
declarations.docstring: The denominator used by the skipped-rank numerator is genuinely odd, because the finite greedy prefix contains no exponent zero.

declarations.name: oddDoublingOrder_finiteErdosSum_den_eq_lcm
declarations.signature: theorem oddDoublingOrder_finiteErdosSum_den_eq_lcm (F : Finset ℕ) (hF : F.Nonempty) (h0 : 0 ∉ F) : oddDoublingOrder (finiteErdosSum F 2).den (finiteErdosSum_den_odd F h0) = F.lcm id
declarations.docstring: The existing finite noncollapse theorem rewritten in the T9 order API: the order of two modulo the actual reduced denominator is `lcm F`.

declarations.name: erdosSupportSeries_finset_eq_cast_finiteErdosSum
declarations.signature: theorem erdosSupportSeries_finset_eq_cast_finiteErdosSum (F : Finset ℕ) : erdosSupportSeries 2 (↑F : Set ℕ) = ((finiteErdosSum F 2 : ℚ) : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: A finite support series is the real cast of the audited rational `finiteErdosSum`.

declarations.name: erdosSupportSeries_diff_finset
declarations.signature: theorem erdosSupportSeries_diff_finset (A : Set ℕ) (F : Finset ℕ) (hFA : (↑F : Set ℕ) ⊆ A) : erdosSupportSeries 2 (A \ (↑F : Set ℕ)) = erdosSupportSeries 2 A - ((finiteErdosSum F 2 : ℚ) : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: Removing a finite fragment from a support subtracts exactly its audited finite rational sum. No ordering or prefix hypothesis is used.

declarations.name: finiteFragment_residual_value
declarations.signature: theorem finiteFragment_residual_value (A : Set ℕ) (F : Finset ℕ) (p r c D : ℕ) (hFA : (↑F : Set ℕ) ⊆ A) (hwhole : erdosSupportSeries 2 A = (p : ℝ) / ((2 ^ c : ℕ) : ℝ)) (hprefix : finiteErdosSum F 2 = (r : ℚ) / (D : ℚ)) (hDpos : 0 < D) (hle : 2 ^ c * r ≤ p * D) : erdosSupportSeries 2 (A \ (↑F : Set ℕ)) = (dyadicResidualNumerator p r c D : ℝ) / ((2 ^ c * D : ℕ) : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: Algebraic composition of the support-difference bridge with displayed dyadic and reduced-prefix fractions.

declarations.name: DyadicPrefixCompressionCertificate
declarations.signature: structure DyadicPrefixCompressionCertificate (A : Set ℕ) (F : Finset ℕ) (p r c D : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: The proof-bearing T12 product. It records the no-odd-cancellation transport, exact residual value, exact finite period, and the T9 analytic conclusion in one reusable certificate.

declarations.name: finiteFragment_dyadicPrefixCompression
declarations.signature: theorem finiteFragment_dyadicPrefixCompression (A : Set ℕ) (F : Finset ℕ) (p r c D : ℕ) (hF : F.Nonempty) (h0 : 0 ∉ F) (hFA : (↑F : Set ℕ) ⊆ A) (hwhole : erdosSupportSeries 2 A = (p : ℝ) / ((2 ^ c : ℕ) : ℝ)) (hprefix : finiteErdosSum F 2 = (r : ℚ) / (D : ℚ)) (hDactual : D = (finiteErdosSum F 2).den) (hrD : r.Coprime D) (hDgtOne : 1 < D) (hle : 2 ^ c * r ≤ p * D) (hNpos : 0 < dyadicResidualNumerator p r c D) (hResidual : ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ a ∈ A \ (↑F : Set ℕ)) : DyadicPrefixCompressionCertificate A F p r c D
declarations.docstring: Generic finite-fragment T12 transport. The prefix certificate names the actual reduced denominator and numerator; the existing noncollapse theorem supplies the exact order, while T9 supplies the analytic disjunction.

declarations.name: two_three_dyadicPrefix_fixture
declarations.signature: theorem two_three_dyadicPrefix_fixture : finiteErdosSum ({2, 3} : Finset ℕ) 2 = (10 : ℚ) / 21 ∧ (finiteErdosSum ({2, 3} : Finset ℕ) 2).den = 21 ∧ oddDoublingOrder 21 (by decide : Odd 21) = 6 ∧ doublingWrapCount 1 21 6 = 2 ∧ dyadicResidualRat 1 10 1 21 = (1 : ℚ) / 42
declarations.docstring: Exact arithmetic, reduced odd denominator, order and wrap count for the `{2,3}` finite fragment.

declarations.name: five_term_dyadicPrefix_fixture
declarations.signature: theorem five_term_dyadicPrefix_fixture : finiteErdosSum ({2, 3, 6, 7, 14} : Finset ℕ) 2 = (172021 : ℚ) / 344043 ∧ (finiteErdosSum ({2, 3, 6, 7, 14} : Finset ℕ) 2).den = 344043 ∧ oddDoublingOrder 344043 (by decide : Odd 344043) = 42 ∧ doublingWrapCount 1 344043 42 = 13 ∧ dyadicResidualRat 1 172021 1 344043 = (1 : ℚ) / 688086
declarations.docstring: Exact arithmetic, reduced odd denominator, order and wrap count for the five-term finite fragment.

declarations.name: two_three_residual_reciprocalMassDivergesOrAtLeast
declarations.signature: theorem two_three_residual_reciprocalMassDivergesOrAtLeast (A : Set ℕ) (hFA : (↑({2, 3} : Finset ℕ) : Set ℕ) ⊆ A) (hwhole : erdosSupportSeries 2 A = (1 : ℝ) / 2) (hResidual : ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ a ∈ A \ (↑({2, 3} : Finset ℕ) : Set ℕ)) : ReciprocalMassDivergesOrAtLeast (A \ (↑({2, 3} : Finset ℕ) : Set ℕ)) (1 / 3 : ℝ)

declarations.name: halfGreedyExcess_add_denominator

declarations.name: halfGreedyNextDyadicExcessNumerator_odd

declarations.name: greedyHalfRemainderRat_eq_rawCommon_divInt

declarations.name: halfGreedyRawResidualNumerator_eq_gcd_mul_displayed
declarations.signature: theorem halfGreedyRawResidualNumerator_eq_gcd_mul_displayed (n : ℕ) : halfGreedyRawResidualNumerator n = (Nat.gcd (halfGreedyPrefixCommonNumerator n) (halfGreedyPrefixCommonDenominator n) : ℤ) * halfGreedyResidualDisplayedNumerator n

declarations.name: halfGreedyRawNextDyadicExcessNumerator_eq_gcd_mul_reduced
declarations.signature: theorem halfGreedyRawNextDyadicExcessNumerator_eq_gcd_mul_reduced (n : ℕ) : halfGreedyRawNextDyadicExcessNumerator n = (Nat.gcd (halfGreedyPrefixCommonNumerator n) (halfGreedyPrefixCommonDenominator n) : ℤ) * halfGreedyNextDyadicExcessNumerator n

declarations.name: halfGreedyRawExcessBound_iff_reduced

declarations.name: greedyHalfRemainderRat_le_twoChannelCap_iff_rawExcess
declarations.signature: theorem greedyHalfRemainderRat_le_twoChannelCap_iff_rawExcess (n : ℕ) : greedyMersenneRemainderRat (1 / 2 : ℚ) n ≤ (1 / (2 : ℚ)) ^ (n + 1) + (1 / 3 : ℚ) * (1 / 4 : ℚ) ^ (n + 1) ↔ 3 * (((2 ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) * halfGreedyRawNextDyadicExcessNumerator n) ≤ (halfGreedyPrefixCommonDenominator n : ℤ)

declarations.name: halfGreedyThreeDepthTakeRunExcessBound_iff_skippedExcessBound
declarations.docstring: The triple-depth take-run socket is not merely sufficient: after the forced-block theorem, it is exactly equivalent to the original skipped-rank excess producer. This records the endpoint of what uniform run geometry can remove from the arithmetic obligation.

declarations.name: greedyHalf_badSkipCapViolation_iff_primitiveLattice
declarations.signature: theorem greedyHalf_badSkipCapViolation_iff_primitiveLattice (n : ℕ) : (halfDyadicCap (n + 1) < greedyMersenneRemainder (1 / 2 : ℝ) n ∧ greedyMersenneRemainder (1 / 2 : ℝ) n < mersenneWeight (n + 1) ∧ halfTwoChannelCap (n + 1) < greedyMersenneRemainder (1 / 2 : ℝ) n) ↔ (0 < halfGreedyNextDyadicExcessNumerator n ∧ 2 * halfGreedyNextDyadicExcessNumerator n < halfGreedyResidualDisplayedNumerator n ∧ (halfGreedyPrefixDenominator n : ℤ) < 3 * (((2 ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) * halfGreedyNextDyadicExcessNumerator n))
declarations.docstring: A skipped, dyadically unsafe, two-channel-cap-violating half-prefix is exactly a point of the primitive integer lattice cut out by the three strict inequalities below. The raw support coordinates introduced above retain the additional common-numerator information that reduction erases.

declarations.name: halfGreedyPrefixSupportTailGap
declarations.docstring: Signed distance by which the actual finite-prefix coefficient tail lies below the preceding integer carry. The `-1` exactly removes the first dyadic channel at the next rank.

declarations.name: greedyHalf_badSkipCapViolation_iff_supportCoeffTailGap

declarations.name: greedyHalf_take_iff_BlockTakeAt
declarations.signature: theorem greedyHalf_take_iff_BlockTakeAt (n : ℕ) : mersenneWeight (n + 1) ≤ greedyMersenneRemainder (1 / 2 : ℝ) n ↔ BlockTakeAt (halfGreedyResidualDisplayedNumerator n).natAbs (halfGreedyPrefixDenominator n) (n + 1)
declarations.docstring: The generic natural `BlockTakeAt` test is exactly the actual real greedy decision in the current displayed half-orbit coordinates.

declarations.name: halfGreedy_take_raw_reduces_to_next
declarations.signature: theorem halfGreedy_take_raw_reduces_to_next (n : ℕ) (htake : mersenneWeight (n + 1) ≤ greedyMersenneRemainder (1 / 2 : ℝ) n) : ∃ g : ℕ, 0 < g ∧ rawTakenResidualNumerator (halfGreedyResidualDisplayedNumerator n).natAbs (halfGreedyPrefixDenominator n) (n + 1) = g * (halfGreedyResidualDisplayedNumerator (n + 1)).natAbs ∧ rawTakenResidualDenominator (halfGreedyPrefixDenominator n) (n + 1) = g * halfGreedyPrefixDenominator (n + 1)
declarations.docstring: An actual taken rank really produces the next displayed state by reducing the generic raw `(H,B)` coordinates by one positive common factor.

declarations.name: halfGreedy_coordinates_add_of_all_skips
declarations.signature: theorem halfGreedy_coordinates_add_of_all_skips (b j : ℕ) (hskip : ∀ t : ℕ, t < j → ¬ mersenneWeight (b + t + 1) ≤ greedyMersenneRemainder (1 / 2 : ℝ) (b + t)) : halfGreedyResidualDisplayedNumerator (b + j) = halfGreedyResidualDisplayedNumerator b ∧ halfGreedyPrefixDenominator (b + j) = halfGreedyPrefixDenominator b

declarations.name: HalfGreedySkippedActualRawMarginWitness
declarations.docstring: The arithmetically meaningful remaining producer: every actual skipped rank is bracketed by consecutive actual takes whose source-coordinate raw margin holds.

declarations.name: HalfGreedySkippedRawBlockWitness
declarations.docstring: Exact actual-state witness needed to consume one raw taken-block margin at a skipped rank. The source coordinates are the state immediately before the earlier take; the target coordinates are the live state at the skipped rank.

declarations.name: halfGreedy_rawBlockWitness_of_actualRawMarginWitness
declarations.signature: theorem halfGreedy_rawBlockWitness_of_actualRawMarginWitness {n : ℕ} (h : HalfGreedySkippedActualRawMarginWitness n) : Nonempty (HalfGreedySkippedRawBlockWitness n)
declarations.docstring: All state-identification and cancellation fields required by the generic raw block theorem follow from an actual consecutive-take witness.

declarations.name: HalfGreedyUnsafeSkipActualRawMarginSupply
declarations.docstring: Minimal producer form: a raw block witness is required only for a putative skipped rank that is not already dyadically safe.

declarations.docstring: The raw block theorem turns the actual-state witness into the precise dyadic safety fact consumed by greedy membership.

declarations.name: half_mem_mersenneAchievementSet_of_skippedRawBlockMarginSupply
