declarations.docstring: Appending `true` preserves every existing largest false rank.

declarations.name: truncatedMersenneWeight_eq_twoPower_add_fourPower_of_lateRank
declarations.signature: theorem truncatedMersenneWeight_eq_twoPower_add_fourPower_of_lateRank {s d : ℕ} (hd2 : 2 ≤ d) (hds : d < s) (hlate : 2 * s < 3 * d) : truncatedMersenneWeight s d = 2 ^ (2 * s - d) + 4 ^ (s - d)
declarations.docstring: In the late range `2*s < 3*d`, Euclidean division has quotient two, so the truncated Mersenne weight has exactly two power terms.

declarations.name: twoPowerSuffixSum_add_boundary
declarations.signature: theorem twoPowerSuffixSum_add_boundary (s d : ℕ) (hds : d < s) : (∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico (d + 1) s, 2 ^ (2 * s - e)) + 2 ^ (s + 1) = 2 ^ (2 * s - d)
declarations.docstring: The descending binary powers in the strict suffix telescope exactly.

declarations.name: three_mul_fourPowerSuffixSum_add_four
declarations.signature: theorem three_mul_fourPowerSuffixSum_add_four (s d : ℕ) (hds : d < s) : 3 * (∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico (d + 1) s, 4 ^ (s - e)) + 4 = 4 ^ (s - d)
declarations.docstring: The descending base-four correction powers telescope in a division-free form.

declarations.name: seamWeightsFrom_sum_eq_twoPowerSuffix_add_fourPowerSuffix_of_lateRank
declarations.signature: theorem seamWeightsFrom_sum_eq_twoPowerSuffix_add_fourPowerSuffix_of_lateRank {s d : ℕ} (hd2 : 2 ≤ d) (hds : d < s) (hlate : 2 * s < 3 * d) : (seamWeightsFrom s (d + 1)).sum = (∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico (d + 1) s, 2 ^ (2 * s - e)) + ∑ e ∈ Finset.Ico (d + 1) s, 4 ^ (s - e)
declarations.docstring: Every strict-suffix weight is in the same two-term quotient-two range.

declarations.name: three_mul_tailWeight_add_exactLateGap_eq_three_mul_headWeight
declarations.signature: theorem three_mul_tailWeight_add_exactLateGap_eq_three_mul_headWeight {s d : ℕ} (hd2 : 2 ≤ d) (hds : d < s) (hlate : 2 * s < 3 * d) : 3 * (seamWeightsFrom s (d + 1)).sum + (3 * 2 ^ (s + 1) + 2 * 4 ^ (s - d) + 4) = 3 * truncatedMersenneWeight s d
declarations.docstring: Sharp division-free adjacent-gap identity. Dividing by three gives `2^(s+1) + (2*4^(s-d)+4)/3`.

declarations.name: four_coeff_lower_le_binaryCoeffTail
declarations.signature: theorem four_coeff_lower_le_binaryCoeffTail (A : Set ℕ) (N : ℕ) : (supportCoeff A (N + 1) : ℝ) / 2 + (supportCoeff A (N + 2) : ℝ) / 4 + (supportCoeff A (N + 3) : ℝ) / 8 + (supportCoeff A (N + 4) : ℝ) / 16 ≤ binaryCoeffTail (supportCoeff A) N

declarations.name: two_lt_binaryCoeffTail_union_Ioi_of_forced_two_three_six

The selected divisors are the row itself, its cofinite half on even rows, and the forced seam ranks `2,3,6`. This is the coefficient-tail version of the adjacent `seamRankFloorError_two_three_six_eq` phase split.

declarations.name: SeamMiddleProducerCardEscape

declarations.name: middleProducer_allRight_forces_carry_lt_tail

declarations.docstring: If a concrete middle transition is followed only by right extensions, then its terminal-augmented finite prefix lies above `1/2`. Equivalently, the middle producer carry is *strictly smaller* than its complete future incidence tail. Thus this strict reverse inequality is not an artifact of a chosen majorant: it is the exact arithmetic signature that any hypothetical final middle producer must satisfy.

declarations.name: middleProducer_allRight_forces_floorZ_lt_takeThreshold
declarations.signature: theorem middleProducer_allRight_forces_floorZ_lt_takeThreshold (D : ℕ) (hD13 : 13 ≤ D) (hncarry : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).successorCarries) (hmiddle : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).remainder + (seamPerturbedFamily D (by omega)).gap - (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).belowPulse < (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).terminalWeight) (hright : ∀ s : ℕ, D + 1 ≤ s → seamGreedyWord (s + 1) = (seamGreedyWord s).extend true) : seamGreedyFloorZ D < seamTakeThreshold D
declarations.docstring: Consuming the exact tail formula, a hypothetical final middle producer followed by an all-right suffix lies strictly *below* the rational take threshold in the corrected seam coordinate.

declarations.name: middleProducer_allRight_forces_rational_skip
declarations.signature: theorem middleProducer_allRight_forces_rational_skip (D : ℕ) (hD13 : 13 ≤ D) (hncarry : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).successorCarries) (hmiddle : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).remainder + (seamPerturbedFamily D (by omega)).gap - (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).belowPulse < (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).terminalWeight) (hright : ∀ s : ℕ, D + 1 ≤ s → seamGreedyWord (s + 1) = (seamGreedyWord s).extend true) : seamWordRationalRemainder (seamGreedyWord D) < mersenneWeightRat D
declarations.docstring: Equivalently, the below word at a hypothetical final middle producer strictly skips its terminal Mersenne weight in the exact rational model.

declarations.name: seamWordRationalRemainder_extend_false
declarations.signature: theorem seamWordRationalRemainder_extend_false {s : ℕ} (hs : 3 ≤ s) (b : SeamRowWord s) : seamWordRationalRemainder (b.extend false) = seamWordRationalRemainder b
declarations.docstring: A false extension preserves the exact rational residual.

declarations.name: seamWordRationalRemainder_extend_true
declarations.signature: theorem seamWordRationalRemainder_extend_true {s : ℕ} (hs : 3 ≤ s) (b : SeamRowWord s) : seamWordRationalRemainder (b.extend true) = seamWordRationalRemainder b - mersenneWeightRat s
declarations.docstring: A true extension subtracts exactly the newly selected Mersenne weight from the rational residual.

declarations.name: floorZRightRunCharge
declarations.signature: def floorZRightRunCharge (S : ℕ) : ℕ → ℚ | 0 => 0 | k + 1 => 4 * floorZRightRunCharge S k + (2 : ℚ) ^ (S + k + 1) + 4 + 4 / ((2 : ℚ) ^ (S + k) - 1) /-- The exact finite rational-residual orbit along any all-right suffix. -/ theorem eventualRightTail_rationalRemainder_add_eq {S : ℕ} (hS5 : 5 ≤ S) (hright : ∀ s : ℕ, S ≤ s → seamGreedyWord (s + 1) = (seamGreedyWord s).extend true) : ∀ k : ℕ, seamWordRationalRemainder (seamGreedyWord (S + k)) = seamWordRationalRemainder (seamGreedyWord S) -
declarations.docstring: The accumulated affine charge in the exact floor-`Z` right recurrence. It is the rational analogue of `affineRightRunCharge`, retaining the Mersenne floor correction rather than only the integer pulse.

declarations.name: eventualRightTail_rationalRemainder_add_eq
declarations.signature: theorem eventualRightTail_rationalRemainder_add_eq {S : ℕ} (hS5 : 5 ≤ S) (hright : ∀ s : ℕ, S ≤ s → seamGreedyWord (s + 1) = (seamGreedyWord s).extend true) : ∀ k : ℕ, seamWordRationalRemainder (seamGreedyWord (S + k)) = seamWordRationalRemainder (seamGreedyWord S) - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, mersenneWeightRat (S + j)
declarations.docstring: The exact finite rational-residual orbit along any all-right suffix.

declarations.name: eventualRightTail_floorZ_succ_eq
declarations.signature: theorem eventualRightTail_floorZ_succ_eq {S s : ℕ} (hS5 : 5 ≤ S) (hright : ∀ t : ℕ, S ≤ t → seamGreedyWord (t + 1) = (seamGreedyWord t).extend true) (hSs : S ≤ s) : seamGreedyFloorZ (s + 1) = 4 * seamGreedyFloorZ s - (2 : ℚ) ^ (s + 1) - 4 - 4 / ((2 : ℚ) ^ s - 1)
declarations.docstring: One exact floor-`Z` step along an all-right suffix.

declarations.name: eventualRightTail_floorZ_add_charge_eq
declarations.signature: theorem eventualRightTail_floorZ_add_charge_eq {S : ℕ} (hS5 : 5 ≤ S) (hright : ∀ s : ℕ, S ≤ s → seamGreedyWord (s + 1) = (seamGreedyWord s).extend true) : ∀ k : ℕ, seamGreedyFloorZ (S + k) + floorZRightRunCharge S k = (4 : ℚ) ^ k * seamGreedyFloorZ S
declarations.docstring: Closed division-free iterate of the floor-`Z` right recurrence.

declarations.name: eventualRightTail_floorZ_add_eq_partialTail
declarations.signature: theorem eventualRightTail_floorZ_add_eq_partialTail {S : ℕ} (hS5 : 5 ≤ S) (hright : ∀ s : ℕ, S ≤ s → seamGreedyWord (s + 1) = (seamGreedyWord s).extend true) (k : ℕ) : seamGreedyFloorZ (S + k) = (4 : ℚ) ^ (S + k) * (seamWordRationalRemainder (seamGreedyWord S) - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, mersenneWeightRat (S + j)) - (2 : ℚ) ^ (S + k)
declarations.docstring: Explicit partial-tail closed form for the same floor-`Z` orbit.

declarations.name: middleThenAllRight_rationalRemainder_add_eq
declarations.signature: theorem middleThenAllRight_rationalRemainder_add_eq (D : ℕ) (hD13 : 13 ≤ D) (hncarry : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).successorCarries) (hmiddle : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).remainder + (seamPerturbedFamily D (by omega)).gap - (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).belowPulse < (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).terminalWeight) (hright : ∀ s : ℕ, D + 1 ≤ s → seamGreedyWord (s + 1) = (seamGreedyWord s).extend true) (k : ℕ) : seamWordRationalRemainder (seamGreedyWord (D + 1 + k)) = seamWordRationalRemainder (seamGreedyWord D) - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, mersenneWeightRat (D + 1 + j)
declarations.docstring: A middle landing preserves the old rational residual, after which the all-right suffix subtracts exactly the consecutive Mersenne partial tail.

declarations.name: middleThenAllRight_floorZ_add_charge_eq
declarations.signature: theorem middleThenAllRight_floorZ_add_charge_eq (D : ℕ) (hD13 : 13 ≤ D) (hncarry : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).successorCarries) (hmiddle : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).remainder + (seamPerturbedFamily D (by omega)).gap - (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).belowPulse < (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).terminalWeight) (hright : ∀ s : ℕ, D + 1 ≤ s → seamGreedyWord (s + 1) = (seamGreedyWord s).extend true) (k : ℕ) : seamGreedyFloorZ (D + 1 + k) + floorZRightRunCharge (D + 1) k = (4 : ℚ) ^ k * (4 * seamGreedyFloorZ D + (2 : ℚ) ^ (D + 1))
declarations.docstring: The same middle-then-right orbit in exact affine floor-`Z` coordinates. The right-run charge closes against the genuine middle landing value, not against a merely assumed skip decision.

declarations.name: middleThenAllRight_floorZ_eq_partialTail
declarations.signature: theorem middleThenAllRight_floorZ_eq_partialTail (D : ℕ) (hD13 : 13 ≤ D) (hncarry : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).successorCarries) (hmiddle : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).remainder + (seamPerturbedFamily D (by omega)).gap - (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).belowPulse < (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).terminalWeight) (hright : ∀ s : ℕ, D + 1 ≤ s → seamGreedyWord (s + 1) = (seamGreedyWord s).extend true) (k : ℕ) : seamGreedyFloorZ (D + 1 + k) = (4 : ℚ) ^ (D + 1 + k) * (seamWordRationalRemainder (seamGreedyWord D) -
declarations.docstring: Explicit partial-tail closed form after substituting the genuine middle landing.

declarations.name: middleThenAllRight_finiteValue_add_eq
declarations.signature: theorem middleThenAllRight_finiteValue_add_eq (D : ℕ) (hD13 : 13 ≤ D) (hncarry : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).successorCarries) (hmiddle : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).remainder + (seamPerturbedFamily D (by omega)).gap - (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).belowPulse < (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).terminalWeight) (hright : ∀ s : ℕ, D + 1 ≤ s → seamGreedyWord (s + 1) = (seamGreedyWord s).extend true) (k : ℕ) : seamGreedyFiniteValue (D + 1 + k) = seamGreedyFiniteValue D + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, mersenneWeight (D + 1 + j)
declarations.docstring: Every finite prefix after the middle landing is the old finite value plus the corresponding initial segment of the consecutive Mersenne tail.

declarations.name: tendsto_middleThenAllRight_finiteValue
declarations.signature: theorem tendsto_middleThenAllRight_finiteValue (D : ℕ) (hD13 : 13 ≤ D) (hncarry : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).successorCarries) (hmiddle : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).remainder + (seamPerturbedFamily D (by omega)).gap - (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).belowPulse < (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).terminalWeight) (hright : ∀ s : ℕ, D + 1 ≤ s → seamGreedyWord (s + 1) = (seamGreedyWord s).extend true) : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ ↦ seamGreedyFiniteValue (D + 1 + k)) atTop (nhds (seamGreedyFiniteValue D + mersenneTail D))
declarations.docstring: The propagated finite prefixes converge to the old prefix plus the complete Mersenne tail above the middle rank.

declarations.name: middleThenAllRight_limit_lt_half
declarations.signature: theorem middleThenAllRight_limit_lt_half (D : ℕ) (hD13 : 13 ≤ D) (hncarry : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).successorCarries) (hmiddle : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).remainder + (seamPerturbedFamily D (by omega)).gap - (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).belowPulse < (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).terminalWeight) (hright : ∀ s : ℕ, D + 1 ≤ s → seamGreedyWord (s + 1) = (seamGreedyWord s).extend true) : seamGreedyFiniteValue D + mersenneTail D < (1 / 2 : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: The limiting lazy endpoint remains strictly below `1/2`.

declarations.name: middleThenAllRight_rationalRemainder_fatalGap
declarations.signature: theorem middleThenAllRight_rationalRemainder_fatalGap (D : ℕ) (hD13 : 13 ≤ D) (hncarry : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).successorCarries) (hmiddle : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).remainder + (seamPerturbedFamily D (by omega)).gap - (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).belowPulse < (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).terminalWeight) (hright : ∀ s : ℕ, D + 1 ≤ s → seamGreedyWord (s + 1) = (seamGreedyWord s).extend true) : mersenneTail D < ((seamWordRationalRemainder (seamGreedyWord D) : ℚ) : ℝ) ∧ ((seamWordRationalRemainder (seamGreedyWord D) : ℚ) : ℝ) < mersenneWeight D
declarations.docstring: Exact fatal-gap interval forced by a final middle landing and an all-right suffix. The lower wall comes from the completed tail; the upper wall is the skipped terminal weight.

declarations.name: middleThenAllRight_floorZ_fatalGap
declarations.signature: theorem middleThenAllRight_floorZ_fatalGap (D : ℕ) (hD13 : 13 ≤ D) (hncarry : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).successorCarries) (hmiddle : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).remainder + (seamPerturbedFamily D (by omega)).gap - (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).belowPulse < (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).terminalWeight) (hright : ∀ s : ℕ, D + 1 ≤ s → seamGreedyWord (s + 1) = (seamGreedyWord s).extend true) : (4 : ℝ) ^ D * mersenneTail D - (2 : ℝ) ^ D < ((seamGreedyFloorZ D : ℚ) : ℝ) ∧ ((seamGreedyFloorZ D : ℚ) : ℝ) < ((seamTakeThreshold D : ℚ) : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: The same fatal gap in the corrected floor coordinate. This is the precise remaining arithmetic window that a genuinely middle transition would have to avoid in order to contradict an all-right suffix.

declarations.name: scaledMersenneTail_floorWall_eq
declarations.signature: theorem scaledMersenneTail_floorWall_eq (D : ℕ) : (4 : ℝ) ^ D * mersenneTail D - (2 : ℝ) ^ D = (1 / 3 : ℝ) + (4 : ℝ) ^ D * mersenneWeightRemainderTail D
declarations.docstring: The scaled lower wall of the fatal gap has an exact leading constant: `1/3`, followed by the positive higher-channel tail.

declarations.name: one_third_lt_scaledMersenneTail_floorWall
declarations.signature: theorem one_third_lt_scaledMersenneTail_floorWall (D : ℕ) : (1 / 3 : ℝ) < (4 : ℝ) ^ D * mersenneTail D - (2 : ℝ) ^ D
declarations.docstring: In particular, the exact scaled tail wall is strictly larger than `1/3` at every row.

declarations.name: middleThenAllRight_landingExcess_two_le
declarations.signature: theorem middleThenAllRight_landingExcess_two_le (D : ℕ) (hD13 : 13 ≤ D) (hncarry : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).successorCarries) (hmiddle : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).remainder + (seamPerturbedFamily D (by omega)).gap - (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).belowPulse < (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).terminalWeight) (hright : ∀ s : ℕ, D + 1 ≤ s → seamGreedyWord (s + 1) = (seamGreedyWord s).extend true) : (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).belowPulse + 2 ≤ 4 * (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).remainder
declarations.docstring: The first genuinely middle-specific consequence of the fatal-gap orbit: pulse absorption and the strict `1/3` wall force the integer landing excess to be at least two, excluding the first positive cell.

declarations.name: half_mem_mersenneAchievementSet_of_middleProducerCardEscape
declarations.docstring: The exact cardinality-scale middle bound rules out the final middle producer of an eventual right seam and therefore proves the half endpoint.

declarations.name: half_mem_mersenneAchievementSet_of_middleProducerRowEscape
declarations.docstring: It is enough that every late middle remainder be at least its row index.

declarations.name: four_mul_le_two_pow_succ
declarations.docstring: From row five onward, four times the row index is still below the next dyadic seam gap.

declarations.name: seamRowSmall_upperOrMiddle
declarations.signature: theorem seamRowSmall_upperOrMiddle {s : ℕ} (hs : 5 ≤ s) (hsmall : seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s < s) : SeamGreedyUpperOrMiddleAt s hs
declarations.docstring: Any row-scale-small remainder forces a non-right successor, without using largest-false geometry.

declarations.name: allRightTail_forces_twoPow_lt_remainder
declarations.signature: theorem allRightTail_forces_twoPow_lt_remainder {s : ℕ} (hs : 5 ≤ s) (hright : ∀ (t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t), ¬ SeamGreedyUpperOrMiddleAt t (by omega)) : 2 ^ s < seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s
declarations.docstring: A right-only tail cannot start on or below the dyadic half-point. A strict deficit is consumed by `upperOrMiddle_within_of_two_pow_deficit`; at exact equality, one right step creates a strict deficit because its pulse charge contains the positive terminal correction `4`.

declarations.name: eventualRightTail_forces_twoPow_lt_remainder
declarations.signature: theorem eventualRightTail_forces_twoPow_lt_remainder {S : ℕ} (hS5 : 5 ≤ S) (hright : ∀ (s : ℕ), S ≤ s → seamGreedyWord (s + 1) = (seamGreedyWord s).extend true) : ∀ (s : ℕ), S ≤ s → 2 ^ s < seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s
declarations.docstring: Word-level form: every row of an eventual right-extension tail lies strictly above its dyadic half-point. This isolates the only possible survivor as the positive affine-excess orbit.

declarations.name: rightBranch_excess_succ_eq
declarations.signature: theorem rightBranch_excess_succ_eq {s : ℕ} (hs : 5 ≤ s) (hR : ¬ SeamGreedyUpperOrMiddleAt s hs) : (seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (s + 1) : ℤ) - ((2 ^ (s + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) = 4 * ((seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s : ℤ) - ((2 ^ s : ℕ) : ℤ)) - ((seamAdjacentCut s hs).belowPulse : ℤ) - 4
declarations.docstring: On a right branch, the signed excess above the dyadic half-point is an exact base-four affine orbit driven by the below-pulse charge.

declarations.name: eventualRightTail_positive_affineExcess
declarations.signature: theorem eventualRightTail_positive_affineExcess {S : ℕ} (hS5 : 5 ≤ S) (hright : ∀ (s : ℕ), S ≤ s → seamGreedyWord (s + 1) = (seamGreedyWord s).extend true) : ∀ (s : ℕ) (hSs : S ≤ s), 0 < (seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s : ℤ) - ((2 ^ s : ℕ) : ℤ) ∧ (seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (s + 1) : ℤ) - ((2 ^ (s + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) = 4 * ((seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s : ℤ) - ((2 ^ s : ℕ) : ℤ)) - ((seamAdjacentCut s (by omega)).belowPulse : ℤ) - 4
declarations.docstring: Hence an eventual right tail is precisely a strictly positive affine excess orbit. The deficit and zero regimes have been eliminated unconditionally above.

declarations.name: middleProducer_allRight_landingExcess_window
declarations.signature: theorem middleProducer_allRight_landingExcess_window (D : ℕ) (hD13 : 13 ≤ D) (hncarry : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).successorCarries) (hmiddle : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).remainder + (seamPerturbedFamily D (by omega)).gap - (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).belowPulse < (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).terminalWeight) (hright : ∀ s : ℕ, D + 1 ≤ s → seamGreedyWord (s + 1) = (seamGreedyWord s).extend true) : 0 < (seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (D + 1) : ℤ) - ((2 ^ (D + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) ∧ (((seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (D + 1) : ℤ) - ((2 ^ (D + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) <
declarations.docstring: A hypothetical final middle producer can land only in a very thin positive-excess window. Its landing excess is exactly the producer carry plus four, while the complete future-tail inequality bounds that carry by the universal support tail strip.

declarations.name: seamMiddleBranch_nextRemainder_add_belowPulse_eq
declarations.signature: theorem seamMiddleBranch_nextRemainder_add_belowPulse_eq {s : ℕ} (hs : 5 ≤ s) (hncarry : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut s hs).successorCarries) (hmiddle : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut s hs).remainder + (seamPerturbedFamily s (by omega)).gap - (seamAdjacentCut s hs).belowPulse < (seamAdjacentCut s hs).terminalWeight) : seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (s + 1) + (seamAdjacentCut s hs).belowPulse = 4 * seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s + 2 ^ (s + 1)
declarations.docstring: Exact additive recurrence on the middle branch. Keeping the pulse on the left removes the truncated subtraction from `nextRemainder_trichotomy` and exposes the full dyadic recovery term used by late-row arguments.

declarations.name: seamMiddleBranch_nextRemainder_ge_row
declarations.signature: theorem seamMiddleBranch_nextRemainder_ge_row {s : ℕ} (hs : 5 ≤ s) (hncarry : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut s hs).successorCarries) (hmiddle : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut s hs).remainder + (seamPerturbedFamily s (by omega)).gap - (seamAdjacentCut s hs).belowPulse < (seamAdjacentCut s hs).terminalWeight) : s + 1 ≤ seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (s + 1)
declarations.docstring: A middle branch cannot itself create a row-scale-small successor. This uses no lower bound on the source remainder.

declarations.name: seamMiddleBranch_nextRemainder_ge_expBarrier
declarations.signature: theorem seamMiddleBranch_nextRemainder_ge_expBarrier {s : ℕ} (hs : 5 ≤ s) (hrow : s ≤ (seamAdjacentCut s hs).remainder) (hncarry : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut s hs).successorCarries) (hmiddle : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut s hs).remainder + (seamPerturbedFamily s (by omega)).gap - (seamAdjacentCut s hs).belowPulse < (seamAdjacentCut s hs).terminalWeight) : 2 ^ (s + 1) + (s + 1) ≤ seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (s + 1)
declarations.docstring: With the row-scale source lower bound, a middle branch enters an exponential barrier above the next row.

declarations.name: seamRightBranch_preserves_expBarrier
declarations.signature: theorem seamRightBranch_preserves_expBarrier {s : ℕ} (hs : 5 ≤ s) (hbarrier : 2 ^ s + s ≤ (seamAdjacentCut s hs).remainder) (hncarry : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut s hs).successorCarries) (hright : (seamAdjacentCut s hs).terminalWeight ≤ 4 * (seamAdjacentCut s hs).remainder + (seamPerturbedFamily s (by omega)).gap - (seamAdjacentCut s hs).belowPulse) : 2 ^ (s + 1) + (s + 1) ≤ seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (s + 1)
declarations.docstring: A right branch preserves the exponential barrier. The pulse cap is exactly strong enough: four copies of the linear surplus `s` pay for the row pulse and leave the next linear surplus.

declarations.name: seamRightRun_preserves_expBarrier
declarations.signature: theorem seamRightRun_preserves_expBarrier {d s : ℕ} (hd5 : 5 ≤ d) (hds : d ≤ s) (hstart : 2 ^ d + d ≤ seamIntegerGreedyRemainder d) (hrun : ∀ (t : ℕ) (hdt : d ≤ t), t < s → ¬ (seamAdjacentCut t (by omega)).successorCarries ∧ (seamAdjacentCut t (by omega)).terminalWeight ≤ 4 * (seamAdjacentCut t (by omega)).remainder + (seamPerturbedFamily t (by omega)).gap - (seamAdjacentCut t (by omega)).belowPulse) : 2 ^ s + s ≤ seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s
declarations.docstring: Iterated form of `seamRightBranch_preserves_expBarrier` on a concrete right-only interval.

declarations.name: seamMiddleThenRightRun_expBarrier
declarations.signature: theorem seamMiddleThenRightRun_expBarrier {d s : ℕ} (hd5 : 5 ≤ d) (hds : d + 1 ≤ s) (hrow : d ≤ (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).remainder) (hncarry : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).successorCarries) (hmiddle : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).remainder + (seamPerturbedFamily d (by omega)).gap - (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).belowPulse < (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).terminalWeight) (hrun : ∀ (t : ℕ) (hdt : d + 1 ≤ t), t < s → ¬ (seamAdjacentCut t (by omega)).successorCarries ∧ (seamAdjacentCut t (by omega)).terminalWeight ≤ 4 * (seamAdjacentCut t (by omega)).remainder + (seamPerturbedFamily t (by omega)).gap -
declarations.docstring: A row-scale middle producer followed by any finite run of right successors can never end in a row-scale-small remainder. This is the exact fan-in used when tracing a hypothetical first late failure backwards to its last non-right producer.

declarations.name: PerturbedFamily.AdjacentCut.above_eq_of_candidate_lt_two_gap
declarations.signature: theorem PerturbedFamily.AdjacentCut.above_eq_of_candidate_lt_two_gap {α : Type*} {F : PerturbedFamily α} {C : ℕ} (K : F.AdjacentCut C) (x : α) (hx : C < F.oldSum x) (hwindow : F.oldSum x < F.oldSum K.below + 2 * F.gap) : K.above = x
declarations.docstring: In a gap-separated adjacent cut, any above-target candidate less than two separation gaps above the lower word is the actual minimal upper word.

declarations.name: largestSkipLowerWord_weight_eq_greedy_of_support
declarations.signature: theorem largestSkipLowerWord_weight_eq_greedy_of_support {s d : ℕ} {u : Finset ℕ} (hd2 : 2 ≤ d) (hu : ∀ e ∈ u, 2 ≤ e ∧ e < d) (hds : d < s) (hsupp : seamWordSupport (seamGreedyWord s) = u ∪ Finset.Ico (d + 1) s) : wordWeightSum s (largestSkipLowerWord s d u).toNatWord = wordWeightSum s (seamGreedyWord s).toNatWord
declarations.docstring: The explicit lower word determined by a largest false rank has exactly the greedy word's weight.

declarations.name: exactLateGap_correction_lt_three_mul_gap

declarations.signature: theorem seamUpperThenRightRun_rowSmall_iff_resetCylinderWindow {d k : ℕ} (hd5 : 5 ≤ d) (hcarry : (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).successorCarries) (hrun : ∀ j : ℕ, j < k → seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (d + j + 2) + 2 ^ (d + j + 2) + (seamAdjacentCut (d + j + 1) (by omega)).belowPulse + 4 = 4 * seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (d + j + 1)) : seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (d + k + 1) < d + k + 1 ↔ 4 ^ k * (4 * (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).overshoot + (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).abovePulse) + affineRightRunCharge (fun j ↦
declarations.docstring: Exact reverse-producer classification: after an upper reset and a right run, a row-small endpoint is equivalent to one explicit top window for the base-four weighted reset-and-pulse charge.

declarations.name: seamUpperThenRightRun_rowSmall_forces_resetCharge_lower
declarations.signature: theorem seamUpperThenRightRun_rowSmall_forces_resetCharge_lower {d k : ℕ} (hd5 : 5 ≤ d) (hk : k ≤ d) (hcarry : (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).successorCarries) (hrun : ∀ j : ℕ, j < k → seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (d + j + 2) + 2 ^ (d + j + 2) + (seamAdjacentCut (d + j + 1) (by omega)).belowPulse + 4 = 4 * seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (d + j + 1)) (hsmall : seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (d + k + 1) < d + k + 1) : 2 ^ (d - k + 1) < 4 * (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).overshoot + (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).abovePulse + 2 * (d + k)
declarations.docstring: After dividing out the base-four length of the right run, a row-small terminal state forces an exponential lower bound on the *upper reset charge* itself. The loss is only twice the terminal row. Under the late largest-false geometry one has `k ≤ d`, so the exponent `d-k+1` is the natural reverse-producer scale.

declarations.name: seamAdjacentCut_overshoot_le_candidateExcess
declarations.signature: theorem seamAdjacentCut_overshoot_le_candidateExcess {s : ℕ} (hs : 5 ≤ s) (x : SeamRowWord s) (hx : seamSubsetTarget s < wordWeightSum s x.toNatWord) : (seamAdjacentCut s hs).overshoot ≤ wordWeightSum s x.toNatWord - seamSubsetTarget s
declarations.docstring: Any explicit word above the seam target bounds the overshoot of the minimal adjacent upper word by its own excess.

declarations.name: seamUpperBranch_nextRemainder_le_pow
declarations.signature: theorem seamUpperBranch_nextRemainder_le_pow {s : ℕ} (hs : 5 ≤ s) (hcarry : (seamAdjacentCut s hs).successorCarries) : seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (s + 1) ≤ 2 ^ (s + 1)
declarations.docstring: An upper successor always satisfies the lower half of the next-row two-sided dyadic invariant.

declarations.name: seamUpperBranch_next_not_successorCarries
declarations.signature: theorem seamUpperBranch_next_not_successorCarries {s : ℕ} (hs : 5 ≤ s) (hcarry : (seamAdjacentCut s hs).successorCarries) : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut (s + 1) (by omega)).successorCarries
declarations.docstring: Upper resets are isolated: an upper branch cannot be followed by a second upper branch. The first reset makes the next row's terminal rank the largest false rank; its exact terminal gap then forces the next overshoot far above the next upper-charge budget.

declarations.name: seamMiddleBranch_next_twoSided_of_not_neg_small
declarations.signature: theorem seamMiddleBranch_next_twoSided_of_not_neg_small {s : ℕ} (hs : 5 ≤ s) (hncarry : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut s hs).successorCarries) (hmiddle : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut s hs).remainder + (seamPerturbedFamily s (by omega)).gap - (seamAdjacentCut s hs).belowPulse < (seamAdjacentCut s hs).terminalWeight) (hcell : 4 * ((seamAdjacentCut s hs).remainder : ℤ) - ((seamAdjacentCut s hs).belowPulse : ℤ) - 4 ≤ -4 ∨ 0 ≤ 4 * ((seamAdjacentCut s hs).remainder : ℤ) - ((seamAdjacentCut s hs).belowPulse : ℤ) - 4) : seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (s + 1) ≤ 2 ^ (s + 1) ∨
declarations.docstring: Outside the three signed cells `-3,-2,-1`, a middle successor satisfies one side of the next-row dyadic invariant. If the coordinate is at most `-4`, the untoggled lower candidate already has small remainder. If it is nonnegative, toggling its terminal bit supplies an upper candidate with small excess.

declarations.name: seamRightBranch_nextRemainder_le_pow_of_remainder_le
declarations.signature: theorem seamRightBranch_nextRemainder_le_pow_of_remainder_le {s : ℕ} (hs : 5 ≤ s) (hncarry : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut s hs).successorCarries) (hright : (seamAdjacentCut s hs).terminalWeight ≤ 4 * (seamAdjacentCut s hs).remainder + (seamPerturbedFamily s (by omega)).gap - (seamAdjacentCut s hs).belowPulse) (hrem : seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s ≤ 2 ^ s) : seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (s + 1) ≤ 2 ^ (s + 1)
declarations.docstring: The remainder witness of the two-sided dyadic invariant is strictly preserved by a right successor.

declarations.name: seamRightBranch_nextOvershoot_le_pow_of_charge_le
declarations.signature: theorem seamRightBranch_nextOvershoot_le_pow_of_charge_le {s : ℕ} (hs : 5 ≤ s) (hncarry : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut s hs).successorCarries) (hcharge : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut s hs).overshoot + (seamAdjacentCut s hs).abovePulse ≤ 2 ^ (s + 2)) : (seamAdjacentCut (s + 1) (by omega)).overshoot ≤ 2 ^ (s + 1)
declarations.docstring: The overshoot witness is preserved by a right successor whenever its pulse-corrected upper charge stays below twice the old gap. The negation of this hypothesis is exactly the narrow pulse leak left by the raw bound `overshoot ≤ 2^s`.

declarations.name: seamRightBranch_nextOvershoot_le_pow_of_overshoot_le_of_noPulseLeak
declarations.signature: theorem seamRightBranch_nextOvershoot_le_pow_of_overshoot_le_of_noPulseLeak {s : ℕ} (hs : 5 ≤ s) (hncarry : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut s hs).successorCarries) (hover : (seamAdjacentCut s hs).overshoot ≤ 2 ^ s) (hnoleak : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut s hs).overshoot + (seamAdjacentCut s hs).abovePulse ≤ 2 ^ (s + 2)) : (seamAdjacentCut (s + 1) (by omega)).overshoot ≤ 2 ^ (s + 1)
declarations.docstring: A raw overshoot witness therefore propagates unless it lies in the explicit pulse leak above twice the old gap.

declarations.name: seamMiddleCoordinate_not_safe_iff_three_cells
declarations.signature: theorem seamMiddleCoordinate_not_safe_iff_three_cells {s : ℕ} (hs : 5 ≤ s) : ¬ (4 * ((seamAdjacentCut s hs).remainder : ℤ) - ((seamAdjacentCut s hs).belowPulse : ℤ) - 4 ≤ -4 ∨ 0 ≤ 4 * ((seamAdjacentCut s hs).remainder : ℤ) - ((seamAdjacentCut s hs).belowPulse : ℤ) - 4) ↔ 4 * ((seamAdjacentCut s hs).remainder : ℤ) - ((seamAdjacentCut s hs).belowPulse : ℤ) - 4 = -3 ∨ 4 * ((seamAdjacentCut s hs).remainder : ℤ) - ((seamAdjacentCut s hs).belowPulse : ℤ) - 4 = -2 ∨ 4 * ((seamAdjacentCut s hs).remainder : ℤ) - ((seamAdjacentCut s hs).belowPulse : ℤ) - 4 = -1
declarations.docstring: The complement of the safe middle-coordinate range consists of exactly three integers.

declarations.name: seamMiddleCell_four_mul_floorZ_le
declarations.signature: theorem seamMiddleCell_four_mul_floorZ_le {s c : ℕ} (hs : 5 ≤ s) (hcell : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut s hs).remainder = (seamAdjacentCut s hs).belowPulse + c) : 4 * seamGreedyFloorZ s ≤ (c : ℚ)
declarations.docstring: In a middle cell `4*R = pulse + c`, the pulse part of `4*R` is already absorbed by the exact floor error. Hence the corrected rational coordinate `4*Z` is bounded by the bare cell label `c`.

declarations.name: seamMiddleCell_scaledRationalRemainder_le
declarations.signature: theorem seamMiddleCell_scaledRationalRemainder_le {s c : ℕ} (hs : 5 ≤ s) (hncarry : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut s hs).successorCarries) (hmiddle : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut s hs).remainder + (seamPerturbedFamily s (by omega)).gap - (seamAdjacentCut s hs).belowPulse < (seamAdjacentCut s hs).terminalWeight) (hcell : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut s hs).remainder = (seamAdjacentCut s hs).belowPulse + c) : (4 : ℚ) ^ (s + 1) * seamWordRationalRemainder (seamGreedyWord (s + 1)) ≤ (2 : ℚ) ^ (s + 2) + c
declarations.docstring: On an actual middle transition, the preceding cancellation bounds the scaled rational residual by the binary tail channel plus the cell label. For the first exceptional cell this leaves only `1`, strictly less than the true correction-tail slack `4/3 + ε`.

declarations.name: seamRightPulseLeak_iff_distanceCell
declarations.signature: theorem seamRightPulseLeak_iff_distanceCell {s : ℕ} (hs : 5 ≤ s) (hover : (seamAdjacentCut s hs).overshoot ≤ 2 ^ s) : 2 ^ (s + 2) < 4 * (seamAdjacentCut s hs).overshoot + (seamAdjacentCut s hs).abovePulse ↔ ∃ k : ℕ, (seamAdjacentCut s hs).overshoot = 2 ^ s - k ∧ 4 * k < (seamAdjacentCut s hs).abovePulse
declarations.docstring: Under the raw overshoot witness, a right-branch pulse leak is exactly a distance cell immediately below `2^s`; its distance `k` satisfies `4*k < abovePulse`.

declarations.name: seamPureHalfPrefixRemainder_eq_ite
declarations.signature: theorem seamPureHalfPrefixRemainder_eq_ite {s : ℕ} (hs : 5 ≤ s) : seamPureHalfPrefixRemainder s = if (seamAdjacentCut s hs).overshoot ≤ 2 ^ s then 2 ^ s - (seamAdjacentCut s hs).overshoot else 2 ^ s + seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s
declarations.docstring: Exact cut formula for the pure-half prefix residual. Below the upper midpoint it is `2^s - overshoot`; above that midpoint it is `2^s + remainder`.

declarations.name: seamPureHalfPrefixRemainder_le_iff_twoSided
declarations.signature: theorem seamPureHalfPrefixRemainder_le_iff_twoSided {s : ℕ} (hs : 5 ≤ s) : seamPureHalfPrefixRemainder s ≤ 2 ^ (s + 1) ↔ seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s ≤ 2 ^ s ∨ (seamAdjacentCut s hs).overshoot ≤ 2 ^ s
declarations.docstring: Consequently the two-sided dyadic cut bound is exactly the single pure-half prefix estimate with the complete omitted-tail budget `2^(s+1)`.

declarations.name: SeamTwoSidedDyadicCellEscape
declarations.docstring: The minimal actual-run input for propagating the two-sided dyadic invariant. It excludes the three middle cells and the right pulse leak, only on branches where those exclusions are needed.

declarations.name: SeamTwoSidedDyadicCellEscape.step
declarations.signature: theorem SeamTwoSidedDyadicCellEscape.step (hescape : SeamTwoSidedDyadicCellEscape) {s : ℕ} (hs : 5 ≤ s) (hinvariant : seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s ≤ 2 ^ s ∨ (seamAdjacentCut s hs).overshoot ≤ 2 ^ s) : seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (s + 1) ≤ 2 ^ (s + 1) ∨ (seamAdjacentCut (s + 1) (by omega)).overshoot ≤ 2 ^ (s + 1)
declarations.docstring: One branch step of the two-sided dyadic invariant under the exact cell escape input.

declarations.name: seamTwoSidedDyadicAt_five
declarations.docstring: The row-five cut is the concrete base of the two-sided invariant.

declarations.name: SeamTwoSidedDyadicCellEscape.twoSided
declarations.signature: theorem SeamTwoSidedDyadicCellEscape.twoSided (hescape : SeamTwoSidedDyadicCellEscape) (s : ℕ) (hs : 5 ≤ s) : seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s ≤ 2 ^ s ∨ (seamAdjacentCut s hs).overshoot ≤ 2 ^ s
declarations.docstring: Excluding only the two local cell families propagates the universal two-sided bound `min(remainder, overshoot) ≤ 2^s`.

declarations.name: seamUpperReset_band_iff_successorRemainder_avoids
declarations.signature: theorem seamUpperReset_band_iff_successorRemainder_avoids {d j : ℕ} (hd5 : 5 ≤ d) (hj : j ≤ d) (hcarry : (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).successorCarries) : (2 ^ (d - j + 1) < 4 * (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).overshoot + (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).abovePulse ∨ 4 * (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).overshoot + (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).abovePulse + 2 * (d + j) ≤ 2 ^ (d - j + 1)) ↔ (seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (d + 1) < 2 ^ (d + 1) - 2 ^ (d - j + 1) ∨ 2 ^ (d + 1) - 2 ^ (d - j + 1) + 2 * (d + j) ≤ seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (d + 1))
declarations.docstring: On an upper branch, avoiding a danger band with the reset charge is exactly the same as the successor remainder avoiding the translated band above the complementary dyadic boundary.

declarations.name: upperResetCharge_dyadicDistance_add_abovePulse
declarations.signature: theorem upperResetCharge_dyadicDistance_add_abovePulse {d j : ℕ} (hd5 : 5 ≤ d) (hj : j + 1 ≤ d) (hle : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).overshoot + (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).abovePulse ≤ 2 ^ (d - j + 1)) : (2 ^ (d - j + 1) - (4 * (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).overshoot + (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).abovePulse)) + (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).abovePulse = 4 * (2 ^ (d - j - 1) - (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).overshoot)
declarations.docstring: When the reset charge lies below a dyadic boundary, its exact remaining distance plus the above pulse is four times the distance of the adjacent overshoot from the quarter-scale boundary.

declarations.name: seamUpperReset_band_of_overshoot_band
declarations.signature: theorem seamUpperReset_band_of_overshoot_band {d j : ℕ} (hd5 : 5 ≤ d) (hj : j + 1 ≤ d) (hO : 2 ^ (d - j - 1) < (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).overshoot ∨ (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).overshoot + (d + j) ≤ 2 ^ (d - j - 1)) : 2 ^ (d - j + 1) < 4 * (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).overshoot + (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).abovePulse ∨ 4 * (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).overshoot + (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).abovePulse + 2 * (d + j) ≤ 2 ^ (d - j + 1)
declarations.docstring: Thus a quarter-scale exclusion for the adjacent overshoot is sufficient for the full reset-charge exclusion. This is the natural-number form of `upperResetCharge_signedDistance_eq_remainderBoundary`, with the linear pulse loss paid explicitly.

declarations.name: seamUpperResetDyadicBandEscape_at_thirteen
declarations.signature: theorem seamUpperResetDyadicBandEscape_at_thirteen (hd5 : 5 ≤ 13) (hcarry : (seamAdjacentCut 13 hd5).successorCarries) : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ 13 → 2 ^ (13 - j + 1) < 4 * (seamAdjacentCut 13 hd5).overshoot + (seamAdjacentCut 13 hd5).abovePulse ∨ 4 * (seamAdjacentCut 13 hd5).overshoot + (seamAdjacentCut 13 hd5).abovePulse + 2 * (13 + j) ≤ 2 ^ (13 - j + 1)
declarations.docstring: The sole non-late upper row at the start of the late regime already escapes every reset band. Its upper successor remainder is exactly `392`, so the main boundary has margin `392` and all smaller boundaries lie above the remainder.

declarations.name: SeamUpperResetDyadicBandEscape
declarations.docstring: No upper reset charge at or after row thirteen lies in any of the linear-width danger bands below the relevant dyadic powers.

declarations.name: SeamUpperResetDyadicBandEscape.not_rowSmall_after_upperRightRun
declarations.signature: theorem SeamUpperResetDyadicBandEscape.not_rowSmall_after_upperRightRun (hband : SeamUpperResetDyadicBandEscape) {d k : ℕ} (hd5 : 5 ≤ d) (hd13 : 13 ≤ d) (hk : k ≤ d) (hcarry : (seamAdjacentCut d hd5).successorCarries) (hrun : ∀ j : ℕ, j < k → seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (d + j + 2) + 2 ^ (d + j + 2) + (seamAdjacentCut (d + j + 1) (by omega)).belowPulse + 4 = 4 * seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (d + j + 1)) : ¬ seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (d + k + 1) < d + k + 1
declarations.docstring: The forbidden-band producer excludes every row-small endpoint whose last non-right producer was an upper reset.

declarations.name: thirteen_not_mem_seamGreedyWord_fourteen
declarations.docstring: The row-thirteen transition is a concrete non-right producer. This is extracted from the already certified largest-false base at row fourteen.

declarations.name: SeamUpperResetDyadicBandEscape.remainder_ge_row
declarations.signature: theorem SeamUpperResetDyadicBandEscape.remainder_ge_row (hband : SeamUpperResetDyadicBandEscape) {s : ℕ} (hs13 : 13 ≤ s) : s ≤ seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s
declarations.docstring: If the dyadic upper-reset bands are avoided, no seam remainder at or after row thirteen can be smaller than its row index. This is the global last-ancestor theorem missing from the local reverse-cylinder development.

declarations.name: SeamUpperResetDyadicBandEscape.toMiddleProducerRowEscape
declarations.docstring: The dyadic upper-reset producer supplies the exact row-scale middle producer required by the cardinality tail argument.

declarations.name: half_mem_mersenneAchievementSet_of_upperResetDyadicBandEscape
declarations.docstring: Final fan-in from the dyadic reset-band producer to the Erdős #257 half-achievement endpoint.

declarations.name: producerCarry
declarations.signature: noncomputable def producerCarry (A : Set ℕ) (d : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: The producer-aligned affine integer carry.

declarations.name: producerCarry_residual_identity
declarations.signature: theorem producerCarry_residual_identity (A : Set ℕ) (d : ℕ) (hone : 1 ∉ A) (hA : A ⊆ Set.Iic d) : (1 : ℝ) / 2 - erdosSupportSeries 2 A = ((producerCarry A d : ℝ) - binaryCoeffTail (supportCoeff A) (2 * d + 2)) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * d + 2)
declarations.docstring: The finite-prefix carry identity at the producer-aligned depth `2d+1`. The support hypothesis matches an adjacent-above producer prefix, whose ranks are all at most `d`.

declarations.name: producerCarry_gt_tail_iff_supportSeries_lt_half
declarations.signature: theorem producerCarry_gt_tail_iff_supportSeries_lt_half (A : Set ℕ) (d : ℕ) (hone : 1 ∉ A) (hA : A ⊆ Set.Iic d) : binaryCoeffTail (supportCoeff A) (2 * d + 2) < (producerCarry A d : ℝ) ↔ erdosSupportSeries 2 A < (1 : ℝ) / 2
declarations.docstring: Exact middle-producer safety criterion: the adjacent-above prefix is below `1/2` iff its positive integer landing carry beats the complete future divisor-incidence tail.

declarations.name: producerCarry_lt_tail_iff_half_lt_supportSeries
declarations.signature: theorem producerCarry_lt_tail_iff_half_lt_supportSeries (A : Set ℕ) (d : ℕ) (hone : 1 ∉ A) (hA : A ⊆ Set.Iic d) : (producerCarry A d : ℝ) < binaryCoeffTail (supportCoeff A) (2 * d + 2) ↔ (1 : ℝ) / 2 < erdosSupportSeries 2 A
declarations.docstring: The complementary exact upper-producer criterion.

declarations.name: producerCarry_sqrt_sufficient
declarations.signature: theorem producerCarry_sqrt_sufficient (A : Set ℕ) (d : ℕ) (hone : 1 ∉ A) (hA : A ⊆ Set.Iic d) (hcarry : 2 * Real.sqrt ((2 * d + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 4 < (producerCarry A d : ℝ)) : erdosSupportSeries 2 A < (1 : ℝ) / 2
declarations.docstring: The support-coefficient strip gives a theorem-ready square-root sufficient condition for middle-producer safety.

declarations.name: producerCarry_linear_sufficient
declarations.signature: theorem producerCarry_linear_sufficient (A : Set ℕ) (d : ℕ) (hone : 1 ∉ A) (hA : A ⊆ Set.Iic d) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hcarry : 2 * (d : ℝ) + 6 < (producerCarry A d : ℝ)) : erdosSupportSeries 2 A < (1 : ℝ) / 2
declarations.docstring: Elementary fallback: for `d ≥ 1`, the affine bound `2d+6` dominates the square-root tail strip.

declarations.name: producerCarry_neg_forces_half_lt_supportSeries
declarations.signature: theorem producerCarry_neg_forces_half_lt_supportSeries (A : Set ℕ) (d : ℕ) (hone : 1 ∉ A) (hA : A ⊆ Set.Iic d) (hcarry : producerCarry A d < 0) : (1 : ℝ) / 2 < erdosSupportSeries 2 A
declarations.docstring: A negative upper-producer integer carry is automatically strictly below the nonnegative incidence tail.

declarations.name: mersenneGap_lt_eight_div_four_pow_succ
declarations.signature: theorem mersenneGap_lt_eight_div_four_pow_succ (d : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) : mersenneGap d < (8 : ℝ) / (4 : ℝ) ^ (d + 1)
declarations.docstring: Eight units at depth `2d+1` dominate the entire rank-`d` superincreasing gap.

declarations.name: producerCarry_le_neg_eight_forces_gap_margin
declarations.signature: theorem producerCarry_le_neg_eight_forces_gap_margin (A : Set ℕ) (d : ℕ) (hone : 1 ∉ A) (hA : A ⊆ Set.Iic d) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hcarry : producerCarry A d ≤ -8) : (1 : ℝ) / 2 + mersenneGap d < erdosSupportSeries 2 A
declarations.docstring: An upper-producer carry of at most `-8` puts the adjacent-above prefix more than one full Mersenne gap above `1/2`.

declarations.name: producerCarry_le_neg_eight_forces_belowTail_gt_half
declarations.signature: theorem producerCarry_le_neg_eight_forces_belowTail_gt_half (A : Set ℕ) (d : ℕ) (base : ℝ) (hone : 1 ∉ A) (hA : A ⊆ Set.Iic d) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hcarry : producerCarry A d ≤ -8) (hdecomp : erdosSupportSeries 2 A = base + mersenneWeight d) : (1 : ℝ) / 2 < base + mersenneTail d
declarations.docstring: If the adjacent-above prefix is `base + w_d`, the preceding margin says that replacing `w_d` by the entire later tail still remains above `1/2`. This is the analytic forced-return statement for the upper producer.

declarations.name: wordPulse_eq_pairedSupportCoeff
declarations.signature: theorem wordPulse_eq_pairedSupportCoeff {s : ℕ} (b : SeamRowWord s) : wordPulse s b.toNatWord = supportCoeff (↑(seamWordSupport b) : Set ℕ) (2 * s + 2) + 2 * supportCoeff (↑(seamWordSupport b) : Set ℕ) (2 * s + 1)
declarations.docstring: The row pulse is exactly the paired odd/even divisor incidence at the two new coefficient rows.

declarations.name: pairedSupportCoeff_insert_terminal_eq_wordPulse
declarations.signature: theorem pairedSupportCoeff_insert_terminal_eq_wordPulse {s : ℕ} (hs : 5 ≤ s) (b : SeamRowWord s) : 2 * supportCoeff (insert s (↑(seamWordSupport b) : Set ℕ)) (2 * s + 1) + supportCoeff (insert s (↑(seamWordSupport b) : Set ℕ)) (2 * s + 2) = wordPulse s b.toNatWord
declarations.docstring: Inserting the terminal rank does not affect either pulse row: for `s ≥ 5`, the rank `s` divides neither `2s+1` nor `2s+2`.

declarations.name: producerCarry_insert_seamWordSupport_eq
declarations.signature: theorem producerCarry_insert_seamWordSupport_eq {s : ℕ} (hs : 5 ≤ s) (b : SeamRowWord s) : producerCarry (insert s (↑(seamWordSupport b) : Set ℕ)) s = 4 * (wordDefect s b.toNatWord - 1) - (wordPulse s b.toNatWord : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: Inserting the terminal rank into any concrete seam word turns its signed integer subset-sum defect into the producer-aligned affine carry.

declarations.name: producerCarry_insert_seamBelowSupport_eq_middleCoordinate
declarations.signature: theorem producerCarry_insert_seamBelowSupport_eq_middleCoordinate (s : ℕ) (hs : 5 ≤ s) : producerCarry (insert s (↑(seamWordSupport (seamAdjacentCut s hs).below) : Set ℕ)) s = 4 * ((seamAdjacentCut s hs).remainder : ℤ) - ((seamAdjacentCut s hs).belowPulse : ℤ) - 4
declarations.docstring: The middle-producer coordinate is exactly the producer carry of the terminal-augmented below support.

declarations.name: producerCarry_insert_seamAboveSupport_eq_neg_upperCoordinate
declarations.signature: theorem producerCarry_insert_seamAboveSupport_eq_neg_upperCoordinate (s : ℕ) (hs : 5 ≤ s) : producerCarry (insert s (↑(seamWordSupport (seamAdjacentCut s hs).above) : Set ℕ)) s = -((4 * (seamAdjacentCut s hs).overshoot + (seamAdjacentCut s hs).abovePulse + 4 : ℕ) : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: The upper-producer coordinate, with the unavoidable four-unit terminal shift, is the negative producer carry of the terminal-augmented above support.

declarations.signature: theorem finalMiddleCell_neg_two_forces_mod_twenty_one (D : ℕ) (hD13 : 13 ≤ D) (hncarry : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).successorCarries) (hmiddle : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).remainder + (seamPerturbedFamily D (by omega)).gap - (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).belowPulse < (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).terminalWeight) (hright : ∀ s : ℕ, D + 1 ≤ s → seamGreedyWord (s + 1) = (seamGreedyWord s).extend true) (hcell : 4 * ((seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).remainder : ℤ) - ((seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).belowPulse : ℤ) - 4 = -2) : D % 21 ∈ ({8, 11, 14, 17, 20} : Finset ℕ)

declarations.name: finalMiddleCell_neg_two_forces_phase_refinement
declarations.signature: theorem finalMiddleCell_neg_two_forces_phase_refinement (D : ℕ) (hD20 : 20 ≤ D) (hncarry : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).successorCarries) (hmiddle : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).remainder + (seamPerturbedFamily D (by omega)).gap - (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).belowPulse < (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).terminalWeight) (hright : ∀ s : ℕ, D + 1 ≤ s → seamGreedyWord (s + 1) = (seamGreedyWord s).extend true) (hcell : 4 * ((seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).remainder : ℤ) - ((seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).belowPulse : ℤ) - 4 = -2) : D % 21 ∈ ({8, 11, 14, 17, 20} : Finset ℕ) ∧
declarations.docstring: Rank `20` refines the final-middle phase sieve: once it is uniformly present, none of the five surviving `21`-phases can occur together with `D = 8 (mod 10)`, while phases `8` and `11 (mod 21)` also exclude `D = 7 (mod 10)`. These seven exclusions reduce the combined `210`-phase survivor set from fifty classes to forty-three.

declarations.name: finalMiddleCell_neg_two_forces_phase_refinement_through_twentyOne
declarations.signature: theorem finalMiddleCell_neg_two_forces_phase_refinement_through_twentyOne (D : ℕ) (hD26 : 26 ≤ D) (hncarry : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).successorCarries) (hmiddle : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).remainder + (seamPerturbedFamily D (by omega)).gap - (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).belowPulse < (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).terminalWeight) (hright : ∀ s : ℕ, D + 1 ≤ s → seamGreedyWord (s + 1) = (seamGreedyWord s).extend true) (hcell : 4 * ((seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).remainder : ℤ) - ((seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).belowPulse : ℤ) - 4 = -2) : D % 21 ∈ ({11, 14, 17, 20} : Finset ℕ) ∧
declarations.docstring: The forced rank `21` removes the entire phase `D = 8 (mod 21)`. Together with the rank-`20` sieve, this leaves thirty-five classes modulo `210`: four surviving `21`-phases, none paired with `D = 8 (mod 10)`, and the phase `11 (mod 21)` also not paired with `D = 7 (mod 10)`.

declarations.name: finalMiddleCell_neg_two_forces_phase_refinement_through_twentySix
declarations.signature: theorem finalMiddleCell_neg_two_forces_phase_refinement_through_twentySix (D : ℕ) (hD27 : 27 ≤ D) (hncarry : ¬ (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).successorCarries) (hmiddle : 4 * (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).remainder + (seamPerturbedFamily D (by omega)).gap - (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).belowPulse < (seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).terminalWeight) (hright : ∀ s : ℕ, D + 1 ≤ s → seamGreedyWord (s + 1) = (seamGreedyWord s).extend true) (hcell : 4 * ((seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).remainder : ℤ) - ((seamAdjacentCut D (by omega)).belowPulse : ℤ) - 4 = -2) : D % 21 ∈ ({11, 14, 17, 20} : Finset ℕ) ∧
