declarations.docstring: Monomial rows with a residual allowed to vary across both rows and columns.

declarations.name: rowReconstructingResidual
declarations.signature: noncomputable def rowReconstructingResidual {d : ℕ} (e : Fin d → ℕ) (z : Fin d → ℂ) : Fin d → Fin d → ℂ
declarations.docstring: A row-dependent residual can reconstruct the ordinary consecutive-power matrix for arbitrary requested exponents.

declarations.name: rowResidualMonomialMatrix_reconstructs_phasePowerMatrix
declarations.signature: theorem rowResidualMonomialMatrix_reconstructs_phasePowerMatrix {d : ℕ} (e : Fin d → ℕ) (z : Fin d → ℂ) (hz : ∀ j, z j ≠ 0) : rowResidualMonomialMatrix e (rowReconstructingResidual e z) z = phasePowerMatrix (fun i : Fin d ↦ i.1) z
declarations.docstring: The explicit row-dependent residual relaxation reconstructs an ordinary Vandermonde-shaped consecutive-power matrix exactly.

declarations.name: norm_rowReconstructingResidual
declarations.signature: theorem norm_rowReconstructingResidual {d : ℕ} (e : Fin d → ℕ) (z : Fin d → ℂ) (hz : ∀ j, ‖z j‖ = 1) : ∀ i j, ‖rowReconstructingResidual e z i j‖ = 1
declarations.docstring: When the pivot phases are unit, every entry of the reconstructing row-dependent residual is also unit.

declarations.name: rowReconstruction_zero_row_one
declarations.signature: theorem rowReconstruction_zero_row_one {d : ℕ} (e : Fin d → ℕ) (z : Fin d → ℂ) (hz : ∀ j, z j ≠ 0) (i : Fin d) (hi : i.1 = 0) : ∀ j, rowResidualMonomialMatrix e (rowReconstructingResidual e z) z i j = 1
declarations.docstring: The reconstructed zeroth row is identically `1`. Thus even allowing row-dependent unit residuals does not let a fixed-rank nonzero minor exclude the locked affine target without an additional arithmetic coupling law.

declarations.name: depth26Word
declarations.docstring: Exact depth-26 cylinder word. Exponents `2,3,6,7,14,20` form the common prefix; exponents `21,...,26` encode `35-k` in big-endian order.

declarations.name: depth26EntryCheck
declarations.docstring: Executable strip and terminal check for the two carries used below.

declarations.name: depth26EntryCheck_eq_true
declarations.signature: theorem depth26EntryCheck_eq_true {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hk2 : k ≤ 2) : depth26EntryCheck k = true

declarations.name: depth26Word_carry_bounds
declarations.signature: theorem depth26Word_carry_bounds {k n : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hk2 : k ≤ 2) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hn26 : n ≤ 26) : (1 : ℤ) ≤ wordCarry (depth26Word k) (n - 1) ∧ wordCarry (depth26Word k) (n - 1) ≤ halfStripBound n

declarations.name: depth26Word_terminal
declarations.signature: theorem depth26Word_terminal {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hk2 : k ≤ 2) : wordCarry (depth26Word k) 25 = (k : ℤ)

declarations.name: depth26FirstTwo
declarations.docstring: Exact selected subwindow on carries one and two at depth 26.

declarations.name: depth26FirstTwo_selectedRowCoeff_eq_one
declarations.signature: theorem depth26FirstTwo_selectedRowCoeff_eq_one (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hk2 : k ≤ 2) : selectedRowCoeff depth26FirstTwo k = 1
declarations.docstring: Both selected words have the actual common proper coefficient one at row 27.

declarations.name: depth27FirstTwo
declarations.docstring: The actual fixed-coefficient constructor step from depth 26 to 27, restricted to the same two target carries.

declarations.name: depth27FirstTwo_hasRewindRestrictionAt
declarations.docstring: The live constructor records the genuine one-row rewind history `[1]`.

declarations.name: depth26RightAncestor_bit14_true
declarations.signature: theorem depth26RightAncestor_bit14_true (hpos : 1 ≤ rewind [1] 1 + 1) (hbound : rewind [1] 1 + 1 ≤ 2) : restrictWord (by omega : 14 ≤ 26) (depth26FirstTwo.word (rewind [1] 1 + 1) hpos hbound) (Fin.last 14) = true
declarations.docstring: Executable marked-bit fact: the right adjacent ancestor still contains exponent 14.

declarations.name: depth26FirstTwo_not_rewindBaseHalfDivisorBoundaryPairAt
declarations.signature: theorem depth26FirstTwo_not_rewindBaseHalfDivisorBoundaryPairAt (a : HalfWord 13) : ¬ RewindBaseHalfDivisorBoundaryPairAt depth26FirstTwo (by omega : 13 + 1 ≤ 26) [1] a
declarations.docstring: Hence no common depth-13 parent can make the adjacent ancestors the required true/false extensions through marked half divisor 14.

declarations.name: depth27_actualRewindSeam_not_boundaryPair
declarations.signature: theorem depth27_actualRewindSeam_not_boundaryPair : depth27FirstTwo.HasRewindRestrictionAt depth26FirstTwo (by omega : 26 ≤ 27) [1] ∧ IsSeamPair [1] 2 ∧ 2 ≤ denom [1] ∧ 27 + 1 = 2 * (13 + 1) ∧ ¬ ∃ a : HalfWord 13, RewindBaseHalfDivisorBoundaryPairAt depth26FirstTwo (by omega : 13 + 1 ≤ 26) [1] a
declarations.docstring: Full concrete falsifier. This includes an actual explicit selected window step, exact rewind provenance, the width hypothesis, the scalar seam, and the doubled-row identity. Only the large protected-window buffer used by the cofinal consumer is intentionally absent.

declarations.name: supportCoeff_eq_of_restriction_at_halfDivisor
declarations.signature: theorem supportCoeff_eq_of_restriction_at_halfDivisor {K M : ℕ} (hKM : K + 1 ≤ M) (hMlt : M < 2 * (K + 1)) (w : HalfWord M) (b : HalfWord (K + 1)) (hrestrict : restrictWord hKM w = b) : supportCoeff (wordSupport w) (2 * (K + 1)) = supportCoeff (wordSupport b) (2 * (K + 1))
declarations.docstring: Restricting a depth-`M` word through the half divisor `K+1` preserves its coefficient at row `2(K+1)`, provided `M` is still below that row. Every proper divisor of `2(K+1)` is at most `K+1`; the only larger divisor is the row itself, which is absent from both finite words.

declarations.name: RewindBaseHalfDivisorBoundaryPairAt
declarations.signature: def RewindBaseHalfDivisorBoundaryPairAt {K M R₀ : ℕ} (W₀ : SelectedHalfWindow M R₀) (hKM : K + 1 ≤ M) (cs : List ℕ) (a : HalfWord K) : Prop
declarations.docstring: The two adjacent rewind ancestors may live at any base depth `M` between the half divisor `K+1` and the produced row. Their restrictions through `K+1` are the two opposite terminal children of one common depth-`K` word. The proof witnesses also certify that both indices lie in the base window.

declarations.name: rewindBaseUnitDropAt_of_halfDivisorBoundaryPair
declarations.signature: theorem rewindBaseUnitDropAt_of_halfDivisorBoundaryPair {K M R₀ : ℕ} (W₀ : SelectedHalfWindow M R₀) (hKM : K + 1 ≤ M) (hMlt : M < 2 * (K + 1)) (cs : List ℕ) (a : HalfWord K) (hpair : RewindBaseHalfDivisorBoundaryPairAt W₀ hKM cs a) : RewindBaseUnitDropAt W₀ (2 * (K + 1)) cs (supportCoeff (wordSupport (extendHalfWord a false)) (2 * (K + 1)))
declarations.docstring: A literal half-divisor boundary pair supplies exactly the operational unit-drop profile at the doubled row inspected by that half divisor.

declarations.name: protectedEvenSeamRealizedAt_succ_of_rewindHalfDivisorBoundaryPair
declarations.signature: theorem protectedEvenSeamRealizedAt_succ_of_rewindHalfDivisorBoundaryPair {K M N R₀ R S : ℕ} (W₀ : SelectedHalfWindow M R₀) (W : SelectedHalfWindow N R) (hKM : K + 1 ≤ M) (hMlt : M < 2 * (K + 1)) (hMN : M ≤ N) (hhalf : (N + 1) / 2 ≤ M) (hrow : N + 1 = 2 * (K + 1)) (cs : List ℕ) (a : HalfWord K) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hwidth : R ≤ denom cs) (hprov : W.HasRewindRestrictionAt W₀ hMN cs) (hseam : IsSeamPair cs R) (hSstrip : S ≤ halfStripBound (N + 1)) (h27 : 27 ≤ S) (hbuffer : S + (supportCoeff (wordSupport (extendHalfWord a false)) (N + 1) + 1) ≤ 2 * R)
declarations.docstring: Full operational fan-in. If the produced row is exactly twice the marked half divisor, the boundary pair discharges the only extra semantic hypothesis of the rewind-seam realization theorem.

declarations.name: protectedEvenSeamRealizedAt_succ_of_fullStrip_rewindHalfDivisorBoundaryPair
declarations.signature: theorem protectedEvenSeamRealizedAt_succ_of_fullStrip_rewindHalfDivisorBoundaryPair {K M N R₀ : ℕ} (W₀ : SelectedHalfWindow M R₀) (W : SelectedHalfWindow N (halfStripBound N)) (hKM : K + 1 ≤ M) (hMlt : M < 2 * (K + 1)) (hMN : M ≤ N) (hhalf : (N + 1) / 2 ≤ M) (hrow : N + 1 = 2 * (K + 1)) (cs : List ℕ) (a : HalfWord K) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hwidth : halfStripBound N ≤ denom cs) (hprov : W.HasRewindRestrictionAt W₀ hMN cs) (hseam : IsSeamPair cs (halfStripBound N)) (h27 : 27 ≤ halfStripBound (N + 1)) (hpair : RewindBaseHalfDivisorBoundaryPairAt W₀ hKM cs a) : ProtectedEvenSeamRealizedAt (N + 1) (seamCut cs : ℤ) (supportCoeff (wordSupport (extendHalfWord a false)) (N + 1) : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: Full-strip specialization. The existing divisor envelope supplies the buffer once the literal half-divisor boundary pair is identified.

declarations.name: seamCut
declarations.docstring: Last target carry which rewinds to the left ancestor.

declarations.name: phase_lt_denom
declarations.signature: theorem phase_lt_denom (cs : List ℕ) : phase cs < denom cs

declarations.name: seamCut_pos
declarations.signature: theorem seamCut_pos (cs : List ℕ) : 1 ≤ seamCut cs

declarations.name: seamCut_lt_rightEndpoint
declarations.signature: theorem seamCut_lt_rightEndpoint (cs : List ℕ) {B : ℕ} (hB : 1 ≤ B) (hwidth : B ≤ denom cs) (hseam : IsSeamPair cs B) : seamCut cs < B
declarations.docstring: A genuine seam pair has a nonempty right side inside `[1,B]`.

declarations.name: rewind_eq_right_iff_seamCut_lt

declarations.docstring: Inside a seam pair, every target strictly after `seamCut` rewinds to the right adjacent ancestor.

declarations.name: supportCoeff_nextRow_eq_of_restriction
declarations.signature: theorem supportCoeff_nextRow_eq_of_restriction {M N : ℕ} (hMN : M ≤ N) (hhalf : (N + 1) / 2 ≤ M) (a : HalfWord N) (b : HalfWord M) (hrestrict : restrictWord hMN a = b) : supportCoeff (wordSupport a) (N + 1) = supportCoeff (wordSupport b) (N + 1)
declarations.docstring: Equality of words after restriction beyond half-depth preserves the next-row proper-divisor coefficient.

declarations.name: RewindBaseUnitDropAt
declarations.signature: def RewindBaseUnitDropAt {M R₀ : ℕ} (W₀ : SelectedHalfWindow M R₀) (n : ℕ) (cs : List ℕ) (c : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: The sole object-level datum not contained in a scalar rewind seam: at the row being produced, the left adjacent base ancestor has coefficient `c+1` and the right adjacent base ancestor has coefficient `c`.

declarations.name: nextRow_profile_of_rewindSeam
declarations.signature: theorem nextRow_profile_of_rewindSeam {M N R₀ R c : ℕ} (W₀ : SelectedHalfWindow M R₀) (W : SelectedHalfWindow N R) (hMN : M ≤ N) (hhalf : (N + 1) / 2 ≤ M) (cs : List ℕ) (hwidth : R ≤ denom cs) (hprov : W.HasRewindRestrictionAt W₀ hMN cs) (hseam : IsSeamPair cs R) (hbaseProfile : RewindBaseUnitDropAt W₀ (N + 1) cs c) : ∀ h (hh : 1 ≤ h) (hhR : h ≤ R), supportCoeff (wordSupport (W.word h hh hhR)) (N + 1) = if h ≤ seamCut cs then c + 1 else c
declarations.docstring: Exact contribution of rewind provenance in the seam branch. It turns a two-coefficient fact about the adjacent base ancestors into the piecewise coefficient profile of the live selected window.

declarations.name: halfTerminalReachable_succ_of_selectedParent
declarations.signature: theorem halfTerminalReachable_succ_of_selectedParent {N R h q C : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (W : SelectedHalfWindow N R) (hh : 1 ≤ h) (hhR : h ≤ R) (hcoeff : supportCoeff (wordSupport (W.word h hh hhR)) (N + 1) = C) (β : Bool) (hq : (q : ℤ) = 2 * (h : ℤ) - (C : ℤ) - (if β then 1 else 0)) (hqpos : 1 ≤ q) (hqstrip : q ≤ halfStripBound (N + 1)) : HalfTerminalReachable (N + 1) q
declarations.docstring: One chosen parent word realizes either Boolean child at the next row.

declarations.name: protectedEvenSeamRealizedAt_succ_of_profile
declarations.signature: theorem protectedEvenSeamRealizedAt_succ_of_profile {N R S δ c : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (W : SelectedHalfWindow N R) (hSstrip : S ≤ halfStripBound (N + 1)) (h27 : 27 ≤ S) (hbuffer : S + (c + 1) ≤ 2 * R) (hprofile : ∀ h (hh : 1 ≤ h) (hhR : h ≤ R), supportCoeff (wordSupport (W.word h hh hhR)) (N + 1) = if h ≤ δ then c + 1 else c) : ProtectedEvenSeamRealizedAt (N + 1) (δ : ℤ) (c : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: A two-valued next-row coefficient profile realizes the exact scalar one-hole seam at the next depth. The buffer is the usual selected-window headroom, with `c+1` the larger of the two coefficients.

declarations.name: protectedEvenSeamRealizedAt_succ_of_selectedRowCoeff_threshold
declarations.signature: theorem protectedEvenSeamRealizedAt_succ_of_selectedRowCoeff_threshold {N R S δ c : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (W : SelectedHalfWindow N R) (hSstrip : S ≤ halfStripBound (N + 1)) (h27 : 27 ≤ S) (hbuffer : S + (c + 1) ≤ 2 * R) (hprofile : ∀ h (_hh : 1 ≤ h) (_hhR : h ≤ R), selectedRowCoeff W h = if h ≤ δ then ((c + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) else (c : ℤ)) : ProtectedEvenSeamRealizedAt (N + 1) (δ : ℤ) (c : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: Solver-facing threshold form in the existing `selectedRowCoeff` coordinate. This is the direct executable fan-in from a two-cylinder selected window to the localized seam consumer.

declarations.name: protectedEvenSeamRealizedAt_succ_of_rewindSeam
declarations.signature: theorem protectedEvenSeamRealizedAt_succ_of_rewindSeam {M N R₀ R S c : ℕ} (W₀ : SelectedHalfWindow M R₀) (W : SelectedHalfWindow N R) (hMN : M ≤ N) (hhalf : (N + 1) / 2 ≤ M) (cs : List ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hwidth : R ≤ denom cs) (hprov : W.HasRewindRestrictionAt W₀ hMN cs) (hseam : IsSeamPair cs R) (hSstrip : S ≤ halfStripBound (N + 1)) (h27 : 27 ≤ S) (hbuffer : S + (c + 1) ≤ 2 * R) (hbaseProfile : RewindBaseUnitDropAt W₀ (N + 1) cs c) : ProtectedEvenSeamRealizedAt (N + 1) (seamCut cs : ℤ) (c : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: Operational seam fan-in. Exact rewind provenance plus an actual scalar seam pair produces a localized realized seam one row later, provided the adjacent base ancestors have the required unit-drop next-row coefficient profile. No global `IsCanonicalEvenSeam` equivalence is needed.

declarations.name: protectedEvenSeamRealizedAt_succ_of_fullStrip_rewindSeam
declarations.signature: theorem protectedEvenSeamRealizedAt_succ_of_fullStrip_rewindSeam {M N R₀ c : ℕ} (W₀ : SelectedHalfWindow M R₀) (W : SelectedHalfWindow N (halfStripBound N)) (hMN : M ≤ N) (hhalf : (N + 1) / 2 ≤ M) (cs : List ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hwidth : halfStripBound N ≤ denom cs) (hprov : W.HasRewindRestrictionAt W₀ hMN cs) (hseam : IsSeamPair cs (halfStripBound N)) (h27 : 27 ≤ halfStripBound (N + 1)) (hbaseProfile : RewindBaseUnitDropAt W₀ (N + 1) cs c) : ProtectedEvenSeamRealizedAt (N + 1) (seamCut cs : ℤ) (c : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: Full-strip specialization: the standard divisor envelope discharges the buffer automatically. Thus the only semantic input not already present in `HasRewindRestrictionAt + IsSeamPair` is the unit coefficient drop between the two adjacent base ancestors.

declarations.name: wordSuffixNumeral

declarations.docstring: Binary value of the indicated terminal word suffix.

declarations.name: HasSuffixCylinderAt
declarations.signature: noncomputable def HasSuffixCylinderAt {M N R : ℕ} (W : SelectedHalfWindow N R) (hMN : M ≤ N) (endpoint : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: A selected window shares one prefix, while its suffix numerals are the consecutive values `endpoint - k` indexed by terminal carry `k`.

declarations.name: supportSuffixNumeral_congr_on
declarations.signature: theorem supportSuffixNumeral_congr_on (A B : Set ℕ) [DecidablePred (· ∈ A)] [DecidablePred (· ∈ B)] (M L : ℕ) (hbits : ∀ j : ℕ, j < L → (M + j + 1 ∈ A ↔ M + j + 1 ∈ B)) : supportSuffixNumeral A M L = supportSuffixNumeral B M L
declarations.docstring: A support suffix numeral depends only on membership in the suffix interval that it reads.

declarations.name: supportSuffixNumeral_extendHalfWord
declarations.signature: theorem supportSuffixNumeral_extendHalfWord {M N : ℕ} (hMN : M ≤ N) (a : HalfWord N) (β : Bool) : wordSuffixNumeral (extendHalfWord a β) M (N + 1 - M) = 2 * wordSuffixNumeral a M (N - M) + if β then 1 else 0

declarations.name: depth18Word_suffix_thirteen
declarations.signature: theorem depth18Word_suffix_thirteen {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hk12 : k ≤ 12) : wordSuffixNumeral (depth18Word k) 13 5 + k = 17
declarations.docstring: The finite depth-18 cylinder has common endpoint 17 after its common depth-13 prefix is removed.

declarations.name: depth18SelectedHalfWindow_hasSuffixCylinderAt_thirteen
declarations.docstring: Exact cylinder certificate for the existing certified induction base.

declarations.name: depth18SelectedHalfWindow_endpoint_covers_strip
declarations.docstring: The depth-18 endpoint covers its complete certified strip.

declarations.name: SelectedHalfWindow.word_stepExplicit
declarations.signature: theorem SelectedHalfWindow.word_stepExplicit {N R S C : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (W : SelectedHalfWindow N R) (hSstrip : S ≤ halfStripBound (N + 1)) (hp_common : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ R → selectedRowCoeff W k = C) (hbuffer : S + C ≤ 2 * R) (q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hqS : q ≤ S) : (W.stepExplicit hN hSstrip hp_common hbuffer).word q hq hqS = extendHalfWord (W.word (parent C q) (explicitParent_pos hq) (explicitParent_le hqS hbuffer)) (decide (explicitParentBitZ C q = 1))
declarations.docstring: The public selected successor really is the canonical parent word with the explicit parity bit appended.

declarations.name: explicitParent_bitNat_recurrence
declarations.signature: theorem explicitParent_bitNat_recurrence (C q : ℕ) : q + C + (if decide (explicitParentBitZ C q = 1) then 1 else 0) = 2 * parent C q
declarations.docstring: Natural-number form of the canonical parent/bit recurrence.

declarations.name: SelectedHalfWindow.hasSuffixCylinderAt_stepExplicit
declarations.signature: theorem SelectedHalfWindow.hasSuffixCylinderAt_stepExplicit {M N R S C E : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (W : SelectedHalfWindow N R) (hMN : M ≤ N) (hSstrip : S ≤ halfStripBound (N + 1)) (hp_common : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ R → selectedRowCoeff W k = C) (hbuffer : S + C ≤ 2 * R) (hcyl : HasSuffixCylinderAt W hMN E) (hRE : R ≤ E) : HasSuffixCylinderAt (W.stepExplicit hN hSstrip hp_common hbuffer) (hMN.trans (Nat.le_succ N)) (2 * E - C) ∧ S ≤ 2 * E - C

declarations.name: depth27SelectedHalfWindow_hasSuffixCylinderAt_thirteen

declarations.name: totient_mul_prime_cocycle
declarations.signature: theorem totient_mul_prime_cocycle {p m : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : Nat.totient (p * m) = (p - 1) * Nat.totient m + if p ∣ m then Nat.totient m else 0
declarations.docstring: Exact prime-dilation cocycle for Euler's totient. The second summand is the weighted correction which square localization removes on a finite horizon.

declarations.name: normalizedTotient
declarations.docstring: Euler's totient in the usual rational normalization. The field convention gives `normalizedTotient 0 = 0`.

declarations.name: normalizedTotient_mul_prime_cocycle
declarations.signature: theorem normalizedTotient_mul_prime_cocycle {p m : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : normalizedTotient (p * m) = (((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) / p + if p ∣ m then (1 : ℚ) / p else 0) * normalizedTotient m
declarations.docstring: Exact prime-dilation cocycle after normalization. The right-hand side is linear in the single normalized value at `m`; the divisibility correction is absorbed into its rational coefficient.

declarations.name: sq_normalizedTotient_linearForm_eq_pairwise
declarations.signature: theorem sq_normalizedTotient_linearForm_eq_pairwise {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (E : Finset ι) (c : ι → ℚ) (n : ι → ℕ) : (∑ i ∈ E, c i * normalizedTotient (n i)) ^ 2 = ∑ i ∈ E, ∑ j ∈ E, (c i * c j) * (normalizedTotient (n i) * normalizedTotient (n j))
declarations.docstring: The algebraic second moment of a finite normalized-totient statistic closes at correlation order two: its exact expansion contains only products `g(n i) * g(n j)`, never a triple product.

declarations.name: affineTwoCube_eq_main_add_edges
declarations.signature: theorem affineTwoCube_eq_main_add_edges (x a b g₀ g₁ g₂ g₁₂ : ℚ) : x * g₀ - (x + a) * g₁ - (x + b) * g₂ + (x + a + b) * g₁₂ = x * (g₀ - g₁ - g₂ + g₁₂) + a * (g₁₂ - g₁) + b * (g₁₂ - g₂)
declarations.docstring: The affine weights in the smallest two-dimensional cube separate into the main alternating term and two edge differences without raising correlation order.

declarations.name: cube_four_terms_distinctTriple_part
declarations.signature: theorem cube_four_terms_distinctTriple_part (u₀ u₁ u₂ u₁₂ : ℚ) : (u₀ + u₁ + u₂ + u₁₂) ^ 3 - (u₀ ^ 3 + u₁ ^ 3 + u₂ ^ 3 + u₁₂ ^ 3) - 3 * (u₀ ^ 2 * (u₁ + u₂ + u₁₂) + u₁ ^ 2 * (u₀ + u₂ + u₁₂) + u₂ ^ 2 * (u₀ + u₁ + u₁₂) + u₁₂ ^ 2 * (u₀ + u₁ + u₂)) = 6 * (u₀ * u₁ * u₂ + u₀ * u₁ * u₁₂ + u₀ * u₂ * u₁₂ + u₁ * u₂ * u₁₂)
declarations.docstring: After removing pure cubes and repeated-index terms, the cube of a four-term linear statistic retains exactly the four distinct-index triple products. Any estimate based on this cubic expansion must therefore account for those triple products; the identity itself supplies no estimate.

declarations.name: affineTwoCube_distinctTriple_part
declarations.signature: theorem affineTwoCube_distinctTriple_part (x a b g₀ g₁ g₂ g₁₂ : ℚ) : 6 * ((x * g₀) * (-(x + a) * g₁) * (-(x + b) * g₂) + (x * g₀) * (-(x + a) * g₁) * ((x + a + b) * g₁₂) + (x * g₀) * (-(x + b) * g₂) * ((x + a + b) * g₁₂) + (-(x + a) * g₁) * (-(x + b) * g₂) * ((x + a + b) * g₁₂)) = 6 * (x * (x + a) * (x + b) * g₀ * g₁ * g₂ - x * (x + a) * (x + a + b) * g₀ * g₁ * g₁₂ - x * (x + b) * (x + a + b) * g₀ * g₂ * g₁₂ + (x + a) * (x + b) * (x + a + b) * g₁ * g₂ * g₁₂)
declarations.docstring: The distinct-shift cubic terms for the affine two-cube have the displayed coefficients, which may vanish for special parameter choices. The sign pattern comes from the two negative cube vertices.

declarations.name: totient_dilation_clean_of_square_residue
declarations.signature: theorem totient_dilation_clean_of_square_residue {p A a t h : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hclean : ¬p ∣ a + h) : Nat.totient (A + p * (a + p * t) + p * h - A) = (p - 1) * Nat.totient (a + p * t + h)
declarations.docstring: General square-witness form. The equality `n = A + p * (a + p*t)` is the quotient-bearing form of `n ≡ A + p*a [MOD p^2]`. If `p ∤ a+h`, the cofactor at shift `h` is clean.

declarations.name: totient_dilation_clean_of_square_witness
declarations.signature: theorem totient_dilation_clean_of_square_witness {p A t h : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hh : 0 < h) (hhp : h < p) : Nat.totient (A + p ^ 2 * t + p * h - A) = (p - 1) * Nat.totient (p * t + h)
declarations.docstring: Canonical anchor residue `a = 0`. The hypotheses `0 < h < p` make the whole horizon `1 ≤ h ≤ J < p` clean after imposing `n = A + p^2*t`.

declarations.name: exists_square_witness_of_modEq
declarations.signature: theorem exists_square_witness_of_modEq {p r n : ℕ} (hrn : r ≤ n) (hmod : n ≡ r [MOD p ^ 2]) : ∃ t : ℕ, n = r + p ^ 2 * t
declarations.docstring: An ordered square congruence has the quotient witness used by the clean dilation theorem.

declarations.name: totient_dilation_clean_of_square_modEq
declarations.signature: theorem totient_dilation_clean_of_square_modEq {p A a n h : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hresidue : A + p * a ≤ n) (hmod : n ≡ A + p * a [MOD p ^ 2]) (hclean : ¬p ∣ a + h) : ∃ t : ℕ, n = A + p * (a + p * t) ∧ Nat.totient (n + p * h - A) = (p - 1) * Nat.totient (a + p * t + h)
declarations.docstring: Direct `Nat.ModEq` adapter: once the CRT representative is at least its target residue, the congruence produces a cofactor and the correction-free totient identity at every clean shift.

declarations.name: pairwise_coprime_prime_squares
declarations.signature: theorem pairwise_coprime_prime_squares {ι : Type*} {E : Finset ι} {p : ι → ℕ} (hprime : ∀ i ∈ E, (p i).Prime) (hinj : Set.InjOn p (E : Set ι)) : Set.Pairwise (E : Set ι) (fun i j => Nat.Coprime (p i ^ 2) (p j ^ 2))
declarations.docstring: Distinct prime labels have pairwise-coprime square moduli.

declarations.name: exists_squareCRT_base
declarations.signature: theorem exists_squareCRT_base {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (E : Finset ι) (p A a : ι → ℕ) (hmod : ∀ i ∈ E, p i ^ 2 ≠ 0) (hcop : Set.Pairwise (E : Set ι) (fun i j => Nat.Coprime (p i ^ 2) (p j ^ 2))) : ∃ n : ℕ, n < ∏ i ∈ E, p i ^ 2 ∧ ∀ i ∈ E, n ≡ A i + p i * a i [MOD p i ^ 2]
declarations.docstring: A finite family of pairwise-coprime square congruences has a simultaneous representative strictly below the product of the square moduli.

declarations.name: exists_squareCRT_base_of_distinct_primes
declarations.signature: theorem exists_squareCRT_base_of_distinct_primes {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (E : Finset ι) (p A a : ι → ℕ) (hprime : ∀ i ∈ E, (p i).Prime) (hinj : Set.InjOn p (E : Set ι)) : ∃ n : ℕ, n < ∏ i ∈ E, p i ^ 2 ∧ ∀ i ∈ E, n ≡ A i + p i * a i [MOD p i ^ 2]
declarations.docstring: Prime-specialized square CRT, including the least-base bound.

declarations.name: exists_large_squareCRT_base
declarations.signature: theorem exists_large_squareCRT_base {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (E : Finset ι) (p A a : ι → ℕ) (B : ℕ) (hmod : ∀ i ∈ E, p i ^ 2 ≠ 0) (hcop : Set.Pairwise (E : Set ι) (fun i j => Nat.Coprime (p i ^ 2) (p j ^ 2))) : ∃ n : ℕ, B < n ∧ n < (∏ i ∈ E, p i ^ 2) * (B + 2) ∧ ∀ i ∈ E, n ≡ A i + p i * a i [MOD p i ^ 2]
declarations.docstring: The least CRT representative can be lifted above any prescribed anchor floor at a cost of less than one additional block of `B+1` square moduli. This is the exact finite-family version of the least-admissible-base ledger.

declarations.name: exists_squareCRT_clean_totient_family
declarations.signature: theorem exists_squareCRT_clean_totient_family {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (E : Finset ι) (p A a : ι → ℕ) (hprime : ∀ i ∈ E, (p i).Prime) (hinj : Set.InjOn p (E : Set ι)) : ∃ n : ℕ, n < (∏ i ∈ E, p i ^ 2) * (E.sup (fun i => A i + p i * a i) + 2) ∧ ∀ i ∈ E, ∀ h : ℕ, ¬p i ∣ a i + h → ∃ t : ℕ, n = A i + p i * (a i + p i * t) ∧ Nat.totient (n + p i * h - A i) = (p i - 1) * Nat.totient (a i + p i * t + h)
declarations.docstring: Simultaneous square-CRT correction suppression on a finite family. One common base works at every label and every shift whose chosen cofactor residue avoids zero modulo the corresponding prime.

declarations.name: exists_squareCRT_clean_horizon
declarations.signature: theorem exists_squareCRT_clean_horizon {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (E : Finset ι) (p A : ι → ℕ) (J : ℕ) (hprime : ∀ i ∈ E, (p i).Prime) (hinj : Set.InjOn p (E : Set ι)) (horizon : ∀ i ∈ E, J < p i) : ∃ n : ℕ, n < (∏ i ∈ E, p i ^ 2) * (E.sup A + 2) ∧ ∀ i ∈ E, ∀ h : ℕ, 0 < h → h ≤ J → ∃ t : ℕ, n = A i + p i ^ 2 * t ∧ Nat.totient (n + p i * h - A i) = (p i - 1) * Nat.totient (p i * t + h)
declarations.docstring: Canonical finite-horizon corollary. If every distinct construction prime exceeds `J`, the residue choice `a = 0` removes every totient dilation correction simultaneously for all `1 ≤ h ≤ J`.

declarations.name: alternating_powerset_sum_eq_zero_of_insert_invariant
declarations.signature: theorem alternating_powerset_sum_eq_zero_of_insert_invariant {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {s : Finset ι} {i : ι} (hi : i ∉ s) (f : Finset ι → ℤ) (hinv : ∀ t ∈ s.powerset, f (insert i t) = f t) : ∑ t ∈ (insert i s).powerset, (-1 : ℤ) ^ t.card * f t = 0
declarations.docstring: Alternating Boolean-cube terms cancel exactly when insertion of one coordinate does not change the underlying term. This is the algebraic core of the first-`k` Hilbert-cube cancellation, separated from all totient and CRT hypotheses.

declarations.name: actualOneCubeCoeff
declarations.signature: def actualOneCubeCoeff (n r0 r1 : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: One-dimensional actual-totient cube coefficient.

declarations.name: actualOneCubeCoeff_cast_eq_weighted_normalizedTotient
declarations.signature: theorem actualOneCubeCoeff_cast_eq_weighted_normalizedTotient {n r0 r1 : ℕ} (h0 : 0 < n + r0) (h1 : 0 < n + r1) : (actualOneCubeCoeff n r0 r1 : ℚ) = (n + r0 : ℕ) * normalizedTotient (n + r0) - (n + r1 : ℕ) * normalizedTotient (n + r1)
declarations.docstring: A raw one-cube coefficient is exactly the corresponding affine-weighted normalized-totient coefficient. The positivity assumptions only discharge the two denominators introduced by `normalizedTotient`.

declarations.name: exists_gt_actualOneCubeCoeff_ne_zero_in_squareClass
declarations.signature: theorem exists_gt_actualOneCubeCoeff_ne_zero_in_squareClass (B : ℕ) : ∃ n > B, n ≡ 8 [MOD 9] ∧ actualOneCubeCoeff n 0 1 ≠ 0
declarations.docstring: Adjacent totients separate arbitrarily far out inside the fixed prime-square class `n ≡ -1 (mod 3²)`. Dirichlet supplies a prime `n` in that class. Then `φ(n) = n - 1` is not divisible by `3`, whereas `3² ∣ n + 1` forces `φ(3²) = 6 ∣ φ(n + 1)`. This is an infinite square-class separation result, rather than a single finite witness.

declarations.name: exists_gt_weightedNormalizedTotient_ne_zero_in_squareClass
declarations.signature: theorem exists_gt_weightedNormalizedTotient_ne_zero_in_squareClass (B : ℕ) : ∃ n > B, n ≡ 8 [MOD 9] ∧ (n : ℚ) * normalizedTotient n - (n + 1 : ℕ) * normalizedTotient (n + 1) ≠ 0
declarations.docstring: The same square-class separation in normalized coordinates. Affine weights recover the raw totient coefficient exactly, so no correlation hypothesis is needed. The free choice of `n` supplies neither a prescribed square-CRT base nor a residue gap at the `periodLcm (2 ^ a)` height.

declarations.name: squareCRT_clean_block_can_vanish
declarations.signature: theorem squareCRT_clean_block_can_vanish : (13 : ℕ).Prime ∧ (5 : ℕ).Prime ∧ 52 ≡ 52 [MOD 13 ^ 2] ∧ 52 ≡ 2 [MOD 5 ^ 2] ∧ actualOneCubeCoeff 52 13 13 = 0 ∧ actualOneCubeCoeff 52 26 18 = 0
declarations.docstring: A clean square-localized cube need not separate: the returned minimal `k = 1`, `J = 2` model has both finite coefficients equal to zero.

declarations.name: squareCRT_vanishing_countermodel_is_clean
declarations.signature: theorem squareCRT_vanishing_countermodel_is_clean : Nat.totient (13 * (4 + 1)) = (13 - 1) * Nat.totient (4 + 1) ∧ Nat.totient (5 * (12 + 1)) = (5 - 1) * Nat.totient (12 + 1) ∧ Nat.totient (13 * (4 + 2)) = (13 - 1) * Nat.totient (4 + 2) ∧ Nat.totient (5 * (12 + 2)) = (5 - 1) * Nat.totient (12 + 2)
declarations.docstring: The vanishing witness is genuinely correction-free at both vertices and both controlled shifts, not merely an equality of unrelated totient values.

declarations.name: squareCRT_clean_block_can_be_nonzero
declarations.signature: theorem squareCRT_clean_block_can_be_nonzero : (3 : ℕ).Prime ∧ (5 : ℕ).Prime ∧ 27 ≡ 0 [MOD 3 ^ 2] ∧ 27 ≡ 2 [MOD 5 ^ 2] ∧ actualOneCubeCoeff 27 3 3 = 0 ∧ actualOneCubeCoeff 27 6 8 = -4
declarations.docstring: Correction suppression is not identically trivial: a nearby clean cube has a nonzero second coefficient.

declarations.name: squareCRT_nonzero_countermodel_is_clean
declarations.signature: theorem squareCRT_nonzero_countermodel_is_clean : Nat.totient (3 * (9 + 1)) = (3 - 1) * Nat.totient (9 + 1) ∧ Nat.totient (5 * (5 + 1)) = (5 - 1) * Nat.totient (5 + 1) ∧ Nat.totient (3 * (9 + 2)) = (3 - 1) * Nat.totient (9 + 2) ∧ Nat.totient (5 * (5 + 2)) = (5 - 1) * Nat.totient (5 + 2)
declarations.docstring: The nonzero witness is also clean at both vertices and both shifts.

declarations.name: mobiusSquarePartialRat
declarations.docstring: Executable rational partial state `1/2 + ∑_{1 ≤ d ≤ D} μ(d)/(2^d-1)^2`.

declarations.name: lambertProjectedDiagonalRat
declarations.docstring: Rational centre for the actual diagonal.

declarations.name: rat_den_int_add_mul
declarations.signature: theorem rat_den_int_add_mul (z c : ℤ) (x : ℚ) : ((z : ℚ) + (c : ℚ) * x).den = x.den / Nat.gcd x.den c.natAbs
declarations.docstring: Exact reduced-denominator formula for an integral affine image of a rational. Adding the integral offset does not change the denominator, while multiplication cancels exactly the gcd with the scaling integer.

declarations.name: lambertProjectedDiagonalRat_den
declarations.signature: theorem lambertProjectedDiagonalRat_den (H D : ℕ) : (lambertProjectedDiagonalRat H D).den = (mobiusSquarePartialRat D).den / Nat.gcd (mobiusSquarePartialRat D).den (diagonalCoefficient H)
declarations.docstring: Specialisation of `rat_den_int_add_mul` to the canonical direct centre.

declarations.name: lambertProjectedDiagonal
declarations.signature: noncomputable def lambertProjectedDiagonal (H D : ℕ) : ℝ
declarations.docstring: Real display of the exact rational centre.

declarations.name: mobiusSquareTail
declarations.docstring: The omitted signed squared-Mersenne tail, indexed from `D+1`.

declarations.name: lambertSquareComplementBound
declarations.signature: noncomputable def lambertSquareComplementBound (H D : ℕ) : ℝ
declarations.docstring: Sharp elementary radius obtained by comparing every later Mersenne denominator with `2^k (2^(D+1)-1)`.

declarations.name: totientSeries_eq_pnat_half_pow
declarations.signature: theorem totientSeries_eq_pnat_half_pow : totientSeries = ∑' n : ℕ+, (Nat.totient (n : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ (n : ℕ)
declarations.docstring: The local `ℕ` series convention agrees with the ladder's positive-index convention.

declarations.name: mobius_square_series_eq_partial_add_tail
declarations.signature: theorem mobius_square_series_eq_partial_add_tail (D : ℕ) : 1 / 2 + ∑' d : ℕ+, ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius (d : ℕ) : ℤ) : ℝ) / (((2 : ℝ) ^ (d : ℕ) - 1) ^ 2) = (mobiusSquarePartialRat D : ℝ) + mobiusSquareTail D
declarations.docstring: The full Möbius-square series splits into the exact rational prefix and the shifted tail.

declarations.name: scaleDiagonalTailDifference_sub_lambertProjectedDiagonal
declarations.signature: theorem scaleDiagonalTailDifference_sub_lambertProjectedDiagonal (H D : ℕ) : scaleDiagonalTailDifference H - lambertProjectedDiagonal H D = (diagonalCoefficient H : ℝ) * mobiusSquareTail D
declarations.docstring: Exact direct projection: no residue split and no `2H ≤ D` condition.

declarations.name: mersenne_shift_lower_bound
declarations.signature: theorem mersenne_shift_lower_bound (D k : ℕ) : (2 : ℝ) ^ k * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (D + 1) - 1) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (D + 1 + k) - 1
declarations.docstring: Later Mersenne denominators grow at least geometrically from the first omitted denominator.

declarations.name: abs_mobiusSquareTail_le
declarations.docstring: The signed square tail is bounded by the exact first-denominator geometric majorant.

declarations.name: mobiusSquareTail_eq_first_support_add_tail
declarations.signature: theorem mobiusSquareTail_eq_first_support_add_tail {D n : ℕ} (hDn : D < n) (hzero : ∀ d : ℕ, D < d → d < n → ArithmeticFunction.moebius d = 0) : mobiusSquareTail D = ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℤ) : ℝ) / (((2 : ℝ) ^ n - 1) ^ 2) + mobiusSquareTail n
declarations.docstring: If `n` is the first nonzero Möbius channel after `D`, the tail splits into that channel and the tail after `n`. This is the exact algebraic input for a one-sided enclosure; no minimisation operator is needed.

declarations.name: mobiusSquareTail_directed_of_first_support
declarations.signature: theorem mobiusSquareTail_directed_of_first_support {D n : ℕ} (hDn : D < n) (hzero : ∀ d : ℕ, D < d → d < n → ArithmeticFunction.moebius d = 0) (hunit : |ArithmeticFunction.moebius n| = 1) : 1 / (((2 : ℝ) ^ n - 1) ^ 2) - 4 / (3 * (((2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) - 1) ^ 2)) ≤ ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℤ) : ℝ) * mobiusSquareTail D ∧ ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℤ) : ℝ) * mobiusSquareTail D ≤ 1 / (((2 : ℝ) ^ n - 1) ^ 2) + 4 / (3 * (((2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) - 1) ^ 2))
declarations.docstring: The sign of the first nonzero omitted Möbius channel directs the entire tail. The remaining uncertainty is the sharp square-tail radius after that channel, so this interval can certify cases missed by the symmetric bound.

declarations.name: directedLambertLowerBound
declarations.signature: noncomputable def directedLambertLowerBound (H n : ℕ) : ℝ
declarations.docstring: Lower endpoint of the directed interval for the actual diagonal.

declarations.name: directedLambertUpperBound
declarations.signature: noncomputable def directedLambertUpperBound (H n : ℕ) : ℝ
declarations.docstring: Upper endpoint of the directed interval for the actual diagonal.

declarations.name: scaleDiagonalTailDifference_directed_lambert_interval
declarations.signature: theorem scaleDiagonalTailDifference_directed_lambert_interval {H D n : ℕ} (hDn : D < n) (hzero : ∀ d : ℕ, D < d → d < n → ArithmeticFunction.moebius d = 0) (hunit : |ArithmeticFunction.moebius n| = 1) : directedLambertLowerBound H n ≤ ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℤ) : ℝ) * (scaleDiagonalTailDifference H - lambertProjectedDiagonal H D) ∧ ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℤ) : ℝ) * (scaleDiagonalTailDifference H - lambertProjectedDiagonal H D) ≤ directedLambertUpperBound H n
declarations.docstring: The actual diagonal displacement from the rational centre lies in the first-support-directed interval.

declarations.name: scaleFullTarget_miss_of_directed_lambert_interval
declarations.signature: theorem scaleFullTarget_miss_of_directed_lambert_interval {H D n : ℕ} (hDn : D < n) (hzero : ∀ d : ℕ, D < d → d < n → ArithmeticFunction.moebius d = 0) (hunit : |ArithmeticFunction.moebius n| = 1) (hsep : ∀ z : ℤ, ¬( directedLambertLowerBound H n ≤ ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℤ) : ℝ) * ((z : ℝ) - lambertProjectedDiagonal H D) ∧ ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℤ) : ℝ) * ((z : ℝ) - lambertProjectedDiagonal H D) ≤ directedLambertUpperBound H n)) : ¬ScaleFullTargetHit H
declarations.docstring: Directed separation from the integer lattice rules out a full-target hit. Unlike the symmetric consumer, the hypothesis only excludes the one interval in which the first omitted Möbius channel can move the centre.

declarations.name: abs_scaleDiagonalTailDifference_sub_lambertProjectedDiagonal_le
declarations.signature: theorem abs_scaleDiagonalTailDifference_sub_lambertProjectedDiagonal_le (H D : ℕ) : |scaleDiagonalTailDifference H - lambertProjectedDiagonal H D| ≤ lambertSquareComplementBound H D
declarations.docstring: The actual diagonal lies in the sharp squared-Mersenne enclosure around the exact rational centre.

declarations.name: scaleFullTarget_miss_of_lambert_projected_separation
declarations.signature: theorem scaleFullTarget_miss_of_lambert_projected_separation {H D : ℕ} (hsep : ∀ z : ℤ, lambertSquareComplementBound H D < |lambertProjectedDiagonal H D - (z : ℝ)|) : ¬ScaleFullTargetHit H
declarations.docstring: Exact rational separation of the squared-Mersenne centre from the integer lattice forces a genuine miss of the actual full target.

declarations.name: LR
declarations.signature: inductive LR | left | right deriving DecidableEq, Repr /-- Exchange the two parabolic directions. -/ def LR.flip : LR → LR | .left => .right | .right => .left @[simp] theorem LR.flip_left : LR.left.flip = LR.right
declarations.docstring: The two Stern--Brocot mediant moves.

declarations.name: LR.flip
declarations.signature: def LR.flip : LR → LR | .left => .right | .right => .left @[simp] theorem LR.flip_left : LR.left.flip = LR.right
declarations.docstring: Exchange the two parabolic directions.

declarations.name: step
declarations.signature: def step : LR → ℕ × ℕ → ℕ × ℕ | .left, (a, b) => (a + b, b) | .right, (a, b) => (a, a + b) /-- The pair reached from `(1,1)`. The list head is the newest move and acts last; this agrees with the newest-run-first convention used below. -/ def sbPair : List LR → ℕ × ℕ | [] => (1, 1) | d :: w => step d (sbPair w) /-- Arithmetic height of a Stern--Brocot word. -/ def sbHeight (w : List LR) : ℕ
declarations.docstring: One mediant step on a positive lattice pair.

declarations.name: sbPair
declarations.signature: def sbPair : List LR → ℕ × ℕ | [] => (1, 1) | d :: w => step d (sbPair w) /-- Arithmetic height of a Stern--Brocot word. -/ def sbHeight (w : List LR) : ℕ
declarations.docstring: The pair reached from `(1,1)`. The list head is the newest move and acts last; this agrees with the newest-run-first convention used below.

declarations.name: sbHeight
declarations.docstring: Arithmetic height of a Stern--Brocot word.

declarations.name: sbPair_coprime
declarations.signature: theorem sbPair_coprime (w : List LR) : Nat.Coprime (sbPair w).1 (sbPair w).2
declarations.docstring: Every word reaches a primitive pair.

declarations.name: sbPair_pos
declarations.signature: theorem sbPair_pos (w : List LR) : 0 < (sbPair w).1 ∧ 0 < (sbPair w).2
declarations.docstring: Both coordinates reached from `(1,1)` stay positive.

declarations.name: runWord
declarations.signature: def runWord : LR → List ℕ → List LR | _, [] => [] | newest, n :: ns => List.replicate n newest ++ runWord newest.flip ns /-- The direction-free continuant state at run boundaries. Its first coordinate is the coordinate changed
declarations.docstring: A word with alternating directions and the supplied run lengths. The first length is the newest run and its direction is `newest`.

declarations.name: runBoundaryPair
declarations.signature: def runBoundaryPair : List ℕ → ℕ × ℕ | [] => (1, 1) | n :: ns => let p
declarations.docstring: The direction-free continuant state at run boundaries. Its first coordinate is the coordinate changed by the newest run; the second is the other coordinate.

declarations.name: runHeight
declarations.docstring: Height in run coordinates.

declarations.name: sbPair_replicate_left_append
declarations.signature: private theorem sbPair_replicate_left_append (n : ℕ) (w : List LR) : sbPair (List.replicate n LR.left ++ w) = ((sbPair w).1 + n * (sbPair w).2, (sbPair w).2)

declarations.name: sbPair_replicate_right_append
declarations.signature: private theorem sbPair_replicate_right_append (n : ℕ) (w : List LR) : sbPair (List.replicate n LR.right ++ w) = ((sbPair w).1, (sbPair w).2 + n * (sbPair w).1)

declarations.name: sbPair_runWord
declarations.signature: theorem sbPair_runWord (newest : LR) (ns : List ℕ) : sbPair (runWord newest ns) = match newest with | .left => runBoundaryPair ns | .right => ((runBoundaryPair ns).2, (runBoundaryPair ns).1)
declarations.docstring: The run continuant is not a new coordinate detached from the tree: it is exactly the pair reached by the corresponding alternating Stern--Brocot word, up to the expected coordinate swap for a newest right run.

declarations.name: sbHeight_runWord
declarations.signature: theorem sbHeight_runWord (newest : LR) (ns : List ℕ) : sbHeight (runWord newest ns) = runHeight ns
declarations.docstring: Run height is the literal arithmetic height on the mediant tree.

declarations.name: runBoundaryPair_coprime
declarations.signature: theorem runBoundaryPair_coprime (ns : List ℕ) : Nat.Coprime (runBoundaryPair ns).1 (runBoundaryPair ns).2
declarations.docstring: The run-boundary pair remains primitive.

declarations.name: runBoundaryPair_fib_lower
declarations.signature: theorem runBoundaryPair_fib_lower (ns : List ℕ) (hpos : ∀ n ∈ ns, 0 < n) : Nat.fib (ns.length + 2) ≤ (runBoundaryPair ns).1 ∧ Nat.fib (ns.length + 1) ≤ (runBoundaryPair ns).2
declarations.docstring: Coordinatewise Fibonacci floor for positive run lengths.

declarations.name: runHeight_fib_lower
declarations.signature: theorem runHeight_fib_lower (ns : List ℕ) (hpos : ∀ n ∈ ns, 0 < n) : Nat.fib (ns.length + 3) ≤ runHeight ns
declarations.docstring: **Fibonacci minimum height.** Every alternating word with `r` nonempty runs has height at least `F_{r+3}`.

declarations.name: sbHeight_runWord_fib_lower
declarations.signature: theorem sbHeight_runWord_fib_lower (newest : LR) (ns : List ℕ) (hpos : ∀ n ∈ ns, 0 < n) : Nat.fib (ns.length + 3) ≤ sbHeight (runWord newest ns)
declarations.docstring: Tree-facing form of the Fibonacci height floor.

declarations.name: runBoundaryPair_replicate_one
declarations.signature: theorem runBoundaryPair_replicate_one (r : ℕ) : runBoundaryPair (List.replicate r 1) = (Nat.fib (r + 2), Nat.fib (r + 1))
declarations.docstring: The all-unit alternating spine is exactly Fibonacci.

declarations.name: runHeight_replicate_one
declarations.signature: theorem runHeight_replicate_one (r : ℕ) : runHeight (List.replicate r 1) = Nat.fib (r + 3)
declarations.docstring: Equality case for the Fibonacci height floor.

declarations.name: defectRunLengths
declarations.signature: def defectRunLengths (e : List ℕ) : List ℕ
declarations.docstring: Replace every nonnegative defect `eᵢ` by the positive run length `1 + eᵢ`.

declarations.name: exactDefectPair
declarations.signature: def exactDefectPair : List ℕ → ℕ × ℕ | [] => (0, 0) | e :: es => let d
declarations.docstring: The exact defect of the two run-boundary coordinates from their Fibonacci values. The term `e * d.1` is the first mixed monomial created at the newest defect; recursively expanding it gives the full positive multiaffine continuant-defect polynomial.

declarations.name: linearDefectPair
declarations.signature: def linearDefectPair : List ℕ → ℕ × ℕ | [] => (0, 0) | e :: es => let d
declarations.docstring: The degree-one part of `exactDefectPair`. It is obtained by deleting the mixed term `e * d.1` at every recursive step.

declarations.name: runBoundaryPair_defectRunLengths
declarations.signature: theorem runBoundaryPair_defectRunLengths (e : List ℕ) : runBoundaryPair (defectRunLengths e) = (Nat.fib (e.length + 2) + (exactDefectPair e).1, Nat.fib (e.length + 1) + (exactDefectPair e).2)
declarations.docstring: Exact coordinate expansion around the all-unit Fibonacci spine.

declarations.name: runHeight_defectRunLengths
declarations.signature: theorem runHeight_defectRunLengths (e : List ℕ) : runHeight (defectRunLengths e) = Nat.fib (e.length + 3) + (exactDefectPair e).1 + (exactDefectPair e).2
declarations.docstring: Exact height expansion. In particular, `exactDefectPair` is not an estimate: it owns every mixed coefficient of the continuant defect.

declarations.name: linearDefectPair_le_exactDefectPair
declarations.signature: theorem linearDefectPair_le_exactDefectPair (e : List ℕ) : (linearDefectPair e).1 ≤ (exactDefectPair e).1 ∧ (linearDefectPair e).2 ≤ (exactDefectPair e).2
declarations.docstring: Every coefficient discarded by the linearization is nonnegative.

declarations.name: runHeight_defect_linear_lower
declarations.signature: theorem runHeight_defect_linear_lower (e : List ℕ) : Nat.fib (e.length + 3) + (linearDefectPair e).1 + (linearDefectPair e).2 ≤ runHeight (defectRunLengths e)
declarations.docstring: Structural linear floor for the full continuant defect. This statement retains the recursively ordered one-site coefficients; the next theorem identifies each of them with a closed Fibonacci product.

declarations.name: linearDefectPair_fib_sum_lower
declarations.signature: theorem linearDefectPair_fib_sum_lower (e : List ℕ) : Nat.fib e.length * e.sum ≤ (linearDefectPair e).1 ∧ Nat.fib (e.length + 1) * e.sum ≤ (linearDefectPair e).1 + (linearDefectPair e).2
declarations.docstring: The recursively ordered coefficients admit the uniform sharp floor: the first-coordinate coefficients are at least `F_r`, and the height coefficients are at least `F_{r+1}`.

declarations.name: runHeight_defect_fib_sum_lower
declarations.signature: theorem runHeight_defect_fib_sum_lower (e : List ℕ) : Nat.fib (e.length + 3) + Nat.fib (e.length + 1) * e.sum ≤ runHeight (defectRunLengths e)
declarations.docstring: **Sharp global stability floor.** If the positive run lengths are `1 + eᵢ`, their height gains at least `F_{r+1}` for every unit of total defect. Boundary one-site rays attain this coefficient exactly.

declarations.name: oneSiteWeight
declarations.docstring: Closed coefficient of a defect at position `i`, counted from the newest run boundary. The hypothesis `i < r` keeps the coefficient inside an `r`-run word without introducing a second indexing type.

declarations.name: oneSiteWeight_eq_base_add
declarations.signature: theorem oneSiteWeight_eq_base_add {r i : ℕ} (hi : i < r) : oneSiteWeight r i = Nat.fib (r + 1) + Nat.fib i * Nat.fib (r - i - 1)
declarations.docstring: The one-site coefficient is the boundary value `F_{r+1}` plus an explicit interior surplus.

declarations.name: linearDefectPair_first_lt_exact_of_head_tail_pos
declarations.signature: theorem linearDefectPair_first_lt_exact_of_head_tail_pos {e : ℕ} (he : 0 < e) {es : List ℕ} (htail : 0 < (exactDefectPair es).1) : (linearDefectPair (e :: es)).1 < (exactDefectPair (e :: es)).1
declarations.docstring: The recursive expansion exposes a strict mixed term as soon as the newest defect and an older defect are both present.

declarations.name: runHeight_one_cons
declarations.signature: private theorem runHeight_one_cons (ns : List ℕ) : runHeight (1 :: ns) = runHeight ns + (runBoundaryPair ns).1

declarations.name: runBoundaryPair_replicate_one_append
declarations.signature: private theorem runBoundaryPair_replicate_one_append (i : ℕ) (ns : List ℕ) : let p

declarations.name: runHeight_oneSiteDefect
declarations.signature: theorem runHeight_oneSiteDefect {r i : ℕ} (hi : i < r) (e : ℕ) : runHeight (List.replicate i 1 ++ (e + 1) :: List.replicate (r - i - 1) 1) = Nat.fib (r + 3) + oneSiteWeight r i * e
declarations.docstring: A single defect is exactly linear, with coefficient `F_{i+2} F_{r-i+1}`. This is the sharp coefficient formula and includes the arbitrary defect magnitude `e`, not only the derivative at `e = 0`.

declarations.name: runHeight_single
declarations.docstring: Exact height of one parabolic run.

declarations.name: runHeight_pair
declarations.signature: @[simp] theorem runHeight_pair (m n : ℕ) : runHeight [m, n] = (m + 1) * (n + 1) + 1
declarations.docstring: Exact height of two alternating parabolic runs. After putting `u = m+1`, `v = n+1`, the two orientations together contribute the weight `2 * 2^{-(uv+1)} = 2^{-uv}` used by the second induced layer.

declarations.name: zeroRunMass
declarations.docstring: Root contribution, before any nonempty parabolic run.

declarations.name: oneRunMass
declarations.docstring: Contribution of the two orientations with one positive run. The natural number index `n` represents run length `n+1`.

declarations.name: oneRunMass_eq_half
declarations.docstring: Exact first induced layer: the two parabolic cusps together carry mass `1/2`.

declarations.name: naturalRunDenominatorExponent
declarations.docstring: Sum of the invariant-coordinate exponents encountered on the unit-run spine. Clearing the corresponding Mersenne resolvents introduces factors on this exponent scale.

declarations.name: naturalRunDenominatorExponent_add_two
declarations.signature: theorem naturalRunDenominatorExponent_add_two (r : ℕ) : naturalRunDenominatorExponent r + 2 = Nat.fib (r + 3)
declarations.docstring: The natural exponent is exactly two below the minimum run height scale: `F₂ + ... + F_{r+1} + 2 = F_{r+3}`.

declarations.name: nat_add_one_pow_le_self_pow_mul_two_pow
declarations.signature: theorem nat_add_one_pow_le_self_pow_mul_two_pow (k a : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : (a + 1) ^ k ≤ k ^ k * 2 ^ a
declarations.docstring: A single explicit penalty `k^k` controls every exponent at every prime at least two.

declarations.name: factorization_add_one_pow_le_penalty_mul
declarations.signature: theorem factorization_add_one_pow_le_penalty_mul (n p k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hp : p ∈ n.primeFactors) : (n.factorization p + 1) ^ k ≤ (if p < 2 ^ k then k ^ k else 1) * p ^ n.factorization p
declarations.docstring: Pointwise prime-factor estimate: only primes below `2^k` pay the explicit `k^k` penalty.

declarations.name: card_small_primeFactors_le_two_pow
declarations.signature: theorem card_small_primeFactors_le_two_pow (n k : ℕ) : (n.primeFactors.filter fun p => p < 2 ^ k).card ≤ 2 ^ k
declarations.docstring: There are at most `2^k` prime factors below the cutoff `2^k`.

declarations.name: divisorSubpowerConst
declarations.docstring: Completely explicit constant for the fixed-`k` divisor bound.

declarations.name: card_divisors_pow_le_divisorSubpowerConst_pow_mul
declarations.signature: theorem card_divisors_pow_le_divisorSubpowerConst_pow_mul (n k : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : n.divisors.card ^ k ≤ divisorSubpowerConst k ^ k * n
declarations.docstring: Fixed-natural-power divisor theorem. All prime-factor bookkeeping is in `ℕ`; the only loss is the explicit penalty from primes below `2^k`.

declarations.name: card_divisors_le_divisorSubpowerConst_mul_rpow
declarations.signature: theorem card_divisors_le_divisorSubpowerConst_mul_rpow (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : (n.divisors.card : ℝ) ≤ (divisorSubpowerConst k : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℝ)⁻¹)
declarations.docstring: Take the real `k`-th root once, after the finite prime-factor product has been closed in `ℕ`. This version includes `n = 0`.

declarations.name: supportCoeff_pow_le_divisorSubpowerConst_pow_mul
declarations.signature: theorem supportCoeff_pow_le_divisorSubpowerConst_pow_mul (A : Set ℕ) (n k : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : supportCoeff A n ^ k ≤ divisorSubpowerConst k ^ k * n
declarations.docstring: The support coefficient inherits the fixed-power divisor theorem.

declarations.name: supportCoeff_le_divisorSubpowerConst_mul_rpow
declarations.signature: theorem supportCoeff_le_divisorSubpowerConst_mul_rpow (A : Set ℕ) (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : (supportCoeff A n : ℝ) ≤ (divisorSubpowerConst k : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℝ)⁻¹)
declarations.docstring: Real subpower form inherited by `supportCoeff`.

declarations.name: SupportCoeffZeroWindow
declarations.signature: def SupportCoeffZeroWindow (A : Set ℕ) (N h : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: `supportCoeff A` vanishes on the `h` positive indices immediately after `N`, namely `N + 1, ..., N + h`.

declarations.name: shiftedTailState_eq_pow_mul_of_supportCoeffZeroWindow

declarations.signature: noncomputable def CylinderStage.promoteLow {K N : ℕ} (S : CylinderStage K N) (hK1N : K + 1 ≤ N) (hbelow : S.endpoint ≤ 2 ^ (N - (K + 1))) : CylinderStage (K + 1) N
declarations.docstring: Low-side cutoff promotion, complementary to `CylinderStage.promoteHigh`. The endpoint is unchanged because the newly exposed bit is uniformly false.

declarations.name: CylinderStage.feedbackStep_or_protectedSeam
declarations.signature: theorem CylinderStage.feedbackStep_or_protectedSeam {K N : ℕ} (S : CylinderStage K N) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hK1N : K + 1 ≤ N) (hrow : N + 1 = 2 * (K + 1)) (h27 : 27 ≤ halfStripBound (N + 1)) : Nonempty (CylinderStage (K + 1) (N + 1)) ∨ ∃ δ c : ℤ, ProtectedEvenSeamRealizedAt (N + 1) δ c
declarations.docstring: **Total feedback step.** At an exact half-divisor horizon, every full suffix-cylinder stage either promotes through the new bit and advances one row, or emits a realized localized one-hole seam. There is no fourth object-level case.

declarations.name: SelectedHalfInterval
declarations.docstring: Selected admissible words indexed by an arbitrary closed carry interval. The interval may be empty; this lets the endpoint cases `hole = 1` and `hole = stripBound` retain one uniform two-sheet interface.

declarations.name: HasSuffixCylinderOnInterval
declarations.signature: noncomputable def HasSuffixCylinderOnInterval {M N L U : ℕ} (W : SelectedHalfInterval N L U) (hMN : M ≤ N) (endpoint : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: Endpoint-indexed suffix cylinder over a shifted carry interval.

declarations.name: SelectedHalfInterval.stepTailExplicit
declarations.signature: noncomputable def SelectedHalfInterval.stepTailExplicit {N R L U C δ : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (W : SelectedHalfWindow N R) (hLpos : 1 ≤ L) (hUstrip : U ≤ halfStripBound (N + 1)) (hbuffer : U + C ≤ 2 * R) (hparentTail : ∀ q : ℕ, L ≤ q → q ≤ U → δ < parent C q) (hcoeff : ∀ k (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkR : k ≤ R), δ < k → supportCoeff (wordSupport (W.word k hk hkR)) (N + 1) = C) : SelectedHalfInterval (N + 1) L U
declarations.docstring: Fixed-coefficient successor restricted to a shifted target interval. Only canonical parents strictly above `δ` are used.

declarations.name: SelectedHalfInterval.word_stepTailExplicit
declarations.signature: theorem SelectedHalfInterval.word_stepTailExplicit {N R L U C δ : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (W : SelectedHalfWindow N R) (hLpos : 1 ≤ L) (hUstrip : U ≤ halfStripBound (N + 1)) (hbuffer : U + C ≤ 2 * R) (hparentTail : ∀ q : ℕ, L ≤ q → q ≤ U → δ < parent C q) (hcoeff : ∀ k (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkR : k ≤ R), δ < k → supportCoeff (wordSupport (W.word k hk hkR)) (N + 1) = C) (q : ℕ) (hqL : L ≤ q) (hqU : q ≤ U) : (SelectedHalfInterval.stepTailExplicit hN W hLpos hUstrip hbuffer hparentTail hcoeff).word q hqL hqU = extendHalfWord (W.word (parent C q) (explicitParent_pos (hLpos.trans hqL)) (explicitParent_le hqU hbuffer))

declarations.name: parent_eq_iff_eq_two_adjacent_children
declarations.signature: theorem parent_eq_iff_eq_two_adjacent_children (C h q : ℕ) (_hq : 1 ≤ q) : parent C q = h ↔ (q : ℤ) = 2 * (h : ℤ) - C ∨ (q : ℤ) = 2 * (h : ℤ) - C - 1
declarations.docstring: A single missing canonical parent produces exactly its two adjacent fixed-coefficient children. This is the iteration law for the seam gap.

declarations.name: parent_ne_iff_avoids_two_adjacent_children
declarations.signature: theorem parent_ne_iff_avoids_two_adjacent_children (C h q : ℕ) (hq : 1 ≤ q) : parent C q ≠ h ↔ (q : ℤ) ≠ 2 * (h : ℤ) - C ∧ (q : ℤ) ≠ 2 * (h : ℤ) - C - 1
declarations.docstring: Complementary operational form: after one common-coefficient row, a target survives exactly when it avoids both adjacent children of the missing parent.

declarations.name: parent_mem_interval_iff_mem_doubled_child_interval
declarations.signature: theorem parent_mem_interval_iff_mem_doubled_child_interval (C a b q : ℕ) (_hab : a ≤ b) : (a ≤ parent C q ∧ parent C q ≤ b) ↔ 2 * (a : ℤ) - C - 1 ≤ (q : ℤ) ∧ (q : ℤ) ≤ 2 * (b : ℤ) - C
declarations.docstring: Interval iteration law. A forbidden parent block `[a,b]` pulls back under one canonical fixed-coefficient row to the consecutive child block `[2a-C-1, 2b-C]`, whose untruncated integer width is exactly doubled.

declarations.name: supportCoeff_extend_true_eq_false_at_double_add_one
declarations.signature: theorem supportCoeff_extend_true_eq_false_at_double_add_one {K : ℕ} (hK : 1 ≤ K) (a : HalfWord K) : supportCoeff (wordSupport (extendHalfWord a true)) (2 * (K + 1) + 1) = supportCoeff (wordSupport (extendHalfWord a false)) (2 * (K + 1) + 1)
declarations.docstring: The complementary boundary bits have the same coefficient at the odd row immediately after their doubled feedback row.

declarations.name: InStripTwoSheetStage
declarations.docstring: Exact data retained after a genuine crossing whose hole remains in the next strip. Both sheet endpoints and the scalar failure coordinate are part of the structure, so subsequent rows can propagate the gap rather than forgetting it behind an existential seam receipt.

declarations.name: InStripTwoSheetStage.HasCommonNextCoeff
declarations.signature: def InStripTwoSheetStage.HasCommonNextCoeff {K N : ℕ} (T : InStripTwoSheetStage K N) (C : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: Cross-sheet coefficient socket for the next row. This is deliberately explicit: retaining two cylinders does not by itself prove their next-row coefficients agree.

declarations.name: InStripTwoSheetStage.hasCommonNextCoeff_at_oddSuccessor
declarations.signature: theorem InStripTwoSheetStage.hasCommonNextCoeff_at_oddSuccessor {K N : ℕ} (T : InStripTwoSheetStage K N) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hdepth : N = 2 * (K + 1)) : T.HasCommonNextCoeff (supportCoeff (wordSupport (extendHalfWord T.boundaryPrefix false)) (N + 1))
declarations.docstring: The complementary literal prefixes discharge the next odd-row common coefficient automatically.

declarations.name: halfTerminalReachable_succ_of_admissibleParent
declarations.signature: theorem halfTerminalReachable_succ_of_admissibleParent {N h q C : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (a : HalfWord N) (ha : HalfStripAdmissible N a) (hterminal : integerHalfCarry (wordSupport a) (N - 1) = h) (hcoeff : supportCoeff (wordSupport a) (N + 1) = C) (beta : Bool) (hqrec : (q : ℤ) = 2 * (h : ℤ) - (C : ℤ) - (if beta then 1 else 0)) (hqpos : 1 ≤ q) (hqstrip : q ≤ halfStripBound (N + 1)) : HalfTerminalReachable (N + 1) q
declarations.docstring: One arbitrary admissible parent word can be extended through a specified fixed coefficient and Boolean child. This removes the artificial need for an initial carry interval when advancing a shifted sheet.

declarations.name: InStripTwoSheetStage.halfTerminalReachable_succ_off_childGap
declarations.signature: theorem InStripTwoSheetStage.halfTerminalReachable_succ_off_childGap {K N B C q : ℕ} (T : InStripTwoSheetStage K N) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hBstrip : B ≤ halfStripBound (N + 1)) (hbuffer : B + C ≤ 2 * halfStripBound N) (hcommon : T.HasCommonNextCoeff C) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hqB : q ≤ B) (hparentGap : parent C q ≠ T.hole) : HalfTerminalReachable (N + 1) q
declarations.docstring: Exact one-row finite-gap transition. Under a genuinely common next coefficient, every target whose canonical parent is not the old hole is realized one row later. By `parent_ne_iff_avoids_two_adjacent_children`, the sole parent hole becomes precisely the adjacent child gap `{2*hole-C-1, 2*hole-C}` (after intersection with the target strip).

declarations.name: InStripTwoSheetStage.halfTerminalReachable_of_ne_hole
declarations.signature: theorem InStripTwoSheetStage.halfTerminalReachable_of_ne_hole {K N q : ℕ} (T : InStripTwoSheetStage K N) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hqB : q ≤ halfStripBound N) (hqHole : q ≠ T.hole) : HalfTerminalReachable N q
declarations.docstring: The two sheets realize every carry in the full strip except their exact hole. This is stronger than the protected `3..27` realization interface.

declarations.name: InStripTwoSheetStage.protectedEvenSeamRealizedAt
declarations.signature: theorem InStripTwoSheetStage.protectedEvenSeamRealizedAt {K N : ℕ} (T : InStripTwoSheetStage K N) (h27 : 27 ≤ halfStripBound N) : ProtectedEvenSeamRealizedAt N (T.seamCut : ℤ) (T.seamCoeff : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: Compatibility projection to the existing localized one-hole consumer.

declarations.name: CylinderStage.feedbackSplitCrossingInStrip
declarations.signature: noncomputable def CylinderStage.feedbackSplitCrossingInStrip {K N : ℕ} (S : CylinderStage K N) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hK1N : K + 1 ≤ N) (hcrossLow : 2 ^ (N - (K + 1)) < S.endpoint) (hcrossHigh : S.endpoint < 2 ^ (N - (K + 1)) + halfStripBound N) (c : ℕ) (hprofile : ∀ k (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkR : k ≤ halfStripBound N), supportCoeff (wordSupport (S.window.word k hk hkR)) (N + 1) = if k ≤ S.endpoint - 2 ^ (N - (K + 1)) then c + 1 else c) (hholePos : 1 ≤ 2 * (S.endpoint - 2 ^ (N - (K + 1))) - c) (hholeStrip : 2 * (S.endpoint - 2 ^ (N - (K + 1))) - c ≤
declarations.docstring: A crossing with an in-strip hole canonically splits into two exact suffix cylinders. The lower sheet covers `1 .. hole-1` with endpoint `hole-1`; the upper sheet covers `hole+1 .. stripBound` with endpoint `2E-c`.

declarations.name: CylinderStage.feedbackAdvance_or_inStripTwoSheet
declarations.signature: theorem CylinderStage.feedbackAdvance_or_inStripTwoSheet {K N : ℕ} (S : CylinderStage K N) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hK1N : K + 1 ≤ N) (hrow : N + 1 = 2 * (K + 1)) : Nonempty (CylinderStage (K + 1) (N + 1)) ∨ Nonempty (InStripTwoSheetStage K (N + 1))
declarations.docstring: **Operational one-depth feedback split.** At an exact half-divisor horizon, a full cylinder either advances as a full cylinder or produces the exact two-sheet state above. Unlike the protected-seam existential, the residual branch retains every admissible word off the hole, both cylinder endpoints, the complementary literal prefixes, and the canonical-parent failure coordinate needed by the finite-gap iterator. This theorem alone is not an iteration closure: later rows still need `HasCommonNextCoeff` receipts.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.HasAdjacentPrefixes
declarations.signature: def ProfiledGapStage.HasAdjacentPrefixes {M N : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) : Prop
declarations.docstring: The two retained cutoff words straddle one binary boundary: the lower prefix is the immediate successor of the upper prefix.

declarations.name: supportSuffixNumeral_zero_split
declarations.signature: theorem supportSuffixNumeral_zero_split (A : Set ℕ) [DecidablePred (· ∈ A)] (M L : ℕ) : supportSuffixNumeral A 0 (M + L) = 2 ^ L * supportSuffixNumeral A 0 M + supportSuffixNumeral A M L
declarations.docstring: Splitting a binary support numeral after its first `M` bits gives the usual prefix-times-place-value plus suffix decomposition.

declarations.name: wordSuffixNumeral_zero_split
declarations.signature: theorem wordSuffixNumeral_zero_split {M N : ℕ} (hMN : M ≤ N) (w : HalfWord N) : wordSuffixNumeral w 0 N = 2 ^ (N - M) * wordSuffixNumeral (restrictWord hMN w) 0 M + wordSuffixNumeral w M (N - M)
declarations.docstring: Whole-word binary value decomposes across a literal cutoff.

declarations.name: supportCoeff_wordSupport_extendHalfWord_eq
declarations.signature: theorem supportCoeff_wordSupport_extendHalfWord_eq {N m : ℕ} (w : HalfWord N) (beta : Bool) : supportCoeff (wordSupport (extendHalfWord w beta)) m = supportCoeff (wordSupport w) m + if beta then (if N + 1 ∈ m.divisors then 1 else 0) else 0
declarations.docstring: Appending one word bit changes a divisor coefficient by the indicator that the new rank is both selected and a divisor of the inspected row.

declarations.name: supportCoeff_eq_and_le_add_one_of_wordNumeral_eq_or_succ
declarations.signature: theorem supportCoeff_eq_and_le_add_one_of_wordNumeral_eq_or_succ (m : ℕ) {N : ℕ} (lower upper : HalfWord N) : (wordSuffixNumeral lower 0 N = wordSuffixNumeral upper 0 N → supportCoeff (wordSupport lower) m = supportCoeff (wordSupport upper) m) ∧ (wordSuffixNumeral lower 0 N = wordSuffixNumeral upper 0 N + 1 → supportCoeff (wordSupport lower) m ≤ supportCoeff (wordSupport upper) m + 1)
declarations.docstring: Incrementing a fixed-length binary word can create at most one new selected divisor. The simultaneous equality clause is the induction invariant needed when the terminal increment does not carry.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.lowerNextCoeff_le_upperNextCoeff_add_one
declarations.signature: theorem ProfiledGapStage.lowerNextCoeff_le_upperNextCoeff_add_one {M N : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) (hadjacent : T.HasAdjacentPrefixes) : supportCoeff (wordSupport T.lowerPrefix) (N + 1) ≤ supportCoeff (wordSupport T.upperPrefix) (N + 1) + 1
declarations.docstring: Stage form of the binary-increment bound: adjacent profiled prefixes have lower next-row coefficient at most one above the upper coefficient.

declarations.name: profiledGapStageOfTwoSheet_hasAdjacentPrefixes
declarations.signature: theorem profiledGapStageOfTwoSheet_hasAdjacentPrefixes {K N : ℕ} (T : InStripTwoSheetStage K N) : (profiledGapStageOfTwoSheet T).HasAdjacentPrefixes
declarations.docstring: The exact two-sheet state starts with adjacent complementary children of its common boundary prefix.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.advanceOfNextCoeffProfile_hasAdjacentPrefixes
declarations.signature: theorem ProfiledGapStage.advanceOfNextCoeffProfile_hasAdjacentPrefixes {M N lowerCoeff upperCoeff : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) (hadjacent : T.HasAdjacentPrefixes) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hprofile : T.HasNextCoeffProfile lowerCoeff upperCoeff) (hchildLoPos : 1 ≤ 2 * T.gapLo - lowerCoeff - 1) (hupperCoeff : upperCoeff ≤ 2 * T.gapHi) (hchildOrder : 2 * T.gapLo - lowerCoeff - 1 ≤ 2 * T.gapHi - upperCoeff) (hchildHiStrip : 2 * T.gapHi - upperCoeff ≤ halfStripBound (N + 1)) (hupperBuffer : halfStripBound (N + 1) + upperCoeff ≤ 2 * halfStripBound N) : (T.advanceOfNextCoeffProfile hN hprofile hchildLoPos hupperCoeff
declarations.docstring: A profiled fixed-cutoff successor leaves both literal prefixes unchanged, and therefore preserves their binary adjacency.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.lowerNextCoeff
declarations.signature: noncomputable def ProfiledGapStage.lowerNextCoeff {M N : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) : ℕ
declarations.docstring: The lower-sheet coefficient forced by the retained literal prefix at the next row.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.upperNextCoeff
declarations.signature: noncomputable def ProfiledGapStage.upperNextCoeff {M N : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) : ℕ
declarations.docstring: The upper-sheet coefficient forced by the retained literal prefix at the next row.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.NextArithmetic
declarations.signature: structure ProfiledGapStage.NextArithmetic {M N : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) : Prop
declarations.docstring: The four non-generic inequalities required to retain both profiled sheets through the next row. Coefficient production and the divisor buffer are not fields: they follow automatically from readiness and the universal square-root envelope.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.upperNextCoeff_le_two_mul_sqrt
declarations.signature: theorem ProfiledGapStage.upperNextCoeff_le_two_mul_sqrt {M N : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) : T.upperNextCoeff ≤ 2 * Nat.sqrt (N + 1)
declarations.docstring: The upper prefix coefficient satisfies the universal divisor envelope.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.upperNextBuffer
declarations.signature: theorem ProfiledGapStage.upperNextBuffer {M N : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) (hN : 1 ≤ N) : halfStripBound (N + 1) + T.upperNextCoeff ≤ 2 * halfStripBound N
declarations.docstring: The standard inverse-parent buffer is automatic for every positive current row.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.advanceOfReady
declarations.signature: noncomputable def ProfiledGapStage.advanceOfReady {M N : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hready : T.Ready) (hnext : T.NextArithmetic) : ProfiledGapStage M (N + 1)
declarations.docstring: A ready profiled stage advances from exactly its arithmetic cell; the per-sheet coefficient profile and upper buffer are synthesized internally.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.advanceOfReady_hasAdjacentPrefixes
declarations.signature: theorem ProfiledGapStage.advanceOfReady_hasAdjacentPrefixes {M N : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) (hadjacent : T.HasAdjacentPrefixes) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hready : T.Ready) (hnext : T.NextArithmetic) : (T.advanceOfReady hN hready hnext).HasAdjacentPrefixes
declarations.docstring: Automatic ready stepping preserves the adjacent-prefix invariant.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.promoteCutoff_ready
declarations.signature: theorem ProfiledGapStage.promoteCutoff_ready {M N : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) (hM : 4 ≤ M) (hboundary : N = 2 * M + 1) : (T.promoteCutoff hM hboundary).Ready
declarations.docstring: Promoting at an odd feedback boundary makes the resulting cutoff ready for the next coefficient row.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.promoteThenAdvance
declarations.signature: noncomputable def ProfiledGapStage.promoteThenAdvance {M N : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) (hM : 4 ≤ M) (hboundary : N = 2 * M + 1) (hnext : (T.promoteCutoff hM hboundary).NextArithmetic) : ProfiledGapStage (M + 1) (N + 1)
declarations.docstring: One complete feedback-boundary operation: promote the cutoff, then take the automatically profiled next row under the promoted arithmetic cell.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.promoteThenAdvance_hasAdjacentPrefixes
declarations.signature: theorem ProfiledGapStage.promoteThenAdvance_hasAdjacentPrefixes {M N : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) (hadjacent : T.HasAdjacentPrefixes) (hM : 4 ≤ M) (hboundary : N = 2 * M + 1) (hnext : (T.promoteCutoff hM hboundary).NextArithmetic) : (T.promoteThenAdvance hM hboundary hnext).HasAdjacentPrefixes
declarations.docstring: The complete promote-then-advance operation preserves binary adjacency.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage
declarations.docstring: A finite carry gap together with independent literal prefixes for its two live suffix-cylinder sheets. The parameter `M` is the actual retained cutoff, rather than the predecessor of that cutoff. The endpoint-separation field is the invariant needed to promote the upper sheet when the cutoff reaches its next feedback boundary.

declarations.name: profiledGapStageOfTwoSheet
declarations.signature: noncomputable def profiledGapStageOfTwoSheet {K N : ℕ} (T : InStripTwoSheetStage K N) : ProfiledGapStage (K + 1) N
declarations.docstring: The exact one-hole feedback state is the initial profiled finite-gap state. Its two cutoff prefixes are the marked true/false children retained by `InStripTwoSheetStage`.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.HasNextCoeffProfile
declarations.signature: def ProfiledGapStage.HasNextCoeffProfile {M N : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) (lowerCoeff upperCoeff : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: Per-sheet constant coefficients at the next row. Equality between the two constants is intentionally not part of this interface.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.Ready
declarations.signature: def ProfiledGapStage.Ready {M N : ℕ} (_T : ProfiledGapStage M N) : Prop
declarations.docstring: The current cutoff can read the next coefficient row whenever the word depth has not passed its doubled feedback boundary.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.hasNextCoeffProfile_of_ready
declarations.signature: theorem ProfiledGapStage.hasNextCoeffProfile_of_ready {M N : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) (hready : T.Ready) : T.HasNextCoeffProfile (supportCoeff (wordSupport T.lowerPrefix) (N + 1)) (supportCoeff (wordSupport T.upperPrefix) (N + 1))
declarations.docstring: Every ready profiled gap has an exact next-row coefficient profile, obtained from its two retained literal prefixes. This is the coefficient producer needed by an iterator; it replaces the non-iterable requirement that the two sheets have one common coefficient.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.advanceOfNextCoeffProfile
declarations.signature: noncomputable def ProfiledGapStage.advanceOfNextCoeffProfile {M N lowerCoeff upperCoeff : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hprofile : T.HasNextCoeffProfile lowerCoeff upperCoeff) (hchildLoPos : 1 ≤ 2 * T.gapLo - lowerCoeff - 1) (hupperCoeff : upperCoeff ≤ 2 * T.gapHi) (hchildOrder : 2 * T.gapLo - lowerCoeff - 1 ≤ 2 * T.gapHi - upperCoeff) (hchildHiStrip : 2 * T.gapHi - upperCoeff ≤ halfStripBound (N + 1)) (hupperBuffer : halfStripBound (N + 1) + upperCoeff ≤ 2 * halfStripBound N) : ProfiledGapStage M (N + 1)
declarations.docstring: Structure-preserving successor with independent coefficients on the two live sheets. The exact child gap is `[2*gapLo-lowerCoeff-1, 2*gapHi-upperCoeff]`; in particular, this constructor continues to apply after cutoff promotion has made the two coefficients different.

declarations.name: halfStripBound_two_mul_add_one_le_pow
declarations.signature: theorem halfStripBound_two_mul_add_one_le_pow {M : ℕ} (hM : 4 ≤ M) : halfStripBound (2 * M + 1) ≤ 2 ^ M
declarations.docstring: The square-root protected strip at an odd feedback boundary lies below the next binary head weight.

declarations.name: selectedHalfWindowPromoteLow
declarations.signature: theorem selectedHalfWindowPromoteLow {M N R E : ℕ} (W : SelectedHalfWindow N R) (hM1N : M + 1 ≤ N) (pfx : HalfWord M) (hpfx : ∀ k (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkR : k ≤ R), restrictWord ((Nat.le_succ M).trans hM1N) (W.word k hk hkR) = pfx) (hcyl : HasSuffixCylinderAt W ((Nat.le_succ M).trans hM1N) E) (hbelow : E ≤ 2 ^ (N - (M + 1))) : HasSuffixCylinderAt W hM1N E ∧ ∀ k (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkR : k ≤ R), restrictWord hM1N (W.word k hk hkR) = extendHalfWord pfx false
declarations.docstring: Low-side promotion for a selected initial window, including the empty window `R = 0`. The existing literal prefix acquires a false head bit and the suffix-cylinder endpoint is unchanged.

declarations.name: selectedHalfIntervalPromoteHigh
declarations.signature: theorem selectedHalfIntervalPromoteHigh {M N L U E : ℕ} (W : SelectedHalfInterval N L U) (hM1N : M + 1 ≤ N) (pfx : HalfWord M) (hpfx : ∀ q (hqL : L ≤ q) (hqU : q ≤ U), restrictWord ((Nat.le_succ M).trans hM1N) (W.word q hqL hqU) = pfx) (hcyl : HasSuffixCylinderOnInterval W ((Nat.le_succ M).trans hM1N) E) (hmargin : 2 ^ (N - (M + 1)) + U ≤ E) : HasSuffixCylinderOnInterval W hM1N (E - 2 ^ (N - (M + 1))) ∧ (∀ q (hqL : L ≤ q) (hqU : q ≤ U), restrictWord hM1N (W.word q hqL hqU) = extendHalfWord pfx true) ∧ U ≤ E - 2 ^ (N - (M + 1))
declarations.docstring: High-side promotion for an endpoint-indexed selected interval. The entire interval lies above the new binary head, so the literal prefix gains a true bit and the endpoint loses exactly that head weight.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.promoteCutoff
declarations.signature: noncomputable def ProfiledGapStage.promoteCutoff {M N : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) (hM : 4 ≤ M) (hboundary : N = 2 * M + 1) : ProfiledGapStage (M + 1) N
declarations.docstring: At an odd feedback boundary, promote both live sheets of a profiled gap through the next cutoff bit. The gap and selected families are unchanged; only their extracted literal prefixes and the upper suffix endpoint are renormalized.

declarations.name: wordSuffixNumeral_extendHalfWord_false_zero
declarations.signature: theorem wordSuffixNumeral_extendHalfWord_false_zero {M : ℕ} (p : HalfWord M) : wordSuffixNumeral (extendHalfWord p false) 0 (M + 1) = 2 * wordSuffixNumeral p 0 M
declarations.docstring: Appending `false` shifts the whole prefix numeral left by one place.

declarations.name: wordSuffixNumeral_extendHalfWord_true_zero
declarations.signature: theorem wordSuffixNumeral_extendHalfWord_true_zero {M : ℕ} (p : HalfWord M) : wordSuffixNumeral (extendHalfWord p true) 0 (M + 1) = 2 * wordSuffixNumeral p 0 M + 1
declarations.docstring: Appending `true` shifts the whole prefix numeral left and adds one.

declarations.name: ProfiledGapStage.promoteCutoff
declarations.signature: noncomputable def ProfiledGapStage.promoteCutoff {M N : ℕ} (T : ProfiledGapStage M N) (hM : 4 ≤ M) (hboundary : N = 2 * M + 1) : ProfiledGapStage (M + 1) N

declarations.name: cardFactors_list_prod_of_primes
declarations.signature: theorem cardFactors_list_prod_of_primes {ps : List ℕ} (hprime : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Prime) : ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors ps.prod = ps.length
declarations.docstring: A product of prime dilation factors has exactly one `Ω` contribution per list entry, including repeated primes.

declarations.name: supportCoeff_iteratedSupportPullback_eq_zero_of_cardFactors_le
declarations.signature: theorem supportCoeff_iteratedSupportPullback_eq_zero_of_cardFactors_le (A : Set ℕ) {ps : List ℕ} {K n : ℕ} (hprime : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Prime) (hbound : ∀ a ∈ A, ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors a ≤ K) (hlen : K < ps.length) : supportCoeff (iteratedSupportPullback ps A) n = 0
declarations.docstring: More than `K` prime pullbacks annihilate every divisor coefficient of a support whose elements have `Ω` at most `K`. No pairwise-coprimality hypothesis is needed for this support-side extinction statement.

declarations.name: iteratedDilationDifference_eq_zero_of_cardFactors_le
declarations.signature: theorem iteratedDilationDifference_eq_zero_of_cardFactors_le (A : Set ℕ) {ps : List ℕ} {K n : ℕ} (hprime : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Prime) (hpair : ps.Pairwise Nat.Coprime) (hn : n.Coprime ps.prod) (hbound : ∀ a ∈ A, ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors a ≤ K) (hlen : K < ps.length) : iteratedDilationDifference ps (supportCoeffInt A) n = 0
declarations.docstring: The finite bounded-`Ω` annihilation theorem: a pairwise-coprime prime list longer than the support's `Ω` ceiling makes the actual iterated dilation difference vanish at arguments coprime to its product.

declarations.name: OrthogonalPetalBouquet
declarations.docstring: A finite-core orthogonal petal bouquet. Every exceptional element and every ray core is absorbed by one fixed positive integer `Q`; the residual petals are nontrivial, coprime to `Q`, globally pairwise coprime, and have summable reciprocal mass. The support equation is deliberately set-valued, so duplicate bookkeeping cannot change the Boolean divisor transform.

declarations.name: ray
declarations.signature: def ray {A : Set ℕ} (hB : OrthogonalPetalBouquet A) (i : ℕ) : ℕ
declarations.docstring: The support ray attached to an index.

declarations.name: ray_pos
declarations.signature: theorem ray_pos {A : Set ℕ} (hB : OrthogonalPetalBouquet A) (i : ℕ) : 0 < hB.ray i

declarations.name: ray_mem
declarations.signature: theorem ray_mem {A : Set ℕ} (hB : OrthogonalPetalBouquet A) (i : ℕ) : hB.ray i ∈ A

declarations.name: exceptional_ne_ray
declarations.signature: theorem exceptional_ne_ray {A : Set ℕ} (hB : OrthogonalPetalBouquet A) {d : ℕ} (hd : d ∈ hB.exceptional) (i : ℕ) : d ≠ hB.ray i
