The forward direction selects the genuine bit length `b = log₂(B)+1` of the first-escape radius. The reverse direction is the terminal transport theorem.

declarations.name: ActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap
declarations.signature: def ActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap (a J K m : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: A one-sided actual-word gap which excludes the positive top-edge carry. Unlike total staircase annihilation, this condition merely asks the final `m`-bit residue to lie at or below the complement of the directed carry strip. By `windowDiscrepancy_emod_two_pow_eq_terminal`, it is a condition on the last `m` actual arithmetic letters alone.

declarations.name: actualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap_iff_terminal
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap_iff_terminal (a J K m : ℕ) : ActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap a J K m ↔ m ≤ K ∧ ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J + K + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) < (2 : ℤ) ^ m ∧ windowDiscrepancy (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) (periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J + (K - m)) m % (2 : ℤ) ^ m ≤ (2 : ℤ) ^ m - ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J + K + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: Exact terminal-suffix form of the one-sided residue gap.

declarations.name: diagonalSuffixResidue_eq_windowDiscrepancy
declarations.signature: theorem diagonalSuffixResidue_eq_windowDiscrepancy (t J m : ℕ) : diagonalSuffixResidue t J m = windowDiscrepancy (periodLcm t) (periodLcm t + J) m % 2 ^ m
declarations.docstring: The sliding-suffix residue is exactly the corresponding translated actual-LCM discrepancy word modulo its suffix modulus.

declarations.name: actualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap_or_of_adjacentSuffixMidband
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap_or_of_adjacentSuffixMidband {a m : ℕ} (hroom : ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + m + 3 : ℕ) : ℤ) < (2 : ℤ) ^ m) (hlo : ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + m + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue (2 ^ a) 0 m) (hhi : diagonalAdjacentSuffixResidue (2 ^ a) 0 m ≤ (2 : ℤ) ^ m - ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + m + 3 : ℕ) : ℤ)) : ActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap a 0 m m ∨ ActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap a 0 (m + 1) m
declarations.docstring: **One-sided adjacent-gap geometry.** To obtain an upper top-edge gap at one of two adjacent depths, the circular suffix displacement need only avoid the two individual upper-edge arcs. The older symmetric certificate spends the sum of both edge widths on both sides; this theorem spends one `2H` edge on each side and asks for no lower margin at the selected depth.

declarations.name: LcmDiagonalTopEdgeGap
declarations.docstring: The corrected top-edge target on the quotient-scale arithmetic word. It retains only the upper edge of `LcmDiagonalArithmeticKill`; no positive lower margin is required.

declarations.name: actualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap_zero_self_iff_lcmDiagonalTopEdgeGap
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap_zero_self_iff_lcmDiagonalTopEdgeGap (a K : ℕ) : ActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap a 0 K K ↔ LcmDiagonalTopEdgeGap (2 ^ a) K
declarations.docstring: At `J = 0` and full precision `m = K`, the localized gap is exactly the one-sided quotient-scale arithmetic gap.

declarations.name: lcmDiagonalTopEdgeGap_of_diagonalFreshLossResidueCert
declarations.signature: theorem lcmDiagonalTopEdgeGap_of_diagonalFreshLossResidueCert {t L : ℕ} (hcert : diagonalFreshLossResidueCert t L) : LcmDiagonalTopEdgeGap t L
declarations.docstring: The older asymmetric fresh-loss certificate is stronger than the new one-sided top-edge target: its strict upper edge gives the desired weak upper edge, while its positive lower edge forces the modulus room.

declarations.name: lcmDiagonalTopEdgeGap_of_lcmDiagonalArithmeticKill
declarations.signature: theorem lcmDiagonalTopEdgeGap_of_lcmDiagonalArithmeticKill {t L : ℕ} (hkill : LcmDiagonalArithmeticKill t L) : LcmDiagonalTopEdgeGap t L
declarations.docstring: The symmetric arithmetic kill also projects to the corrected one-sided gap.

declarations.name: actualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap_zero_self_of_diagonalSymmetricResidueCert
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap_zero_self_of_diagonalSymmetricResidueCert {a K : ℕ} (hcert : diagonalSymmetricResidueCert (2 ^ a) K) : ActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap a 0 K K
declarations.docstring: Symmetric diagonal certificates can be consumed by the localized top-edge route without passing through the real tail first.

declarations.name: ActualLcmTerminalPuncturedDyadicStaircase
declarations.signature: def ActualLcmTerminalPuncturedDyadicStaircase (a J K m : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: A viable weakening of the impossible full staircase. Only the letters before the terminal one are annihilated at their binary places; the last letter is retained as a nonzero residue and is required to land below the top-edge carry band.

declarations.name: actualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap_of_puncturedDyadicStaircase
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap_of_puncturedDyadicStaircase {a J K m : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : J + K + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) (hpunc : ActualLcmTerminalPuncturedDyadicStaircase a J K m) : ActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap a J K m
declarations.docstring: A punctured staircase produces the one-sided top-edge residue gap. The terminal arithmetic letter survives literally; every earlier suffix letter vanishes modulo `2^m` after its binary weight is included.

declarations.name: puncturedDyadicStaircase_penultimate_eq_half
declarations.signature: theorem puncturedDyadicStaircase_penultimate_eq_half {a J K m : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : J + K + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) (hpunc : ActualLcmTerminalPuncturedDyadicStaircase a J K m) : lcmRayArithmeticLetter (2 ^ a) (J + K - 1) = (2 : ℤ) ^ (m - 1) ∧ (2 : ℤ) ^ m < 2 * ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J + K + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: The punctured route has an exact penultimate-letter cost. At the wide modulus required by the carry strip, positivity and the elementary letter upper bound force the penultimate letter to be exactly the half-turn `2^(m-1)`. In particular the modulus must be the first dyadic scale above the room bound; taking an extra bit makes even the punctured route empty.

declarations.name: actualLcmTailDiff_notMem_int_of_topEdgeResidueGap
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTailDiff_notMem_int_of_topEdgeResidueGap {a J K m : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : J + K + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) (hgap : ActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap a J K m) : totientTail (2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J) - totientTail (periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J) ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: **Non-vacuous localized top-edge consumer.** If a terminal dyadic residue avoids the upper carry strip at any precision `m ≤ K`, the positive actual-LCM tail difference cannot be integral. This is strictly weaker than the symmetric certified-kill band and does not demand zero residue.

declarations.name: actualLcmTailOrbit_notMem_int_of_topEdgeResidueGap
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTailOrbit_notMem_int_of_topEdgeResidueGap {a K m : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : K + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) (hgap : ActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGap a 0 K m) : actualLcmTailOrbit a ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: The localized residue-gap consumer at the actual orbit `J = 0`.

declarations.name: PowerTwoActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGapSupply
declarations.docstring: Cofinal supply target for the genuinely non-vacuous one-sided actual-word gap.

declarations.name: PowerTwoAdjacentSuffixMidbandSupply
declarations.docstring: The exact cofinal arithmetic socket exposed by one-sided adjacent-gap geometry. At depth `m`, the adjacent suffix displacement avoids only the two individual upper-edge arcs. The buffer is stated for the larger candidate depth `m + 1`, so either branch produced below remains inside the actual-LCM sign corridor.

declarations.name: PowerTwoOddGuardTopEdgeHalfWordBandSupply
declarations.docstring: Odd-depth half-word form of the one-sided top-edge producer. If `m = 2q+1`, the adjacent suffix residue is twice the half-word residue, and both directed edge widths divide by two to the same exact threshold `periodLcm (2^a) + q + 2`. This is substantially weaker than the older fixed `1/32` central band.

declarations.name: centeredTopEdgeBand_iff_abs
declarations.signature: theorem centeredTopEdgeBand_iff_abs {M B z : ℤ} (hM : 0 < M) (hBhalf : 2 * B ≤ M) (hz : |z| ≤ M / 2) : (B ≤ z % M ∧ z % M ≤ M - B) ↔ B ≤ |z|
declarations.docstring: A closed Euclidean band of arbitrary half-width is exactly a lower bound on the absolute value of a centered representative.

declarations.name: twice_topEdgeHalfWordThreshold_le_fourPow
declarations.signature: theorem twice_topEdgeHalfWordThreshold_le_fourPow {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hdepth : oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a) = 2 * q + 1) : 2 * ((periodLcm (2 ^ a) + q + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (4 : ℤ) ^ q
declarations.docstring: At the guarded canonical rank, the exact top-edge threshold fits inside the signed half-cell of the base-four half-word.

declarations.name: oddGuardTopEdgeHalfWordBand_iff_actualFinalCenteredMagnitude
declarations.signature: theorem oddGuardTopEdgeHalfWordBand_iff_actualFinalCenteredMagnitude {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hdepth : oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a) = 2 * q + 1) : let B : ℤ
declarations.docstring: Pointwise exact form of the new producer: the half-word avoids both top-edge arcs precisely when its actual centered lift has magnitude at least `periodLcm (2^a) + q + 2`.

declarations.name: oddHalfWordTopEdgeBand_iff_actualCenteredMagnitude_of_fit
declarations.signature: theorem oddHalfWordTopEdgeBand_iff_actualCenteredMagnitude_of_fit {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (B : ℤ) (hfit : 2 * B ≤ (4 : ℤ) ^ q) : (B ≤ powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q % (4 : ℤ) ^ q ∧ powerTwoOddHalfCorrectionWord a q % (4 : ℤ) ^ q ≤ (4 : ℤ) ^ q - B) ↔ B ≤ |actualOddHalfCenteredLift a q|
declarations.docstring: Arbitrary-rank version of the exact centered-state identity. The canonical-depth hypothesis is used only to prove that the requested edge width fits inside the half-cell; once that fit is supplied explicitly, the identity holds at every odd rank.

declarations.name: PowerTwoActualFinalTopEdgeMagnitudeSupply
declarations.docstring: Cofinal actual-state form of the exact top-edge half-word producer.

declarations.name: topEdgeHalfWordBandSupply_iff_actualFinalCenteredMagnitudeSupply
declarations.docstring: The exact top-edge half-word supply and the final centered-magnitude supply are equivalent, not merely one-way reductions.

declarations.name: exists_int_scaled_actualLcmTailOrbit_sub_eq
declarations.signature: theorem exists_int_scaled_actualLcmTailOrbit_sub_eq {a q : ℕ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) : ∃ k : ℤ, (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * q + 1) * (actualLcmTailOrbit a - (k : ℝ)) = (totientTail (2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + (2 * q + 1)) - totientTail (periodLcm (2 ^ a) + (2 * q + 1))) - ((diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 1 + 1) - 2 * actualOddHalfCenteredLift a q : ℤ) : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: The actual LCM orbit differs from an integer by one exact shifted-tail error. The integer is selected by centering the even odd-depth raw block; no integrality or half-cell-fit hypothesis is used.

declarations.name: exists_int_actualLcmTailOrbit_close_of_actualTerminalCarryCorridor
declarations.signature: theorem exists_int_actualLcmTailOrbit_close_of_actualTerminalCarryCorridor {a q : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : 2 * q + 1 + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) (hcorr : diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 1 + 1) - ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + (2 * q + 1) + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) < 2 * actualOddHalfCenteredLift a q ∧ 2 * actualOddHalfCenteredLift a q < diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 1 + 1)) : ∃ k : ℤ, |actualLcmTailOrbit a - (k : ℝ)| < actualLcmRawErrorRadius a q
declarations.docstring: A hit in the open terminal/carry corridor gives an integer within the elementary raw-error radius of the actual LCM orbit. Thus the corridor is an exact shrinking anti-concentration target, not merely a modular band.

declarations.name: actualTerminalCarryCorridorEscape_of_actualLcmOrbitSeparation
declarations.signature: theorem actualTerminalCarryCorridorEscape_of_actualLcmOrbitSeparation {a q : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : 2 * q + 1 + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) (hsep : ∀ k : ℤ, actualLcmRawErrorRadius a q ≤ |actualLcmTailOrbit a - (k : ℝ)|) : 2 * actualOddHalfCenteredLift a q ≤ diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 1 + 1) - ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + (2 * q + 1) + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∨ diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 1 + 1) ≤ 2 * actualOddHalfCenteredLift a q
declarations.docstring: Separation from every integer by the elementary raw-error radius forces escape from the open terminal/carry corridor at that rank.

declarations.name: two_mul_actualOddHalfCenteredLift_eq_terminal_sub_trueCarry
declarations.signature: theorem two_mul_actualOddHalfCenteredLift_eq_terminal_sub_trueCarry {a q : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : 2 * q + 1 + 1 + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) (hfit : 2 * ((periodLcm (2 ^ a) + q + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (4 : ℤ) ^ q) {z : ℤ} (hz : (z : ℝ) = actualLcmTailOrbit a) : 2 * actualOddHalfCenteredLift a q = diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 1 + 1) - carryOrbit (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) z (2 * q + 1)
declarations.docstring: If the actual LCM tail orbit is integral, then the doubled centered odd-half state is exactly the terminal arithmetic letter minus the positive true carry at the same endpoint. The half-cell fit is what turns the modular identity into an equality of integers.

declarations.name: actualLcmTailOrbit_notMem_int_of_actualTerminalCarryCorridorEscape
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTailOrbit_notMem_int_of_actualTerminalCarryCorridorEscape {a q : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : 2 * q + 1 + 1 + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) (hfit : 2 * ((periodLcm (2 ^ a) + q + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (4 : ℤ) ^ q) (hescape : 2 * actualOddHalfCenteredLift a q ≤ diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 1 + 1) - ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + (2 * q + 1) + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∨ diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 1 + 1) ≤ 2 * actualOddHalfCenteredLift a q) : actualLcmTailOrbit a ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: Under integrality, the doubled centered state lies in the open corridor between the terminal letter minus the directed endpoint bound and the terminal letter itself. Escaping either side therefore proves exact nonintegrality at that rank.

declarations.name: actualLcmTailOrbit_notMem_int_of_actualTerminalDominance
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTailOrbit_notMem_int_of_actualTerminalDominance {a q : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : 2 * q + 1 + 1 + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) (hfit : 2 * ((periodLcm (2 ^ a) + q + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (4 : ℤ) ^ q) (hdom : diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 1 + 1) ≤ 2 * actualOddHalfCenteredLift a q) : actualLcmTailOrbit a ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: A terminal letter dominated by twice the actual centered state excludes an integral actual-LCM orbit at that odd rank.

declarations.name: PowerTwoFlexibleActualTerminalCarryCorridorEscapeSupply
declarations.docstring: Cofinal supply of odd ranks whose centered state escapes the exact open terminal/carry corridor forced by an integral actual-LCM orbit.

declarations.name: PowerTwoFlexibleActualTerminalDominanceSupply
declarations.docstring: Cofinal one-sided producer exposed by the exact terminal/carry identity. Unlike the two-sided magnitude target, it only asks the centered state to dominate half of the final literal arithmetic letter.

declarations.name: flexibleActualTerminalCarryCorridorEscapeSupply_of_dominance
declarations.docstring: Terminal dominance is the upper escape branch of the exact carry corridor.

declarations.name: PowerTwoFlexibleActualTopEdgeMagnitudeSupply
declarations.docstring: Strictly weaker cofinal producer: the witness may use any odd rank whose exact top-edge threshold fits the half-cell and whose adjacent depth remains inside the actual-LCM sign corridor.

declarations.name: flexibleActualTerminalCarryCorridorEscapeSupply_of_magnitude
declarations.docstring: The two-sided centered-magnitude producer implies escape from the exact terminal/carry corridor. The positive centered branch escapes above the terminal letter; the negative branch escapes below the directed endpoint bound.

declarations.name: flexibleActualTopEdgeMagnitudeSupply_of_actualFinal
declarations.docstring: The canonical final-state producer is a special case of the flexible odd-rank producer.

declarations.name: powerTwoAdjacentSuffixMidbandSupply_of_flexibleActualTopEdgeMagnitude
declarations.docstring: An exact centered-magnitude witness at any admissible odd rank supplies the one-sided adjacent-suffix midband.

declarations.name: powerTwoAdjacentSuffixMidbandSupply_of_oddGuardTopEdgeHalfWordBand
declarations.docstring: The exact odd half-word band supplies the one-sided adjacent midband. The linear LCM guard pays the larger-depth sign buffer automatically.

declarations.name: powerTwoActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGapSupply_of_adjacentSuffixMidband
declarations.docstring: A cofinal one-sided adjacent midband gives the corrected actual-LCM top-edge supply, choosing whichever of depths `m` and `m + 1` has the upper gap.

declarations.name: powerTwoActualLcmTopEdgeResidueGapSupply_of_oddGuardHalfWordBand
declarations.docstring: The existing odd-guard half-word producer reaches the corrected top-edge supply. The new linear LCM guard is the missing quantitative link: it keeps both adjacent certificate depths inside the `a+6` sign corridor.

declarations.name: actualLcmOrbitNonintegralitySupply_of_topEdgeResidueGap
declarations.docstring: A cofinal localized top-edge gap supplies exact actual-LCM orbit nonintegrality.

declarations.name: actualLcmOrbitNonintegralitySupply_of_flexibleActualTerminalDominance
declarations.docstring: The one-sided terminal-dominance producer supplies cofinal exact nonintegrality of the actual LCM orbit.

declarations.name: actualLcmOrbitNonintegralitySupply_of_flexibleActualTerminalCarryCorridorEscape
declarations.docstring: Escaping either side of the exact terminal/carry corridor supplies cofinal nonintegrality of the actual LCM orbit.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_topEdgeResidueGapSupply

declarations.docstring: Endpoint fan-in from the localized one-sided producer to Erdős #249.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_adjacentSuffixMidbandSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_adjacentSuffixMidbandSupply (hsupply : PowerTwoAdjacentSuffixMidbandSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: Direct #249 endpoint for the weaker one-sided adjacent-suffix producer.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_oddGuardTopEdgeHalfWordBandSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_oddGuardTopEdgeHalfWordBandSupply (hsupply : PowerTwoOddGuardTopEdgeHalfWordBandSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: Direct #249 endpoint for the exact odd half-word top-edge band.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_actualFinalTopEdgeMagnitudeSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_actualFinalTopEdgeMagnitudeSupply (hsupply : PowerTwoActualFinalTopEdgeMagnitudeSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: Direct #249 endpoint in the exact centered actual-state formulation.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_flexibleActualTopEdgeMagnitudeSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_flexibleActualTopEdgeMagnitudeSupply (hsupply : PowerTwoFlexibleActualTopEdgeMagnitudeSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)

declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_flexibleActualTerminalDominanceSupply (hsupply : PowerTwoFlexibleActualTerminalDominanceSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: Direct #249 endpoint for the one-sided terminal-dominance producer.

declarations.name: irrational_totientSeries_of_flexibleActualTerminalCarryCorridorEscapeSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totientSeries_of_flexibleActualTerminalCarryCorridorEscapeSupply (hsupply : PowerTwoFlexibleActualTerminalCarryCorridorEscapeSupply) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: Direct #249 endpoint for the exact terminal/carry corridor-escape producer.

declarations.name: actualLcmTailDiff_notMem_int_of_terminalDyadicStaircase
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTailDiff_notMem_int_of_terminalDyadicStaircase {a J K m : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : J + K + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) (hstair : ActualLcmTerminalDyadicStaircase a J K m) (hwide : ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J + K + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) < (2 : ℤ) ^ m) : totientTail (2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J) - totientTail (periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J) ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: The formal terminal-staircase implication. Its hypotheses are inconsistent by `not_actualLcmTerminalDyadicStaircase_of_room`; the theorem is retained as an explicit consumer-shaped record of the failed route. A fixed small modulus also cannot suffice, as `small_modulus_has_positive_divisible_candidate` shows.

declarations.name: actualLcmTailOrbit_notMem_int_of_terminalDyadicStaircase
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTailOrbit_notMem_int_of_terminalDyadicStaircase {a K m : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : K + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) (hstair : ActualLcmTerminalDyadicStaircase a 0 K m) (hwide : ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + K + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) < (2 : ℤ) ^ m) : actualLcmTailOrbit a ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: The same producer specialized to the actual orbit at `J = 0`.

declarations.name: carryDerivative
declarations.signature: def carryDerivative (u : ℕ → ℤ) (n : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: The discrete derivative naturally recovered from a binary carry orbit.

declarations.name: carryDerivative_eq_scaledCoeff_of_recurrence
declarations.signature: theorem carryDerivative_eq_scaledCoeff_of_recurrence {c : ℕ → ℕ} {v : ℕ} {u : ℕ → ℤ} (hrec : ∀ N : ℕ, u (N + 1) = 2 * u N - ((v * c (N + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : carryDerivative u n = ((v * c n : ℕ) : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: Any exact binary-orbit recurrence recovers its coefficient at every positive index through `carryDerivative`. Temperedness is not needed.

declarations.name: totient_temperedOrbit_derivative
declarations.signature: theorem totient_temperedOrbit_derivative {v : ℕ} {u : ℕ → ℤ} (hu : IsTemperedBinaryOrbit Nat.totient v u) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : carryDerivative u n = ((v * Nat.totient n : ℕ) : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: A tempered totient orbit recovers the scaled totient sequence through its discrete carry derivative.

declarations.name: totient_carryDerivative_coprime_mul
declarations.signature: theorem totient_carryDerivative_coprime_mul {v : ℕ} {u : ℕ → ℤ} (hu : IsTemperedBinaryOrbit Nat.totient v u) {m n : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) (hcop : Nat.Coprime m n) : (v : ℤ) * carryDerivative u (m * n) = carryDerivative u m * carryDerivative u n
declarations.docstring: The carry derivative inherits Euler totient's multiplicativity on coprime positive arguments.

declarations.name: totient_carryDerivative_gcd_mul
declarations.signature: theorem totient_carryDerivative_gcd_mul {v : ℕ} {u : ℕ → ℤ} (hu : IsTemperedBinaryOrbit Nat.totient v u) {m n : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hn : 0 < n) : carryDerivative u (m * n) * carryDerivative u (m.gcd n) = (m.gcd n : ℤ) * carryDerivative u m * carryDerivative u n
declarations.docstring: GCD-corrected multiplicativity of the carry derivative. Unlike the coprime specialization, this identity retains the exact non-coprime defect.

declarations.name: carryKernelSeq
declarations.signature: def carryKernelSeq (u : ℕ → ℤ) (j r : ℕ) : ℕ → ℚ
declarations.docstring: A dyadic section of an integer carry orbit, viewed over `ℚ`.

declarations.name: totient_carryKernel_diff
declarations.signature: theorem totient_carryKernel_diff {v : ℕ} {u : ℕ → ℤ} (hu : IsTemperedBinaryOrbit Nat.totient v u) {j r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) : (fun n => (v : ℚ) * totientKernelSeq j r n) = fun n => 2 * carryKernelSeq u j (r - 1) n - carryKernelSeq u j r n
declarations.docstring: Every positive-residue totient-kernel channel is a two-term difference of adjacent carry-kernel channels. This is the exact coefficient-to-carry bridge used by rank-transfer arguments.

declarations.name: TotientOddIndex
declarations.docstring: The odd canonical dyadic channels through levels `1,...,e`.

declarations.name: TotientCarryIndex
declarations.docstring: The full carry-section family through levels `1,...,e`.

declarations.name: canonicalTotientOddKernelFamily
declarations.signature: def canonicalTotientOddKernelFamily (e : ℕ) : TotientOddIndex e → ℕ → ℚ | ⟨j, r⟩ => totientKernelSeq (j.val + 1) (2 * r.val + 1) /-- Every carry section through levels `1,...,e`, without quotienting or identifying residue channels. -/ def canonicalCarryKernelFamily (u : ℕ → ℤ) (e : ℕ) : TotientCarryIndex e → ℕ → ℚ | ⟨j, r⟩ => carryKernelSeq u (j.val + 1) r.val /-- Embed an odd-channel index as its even predecessor carry section. -/ def carryEvenIndex {e : ℕ} : TotientOddIndex e → TotientCarryIndex e | ⟨j, r⟩ => ⟨j, ⟨2 * r.val,
declarations.docstring: The odd-residue part of the canonical totient family.

declarations.name: canonicalCarryKernelFamily
declarations.signature: def canonicalCarryKernelFamily (u : ℕ → ℤ) (e : ℕ) : TotientCarryIndex e → ℕ → ℚ | ⟨j, r⟩ => carryKernelSeq u (j.val + 1) r.val /-- Embed an odd-channel index as its even predecessor carry section. -/ def carryEvenIndex {e : ℕ} : TotientOddIndex e → TotientCarryIndex e | ⟨j, r⟩ => ⟨j, ⟨2 * r.val,
declarations.docstring: Every carry section through levels `1,...,e`, without quotienting or identifying residue channels.

declarations.name: carryEvenIndex
declarations.signature: def carryEvenIndex {e : ℕ} : TotientOddIndex e → TotientCarryIndex e | ⟨j, r⟩ => ⟨j, ⟨2 * r.val,
declarations.docstring: Embed an odd-channel index as its even predecessor carry section.

declarations.name: carryOddIndex
declarations.signature: def carryOddIndex {e : ℕ} : TotientOddIndex e → TotientCarryIndex e | ⟨j, r⟩ => ⟨j, ⟨2 * r.val + 1,
declarations.docstring: Embed an odd-channel index as the corresponding odd carry section.

declarations.name: canonicalCarryDifferenceFamily
declarations.signature: def canonicalCarryDifferenceFamily (u : ℕ → ℤ) (e : ℕ) : TotientOddIndex e → ℕ → ℚ
declarations.docstring: The carry differences that recover the odd canonical totient channels.

declarations.name: card_totientOddIndex
declarations.signature: theorem card_totientOddIndex (e : ℕ) : Fintype.card (TotientOddIndex e) = 2 ^ e - 1
declarations.docstring: There are exactly `2^e-1` odd canonical channels through level `e`.

declarations.name: linearIndependent_totientOddKernelFamily
declarations.signature: theorem linearIndependent_totientOddKernelFamily (e : ℕ) (hcanon : LinearIndependent ℚ (canonicalTotientKernelFamily e)) : LinearIndependent ℚ (canonicalTotientOddKernelFamily e)
declarations.docstring: Linear independence of the full canonical family restricts to the odd canonical channels.

declarations.name: linearIndependent_totientOddKernelFamily_of_certificate
declarations.signature: theorem linearIndependent_totientOddKernelFamily_of_certificate (e : ℕ) (cert : SeparatedMinorCertificate (canonicalTotientKernelFamily e)) : LinearIndependent ℚ (canonicalTotientOddKernelFamily e)
declarations.docstring: A separated minor for the canonical family already certifies independence of all its odd channels.

declarations.name: canonicalCarryDifferenceFamily_eq_smul_totient
declarations.signature: theorem canonicalCarryDifferenceFamily_eq_smul_totient {v : ℕ} {u : ℕ → ℤ} (hu : IsTemperedBinaryOrbit Nat.totient v u) (e : ℕ) : canonicalCarryDifferenceFamily u e = fun i => (v : ℚ) • canonicalTotientOddKernelFamily e i
declarations.docstring: The recurrence identifies the canonical carry differences with the odd totient channels, scaled by the orbit multiplier.

declarations.name: canonicalCarryDifferenceFamily_mem_span
declarations.signature: theorem canonicalCarryDifferenceFamily_mem_span (u : ℕ → ℤ) (e : ℕ) (i : TotientOddIndex e) : canonicalCarryDifferenceFamily u e i ∈ Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range (canonicalCarryKernelFamily u e))
declarations.docstring: Every canonical carry difference lies in the span of the full finite-level carry family.

declarations.name: finrank_canonicalCarryKernel_ge_of_linearIndependent
declarations.signature: theorem finrank_canonicalCarryKernel_ge_of_linearIndependent {v : ℕ} {u : ℕ → ℤ} (hv : 0 < v) (hu : IsTemperedBinaryOrbit Nat.totient v u) (e : ℕ) (hcanon : LinearIndependent ℚ (canonicalTotientKernelFamily e)) : 2 ^ e - 1 ≤ finrank ℚ (Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range (canonicalCarryKernelFamily u e)))
declarations.docstring: **Finite-level carry anti-compression.** A nonzero-multiplier orbit whose canonical totient family is linearly independent must retain at least `2^e-1` dimensions among its carry sections through level `e`. Temperedness is not used beyond supplying the exact recurrence through the existing orbit interface.

declarations.name: finrank_canonicalCarryKernel_ge_of_certificate
declarations.signature: theorem finrank_canonicalCarryKernel_ge_of_certificate {v : ℕ} {u : ℕ → ℤ} (hv : 0 < v) (hu : IsTemperedBinaryOrbit Nat.totient v u) (e : ℕ) (cert : SeparatedMinorCertificate (canonicalTotientKernelFamily e)) : 2 ^ e - 1 ≤ finrank ℚ (Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range (canonicalCarryKernelFamily u e)))
declarations.docstring: Certificate-facing form of `finrank_canonicalCarryKernel_ge_of_linearIndependent`. This is immediately usable with the existing finite separated-minor owner.

declarations.name: finrank_canonicalCarryKernel_ge
declarations.signature: theorem finrank_canonicalCarryKernel_ge {v : ℕ} {u : ℕ → ℤ} (hv : 0 < v) (hu : IsTemperedBinaryOrbit Nat.totient v u) (e : ℕ) : 2 ^ e - 1 ≤ finrank ℚ (Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range (canonicalCarryKernelFamily u e)))
declarations.docstring: **Universal finite-level carry anti-compression.** Every positive-scale tempered totient orbit retains at least `2^e-1` dimensions among its canonical carry sections through level `e`. The bound is unconditional once the orbit is given: the CRT--Dirichlet minor has already discharged the coefficient-side independence hypothesis. Rationality is used only downstream to produce such an orbit.

declarations.name: not_irrational_totientSeries_implies_unbounded_carryRank
declarations.signature: theorem not_irrational_totientSeries_implies_unbounded_carryRank (hcanon : ∀ e : ℕ, LinearIndependent ℚ (canonicalTotientKernelFamily e)) (hirr : ¬ Irrational (binaryCoeffSeries Nat.totient)) : ∃ v : ℕ, 0 < v ∧ ∃ u : ℕ → ℤ, IsTemperedBinaryOrbit Nat.totient v u ∧ ∀ e : ℕ, 2 ^ e - 1 ≤ finrank ℚ (Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range (canonicalCarryKernelFamily u e)))
declarations.docstring: Rationality of the totient coefficient series, together with an all-level canonical independence producer, yields one tempered integral carry whose finite-level section ranks grow at least as `2^e-1`.

declarations.name: not_irrational_totientSeries_implies_unbounded_carryRank_unconditional
declarations.signature: theorem not_irrational_totientSeries_implies_unbounded_carryRank_unconditional (hirr : ¬ Irrational (binaryCoeffSeries Nat.totient)) : ∃ v : ℕ, 0 < v ∧ ∃ u : ℕ → ℤ, IsTemperedBinaryOrbit Nat.totient v u ∧ ∀ e : ℕ, 2 ^ e - 1 ≤ finrank ℚ (Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range (canonicalCarryKernelFamily u e)))
declarations.docstring: **Unconditional anti-compression consequence of the CRT--Dirichlet minor.** If the totient series were rational, its tempered integral carry would have unbounded dyadic section rank. This does not by itself prove irrationality: a separate theorem bounding the dyadic section rank of every rationality-supplied tempered carry is still required, and no such finite-rank compression theorem follows from the recurrence and temperedness alone.

declarations.name: exponent_mul_primeFactors_card_lt
declarations.signature: theorem exponent_mul_primeFactors_card_lt {a n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hrough : ∀ r : ℕ, Nat.Prime r → r ∣ n → 2 ^ a < r) (hnPow : n < 2 ^ (2 * 2 ^ a)) : a * n.primeFactors.card < 2 * 2 ^ a
declarations.docstring: A `2^a`-rough integer below the actual-LCM height range has at most `2/a` as many distinct prime factors as the roughness cutoff. This is the vanishing version of the fixed `1/4` estimate used by the sign corridor.

declarations.name: one_sub_two_div_lt_totient_density_of_rough
declarations.signature: theorem one_sub_two_div_lt_totient_density_of_rough {a n : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hn : 0 < n) (hrough : ∀ r : ℕ, Nat.Prime r → r ∣ n → 2 ^ a < r) (hnPow : n < 2 ^ (2 * 2 ^ a)) : (n : ℚ) * (1 - (2 : ℚ) / a) < Nat.totient n
declarations.docstring: Quantitative rough Euler-density estimate. The defect is less than `2/a`, so the density tends to one along the power-of-two LCM scale without using the prime number theorem.

declarations.name: clean_periodLcm_divisor_of_sq_le
declarations.signature: theorem clean_periodLcm_divisor_of_sq_le {t j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) (hsq : j * j ≤ t) : j ∣ periodLcm t ∧ ∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ j → p ∣ periodLcm t / j
declarations.docstring: If `j² ≤ t`, then `j` is not merely a divisor of `L(t)`: every prime of `j` still occurs in the complementary cofactor `L(t) / j`. The square cutoff is the elementary uniform range in which the exact ray factorisation can be used without inspecting the prime-power exponents of `j`.

declarations.name: three_mul_periodLcm_add_one_lt_two_pow
declarations.signature: theorem three_mul_periodLcm_add_one_lt_two_pow {a : ℕ} (ha : 4 ≤ a) : 3 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + 1 < 2 ^ (2 * 2 ^ a)
declarations.docstring: The three fixed ray endpoints fit below the rough-density height range. The twelve-bit saving for the actual LCM makes this a completely elementary consequence, with ample room for the additive endpoint.

declarations.name: clean_ray_cofactor_primeFactors_gt
declarations.signature: theorem clean_ray_cofactor_primeFactors_gt {t j q r : ℕ} (hj : j ∣ periodLcm t) (hclean : ∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ j → p ∣ periodLcm t / j) (hr : Nat.Prime r) (hrdvd : r ∣ q * (periodLcm t / j) + 1) : t < r
declarations.docstring: A clean LCM-ray cofactor has no prime at or below the LCM cutoff.

declarations.name: fixed_rank_clean_endpoint_totient_bounds
declarations.signature: theorem fixed_rank_clean_endpoint_totient_bounds {a j q : ℕ} (ha : 4 ≤ a) (hj : 0 < j) (hsq : j * j ≤ 2 ^ a) (hq : q ≤ 3) : let H
declarations.docstring: Uniform fixed-rank ray estimate. On every clean offset `j² ≤ 2^a` and every rank `q ≤ 3`, the exact endpoint totient differs from its affine main term `φ(j)·(q·(H/j)+1)` by a relative amount below `2/a`. This is the quantitative input needed to make every fixed-rank second difference `o(H)`; unlike the earlier fixed `3/4` corridor, its error tends to zero with the LCM scale.

declarations.name: fixedRankEndpointDefect
declarations.signature: def fixedRankEndpointDefect (a j q : ℕ) : ℚ
declarations.docstring: The nonnegative loss from the affine fixed-rank main term.

declarations.name: fixedRankSecondDifference
declarations.docstring: The integral second difference across the first three positive LCM ranks. Its coefficient vector `(1,-2,1)` has `ℓ¹` height four.

declarations.name: MiddleRankTotientExtremal
declarations.docstring: The exact ordering socket for the fixed-rank curvature: the rank-two totient is strictly below both outer ranks or strictly above both of them. This is the local conclusion supplied by any factor-separated ordering of the three nonproportional linear forms. The unresolved arithmetic step for Erdős #249 is to force this socket on cofinally many prescribed LCM heights, not merely on a positive-density set of unrestricted heights.

declarations.name: fixedRankSecondDifference_pos_of_middle_strict_min
declarations.signature: theorem fixedRankSecondDifference_pos_of_middle_strict_min {H j : ℕ} (hleft : Nat.totient (2 * H + j) < Nat.totient (H + j)) (hright : Nat.totient (2 * H + j) < Nat.totient (3 * H + j)) : 0 < fixedRankSecondDifference H j
declarations.docstring: If the middle-rank totient is the strict minimum, the primitive three-rank curvature is positive.

declarations.name: fixedRankSecondDifference_neg_of_middle_strict_max
declarations.signature: theorem fixedRankSecondDifference_neg_of_middle_strict_max {H j : ℕ} (hleft : Nat.totient (H + j) < Nat.totient (2 * H + j)) (hright : Nat.totient (3 * H + j) < Nat.totient (2 * H + j)) : fixedRankSecondDifference H j < 0
declarations.docstring: If the middle-rank totient is the strict maximum, the primitive three-rank curvature is negative.

declarations.name: fixedRankSecondDifference_ne_zero_of_middleRankTotientExtremal
declarations.signature: theorem fixedRankSecondDifference_ne_zero_of_middleRankTotientExtremal {H j : ℕ} (h : MiddleRankTotientExtremal H j) : fixedRankSecondDifference H j ≠ 0
declarations.docstring: A middle-extremal ordering is already enough to separate the normalized fixed-rank curvature from zero; no quantitative gap is required.

declarations.name: PowerTwoLcmMiddleRankExtremalSupply
declarations.docstring: The specified sparse-orbit input suggested by simultaneous totient ordering results: a fixed offset whose rank-two value is extremal at arbitrarily large power-of-two LCM heights.

declarations.name: cofinal_fixedRankSecondDifference_ne_zero_of_middleRankExtremalSupply
declarations.signature: theorem cofinal_fixedRankSecondDifference_ne_zero_of_middleRankExtremalSupply {j : ℕ} (h : PowerTwoLcmMiddleRankExtremalSupply j) : ∀ A : ℕ, ∃ a : ℕ, A ≤ a ∧ fixedRankSecondDifference (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) j ≠ 0
declarations.docstring: The exact Lean consumer of the sparse-orbit ordering wish. Once the middle-extremal ordering is transferred to cofinally many LCM heights, the primitive fixed-rank curvature is nonzero at those same heights.

declarations.name: affine_rank_three_kernel_classification
declarations.signature: theorem affine_rank_three_kernel_classification {c₁ c₂ c₃ : ℤ} (hzero : c₁ + c₂ + c₃ = 0) (hlinear : c₁ + 2 * c₂ + 3 * c₃ = 0) : c₁ = c₃ ∧ c₂ = -2 * c₃ ∧ |c₁| + |c₂| + |c₃| = 4 * |c₃|
declarations.docstring: The primitive three-coordinate kernel annihilating both the constant and linear rank moments is unique. The pivot minor on the first two columns is `1`, hence odd; no hidden lattice index enlarges the primitive kernel.

declarations.name: affine_rank_three_pivotMinor_odd
declarations.docstring: The chosen affine-moment pivot minor is an odd unit.

declarations.name: fixedRankSecondDifference_two_mul_even
declarations.signature: theorem fixedRankSecondDifference_two_mul_even {H j : ℕ} (hH : Even H) (hj : Even j) : fixedRankSecondDifference (2 * H) (2 * j) = 2 * fixedRankSecondDifference H j
declarations.docstring: Exact dyadic scaling of the primitive rank curvature when the reduced height and offset are even.

declarations.name: fixedRankSecondDifference_two_mul_odd
declarations.signature: theorem fixedRankSecondDifference_two_mul_odd {H j : ℕ} (hH : Even H) (hj : Odd j) : fixedRankSecondDifference (2 * H) (2 * j) = fixedRankSecondDifference H j
declarations.docstring: Exact dyadic scaling of the primitive rank curvature at an odd reduced offset: the final factor of two does not enlarge the curvature.

declarations.name: fixedRankSecondDifference_two_pow_succ_mul
declarations.signature: theorem fixedRankSecondDifference_two_pow_succ_mul (H j n : ℕ) (hH : Even H) (hj : Odd j) : fixedRankSecondDifference (2 ^ (n + 1) * H) (2 ^ (n + 1) * j) = (2 : ℤ) ^ n * fixedRankSecondDifference H j
declarations.docstring: Iterating the parity split gives the exact valuation contribution of a dyadically scaled odd offset.

declarations.name: fixedRankSecondDifference_even
declarations.signature: theorem fixedRankSecondDifference_even {H j : ℕ} (hH : 2 ≤ H) (hj : 1 ≤ j) : Even (fixedRankSecondDifference H j)
declarations.docstring: Every positive-offset curvature above height two is even.

declarations.name: two_pow_succ_dvd_fixedRankSecondDifference
declarations.signature: theorem two_pow_succ_dvd_fixedRankSecondDifference (H j n : ℕ) (hH : Even H) (hHtwo : 2 ≤ H) (hj : Odd j) : (2 : ℤ) ^ (n + 1) ∣ fixedRankSecondDifference (2 ^ (n + 1) * H) (2 ^ (n + 1) * j)
declarations.docstring: The primitive rank kernel acquires exactly the expected growing dyadic divisor on scaled odd offsets.

declarations.name: fixedRankSecondDifference_dyadic_fixture_exact
declarations.docstring: Sharpness of the two-adic theorem: the normalized one-by-one minor is odd at every depth. Thus the bounded-height primitive kernel alone cannot force even one additional factor of two.

declarations.name: fixedRankEndpointDefect_nonneg_and_lt
declarations.signature: theorem fixedRankEndpointDefect_nonneg_and_lt {a j q : ℕ} (ha : 4 ≤ a) (hj : 0 < j) (hsq : j * j ≤ 2 ^ a) (hq : q ≤ 3) : 0 ≤ fixedRankEndpointDefect a j q ∧ fixedRankEndpointDefect a j q < (Nat.totient j : ℚ) * ((q * (periodLcm (2 ^ a) / j) + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) * (2 / (a : ℚ))
declarations.docstring: The fixed-rank endpoint defect is nonnegative and has relative size strictly below `2/a`.

declarations.name: fixedRankSecondDifference_periodLcm_eq_mul
declarations.signature: theorem fixedRankSecondDifference_periodLcm_eq_mul {t j : ℕ} (hjdvd : j ∣ periodLcm t) (hclean : ∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ j → p ∣ periodLcm t / j) : fixedRankSecondDifference (periodLcm t) j = (Nat.totient j : ℤ) * ((Nat.totient (3 * (periodLcm t / j) + 1) : ℤ) - 2 * Nat.totient (2 * (periodLcm t / j) + 1) + Nat.totient (periodLcm t / j + 1))
declarations.docstring: Exact clean-ray factorisation of the primitive rank curvature.

declarations.name: two_mul_totient_dvd_fixedRankSecondDifference
declarations.signature: theorem two_mul_totient_dvd_fixedRankSecondDifference {a j : ℕ} (ha : 4 ≤ a) (hj : 0 < j) (hsq : j * j ≤ 2 ^ a) : (2 * (Nat.totient j : ℤ)) ∣ fixedRankSecondDifference (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) j
declarations.docstring: On the square-root clean window the primitive curvature is divisible by `2·φ(j)`. The factor `φ(j)` is the exact local ray factor; the extra `2` comes from parity of the three odd rough cofactors.

declarations.name: fixed_rank_secondDifference_abs_lt
declarations.signature: theorem fixed_rank_secondDifference_abs_lt {a j : ℕ} (ha : 4 ≤ a) (hj : 0 < j) (hsq : j * j ≤ 2 ^ a) : let H
declarations.docstring: **Fixed-offset second-rank cancellation.** On every clean offset in the square-root window, the three endpoint ranks have an affine main term, so its second difference vanishes. What remains is bounded by the sum of three nonnegative rough-Euler defects, hence is `O(H/a)` with an explicit constant. This is a rigorous nonlinear normalization unavailable to any fixed-density estimate: the right-hand side is `o(H)` for every fixed offset `j`.

declarations.name: exists_primitive_fixedRankCurvature_with_bound
declarations.signature: theorem exists_primitive_fixedRankCurvature_with_bound {a j : ℕ} (ha : 4 ≤ a) (hj : 0 < j) (hsq : j * j ≤ 2 ^ a) : ∃ z : ℤ, fixedRankSecondDifference (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) j = (2 * (Nat.totient j : ℤ)) * z ∧ |(z : ℚ)| < ((8 * (periodLcm (2 ^ a) / j) + 4 : ℕ) : ℚ) / a ∧ (z = 0 ∨ 1 ≤ |z|)
declarations.docstring: **Primitive localized curvature.** After removing the exact local factor `2·φ(j)`, the three-rank curvature is an integer whose Archimedean height is strictly below `(8·H/j+4)/a`. The final disjunction is the exact second-order anti-concentration boundary: the normalized curvature either vanishes, or its absolute value is at least one. Thus any future argument only has to separate this primitive integer from zero; no coefficient gcd or hidden lattice index remains.

declarations.name: allBaseTotientKernelSeq
declarations.signature: def allBaseTotientKernelSeq (k j r : ℕ) : ℕ → ℚ
declarations.docstring: The `(j,r)` base-`k` kernel channel of Euler's totient, viewed over `ℚ`.

declarations.name: totientKernelReductionScalar
declarations.docstring: The constant rational multiplier in the one-step composite-base residue reduction. Its denominator is nonzero whenever `k > 0`.

declarations.name: totientKernelReductionScalar_ne_zero
declarations.signature: theorem totientKernelReductionScalar_ne_zero (k r : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) : totientKernelReductionScalar k r ≠ 0
declarations.docstring: The reduction scalar is nonzero for every positive base.

declarations.name: allBaseTotientKernelSeq_mul_residue_step
declarations.signature: theorem allBaseTotientKernelSeq_mul_residue_step (k j r : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (hj : 1 ≤ j) : allBaseTotientKernelSeq k (j + 1) (k * r) = totientKernelReductionScalar k r • allBaseTotientKernelSeq k j r
declarations.docstring: **Composite residue scalar reduction.** Once the lower level is positive, multiplying its residue and modulus by `k` scales the entire totient section by a constant depending only on `k` and the residue `r`. The factor is `totient(k) * gcd(k,r) / totient(gcd(k,r))`; it is not in general `totient(k)` for composite `k`.

declarations.name: canonicalAllBaseTotientKernelFamily
declarations.signature: def canonicalAllBaseTotientKernelFamily (k e : ℕ) : TotientKernelIndex k e → ℕ → ℚ | Sum.inl .F00 => allBaseTotientKernelSeq k 0 0 | Sum.inl .F10 => allBaseTotientKernelSeq k 1 0 | Sum.inr i => allBaseTotientKernelSeq k (totientKernelSectionLevel i) (totientKernelSectionResidue i) /-- Every base-`k` totient channel at levels `0,...,e`, before removing reducible residue channels. -/ abbrev AllBaseTotientKernelThroughLevelIndex (k e : ℕ)
declarations.docstring: The filtration-compatible all-base family: two distinguished zero residue channels and every positive residue not divisible by `k`.

declarations.name: AllBaseTotientKernelThroughLevelIndex
declarations.docstring: Every base-`k` totient channel at levels `0,...,e`, before removing reducible residue channels.

declarations.name: allBaseTotientKernelThroughLevelFamily
declarations.signature: def allBaseTotientKernelThroughLevelFamily (k e : ℕ) : AllBaseTotientKernelThroughLevelIndex k e → ℕ → ℚ | ⟨j, r⟩ => allBaseTotientKernelSeq k j.val r.val /-- Every channel through a positive depth belongs to the span of the filtration-compatible canonical all-base family. This spanning theorem is unconditional: composite residues are reduced recursively
declarations.docstring: The complete finite all-base kernel through level `e`.

declarations.name: allBaseTotientKernelSeq_mem_span_canonical_of_le
declarations.signature: theorem allBaseTotientKernelSeq_mem_span_canonical_of_le {k e j r : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hj : j ≤ e) (hr : r < k ^ j) : allBaseTotientKernelSeq k j r ∈ Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range (canonicalAllBaseTotientKernelFamily k e))
declarations.docstring: Every channel through a positive depth belongs to the span of the filtration-compatible canonical all-base family. This spanning theorem is unconditional: composite residues are reduced recursively by `allBaseTotientKernelSeq_mul_residue_step`.

declarations.name: range_canonicalAllBaseTotientKernelFamily_subset_throughLevel
declarations.signature: theorem range_canonicalAllBaseTotientKernelFamily_subset_throughLevel (k e : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (he : 1 ≤ e) : Set.range (canonicalAllBaseTotientKernelFamily k e) ⊆ Set.range (allBaseTotientKernelThroughLevelFamily k e)
declarations.docstring: At positive depth, every canonical all-base channel occurs literally in the complete finite truncation.

declarations.name: span_allBaseTotientKernelThroughLevelFamily_eq_canonical
declarations.signature: theorem span_allBaseTotientKernelThroughLevelFamily_eq_canonical (k e : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (he : 1 ≤ e) : Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range (allBaseTotientKernelThroughLevelFamily k e)) = Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range (canonicalAllBaseTotientKernelFamily k e))
declarations.docstring: The complete all-base kernel through a positive level and the canonical filtration-compatible family span the same subspace.

declarations.name: finrank_canonicalAllBaseTotientKernel_eq_of_linearIndependent
declarations.signature: theorem finrank_canonicalAllBaseTotientKernel_eq_of_linearIndependent (k e : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hcanon : LinearIndependent ℚ (canonicalAllBaseTotientKernelFamily k e)) : finrank ℚ (Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range (canonicalAllBaseTotientKernelFamily k e))) = k ^ e + 1
declarations.docstring: Linear independence of the canonical all-base family implies the exact cardinality-sized rank. This is the explicit external-input boundary: the hypothesis is not proved in this module.

declarations.name: finrank_allBaseTotientKernelThroughLevelFamily_eq_of_linearIndependent
declarations.signature: theorem finrank_allBaseTotientKernelThroughLevelFamily_eq_of_linearIndependent (k e : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (he : 1 ≤ e) (hcanon : LinearIndependent ℚ (canonicalAllBaseTotientKernelFamily k e)) : finrank ℚ (Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range (allBaseTotientKernelThroughLevelFamily k e))) = k ^ e + 1
declarations.docstring: **Conditional exact rank of the actual all-base truncation.** The arithmetic spanning and index-cardinality layers are formalised above. The only hypothesis is linear independence of the explicit canonical family, which is the external affine-ordering boundary and is not discharged here.

declarations.name: TotientKernelHeadIndex
declarations.signature: inductive TotientKernelHeadIndex | F00 | F10 deriving DecidableEq instance : Fintype TotientKernelHeadIndex
declarations.docstring: The two distinguished zero-residue channels, conventionally denoted `F00` and `F10`.

declarations.name: card_totientKernelHeadIndex
declarations.docstring: There are exactly two distinguished zero-residue indices.

declarations.name: TotientKernelSectionIndex
declarations.docstring: Coordinates for the nonzero canonical sections through levels `1, ..., e`. At the level represented by `j : Fin e`, the pair `(q,d)` encodes the residue `k * q + (d + 1)`.

declarations.name: TotientKernelIndex
declarations.docstring: The complete finite-level all-base index: two distinguished channels and all canonical nonzero section coordinates.

declarations.name: totientKernelSectionLevel
declarations.signature: def totientKernelSectionLevel {k e : ℕ} (i : TotientKernelSectionIndex k e) : ℕ
declarations.docstring: The positive level represented by a section coordinate.

declarations.name: totientKernelSectionResidue
declarations.signature: def totientKernelSectionResidue {k e : ℕ} (i : TotientKernelSectionIndex k e) : ℕ
declarations.docstring: The residue represented by quotient `q` and nonzero last base-`k` digit `d + 1`.

declarations.name: totientKernelSectionLevel_bounds
declarations.signature: theorem totientKernelSectionLevel_bounds {k e : ℕ} (i : TotientKernelSectionIndex k e) : 1 ≤ totientKernelSectionLevel i ∧ totientKernelSectionLevel i ≤ e
declarations.docstring: A section coordinate always represents one of the levels `1, ..., e`.

declarations.name: totientKernelSectionDigit_bounds
declarations.signature: theorem totientKernelSectionDigit_bounds {k e : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (i : TotientKernelSectionIndex k e) : 0 < i.2.2.val + 1 ∧ i.2.2.val + 1 < k
declarations.docstring: The encoded last digit is strictly between zero and the base.

declarations.name: totientKernelSectionResidue_pos
declarations.signature: theorem totientKernelSectionResidue_pos {k e : ℕ} (i : TotientKernelSectionIndex k e) : 0 < totientKernelSectionResidue i
declarations.docstring: The encoded residue is positive.

declarations.name: totientKernelSectionResidue_lt_pow
declarations.signature: theorem totientKernelSectionResidue_lt_pow {k e : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (i : TotientKernelSectionIndex k e) : totientKernelSectionResidue i < k ^ totientKernelSectionLevel i
declarations.docstring: The quotient and digit bounds put the encoded residue below its level modulus.

declarations.name: totientKernelSectionResidue_mod
declarations.signature: theorem totientKernelSectionResidue_mod {k e : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (i : TotientKernelSectionIndex k e) : totientKernelSectionResidue i % k = i.2.2.val + 1
declarations.docstring: Reducing an encoded residue modulo `k` recovers its nonzero last digit.

declarations.name: totientKernelSectionResidue_not_dvd
declarations.signature: theorem totientKernelSectionResidue_not_dvd {k e : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (i : TotientKernelSectionIndex k e) : ¬k ∣ totientKernelSectionResidue i
declarations.docstring: The encoded residue is not divisible by the base.

declarations.name: totientKernelSectionIndex_spec
declarations.signature: theorem totientKernelSectionIndex_spec {k e : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (i : TotientKernelSectionIndex k e) : 1 ≤ totientKernelSectionLevel i ∧ totientKernelSectionLevel i ≤ e ∧ 1 ≤ totientKernelSectionResidue i ∧ totientKernelSectionResidue i < k ^ totientKernelSectionLevel i ∧ ¬k ∣ totientKernelSectionResidue i
declarations.docstring: Every section coordinate has the advertised level, residue, and nondivisibility properties.

declarations.name: totientKernelResidueAtLevel
declarations.signature: def totientKernelResidueAtLevel (k : ℕ) {j : ℕ} (qd : Fin (k ^ j) × Fin (k - 1)) : ℕ
declarations.docstring: The residue represented by quotient/nonzero-digit coordinates at the fixed positive level `j + 1`.

declarations.name: totientKernelResidueAtLevel_pos
declarations.signature: theorem totientKernelResidueAtLevel_pos (k : ℕ) {j : ℕ} (qd : Fin (k ^ j) × Fin (k - 1)) : 0 < totientKernelResidueAtLevel k qd
declarations.docstring: A fixed-level encoded residue is positive.

declarations.name: totientKernelResidueAtLevel_lt_pow
declarations.signature: theorem totientKernelResidueAtLevel_lt_pow (k : ℕ) {j : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (qd : Fin (k ^ j) × Fin (k - 1)) : totientKernelResidueAtLevel k qd < k ^ (j + 1)
declarations.docstring: A fixed-level encoded residue lies below `k^(j+1)`.

declarations.name: totientKernelResidueAtLevel_mod
declarations.signature: theorem totientKernelResidueAtLevel_mod (k : ℕ) {j : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (qd : Fin (k ^ j) × Fin (k - 1)) : totientKernelResidueAtLevel k qd % k = qd.2.val + 1
declarations.docstring: Modulo the base, a fixed-level encoded residue is exactly its nonzero last digit.

declarations.name: totientKernelResidueAtLevel_not_dvd
declarations.signature: theorem totientKernelResidueAtLevel_not_dvd (k : ℕ) {j : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (qd : Fin (k ^ j) × Fin (k - 1)) : ¬k ∣ totientKernelResidueAtLevel k qd
declarations.docstring: A fixed-level encoded residue is not divisible by the base.

declarations.name: totientKernelResidueAtLevel_injective
declarations.signature: theorem totientKernelResidueAtLevel_injective (k j : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) : Function.Injective (totientKernelResidueAtLevel k : Fin (k ^ j) × Fin (k - 1) → ℕ)
declarations.docstring: Quotient/nonzero-digit coordinates are injective at each fixed level.

declarations.name: existsUnique_totientKernelResidueAtLevel
declarations.signature: theorem existsUnique_totientKernelResidueAtLevel (k j r : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (_hrpos : 1 ≤ r) (hrlt : r < k ^ (j + 1)) (hnotdvd : ¬k ∣ r) : ∃! qd : Fin (k ^ j) × Fin (k - 1), totientKernelResidueAtLevel k qd = r
declarations.docstring: Every positive nonmultiple below `k^(j+1)` has a unique fixed-level quotient/nonzero-digit representation. The representative is Euclidean: `q = r / k` and `d = r % k - 1`.

declarations.name: card_totientKernelSectionLevel
declarations.signature: theorem card_totientKernelSectionLevel (k j : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Fin (k ^ j) × Fin (k - 1)) = k ^ (j + 1) - k ^ j
declarations.docstring: At level `j + 1`, the quotient/nonzero-digit coordinates have cardinality `k^(j+1) - k^j`.

declarations.name: card_totientKernelSectionIndex
declarations.signature: theorem card_totientKernelSectionIndex (k e : ℕ) : Fintype.card (TotientKernelSectionIndex k e) = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range e, (k ^ (j + 1) - k ^ j)
declarations.docstring: The section-coordinate cardinality is the transparent telescoping sum `sum_{j<e} (k^(j+1) - k^j)`.

declarations.name: card_totientKernelIndex_eq_two_add_sum
declarations.signature: theorem card_totientKernelIndex_eq_two_add_sum (k e : ℕ) : Fintype.card (TotientKernelIndex k e) = 2 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range e, k ^ j * (k - 1)
declarations.docstring: Before telescoping, the complete index cardinality is two plus one block of `k^j * (k - 1)` coordinates at every `j < e`.

declarations.name: card_totientKernelIndex
declarations.signature: theorem card_totientKernelIndex (k e : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) : Fintype.card (TotientKernelIndex k e) = k ^ e + 1
declarations.docstring: The all-base combinatorial index has cardinality `k^e + 1` for every `k ≥ 2`. The statement is valid also at `e = 0`; the intended finite-level application uses `e ≥ 1`.

declarations.name: totient_mul_eq_of_primes_dvd
declarations.signature: theorem totient_mul_eq_of_primes_dvd : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < k → ∀ m : ℕ, (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ k → p ∣ m) → Nat.totient (k * m) = k * Nat.totient m
declarations.docstring: If every prime dividing `k` also divides `m`, then multiplying the argument by `k` multiplies the totient by exactly `k`.

declarations.name: totient_pow_mul_eq
declarations.signature: theorem totient_pow_mul_eq (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (n : ℕ) : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → Nat.totient (k ^ j * n) = k ^ (j - 1) * Nat.totient (k * n)
declarations.docstring: The zero-residue relation of the totient `k`-kernel: for `j ≥ 1`, `φ (k^j * n) = k^(j-1) * φ (k * n)`.

declarations.name: totient_pow_mul_gcd_cross_eq
declarations.signature: theorem totient_pow_mul_gcd_cross_eq (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (m t : ℕ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) : Nat.totient (Nat.gcd k m) * Nat.totient (k ^ t * m) = k ^ (t - 1) * Nat.totient k * Nat.gcd k m * Nat.totient m
declarations.docstring: Division-free composite-base reduction for a positive power of `k`. The rational scalar usually written `k^(t-1) * φ(k) * gcd(k,m) / φ(gcd(k,m))` is cross-multiplied so that the statement remains in `ℕ` without an exact-division side condition.

declarations.name: gcd_pow_mul_add_eq_gcd
declarations.signature: theorem gcd_pow_mul_add_eq_gcd (k h n u : ℕ) (hh : 1 ≤ h) : Nat.gcd k (k ^ h * n + u) = Nat.gcd k u
declarations.docstring: Adding a multiple of `k` does not change the gcd with `k`; written in the exact affine-section shape used by the all-base totient kernel.

declarations.name: totient_pow_mul_affine_gcd_cross_eq
declarations.signature: theorem totient_pow_mul_affine_gcd_cross_eq (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (h n u t : ℕ) (hh : 1 ≤ h) (ht : 1 ≤ t) : Nat.totient (Nat.gcd k u) * Nat.totient (k ^ t * (k ^ h * n + u)) = k ^ (t - 1) * Nat.totient k * Nat.gcd k u * Nat.totient (k ^ h * n + u)
declarations.docstring: Exact affine-section specialization of `totient_pow_mul_gcd_cross_eq`. For `m = k^h n + u` with `h ≥ 1`, the correction factor is controlled by `gcd(k,u)` and is therefore constant along the section. This is the arithmetic layer needed before the finite-dimensional all-base kernel basis argument; it does not assert the remaining linear independence theorem.

declarations.name: totientKernelSeq
declarations.signature: def totientKernelSeq (j r : ℕ) : ℕ → ℚ
declarations.docstring: The `(j,r)` dyadic-kernel channel of Euler's totient, viewed over `ℚ`.

declarations.name: TotientCanonicalIndex
declarations.docstring: The canonical channels through level `e`: the two zero-residue base channels, followed by every odd residue at levels `1,...,e`.

declarations.name: canonicalTotientKernelFamily
declarations.signature: def canonicalTotientKernelFamily (e : ℕ) : TotientCanonicalIndex e → ℕ → ℚ | Sum.inl i => totientKernelSeq i.val 0 | Sum.inr ⟨j, r⟩ => totientKernelSeq (j.val + 1) (2 * r.val + 1) /-- Every dyadic totient channel at levels `0,...,e`, before removing the even-residue repetitions. -/ abbrev TotientKernelThroughLevelIndex (e : ℕ)
declarations.docstring: The canonical family indexed without duplicate even-residue channels.

declarations.name: TotientKernelThroughLevelIndex
declarations.docstring: Every dyadic totient channel at levels `0,...,e`, before removing the even-residue repetitions.

declarations.name: totientKernelThroughLevelFamily
declarations.signature: def totientKernelThroughLevelFamily (e : ℕ) : TotientKernelThroughLevelIndex e → ℕ → ℚ | ⟨j, r⟩ => totientKernelSeq j.val r.val /-- The canonical family has exactly `2^e+1` channels. -/ theorem card_totientCanonicalIndex (e : ℕ) : Fintype.card (TotientCanonicalIndex e) = 2 ^ e + 1
declarations.docstring: The complete finite dyadic kernel through level `e`.

declarations.name: card_totientCanonicalIndex
declarations.signature: theorem card_totientCanonicalIndex (e : ℕ) : Fintype.card (TotientCanonicalIndex e) = 2 ^ e + 1
declarations.docstring: The canonical family has exactly `2^e+1` channels.

declarations.name: evaluationLinearMap
declarations.signature: def evaluationLinearMap {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (rowIndex : ι → ℕ) : (ℕ → ℚ) →ₗ[ℚ] (ι → ℚ)
declarations.docstring: Pull a finite family of sequences back along a finite family of evaluation points.

declarations.name: SeparatedMinorCertificate
declarations.signature: structure SeparatedMinorCertificate {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (family : ι → ℕ → ℚ)
declarations.docstring: A square nonzero evaluation minor. This is the exact finite object needed to turn number-theoretic row construction into linear independence.

declarations.name: linearIndependent_of_separatedMinorCertificate
declarations.signature: theorem linearIndependent_of_separatedMinorCertificate {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (family : ι → ℕ → ℚ) (cert : SeparatedMinorCertificate family) : LinearIndependent ℚ family
declarations.docstring: A nonzero square evaluation minor proves that the underlying functions are linearly independent.

declarations.name: finrank_canonicalTotientKernel_eq_of_linearIndependent
declarations.signature: theorem finrank_canonicalTotientKernel_eq_of_linearIndependent (e : ℕ) (hcanon : LinearIndependent ℚ (canonicalTotientKernelFamily e)) : finrank ℚ (Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range (canonicalTotientKernelFamily e))) = 2 ^ e + 1
declarations.docstring: Linear independence of the canonical family gives its exact finite-level dimension. This is the producer-neutral endpoint consumed by explicit minors and the CRT--Dirichlet construction below.

declarations.name: finrank_canonicalTotientKernel_eq_of_certificate
declarations.signature: theorem finrank_canonicalTotientKernel_eq_of_certificate (e : ℕ) (cert : SeparatedMinorCertificate (canonicalTotientKernelFamily e)) : finrank ℚ (Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range (canonicalTotientKernelFamily e))) = 2 ^ e + 1
declarations.docstring: A separated minor for the canonical family gives the exact finite-level dimension promised by the dyadic rank route.

declarations.name: totient_two_pow_succ_mul_of_odd
declarations.signature: theorem totient_two_pow_succ_mul_of_odd (t m : ℕ) (hm : Odd m) : Nat.totient (2 ^ (t + 1) * m) = 2 ^ t * Nat.totient m
declarations.docstring: Totient of an odd number multiplied by a positive power of two.

declarations.name: totient_two_pow_mul_two
declarations.signature: theorem totient_two_pow_mul_two (j n : ℕ) : Nat.totient (2 ^ j * (2 * n)) = 2 ^ j * Nat.totient (2 * n)
declarations.docstring: Repeated doubling scales the totient once the argument is already even.

declarations.name: totientKernel_zero_residue
declarations.signature: theorem totientKernel_zero_residue (j n : ℕ) : totientKernelSeq (j + 1) 0 n = (2 ^ j : ℚ) * totientKernelSeq 1 0 n
declarations.docstring: Every positive zero-residue channel is a scalar multiple of the first zero-residue channel.

declarations.name: totientKernel_even_residue_reduce

declarations.name: totientKernel_even_residue_step

declarations.name: TotientAffineIndex

declarations.docstring: A nonzero affine slope has a root modulo any larger prime.

declarations.name: affine_target_coprime_of_cross
declarations.signature: theorem affine_target_coprime_of_cross {ai ri aj rj q n : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (hcross : aj * ri ≠ ai * rj) (hleft : aj * ri < q) (hright : ai * rj < q) (hoff : q ∣ aj * n + rj) : (ai * n + ri).Coprime q

declarations.name: TotientAffinePrimeRow

declarations.name: paritySeparatedMatrix_det_ne_zero

declarations.docstring: A square natural matrix whose columns admit fixed powers of two and whose quotient is the identity modulo two has nonzero determinant over `ℚ`. This is the finite linear-algebra consumer for the CRT--Dirichlet rows below: the target entry in column `j` has exact two-adic depth `depth j`, while every off-target entry has at least one additional factor of two.

Indeed, at every depth `e` it contains the canonical independent family of exact rank `2^e+1`; choosing `e` equal to a hypothetical ambient finrank gives an immediate contradiction.
