declarations.signature: theorem theoremA_witness : ∃ t : ℕ, 15 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ 29 ∧ LargestSkipLateAt t
declarations.docstring: The hypothesis of `Theorem A` holds at `N = 14`: `seamIntegerGreedyRemainder 14 = 392 ≤ 2 ^ 14`. The theorem therefore *produces* a late largest false rank somewhere in `[15, 29]`.

declarations.name: weightedBoolSum_append_singleton
declarations.signature: theorem weightedBoolSum_append_singleton : ∀ (l : List ℕ) (bs : List Bool), bs.length = l.length → ∀ (x : ℕ) (b : Bool), weightedBoolSum (l ++ [x]) (bs ++ [b]) = weightedBoolSum l bs + (if b then x else 0)
declarations.docstring: Appending one weight and one bit adds exactly that weight when the bit is set. The length hypothesis keeps the two lists aligned.

declarations.name: gapDominates_of_append
declarations.signature: theorem gapDominates_of_append {gap : ℕ} : ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ), GapDominates gap (l₁ ++ l₂) → GapDominates gap l₁
declarations.docstring: A prefix of a gap-dominating word is gap-dominating.

declarations.name: integerGreedyBits_singleton
declarations.signature: theorem integerGreedyBits_singleton (x C : ℕ) : integerGreedyBits [x] C = [decide (x ≤ C)]
declarations.docstring: The descending greedy on a one-element word.

declarations.name: weightedBoolSum_succ_row
declarations.signature: theorem weightedBoolSum_succ_row (s : ℕ) : ∀ (d : ℕ), 2 ≤ d → d ≤ s → ∀ (bs : List Bool), bs.length = s - d → ∀ (b : Bool), weightedBoolSum (seamWeightsFrom (s + 1) d) (bs ++ [b]) = 4 * weightedBoolSum (seamWeightsFrom s d) bs + weightedBoolSum (rowCarriesFrom s d) bs + (if b then truncatedMersenneWeight (s + 1) s else 0)
declarations.docstring: **The lifted subset sum, exactly.** Selecting the same ranks at row `s + 1` as at row `s`, and choosing `b` at the brand-new rank `s`, multiplies the row-`s` subset sum by four and adds the carries actually collected — no slack.

declarations.name: weightedBoolSum_succ_row_true
declarations.signature: theorem weightedBoolSum_succ_row_true {s : ℕ} (hs : 2 ≤ s) (bs : List Bool) (hlen : bs.length = s - 2) : weightedBoolSum (seamWeights (s + 1)) (bs ++ [true]) = 4 * weightedBoolSum (seamWeights s) bs + weightedBoolSum (rowCarriesFrom s 2) bs + truncatedMersenneWeight (s + 1) s

declarations.name: weightedBoolSum_succ_row_false
declarations.signature: theorem weightedBoolSum_succ_row_false {s : ℕ} (hs : 2 ≤ s) (bs : List Bool) (hlen : bs.length = s - 2) : weightedBoolSum (seamWeights (s + 1)) (bs ++ [false]) = 4 * weightedBoolSum (seamWeights s) bs + weightedBoolSum (rowCarriesFrom s 2) bs

declarations.name: truncatedMersenneWeight_succ_top
declarations.signature: theorem truncatedMersenneWeight_succ_top {s : ℕ} (hs : 3 ≤ s) : truncatedMersenneWeight (s + 1) s = 2 ^ (s + 2) + 4
declarations.docstring: **The brand-new rank is worth exactly `2 ^ (s+2) + 4`.** Rank `s` appears for the first time at row `s + 1`, where `⌊2 * (s+1) / s⌋ = 2`.

declarations.name: greedyWord
declarations.docstring: The concrete row-`s` greedy take/skip word.

declarations.name: greedySum
declarations.docstring: The subset sum the row-`s` greedy actually achieves.

declarations.name: carryTaken
declarations.docstring: The carry the row-`s` greedy support actually collects on the step `s ↦ s + 1`. Every summand is `rowCarry s d ≤ 2`, and only ranks dividing `2*s+1` or `2*s+2` contribute at all.

declarations.name: greedySum_add_remainder
declarations.signature: theorem greedySum_add_remainder (s : ℕ) : greedySum s + seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s = seamSubsetTarget s

declarations.name: liftedPrefix
declarations.docstring: The row-`s+1` weight word without its brand-new last rank.

declarations.name: seamWeights_succ_split
declarations.signature: theorem seamWeights_succ_split {s : ℕ} (hs : 2 ≤ s) : seamWeights (s + 1) = liftedPrefix s ++ [truncatedMersenneWeight (s + 1) s]

declarations.name: weightedBoolSum_liftedPrefix
declarations.signature: theorem weightedBoolSum_liftedPrefix (s : ℕ) (hs : 2 ≤ s) : weightedBoolSum (liftedPrefix s) (greedyWord s) = 4 * greedySum s + carryTaken s
declarations.docstring: The row-`s` greedy support, read inside row `s + 1` with the new rank declined, has subset sum exactly `4 * greedySum s + carryTaken s`.

declarations.name: prefixSum_lower_bound
declarations.signature: theorem prefixSum_lower_bound {s : ℕ} (hs : 3 ≤ s) : 4 * greedySum s + carryTaken s ≤ weightedBoolSum (liftedPrefix s) (integerGreedyBits (liftedPrefix s) (seamSubsetTarget (s + 1)))
declarations.docstring: The row-`s+1` greedy achieves at least the lift of the row-`s` greedy.

declarations.name: topRemainder
declarations.docstring: The capacity that actually reaches the brand-new rank `s` at row `s + 1`.

declarations.name: topRemainder_le
declarations.signature: theorem topRemainder_le {s : ℕ} (hs : 3 ≤ s) : topRemainder s + carryTaken s ≤ 4 * seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s + 2 ^ (s + 1)
declarations.docstring: **The transfer bound.** What reaches the brand-new rank is at most four times the row-`s` remainder plus the target increment, less the carries.

declarations.name: greedyWord_succ_split
declarations.signature: theorem greedyWord_succ_split {s : ℕ} (hs : 2 ≤ s) : greedyWord (s + 1) = integerGreedyBits (liftedPrefix s) (seamSubsetTarget (s + 1)) ++ [decide (truncatedMersenneWeight (s + 1) s ≤ topRemainder s)]
declarations.docstring: Row `s+1`'s greedy word, split at the brand-new rank.

declarations.name: getD_append_singleton
declarations.signature: theorem getD_append_singleton (p : List Bool) (b : Bool) : (p ++ [b]).getD p.length false = b

declarations.name: topRank_notMem_support
declarations.signature: theorem topRank_notMem_support {s : ℕ} (hs : 3 ≤ s) (h : 4 * seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s < 2 ^ (s + 1) + 4 + carryTaken s) : s ∉ seamWordSupport (seamGreedyWord (s + 1))
declarations.docstring: **The criterion.** If the row-`s` greedy remainder is small, the brand-new rank `s` is skipped at row `s + 1`.

declarations.name: largestSkipLateAt_succ_of_small_remainder
declarations.signature: theorem largestSkipLateAt_succ_of_small_remainder {s : ℕ} (hs : 3 ≤ s) (h : 4 * seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s ≤ 2 ^ (s + 1)) : LargestSkipLateAt (s + 1)
declarations.docstring: **A small remainder buys a late skip.** `LargestSkipLateAt (s+1)` follows from `4 * seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s ≤ 2 ^ (s+1)` alone.

declarations.name: remainder_succ_le_of_large
declarations.signature: theorem remainder_succ_le_of_large {s : ℕ} (hs : 3 ≤ s) (h : 2 ^ (s + 1) + 4 + carryTaken s ≤ 4 * seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s) : seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (s + 1) + 2 ^ (s + 1) + 4 + carryTaken s ≤ 4 * seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s
declarations.docstring: **The escape step.** When the criterion does *not* fire at `s`, the row-`s` greedy support extended by the brand-new rank is admissible at row `s + 1`, and the remainder drops by a full `2 ^ (s+1)`.

declarations.name: remainder_succ_le_of_large'
declarations.signature: theorem remainder_succ_le_of_large' {s : ℕ} (hs : 3 ≤ s) (h : 2 ^ (s + 1) + 2 * s + 4 ≤ 4 * seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s) : seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (s + 1) + 2 ^ (s + 1) + 4 ≤ 4 * seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s
declarations.docstring: Carry-free form of the escape step: `carryTaken s ≤ 2 * (s - 2)` always, so `2 ^ (s+1) + 2 * s + 4 ≤ 4 * r s` is enough to trigger it.

declarations.name: dichotomy
declarations.signature: theorem dichotomy {s : ℕ} (hs : 3 ≤ s) : LargestSkipLateAt (s + 1) ∨ seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (s + 1) + 2 ^ (s + 1) + 4 ≤ 4 * seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s
declarations.docstring: **The dichotomy.** Every row either buys a late skip at the next row, or hands down a remainder that has dropped by a full `2 ^ (s+1)`.

declarations.name: deficit_grows
declarations.signature: theorem deficit_grows {s K : ℕ} (hs : 3 ≤ s) (h : seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s < 2 ^ s) (hno : ∀ t : ℕ, s + 1 ≤ t → t ≤ s + K → ¬ LargestSkipLateAt t) : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ K → seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (s + k) + 4 ^ k * (2 ^ s - seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s) ≤ 2 ^ (s + k)
declarations.docstring: The quadrupling deficit invariant.

declarations.name: exists_largestSkipLateAt_of_deficit
declarations.signature: theorem exists_largestSkipLateAt_of_deficit {s j : ℕ} (hs : 3 ≤ s) (hjs : j ≤ s) (h : seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s + 2 ^ j ≤ 2 ^ s) : ∃ t : ℕ, s + 1 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ 2 * s - j + 1 ∧ LargestSkipLateAt t
declarations.docstring: **The escape theorem, quantitative.** A deficit of `2 ^ j` below `2 ^ s` in the row-`s` remainder forces a late largest false rank within `s - j + 1` rows: the deficit quadruples every row that fails to buy a skip, and it cannot outrun `2 ^ (s+k)` for longer than that.

declarations.name: exists_largestSkipLateAt_of_remainder_lt
declarations.signature: theorem exists_largestSkipLateAt_of_remainder_lt {s : ℕ} (hs : 3 ≤ s) (h : seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s < 2 ^ s) : ∃ t : ℕ, s + 1 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ 2 * s + 1 ∧ LargestSkipLateAt t
declarations.docstring: **The escape theorem.** A row whose greedy remainder has dropped below `2 ^ s` forces a late largest false rank at some row in the window `[s+1, 2s+1]`.

declarations.name: half_mem_of_remainder_lt_cofinally
declarations.signature: theorem half_mem_of_remainder_lt_cofinally (h : ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ s : ℕ, N ≤ s ∧ seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s < 2 ^ s) : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∈ mersenneAchievementSet
declarations.docstring: **The reduction.** Erdős `#257`'s `1/2` question is *implied* by a single inequality holding infinitely often: `seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s < 2 ^ s`.

declarations.name: remainder_ge_of_half_notMem
declarations.signature: theorem remainder_ge_of_half_notMem (h : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∉ mersenneAchievementSet) : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ s : ℕ, N ≤ s → 2 ^ s ≤ seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s
declarations.docstring: Contrapositive of the preceding reduction: if `1/2` is *not* achieved, then from some row on the seam greedy remainder never again drops below `2 ^ s`.

declarations.name: rem
declarations.docstring: Kernel-computable form of the seam greedy remainder. `seamWeightsFrom` is defined by well-founded recursion; `SkipD3.wgt` is the same list by structural recursion, so `rem` reduces inside the kernel.

declarations.name: rem_eq
declarations.signature: theorem rem_eq (s : ℕ) : rem s = seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s

declarations.name: lateAt_succ_of_rem
declarations.signature: theorem lateAt_succ_of_rem {s : ℕ} (hs : 3 ≤ s) (h : 4 * rem s ≤ 2 ^ (s + 1)) : LargestSkipLateAt (s + 1)
declarations.docstring: The criterion, in kernel-computable form.

declarations.name: lateAt_15
declarations.docstring: Smallest witness: `seamIntegerGreedyRemainder 14 = 392`, far below `2 ^ 13 = 8192`, so rank `14` is skipped at row `15`.

declarations.name: lateAt_1201
declarations.docstring: The first row past `Corr3`'s certified block `[501, 1200]`.

declarations.name: lateAt_12003
declarations.docstring: A kernel-checked finite witness at row `12003`.

declarations.name: escape_witness_20
declarations.signature: theorem escape_witness_20 : 2 ^ 21 < 4 * seamIntegerGreedyRemainder 20 ∧ ∃ t : ℕ, 21 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ 23 ∧ LargestSkipLateAt t
declarations.docstring: The hypothesis of the escape theorem is satisfiable, and *not* only through the immediate criterion: at `s = 20` the remainder `549353` sits below `2 ^ 20` with a deficit past `2 ^ 18`, while `4 * rem 20 = 2197412 > 2 ^ 21`, so the criterion does **not** fire at `20` and the deficit argument has to run. The quantitative form pins the resulting skip to the three-row window `[21, 23]`.

declarations.name: escape_step_witness_19
declarations.docstring: The hypothesis of the escape step — the *other* branch of `dichotomy` — is satisfiable too: at `s = 19` the criterion misses by a wide margin (`4 * r 19 = 3697820` against `2 ^ 20 + 42 = 1048618`), so the remainder really does drop by a full `2 ^ 20` from row `19` to row `20`.

declarations.name: remainder_lt_witness
declarations.signature: theorem remainder_lt_witness {N : ℕ} (hN : N ≤ 12002) : ∃ s : ℕ, N ≤ s ∧ seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s < 2 ^ s
declarations.docstring: The hypothesis of `half_mem_of_remainder_lt_cofinally` is satisfied at every `N ≤ 12002`. Cofinality — the one thing `#257` actually needs — is exactly what is *not* proved here.

declarations.name: criterion_not_necessary
declarations.docstring: **The criterion is sufficient but not necessary.** At `s = 19` the transfer bound is far too weak — `4 * r 19 = 3697820` against `2 ^ 20 = 1048576` — and yet the brand-new rank `19` really is skipped at row `20`. Thus the displayed sufficient inequality is not a necessary condition for that skip.

declarations.name: lateSkip_does_not_give_escape
declarations.docstring: **A late skip does not supply the escape hypothesis.** Row `19` has a late largest false rank (`d = 14`, and `2 * 19 = 38 < 42 = 3 * 14`), yet its greedy remainder is `924455 ≥ 524288 = 2 ^ 19`. This is a concrete counterexample to the implication from a late skip at row `s` to the escape hypothesis at the same row.

declarations.name: gap_is_two_pow_succ
declarations.signature: theorem gap_is_two_pow_succ {s : ℕ} (hs : 2 ≤ s) : GapDominates (2 ^ (s + 1)) (seamWeights s)
declarations.docstring: The `GapDominates` estimate available for the seam weights. This statement does not claim that `2 ^ (s+1)` is the largest admissible gap parameter.

declarations.name: weightedBoolSum_append
declarations.signature: theorem weightedBoolSum_append (vs : List ℕ) (cs : List Bool) : ∀ (ws : List ℕ) (bs : List Bool), bs.length = ws.length → weightedBoolSum (ws ++ vs) (bs ++ cs) = weightedBoolSum ws bs + weightedBoolSum vs cs
declarations.docstring: A weighted subset sum splits along a concatenation, provided the bit word is split at the matching place.

declarations.name: gapDominates_of_append
declarations.signature: theorem gapDominates_of_append {gap : ℕ} (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) : GapDominates gap (l₁ ++ l₂) → GapDominates gap l₁
declarations.docstring: A prefix of a gap-dominating word is gap-dominating.

declarations.name: liftWeights_length
declarations.signature: theorem liftWeights_length : ∀ (ws cs : List ℕ), cs.length = ws.length → (liftWeights ws cs).length = ws.length
declarations.docstring: The lift keeps the alignment length.

declarations.name: four_mul_weightedBoolSum_le_lift
declarations.signature: theorem four_mul_weightedBoolSum_le_lift : ∀ (ws cs : List ℕ) (bs : List Bool), cs.length = ws.length → 4 * weightedBoolSum ws bs ≤ weightedBoolSum (liftWeights ws cs) bs
declarations.docstring: Selecting a bit word inside the lifted weights achieves at least four times what it achieves inside the base weights.

declarations.name: weightedBoolSum_lift_le
declarations.signature: theorem weightedBoolSum_lift_le : ∀ (ws cs : List ℕ) (bs : List Bool), cs.length = ws.length → weightedBoolSum (liftWeights ws cs) bs ≤ 4 * weightedBoolSum ws bs + cs.sum
declarations.docstring: …and at most four times that plus the whole carry budget.

declarations.name: topWeight_eq
declarations.signature: theorem topWeight_eq {s : ℕ} (hs : 3 ≤ s) : truncatedMersenneWeight (s + 1) s = 2 ^ (s + 2) + 4
declarations.docstring: The brand-new top rank `s` of row `s + 1` carries weight `2 ^ (s+2) + 4`.

declarations.name: liftedPrefix
declarations.docstring: The row-`s+1` weight word with its top rank removed: every row-`s` weight quadrupled and given its carry.

declarations.name: topEntry
declarations.docstring: The row-`s+1` greedy remainder on entering its top rank `s` — the single number the last take/skip decision of row `s + 1` compares against.

declarations.name: seamWeights_succ_split
declarations.signature: theorem seamWeights_succ_split {s : ℕ} (hs : 2 ≤ s) : seamWeights (s + 1) = liftedPrefix s ++ [truncatedMersenneWeight (s + 1) s]

declarations.name: topEntry_le
declarations.signature: theorem topEntry_le {s : ℕ} (hs : 3 ≤ s) : topEntry s ≤ 4 * seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s + 2 ^ (s + 1)
declarations.docstring: **The one inequality everything rests on.** The remainder with which row `s + 1` reaches its top rank is at most four times the row-`s` greedy defect plus the exact target increment. Proof: feeding the row-`s` greedy word into the lifted prefix is admissible, and the greedy is maximal.

declarations.name: seamGreedyBits_succ_split
declarations.signature: theorem seamGreedyBits_succ_split {s : ℕ} (hs : 3 ≤ s) : integerGreedyBits (seamWeights (s + 1)) (seamSubsetTarget (s + 1)) = integerGreedyBits (liftedPrefix s) (seamSubsetTarget (s + 1)) ++ integerGreedyBits [truncatedMersenneWeight (s + 1) s] (topEntry s)

declarations.name: top_mem_iff
declarations.signature: theorem top_mem_iff {s : ℕ} (hs : 3 ≤ s) : s ∈ seamWordSupport (seamGreedyWord (s + 1)) ↔ truncatedMersenneWeight (s + 1) s ≤ topEntry s
declarations.docstring: The top rank of row `s + 1` is selected exactly when the entering remainder can pay for it.

declarations.name: largestSkipLateAt_succ_of_remainder_le
declarations.signature: theorem largestSkipLateAt_succ_of_remainder_le {s : ℕ} (hs : 3 ≤ s) (h : seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s ≤ 2 ^ (s - 1)) : LargestSkipLateAt (s + 1)
declarations.docstring: **The criterion.** If the row-`s` greedy defect is at most `2 ^ (s - 1)`, then the factor-four lift and target increment still leave row `s + 1` unable to afford its top rank. That rank — which is late — is skipped, and `LargestSkipLateAt (s + 1)` holds. No information about row `s + 1` is used beyond this one size comparison.

declarations.name: remainder_gt_of_not_largestSkipLateAt
declarations.signature: theorem remainder_gt_of_not_largestSkipLateAt {s : ℕ} (hs : 3 ≤ s) (h : ¬ LargestSkipLateAt (s + 1)) : 2 ^ (s - 1) < seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s
declarations.docstring: Contrapositive shape: a row whose successor has no late largest false rank must already carry a defect strictly above `2 ^ (s - 1)`.

declarations.name: remainder_succ_add_le_of_not_largestSkipLateAt
declarations.signature: theorem remainder_succ_add_le_of_not_largestSkipLateAt {s : ℕ} (hs : 3 ≤ s) (h : ¬ LargestSkipLateAt (s + 1)) : seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (s + 1) + 2 ^ (s + 1) + 4 ≤ 4 * seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s
declarations.docstring: **The descent.** If row `s + 1` has no late largest false rank then it took its top rank, and the row step therefore loses that rank's whole weight `2 ^ (s+2) + 4` against the target increment `2 ^ (s+1)`.

declarations.name: cLoss
declarations.signature: def cLoss : ℕ → ℕ | 0 => 0 | j + 1 => 4 * cLoss j + 4 theorem three_mul_cLoss_add_four (j : ℕ) : 3 * cLoss j + 4 = 4 ^ (j + 1)
declarations.docstring: The accumulated loss after `j` further descent steps: `cLoss j = (4^(j+1) - 4)/3`.

declarations.name: descent_iterate
declarations.signature: theorem descent_iterate {S : ℕ} (hS : 3 ≤ S) (hno : ∀ t : ℕ, S ≤ t → ¬ LargestSkipLateAt t) {s : ℕ} (hs : S ≤ s) (hsmall : seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s ≤ 2 ^ s + 1) : ∀ j : ℕ, seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (s + 1 + j) + cLoss j ≤ 2 ^ (s + 1 + j)
declarations.docstring: Once the defect dips to `2 ^ s + 1` while `LargestSkipLateAt` is failing everywhere above, the descent drives it down by a factor four per row against a reference that only doubles.

declarations.name: remainder_ge_of_no_largestSkipLate
declarations.signature: theorem remainder_ge_of_no_largestSkipLate {S : ℕ} (hS : 3 ≤ S) (hno : ∀ t : ℕ, S ≤ t → ¬ LargestSkipLateAt t) {s : ℕ} (hs : S ≤ s) : 2 ^ s + 2 ≤ seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s
declarations.docstring: **The contrapositive law.** If `LargestSkipLateAt` fails from `S` on, then from `S` on the greedy defect never drops below `2 ^ s + 2`.

declarations.name: half_mem_of_remainder_dips
declarations.signature: theorem half_mem_of_remainder_dips (h : ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ s : ℕ, N ≤ s ∧ seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s ≤ 2 ^ (s - 1)) : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∈ mersenneAchievementSet
declarations.docstring: **Criterion, plain form.** If the concrete seam greedy defect is at most `2 ^ (s - 1)` at cofinally many rows, then `1/2` is achieved.

declarations.name: half_mem_of_remainder_dips_strong
declarations.signature: theorem half_mem_of_remainder_dips_strong (h : ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ s : ℕ, N ≤ s ∧ seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s ≤ 2 ^ s + 1) : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∈ mersenneAchievementSet
declarations.docstring: **Criterion, sharpened by the descent.** The threshold can be raised from `2 ^ (s-1)` to `2 ^ s + 1`, the integer cutoff below the descent recurrence's rational fixed-point offset `4/3`.

declarations.name: remainder_ge_of_half_not_mem
declarations.signature: theorem remainder_ge_of_half_not_mem (h : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∉ mersenneAchievementSet) : ∃ S : ℕ, ∀ s : ℕ, S ≤ s → 2 ^ s + 2 ≤ seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s
declarations.docstring: **The contrapositive law, in `#257` vocabulary.** Failure of half membership forces the greedy defect above `2 ^ s` from some row on.

declarations.name: seamIntegerGreedyRemainder_eq_wgt
declarations.signature: theorem seamIntegerGreedyRemainder_eq_wgt (s : ℕ) : seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s = seamSubsetTarget s - weightedBoolSum (SkipD3.wgt s 2 (s - 2)) (SkipD3.gb s)
declarations.docstring: The greedy defect through `SkipD3`'s kernel-computable row word.

declarations.name: criterion_hypothesis_seven
declarations.docstring: **The criterion's hypothesis is satisfied**, at `s = 7`: `3 ≤ 2 ^ 6`.

declarations.name: largestSkipLateAt_eight
declarations.docstring: …and the criterion then delivers the `#257` predicate at row `8`, from the size of row `7`'s defect alone.

declarations.name: criterion_hypothesis_fourteen
declarations.docstring: **The criterion's hypothesis at `Corr2`'s own row.** `Corr2` computes `seamIntegerGreedyRemainder 14 = 392`, and `392 ≤ 2 ^ 13`.

declarations.name: criterion_fails_fifteen
declarations.docstring: The criterion is a genuine condition, not automatic: at `s = 15` the defect `34333` exceeds `2 ^ 14 = 16384`, so the criterion is silent there.

declarations.name: not_largestSkipLateAt_twelve
declarations.docstring: **The descent's hypothesis is satisfied**, at row `12`: every late rank of row `12` (that is, `9, 10, 11`) is selected, so row `12` has no late largest false rank.

declarations.name: not_largestSkipLateAt_thirteen
declarations.docstring: The same at row `13`: the late ranks `9, 10, 11, 12` are all selected.

declarations.name: descent_twelve
declarations.docstring: The descent instantiated at `s = 12`.

declarations.name: descent_twelve_defect
declarations.docstring: At `s = 12` the descent inequality is within one: its two sides are `23343` and `23344`. This is a concrete tightness witness, not a theorem that the constants are globally optimal.

declarations.name: remainder_gt_twelve
declarations.docstring: The contrapositive of the criterion instantiated at `s = 12`: row `13`'s failure forces row `12`'s defect above `2 ^ 11`. The kernel-checked values are `5836 > 2048`.

declarations.name: dip_witness
declarations.signature: theorem dip_witness {N : ℕ} (hN : N ≤ 14) : ∃ s : ℕ, N ≤ s ∧ seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s ≤ 2 ^ (s - 1)
declarations.docstring: The body of `half_mem_of_remainder_dips` is satisfied at every `N ≤ 14`. This is a finite near-end witness only; it does not establish the theorem's cofinality hypothesis.

declarations.name: w
declarations.docstring: `truncatedMersenneWeight`, unfolded.

declarations.name: wts
declarations.signature: def wts (s : ℕ) : ℕ → List ℕ | 0 => [] | (n + 1) => w s (s - (n + 1)) :: wts s n /-- Weights for ranks `d, …, s-1`. -/ def wtsFrom (s d : ℕ) : List ℕ
declarations.docstring: `seamWeightsFrom s d`, structurally.

declarations.name: wtsFrom
declarations.signature: def wtsFrom (s d : ℕ) : List ℕ
declarations.docstring: Weights for ranks `d, …, s-1`.

declarations.name: wtsEarly
declarations.signature: def wtsEarly (s d : ℕ) : List ℕ
declarations.docstring: Weights for ranks `2, …, d-1`.

declarations.name: grd
declarations.signature: def grd : List ℕ → ℕ → List Bool | [], _ => [] | (x :: xs), C => if x ≤ C then true :: grd xs (C - x) else false :: grd xs C def rem : List ℕ → ℕ → ℕ | [], C => C | (x :: xs), C => if x ≤ C then rem xs (C - x) else rem xs C /-- `lateCorrection s d = ∑_{k=1}^{s-d} 4 ^ k`. -/ def corr (s d : ℕ) : ℕ

declarations.name: rem
declarations.signature: def rem : List ℕ → ℕ → ℕ | [], C => C | (x :: xs), C => if x ≤ C then rem xs (C - x) else rem xs C /-- `lateCorrection s d = ∑_{k=1}^{s-d} 4 ^ k`. -/ def corr (s d : ℕ) : ℕ

declarations.name: corr
declarations.docstring: `lateCorrection s d = ∑_{k=1}^{s-d} 4 ^ k`.

declarations.name: entry
declarations.docstring: `lateEntryRemainder s d`.

declarations.name: firstLate
declarations.docstring: First late rank: least `d` with `2 * s < 3 * d`.

declarations.name: hyps
declarations.docstring: The two side conditions of `mem_seamGreedySupport_iff_testBit`.

declarations.name: probe_largestSkipLateAt_twenty
declarations.docstring: `LargestSkipLateAt 20`, proved with zero input from Corr1.

declarations.name: probe_hyps_26
declarations.docstring: The side conditions hold at a SECOND, independently chosen row.

declarations.name: probe_25_not_mem_26
declarations.docstring: Corr1's criterion, applied at `s = 26`, produces a genuine late skip.

declarations.name: probe_largestSkipLateAt_26
declarations.docstring: …and hence `LargestSkipLateAt 26`, a row Corr1 does not itself treat.

declarations.name: not_dvd_succ_of_dvd
declarations.signature: theorem not_dvd_succ_of_dvd {s d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) (h : d ∣ 2 * s + 1) : ¬ d ∣ 2 * s + 2

declarations.name: rowCarry_eq_rowPulse
declarations.signature: theorem rowCarry_eq_rowPulse {s d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) : rowCarry s d = rowPulse s d
declarations.docstring: **`Corr2.rowCarry` = the corpus's `rowPulse`.** Not a new invariant: a second formula for a function the imported file already has.

declarations.name: truncatedMersenneWeight_succ_row_is_corpus
declarations.signature: theorem truncatedMersenneWeight_succ_row_is_corpus {s d : ℕ} (hs : 2 ≤ s) (hd : 2 ≤ d) : truncatedMersenneWeight (s + 1) d = 4 * truncatedMersenneWeight s d + rowCarry s d
declarations.docstring: Hence `Corr2.truncatedMersenneWeight_succ_row` is the corpus's `truncatedMersenneWeight_succ`, verbatim.

declarations.name: rowCarry_le_two_is_corpus
declarations.signature: theorem rowCarry_le_two_is_corpus {s d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) : rowCarry s d ≤ 2
declarations.docstring: And `Corr2.rowCarry_le_two` is the corpus's `rowPulse_le_two`.

declarations.name: seamSubsetTarget_succ_is_corpus
declarations.signature: theorem seamSubsetTarget_succ_is_corpus {s : ℕ} (hs : 2 ≤ s) : seamSubsetTarget (s + 1) = 4 * seamSubsetTarget s + 2 ^ (s + 1)
declarations.docstring: `Erdos249257.HalfCylinderIntegerGreedy.seamSubsetTarget_succ` already says this, for every `s ≥ 2`. `Corr2` reproves it from scratch, gaining only the single meaningless row `s = 1`.

declarations.name: hyp_lift_split_holds
declarations.docstring: The `lift_split` hypothesis `cs.sum ≤ E` is met by the real carry word of a real row: row `13`'s carries sum to `9`, well under `2 ^ 14`.

declarations.name: branches_both_realised
declarations.signature: theorem branches_both_realised : (∃ (p b₁ b₂ : List Bool), integerGreedyBits (seamWeights 13) (seamSubsetTarget 13) = p ++ false :: b₁ ∧ (p ++ true :: b₂) <+: integerGreedyBits (seamWeights 14) (seamSubsetTarget 14)) ∧ integerGreedyBits (seamWeights 14) (seamSubsetTarget 14) <+: integerGreedyBits (seamWeights 15) (seamSubsetTarget 15)
declarations.docstring: Both branches of `seamGreedy_succ_first_difference` really occur, and the theorem is applied at rows the corpus cares about.

declarations.name: remainder_bound_slack_thirteen
declarations.signature: theorem remainder_bound_slack_thirteen : seamIntegerGreedyRemainder 14 = 392 ∧ 4 * seamIntegerGreedyRemainder 13 + 2 ^ 14 = 76972 ∧ 4 * seamIntegerGreedyRemainder 13 + 2 ^ 14 - seamIntegerGreedyRemainder 14 = 76580
declarations.docstring: The `s = 13 → 14` instance of `seamIntegerGreedyRemainder_succ_le`: the true value is `392`, the proved bound is `76972`.

declarations.name: bound_exceeds_smallest_weight_fourteen
declarations.docstring: The bound of `seamIntegerGreedyRemainder_succ_le` at `s = 13` is larger than the smallest weight of row `14`, which already caps the remainder here (`seamIntegerGreedyRemainder 14 = 392 < 32772`). Numerically, the ceiling `seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s < truncatedMersenneWeight s (s-1)` holds at every `s ∈ [4,400)` except the single row `s = 5`, and it beats the proved bound on `301` of the `394` rows in `[6,400)`.

declarations.name: headline_from_corpus_trichotomy
declarations.signature: theorem headline_from_corpus_trichotomy {s : ℕ} (hs : 5 ≤ s) : seamIntegerGreedyRemainder (s + 1) ≤ 4 * seamIntegerGreedyRemainder s + 2 ^ (s + 1)

declarations.name: d0Of

declarations.name: probe
declarations.signature: def probe (s : ℕ) : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ × ℕ × Bool

declarations.name: lfrOf

declarations.name: lateB
