declarations.docstring: Exact normalized gap with the +1 critical point as base.

declarations.name: quartic_fails_value_separation_minus_one
declarations.signature: theorem quartic_fails_value_separation_minus_one {S : ℝ} (hS : 1 < S) : ¬ (∀ d : ℂ, p.derivative.eval d = 0 → d ≠ -1 → S ≤ ‖(1 : ℂ) - p.eval d / p.eval (-1)‖)
declarations.docstring: The necessary premise fails at -1 for EVERY S > 1.

declarations.name: quartic_fails_value_separation_plus_one
declarations.signature: theorem quartic_fails_value_separation_plus_one {S : ℝ} (hS : 1 < S) : ¬ (∀ d : ℂ, p.derivative.eval d = 0 → d ≠ 1 → S ≤ ‖(1 : ℂ) - p.eval d / p.eval 1‖)
declarations.docstring: The necessary premise likewise fails at +1 for EVERY S > 1.

declarations.name: eval_real
declarations.signature: theorem eval_real (x : ℝ) : p.eval (x : ℂ) = (f x : ℂ)

declarations.name: derivative_factorisation
declarations.signature: theorem derivative_factorisation : p.derivative = C 4 * (X - C (-1)) * (X - C (t : ℂ)) * (X - C 1)

declarations.name: derivative_root_iff
declarations.signature: theorem derivative_root_iff (z : ℂ) : p.derivative.eval z = 0 ↔ z = -1 ∨ z = (t : ℂ) ∨ z = 1

declarations.name: exists_zero_open
declarations.signature: theorem exists_zero_open {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : Continuous g) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) (ha : g a < 0) (hb : 0 < g b) : ∃ r, r ∈ Ioo a b ∧ g r = 0
declarations.docstring: A strictly signed endpoint version of the intermediate value theorem.

declarations.name: RootBoxes
declarations.docstring: Four roots with strict, exact rational localisation.

declarations.name: realPoints
declarations.docstring: Increasing order of all four roots and all three critical points.

declarations.name: realPoints_separated
declarations.signature: theorem realPoints_separated (R : RootBoxes) (i j : Fin 7) (hij : i ≠ j) : (1 / 4 : ℝ) < |realPoints R i - realPoints R j|

declarations.name: points_separated
declarations.signature: theorem points_separated (R : RootBoxes) (i j : Fin 7) (hij : i ≠ j) : (1 / 4 : ℝ) < dist (points R i) (points R j)

declarations.name: root_eval_zero
declarations.signature: theorem root_eval_zero (R : RootBoxes) (i : Fin 4) : p.eval (roots R i) = 0

declarations.name: root_exhaustion
declarations.signature: theorem root_exhaustion (R : RootBoxes) (z : ℂ) : p.eval z = 0 ↔ ∃ i : Fin 4, roots R i = z
declarations.docstring: There are no further, non-real complex roots.

declarations.name: critical_exhaustion
declarations.signature: theorem critical_exhaustion (z : ℂ) : p.derivative.eval z = 0 ↔ ∃ i : Fin 3, criticals i = z

declarations.name: combined
declarations.signature: def combined (R : RootBoxes) : Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 3 → ℂ

declarations.name: combined_eq
declarations.signature: theorem combined_eq (R : RootBoxes) (u : Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 3) : combined R u = points R (combinedIndex u)

declarations.name: combined_separated
declarations.signature: theorem combined_separated (R : RootBoxes) (u v : Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 3) (huv : u ≠ v) : (1 / 4 : ℝ) < dist (combined R u) (combined R v)

declarations.name: separated_enumerations
declarations.signature: theorem separated_enumerations : ∃ (r : Fin 4 → ℂ) (c : Fin 3 → ℂ), (∀ z, p.eval z = 0 ↔ ∃ i, r i = z) ∧ (∀ z, p.derivative.eval z = 0 ↔ ∃ j, c j = z) ∧ (∀ u v : Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 3, u ≠ v → (1 / 4 : ℝ) < dist (Sum.elim r c u) (Sum.elim r c v))
declarations.docstring: The exact finite, multiplicity-sensitive separation hypothesis of the paper.

declarations.name: no_common_root
declarations.signature: theorem no_common_root (z : ℂ) (hz : p.eval z = 0) : p.derivative.eval z ≠ 0

declarations.name: critical_values_injective
declarations.signature: theorem critical_values_injective : Function.Injective (fun i : Fin 3 => p.eval (criticals i))
declarations.docstring: The obstruction remains even when all critical values are distinct.

declarations.name: strict_violation
declarations.signature: theorem strict_violation : ‖p.eval 1 - p.eval (-1)‖ < (((p.natDegree - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((1 / 4 : ℝ) / 4) ^ p.natDegree)

declarations.name: full_separation_counterexample
declarations.signature: theorem full_separation_counterexample : p.Monic ∧ p.natDegree = 4 ∧ (∃ (r : Fin 4 → ℂ) (c : Fin 3 → ℂ), (∀ z, p.eval z = 0 ↔ ∃ i, r i = z) ∧ (∀ z, p.derivative.eval z = 0 ↔ ∃ j, c j = z) ∧ (∀ u v : Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 3, u ≠ v → (1 / 4 : ℝ) < dist (Sum.elim r c u) (Sum.elim r c v))) ∧ p.derivative.eval 1 = 0 ∧ p.derivative.eval (-1) = 0 ∧ p.eval 1 ≠ p.eval (-1) ∧ ‖p.eval 1 - p.eval (-1)‖ < (3 : ℝ) * ((1 / 4 : ℝ) / 4) ^ 4
declarations.docstring: A monic degree-four counterexample with complete separated enumerations.

declarations.name: sub_mul_self_pos_of_abs_lt_abs
declarations.signature: theorem sub_mul_self_pos_of_abs_lt_abs {x y : ℝ} (h : |y| < |x|) : 0 < (x - y) * x
declarations.docstring: Subtracting a strictly smaller number in absolute value preserves the strict sign of a nonzero real number.

declarations.name: sub_values_mul_neg_of_abs_lt_abs
declarations.signature: theorem sub_values_mul_neg_of_abs_lt_abs {x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ : ℝ} (hx : x₁ * x₂ < 0) (h₁ : |y₁| < |x₁|) (h₂ : |y₂| < |x₂|) : (x₁ - y₁) * (x₂ - y₂) < 0
declarations.docstring: Pointwise domination preserves an alternating sign change after subtraction.

declarations.name: exists_root_between_of_eval_mul_neg
declarations.signature: theorem exists_root_between_of_eval_mul_neg {p : ℝ[X]} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) (hneg : p.eval a * p.eval b < 0) : ∃ x ∈ Ioo a b, p.eval x = 0
declarations.docstring: A real polynomial whose endpoint values have opposite strict signs has a root strictly between those endpoints.

declarations.name: eq_zero_of_endpoint_zeros_and_alternation
declarations.signature: theorem eq_zero_of_endpoint_zeros_and_alternation {n : ℕ} {p : ℝ[X]} {a b : ℝ} {c : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ} (hc : StrictMono c) (ha : a < c 0) (hb : c (Fin.last n) < b) (hpa : p.eval a = 0) (hpb : p.eval b = 0) (halt : ∀ i : Fin n, p.eval (c i.castSucc) * p.eval (c i.succ) < 0) (hdeg : p.natDegree < n + 2) : p = 0
declarations.docstring: Two endpoint zeros together with `n` sign changes force a polynomial of degree below `n + 2` to vanish identically.

declarations.name: exists_peak_le_of_monic_comparison
declarations.signature: theorem exists_peak_le_of_monic_comparison {n : ℕ} {p u : ℝ[X]} {a b C : ℝ} {c : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ} (hp : p.IsMonicOfDegree (n + 2)) (hu : u.IsMonicOfDegree (n + 2)) (hc : StrictMono c) (ha : a < c 0) (hb : c (Fin.last n) < b) (hpa : p.eval a = 0) (hpb : p.eval b = 0) (hua : u.eval a = 0) (hub : u.eval b = 0) (hpalt : ∀ i : Fin n, p.eval (c i.castSucc) * p.eval (c i.succ) < 0) (hubound : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), |u.eval (c i)| ≤ C) : ∃ i : Fin (n + 1), |p.eval (c i)| ≤ C
declarations.docstring: **Constrained alternation theorem.** Let `p` and `u` be monic degree `n + 2` real polynomials sharing two endpoint zeros. If `p` alternates at `n + 1` ordered interior points, then `u` cannot be bounded by `C` at all of those points while `p` is strictly larger than `C` there.

declarations.name: endpointScale
declarations.docstring: The scale that sends the two outermost roots of `T_n` to `-1` and `1`.

declarations.name: monicScaledChebyshev
declarations.docstring: The endpoint-normalised monic Chebyshev comparison polynomial.

declarations.name: comparisonBound
declarations.docstring: The sharp normalised height. A later algebraic simplification rewrites this as `1 / (2^(n-1) * cos(pi/(2n))^n)`.

declarations.name: endpointScale_pos
declarations.signature: theorem endpointScale_pos {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) : 0 < endpointScale n

declarations.name: endpointScale_ne_zero
declarations.signature: theorem endpointScale_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) : endpointScale n ≠ 0

declarations.name: eval_monicScaledChebyshev
declarations.signature: theorem eval_monicScaledChebyshev {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (x : ℝ) : (monicScaledChebyshev n).eval x = ((2 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1))⁻¹ * (endpointScale n)⁻¹ ^ n * (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (n : ℤ)).eval (endpointScale n * x)
declarations.docstring: Evaluation formula exposing the ordinary Chebyshev polynomial at the contracted point `r*x`.

declarations.name: monicScaledChebyshev_isMonicOfDegree
declarations.signature: theorem monicScaledChebyshev_isMonicOfDegree {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) : (monicScaledChebyshev n).IsMonicOfDegree n
declarations.docstring: The comparison polynomial is genuinely monic of degree `n`.

declarations.name: eval_chebyshev_endpointScale
declarations.signature: private theorem eval_chebyshev_endpointScale {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) : (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (n : ℤ)).eval (endpointScale n) = 0

declarations.name: abs_eval_monicScaledChebyshev_le
declarations.signature: theorem abs_eval_monicScaledChebyshev_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| ≤ 1) : |(monicScaledChebyshev n).eval x| ≤ comparisonBound n
declarations.docstring: Uniform sharp comparison bound on the normalised root interval.

declarations.name: exists_peak_le_comparisonBound
declarations.signature: theorem exists_peak_le_comparisonBound {m : ℕ} {p : ℝ[X]} {c : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ} (hp : p.IsMonicOfDegree (m + 2)) (hc : StrictMono c) (ha : -1 < c 0) (hb : c (Fin.last m) < 1) (hpa : p.eval (-1) = 0) (hpb : p.eval 1 = 0) (hpalt : ∀ i : Fin m, p.eval (c i.castSucc) * p.eval (c i.succ) < 0) (hc_mem : ∀ i : Fin (m + 1), |c i| ≤ 1) : ∃ i : Fin (m + 1), |p.eval (c i)| ≤ comparisonBound (m + 2)
declarations.docstring: Concrete sharp alternation consequence in degree `m+2`. This is the formal core of the sharp collinear diameter theorem after affine normalisation and the elementary choice of one extremum in each root gap.

declarations.name: hasSum_taylor_diagonal_circle
declarations.signature: theorem hasSum_taylor_diagonal_circle (a b : ℕ → ℂ) (ha : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖a n‖)) (hb : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖b n‖)) : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => a n * conj (b n)) (circleAverage (fun z => ∑' q : ℕ × ℕ, a q.1 * conj (b q.2) * z ^ q.1 * conj (z ^ q.2)) 0 1)
declarations.docstring: Absolute double-series transport and monomial orthogonality extract the diagonal. No diagonal or energy identity is assumed.

declarations.name: hasSum_complex_product_of_norms
declarations.signature: theorem hasSum_complex_product_of_norms (f g : ℕ → ℂ) {u v : ℂ} (hf : HasSum f u) (hg : HasSum g v) (hnf : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖f n‖)) (hng : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖g n‖)) : HasSum (fun q : ℕ × ℕ => f q.1 * g q.2) (u * v)
declarations.docstring: Keep the product-series inference abstract before substituting Cauchy coefficients.

declarations.name: hasSum_cauchy_circle_product
declarations.signature: theorem hasSum_cauchy_circle_product {g : ℂ → ℂ} {R : ℝ≥0} (hg : DiffContOnCl ℂ g (ball 0 R)) (hR : 1 < R) : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => cauchyPowerSeries g 0 R n (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) * conj (cauchyPowerSeries g 0 R n (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)))) (circleAverage (fun z => g z * conj (g z)) 0 1)
declarations.docstring: Cauchy's actual coefficients give the norm-square energy of the analytic function on the unit circle. This complex-valued form precedes real projection.

declarations.name: hasSum_cauchy_circle_norm_sq
declarations.signature: theorem hasSum_cauchy_circle_norm_sq {g : ℂ → ℂ} {R : ℝ≥0} (hg : DiffContOnCl ℂ g (ball 0 R)) (hR : 1 < R) : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => ‖cauchyPowerSeries g 0 R n (fun _ => (1 : ℂ))‖ ^ 2) (circleAverage (fun z => ‖g z‖ ^ 2) 0 1)
declarations.docstring: Classical Parseval identity, stated as a real HasSum for the actual Cauchy coefficient norms. Analyticity beyond the unit circle supplies every summability and interchange premise.

declarations.name: hasSum_scalar_taylor
declarations.signature: theorem hasSum_scalar_taylor {g : ℂ → ℂ} {p : FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ ℂ ℂ} {r : ℝ≥0∞} (hg : HasFPowerSeriesOnBall g p 0 r) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ eball 0 r) : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => p.coeff n * z ^ n) (g z)
declarations.docstring: Scalar Taylor evaluation, with coefficients evaluated at the unit vector.

declarations.name: hasSum_degree_scalar_taylor
declarations.signature: theorem hasSum_degree_scalar_taylor {g : ℂ → ℂ} {p : FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ ℂ ℂ} {r : ℝ≥0∞} (hg : HasFPowerSeriesOnBall g p 0 r) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ eball 0 r) : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℂ) * p.coeff n * z ^ n) (z * deriv g z)
declarations.docstring: Applying the derivative series at the radial vector gives the original Taylor coefficients weighted by their degrees; the degree-zero term is zero.

declarations.name: hasSum_cauchy_on_unit_circle
declarations.signature: theorem hasSum_cauchy_on_unit_circle {g : ℂ → ℂ} {R : ℝ≥0} (hg : DiffContOnCl ℂ g (ball 0 R)) (hR : 1 < R) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ sphere 0 1) : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => cauchyPowerSeries g 0 R n (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) * z ^ n) (g z)
declarations.docstring: Cauchy's coefficients identify the actual function at every unit-circle point when the analytic disc has radius strictly larger than one.

declarations.name: hasSum_degree_cauchy_on_unit_circle
declarations.signature: theorem hasSum_degree_cauchy_on_unit_circle {g : ℂ → ℂ} {R : ℝ≥0} (hg : DiffContOnCl ℂ g (ball 0 R)) (hR : 1 < R) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ sphere 0 1) : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℂ) * cauchyPowerSeries g 0 R n (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) * z ^ n) (z * deriv g z)
declarations.docstring: Cauchy's degree-weighted coefficients identify `z * g'(z)` on the same unit circle. No derivative-series equality is assumed.

declarations.name: circle_taylor_energy_le_coefficient_deficit
declarations.signature: theorem circle_taylor_energy_le_coefficient_deficit {g : ℂ → ℂ} {R : ℝ≥0} (hg : DiffContOnCl ℂ g (ball 0 R)) (hR : 1 < R) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : circleAverage (fun z => ‖g z‖ ^ 2 - 2 * (z * deriv g z * conj (g z)).re) 0 1 ≤ ‖g 0‖ ^ 2 - ((2 : ℝ) * k - 1) * ‖cauchyPowerSeries g 0 R k (fun _ => (1 : ℂ))‖ ^ 2
declarations.docstring: Retain any specified positive-degree coefficient deficit instead of discarding it. All other positive-degree contributions are nonpositive. No bound is assumed.

declarations.name: scalar_coefficient_geometric_majorant
declarations.signature: theorem scalar_coefficient_geometric_majorant (p : FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ ℂ ℂ) (hp : 1 < p.radius) : ∃ q ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, ∃ C > 0, ∀ n, ‖p n (fun _ => (1 : ℂ))‖ ≤ C * q ^ n
declarations.docstring: Evaluating multilinear coefficients on the constant unit vector inherits an exponential bound whenever the convergence radius exceeds one.

declarations.name: summable_scalar_coefficient_and_degree
declarations.signature: theorem summable_scalar_coefficient_and_degree (p : FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ ℂ ℂ) (hp : 1 < p.radius) : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖p n (fun _ => (1 : ℂ))‖) ∧ Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖(n : ℂ) * p n (fun _ => (1 : ℂ))‖)
declarations.docstring: A geometric bound supplies absolute summability both for coefficients and for the coefficients of `z * g'(z)`, indexed by the original degree.

declarations.name: cauchy_coefficient_geometric_majorant
declarations.signature: theorem cauchy_coefficient_geometric_majorant {g : ℂ → ℂ} {R : ℝ≥0} (hg : DiffContOnCl ℂ g (ball 0 R)) (hR : 1 < R) : ∃ q ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, ∃ C > 0, ∀ n, ‖cauchyPowerSeries g 0 R n (fun _ => (1 : ℂ))‖ ≤ C * q ^ n
declarations.docstring: Cauchy's actual Taylor coefficients for a function analytic on a disc of radius `R > 1` satisfy the geometric majorant; no coefficient decay hypothesis is added.

declarations.name: summable_cauchy_coefficient_and_degree
declarations.signature: theorem summable_cauchy_coefficient_and_degree {g : ℂ → ℂ} {R : ℝ≥0} (hg : DiffContOnCl ℂ g (ball 0 R)) (hR : 1 < R) : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖cauchyPowerSeries g 0 R n (fun _ => (1 : ℂ))‖) ∧ Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖(n : ℂ) * cauchyPowerSeries g 0 R n (fun _ => (1 : ℂ))‖)
declarations.docstring: Absolute coefficient and degree-weighted coefficient suppliers for termwise circle integration on the unit circle.

declarations.name: hasSum_cauchy_derivative_circle_product
declarations.signature: theorem hasSum_cauchy_derivative_circle_product {g : ℂ → ℂ} {R : ℝ≥0} (hg : DiffContOnCl ℂ g (ball 0 R)) (hR : 1 < R) : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℂ) * cauchyPowerSeries g 0 R n (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) * conj (cauchyPowerSeries g 0 R n (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)))) (circleAverage (fun z => z * deriv g z * conj (g z)) 0 1)
declarations.docstring: Diagonal extraction with the first coefficient sequence weighted by its actual degree identifies the radial derivative cross integral.

declarations.name: hasSum_cauchy_derivative_circle_energy
declarations.signature: theorem hasSum_cauchy_derivative_circle_energy {g : ℂ → ℂ} {R : ℝ≥0} (hg : DiffContOnCl ℂ g (ball 0 R)) (hR : 1 < R) : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * ‖cauchyPowerSeries g 0 R n (fun _ => (1 : ℂ))‖ ^ 2) (circleAverage (fun z => (z * deriv g z * conj (g z)).re) 0 1)
declarations.docstring: The real radial-derivative energy is the degree-weighted norm-square coefficient series. The function and coefficient suppliers are actual analytic objects, not an assumed energy identity.

declarations.name: circleAverage_monomial
declarations.signature: private theorem circleAverage_monomial (n : ℕ) : circleAverage (fun z : ℂ => z ^ n) 0 1 = if n = 0 then 1 else 0

declarations.name: circleAverage_monomial_conj
declarations.signature: theorem circleAverage_monomial_conj (n m : ℕ) : circleAverage (fun z : ℂ => z ^ n * conj (z ^ m)) 0 1 = if n = m then 1 else 0
declarations.docstring: Mixed monomials are orthogonal for normalized unit-circle integration. This is an exact integral identity, with no analytic-energy bound assumed.

declarations.name: circle_taylor_energy_le_value_zero
declarations.signature: theorem circle_taylor_energy_le_value_zero {g : ℂ → ℂ} {R : ℝ≥0} (hg : DiffContOnCl ℂ g (ball 0 R)) (hR : 1 < R) : circleAverage (fun z => ‖g z‖ ^ 2 - 2 * (z * deriv g z * conj (g z)).re) 0 1 ≤ ‖g 0‖ ^ 2
declarations.docstring: Analyticity beyond the circle makes every positive-degree coefficient's contribution to this energy nonpositive. No energy bound is assumed.

declarations.name: taylorDeficitTerm
declarations.signature: def taylorDeficitTerm (a : ℕ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ
declarations.docstring: The positive-degree contribution, with the constant coefficient excluded.

declarations.name: taylorDeficitTerm_nonneg
declarations.signature: theorem taylorDeficitTerm_nonneg (a : ℕ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ taylorDeficitTerm a n

declarations.name: circle_taylor_energy_add_finite_deficit_le
declarations.signature: theorem circle_taylor_energy_add_finite_deficit_le {g : ℂ → ℂ} {R : ℝ≥0} (hg : DiffContOnCl ℂ g (ball 0 R)) (hR : 1 < R) (s : Finset ℕ) : circleAverage (fun z => ‖g z‖ ^ 2 - 2 * (z * deriv g z * conj (g z)).re) 0 1 + ∑ n ∈ s, taylorDeficitTerm (fun k => cauchyPowerSeries g 0 R k (fun _ => (1 : ℂ))) n ≤ ‖g 0‖ ^ 2
declarations.docstring: Every finite coefficient set can be retained in the circle energy bound. In particular this is not a statement obtained by adding individual bounds.

declarations.name: circle_taylor_deficit_hasSum
declarations.signature: theorem circle_taylor_deficit_hasSum {g : ℂ → ℂ} {R : ℝ≥0} (hg : DiffContOnCl ℂ g (ball 0 R)) (hR : 1 < R) : HasSum (taylorDeficitTerm (fun n => cauchyPowerSeries g 0 R n (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)))) (‖g 0‖ ^ 2 - (circleAverage (fun z => ‖g z‖ ^ 2) 0 1 - 2 * circleAverage (fun z => (z * deriv g z * conj (g z)).re) 0 1))
declarations.docstring: Exact summable diagonal deficit for a function analytic beyond the circle.

declarations.name: circle_taylor_energy_identity
declarations.signature: theorem circle_taylor_energy_identity {g : ℂ → ℂ} {R : ℝ≥0} (hg : DiffContOnCl ℂ g (ball 0 R)) (hR : 1 < R) : circleAverage (fun z => ‖g z‖ ^ 2 - 2 * (z * deriv g z * conj (g z)).re) 0 1 = ‖g 0‖ ^ 2 - ∑' n, taylorDeficitTerm (fun k => cauchyPowerSeries g 0 R k (fun _ => (1 : ℂ))) n
declarations.docstring: The diagonal identity after integration, with every infinite series justified by the two supplied HasSum theorems.

declarations.name: pairEnergy5
declarations.signature: def pairEnergy5 (x0 x1 x2 x3 x4 : ℝ) : ℝ
declarations.docstring: The second elementary symmetric polynomial in five real variables.

declarations.name: pairEnergy5_absorb
declarations.signature: theorem pairEnergy5_absorb {y z a b c : ℝ} (hy1 : y ≤ 1) (hz1 : 1 ≤ z) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hb0 : 0 ≤ b) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) : pairEnergy5 (y * z) 1 a b c ≤ pairEnergy5 y z a b c
declarations.docstring: Absorbing a large entry into the exceptional entry cannot increase the five-variable pair energy.

declarations.name: pairEnergy5_lower_of_four_large
declarations.signature: theorem pairEnergy5_lower_of_four_large {y z1 z2 z3 z4 : ℝ} (hy0 : 0 ≤ y) (hz1 : 1 ≤ z1) (hz2 : 1 ≤ z2) (hz3 : 1 ≤ z3) (hz4 : 1 ≤ z4) (hprod : y * z1 * z2 * z3 * z4 ≤ 1) : 6 + 4 * (y * z1 * z2 * z3 * z4) ≤ pairEnergy5 y z1 z2 z3 z4
declarations.docstring: Sharp lower bound when four of five nonnegative entries are at least one and the total product is at most one.

declarations.name: pairEnergy5_lower_six_of_four_large
declarations.signature: theorem pairEnergy5_lower_six_of_four_large {y z1 z2 z3 z4 : ℝ} (hy0 : 0 ≤ y) (hz1 : 1 ≤ z1) (hz2 : 1 ≤ z2) (hz3 : 1 ≤ z3) (hz4 : 1 ≤ z4) : 6 ≤ pairEnergy5 y z1 z2 z3 z4
declarations.docstring: Product-free base layer: the six mutual products of four entries at least one already contribute six to the pair energy.

declarations.name: five_exists_two_lt_one_of_pairEnergy_lt_six

declarations.name: diffContOnCl_weightedAnalyticLog

declarations.name: weighted_closed_disc_add_finite_deficit_le

declarations.name: weighted_closed_disc_full_deficit

declarations.name: weighted_closed_disc_single_deficit
declarations.signature: theorem weighted_closed_disc_single_deficit {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (w : ι → ℝ) (c : ι → ℂ) (hw0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ w j) (hw : ∑ j, w j = 1) (hc : ∀ j, ‖c j‖ ≤ 1) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : weightedQuadratic w c + ((2 : ℝ) * k - 1) * ‖weightedTaylorCoeff w c k‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1

declarations.name: weightedTaylorCoeff_eq_zero_of_equality
declarations.signature: theorem weightedTaylorCoeff_eq_zero_of_equality {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (w : ι → ℝ) (c : ι → ℂ) (hw0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ w j) (hw : ∑ j, w j = 1) (hc : ∀ j, ‖c j‖ ≤ 1) (heq : weightedQuadratic w c = 1) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : weightedTaylorCoeff w c k = 0

declarations.name: weighted_cauchy_coefficient_radial
declarations.signature: theorem weighted_cauchy_coefficient_radial {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (w : ι → ℝ) (c : ι → ℂ) (hc : ∀ j, ‖c j‖ ≤ 1) (r : ℝ) (R : ℝ≥0) (hR : 0 < R) (hRc : ∀ j, ‖(r : ℂ) * c j‖ * (R : ℝ) < 1) (n : ℕ) : cauchyPowerSeries (weightedAnalyticLog w (fun j => (r : ℂ) * c j)) 0 R n (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) = (r : ℂ) ^ n * weightedTaylorCoeff w c n

declarations.name: weightedTaylorCoeff_zero

declarations.name: weightedTaylorCoeff_one

declarations.name: weightedAnalyticLog_eq_one_on_halfDisc

declarations.name: weighted_centres_zero_of_rational_vanishing

declarations.name: weightedGeometric_eq_one_of_support_zero
declarations.signature: theorem weightedGeometric_eq_one_of_support_zero {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (w : ι → ℝ) (c : ι → ℂ) (hw0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ w j) (hs : ∀ j, 0 < w j → c j = 0) (z : ℂ) : weightedGeometric w c z = 1

declarations.name: weighted_equality_iff_positive_support_zero

declarations.name: weighted_interior_point_le_energy
declarations.signature: theorem weighted_interior_point_le_energy {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (w : ι → ℝ) (c : ι → ℂ) (hw0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ w j) (hw : ∑ j, w j = 1) (R : ℝ≥0) (hR : 1 < R) (hc : ∀ j, ‖c j‖ * (R : ℝ) < 1) : (∑ j, w j * ‖weightedAnalyticLog w c (c j)‖ ^ 2) ≤ circleAverage (fun z => ‖weightedAnalyticLog w c z‖ ^ 2 * (∑ j, w j * poissonKernel 0 (c j) z)) 0 1

declarations.name: weighted_open_disc_product_bound

declarations.name: poissonKernel_unit_fraction
declarations.signature: theorem poissonKernel_unit_fraction {c z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) : poissonKernel 0 c z = (1 - ‖conj c * z‖ ^ 2) / ‖1 - conj c * z‖ ^ 2

declarations.name: weighted_poisson_log_identity

declarations.docstring: The finite normalized Poisson mixture is exactly the rational expression in the actual logarithmic energy. Nonnegative weights are unnecessary here.

declarations.name: circle_weighted_poisson_energy_le_one

declarations.name: weightedAnalyticLog_radial

declarations.name: weightedAnalyticLog_radial_at_center

declarations.name: deriv_weightedAnalyticLog_zero

declarations.name: weightedAnalyticLog_not_constant_of_first_moment
