declarations.signature: theorem zudilin_rpow_lt_iff_contourRegion (a b : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : b < a) : ((b : ℝ) ^ zudilinMu < (a : ℝ)) ↔ ZudilinContourRegion a b
declarations.docstring: The paper's "equivalently": for integers `a > b ≥ 1`, `b^μ < a ↔ log b / log a < θ*`, with `b^μ` the real power.

declarations.name: rational_base_threshold
declarations.signature: theorem rational_base_threshold (a b : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : b < a) (_hcop : Nat.Coprime a b) (h : (b : ℝ) ^ zudilinMu < (a : ℝ)) : Irrational (paperLambert ((a : ℝ) / b))
declarations.docstring: **`res:rational-base-threshold` / `long1049:res:region`.** For coprime integers `a > b ≥ 1` with `b^μ < a`, equivalently `log b / log a < θ*`, the value `F(a/b) = ∑_{m≥1} ((a/b)^m - 1)⁻¹` is irrational. Coprimality is carried to match the paper; it is not used.

declarations.name: rational_base_threshold_log
declarations.signature: theorem rational_base_threshold_log (a b : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : b < a) (_hcop : Nat.Coprime a b) (h : Real.log (b : ℝ) / Real.log (a : ℝ) < zudilinContour) : Irrational (paperLambert ((a : ℝ) / b))
declarations.docstring: The same conclusion from the displayed logarithmic form of the hypothesis.

declarations.name: thirtyoneFour_irrational
declarations.docstring: **`long1049:res:31over4`, first clause.**

declarations.name: thirtyoneFour_pow_irrational
declarations.signature: theorem thirtyoneFour_pow_irrational (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) : Irrational (paperLambert (((31 : ℝ) / 4) ^ r))
declarations.docstring: **`long1049:res:31over4`, second clause: every positive integer power.**

declarations.name: thirtyoneFour_ratio_chain
declarations.signature: theorem thirtyoneFour_ratio_chain : 1 / 2 - 1 / Real.pi ^ 2 < Real.log 4 / Real.log 31 ∧ Real.log 4 / Real.log 31 < (81 : ℝ) / 200 ∧ (81 : ℝ) / 200 < zudilinContour
declarations.docstring: **The displayed chain `1/2 - 1/π² < log 4 / log 31 < 81/200 < θ*`.**

declarations.name: bvMu
declarations.docstring: `μ_BV = 2π²/(π² - 2)`, the Bundschuh–Väänänen exponent.

declarations.name: inv_bvMu_eq
declarations.docstring: `1/μ_BV = 1/2 - 1/π²`: the Bundschuh–Väänänen exponent and the displayed Bundschuh–Väänänen region cutoff are reciprocal.

declarations.name: thirtyoneFour_between_rpow
declarations.signature: theorem thirtyoneFour_between_rpow : (4 : ℝ) ^ zudilinMu < 31 ∧ (31 : ℝ) < (4 : ℝ) ^ bvMu
declarations.docstring: **The displayed chain `4^μ < 31 < 4^{μ_BV}`.** The left inequality places `31/4` inside the region of the rational-base theorem, the right one places it outside the Bundschuh–Väänänen region.

declarations.name: thirtyoneFour_outside_bv_inside_contour
declarations.docstring: **`31/4` is outside the Bundschuh–Väänänen region and inside the contour region.**

declarations.name: rational_base_measure_uniform
declarations.signature: theorem rational_base_measure_uniform (a b r : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : b < a) (_hcop : Nat.Coprime a b) (hr : 0 < r) (hθ : Real.log (b : ℝ) / Real.log (a : ℝ) < zudilinContour) : irrationalityExponent (paperLambert (((a : ℝ) / b) ^ r)) ≤ (1 - Real.log (b : ℝ) / Real.log (a : ℝ)) / (zudilinContour - Real.log (b : ℝ) / Real.log (a : ℝ))
declarations.docstring: **`cor:rational-base-measure` / `long1049:cor:rational-base-measure`.** For coprime `a > b ≥ 1` with `θ = log b / log a < θ*` and every integer `r ≥ 1`, the irrationality exponent of `F((a/b)^r)` — by definition the supremum of the exponents `ν` for which `|ξ - p/q| < q^{-ν}` has infinitely many reduced rational solutions — is at most `(1 - θ)/(θ* - θ)`.

declarations.name: thirtyoneFour_power_measure_lt_301
declarations.signature: theorem thirtyoneFour_power_measure_lt_301 (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) : irrationalityExponent (paperLambert (((31 : ℝ) / 4) ^ r)) < 301
declarations.docstring: The displayed special case: `μ_irr(F((31/4)^r)) < 301` for every `r ≥ 1`.

declarations.name: qq
declarations.docstring: The indeterminate `q` of `ℚ⟦q⟧`.

declarations.name: qfac
declarations.docstring: `(q;q)_n = ∏_{i < n} (1 - q^{i+1})`, the tree's finite `q`-Pochhammer `qPochhammer q q n`.

declarations.name: qfac_succ
declarations.signature: lemma qfac_succ (n : ℕ) : qfac (n + 1) = qfac n * (1 - qq ^ (n + 1))

declarations.name: qfac_mul_ifac
declarations.signature: lemma qfac_mul_ifac (n : ℕ) : qfac n * ifac n = 1

declarations.name: ifac_mul_qfac
declarations.signature: lemma ifac_mul_qfac (n : ℕ) : ifac n * qfac n = 1

declarations.name: ifac_succ
declarations.signature: lemma ifac_succ (n : ℕ) : ifac n = ifac (n + 1) * (1 - qq ^ (n + 1))

declarations.name: gaussBinom_eq
declarations.signature: lemma gaussBinom_eq {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) : gaussBinom qq n k = qfac n * ifac k * ifac (n - k)

declarations.name: ifac_mul_gaussBinom
declarations.signature: lemma ifac_mul_gaussBinom {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) : ifac n * gaussBinom qq n k = ifac k * ifac (n - k)

declarations.name: BW
declarations.docstring: Formal power series in `w` over `ℚ⟦q⟧`.

declarations.name: ww
declarations.docstring: The indeterminate `w`.

declarations.name: wPoch
declarations.docstring: `(w;q)_j = ∏_{i < j} (1 - w q^i)`, the tree's finite `q`-Pochhammer in `ℚ⟦q⟧⟦w⟧`.

declarations.name: coeff_eE
declarations.signature: lemma coeff_eE (n : ℕ) : coeff n eE = ifac n

declarations.name: coeff_eP
declarations.signature: lemma coeff_eP (n : ℕ) : coeff n eP = (-1) ^ n * qq ^ (n.choose 2) * ifac n

declarations.name: rescale_q_eE
declarations.signature: lemma rescale_q_eE : rescale qq eE = (1 - ww) * eE

declarations.name: rescale_rescale_eE
declarations.signature: lemma rescale_rescale_eE (a b : PowerSeries ℚ) : rescale b (rescale a eE) = rescale (a * b) eE

declarations.name: eE_mul_wPoch
declarations.signature: lemma eE_mul_wPoch (j : ℕ) : eE * wPoch j = rescale (qq ^ j) eE
declarations.docstring: `E(w) (w;q)_j = E(q^j w)`.

declarations.name: map_gaussBinom
declarations.signature: lemma map_gaussBinom {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S) (q : R) : ∀ n k, f (gaussBinom q n k) = gaussBinom (f q) n k | 0, 0 =>
declarations.docstring: Gaussian binomials commute with ring homomorphisms.

declarations.name: coeff_wPoch
declarations.signature: lemma coeff_wPoch (j l : ℕ) : coeff l (wPoch j) = gaussBinom qq j l * (-1) ^ l * qq ^ (l.choose 2)

declarations.name: wsum
declarations.docstring: `wsum F = ∑_i w^i F_i`, the sum converging `w`-adically.

declarations.name: coeff_wsum
declarations.signature: lemma coeff_wsum (F : ℕ → BW) (n : ℕ) : coeff n (wsum F) = ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), coeff (n - i) (F i)

declarations.name: hasSum_wsum
declarations.signature: lemma hasSum_wsum (F : ℕ → BW) : HasSum (fun i => ww ^ i * F i) (wsum F)

declarations.name: mul_wsum
declarations.signature: lemma mul_wsum (G : BW) (F : ℕ → BW) : G * wsum F = wsum (fun i => G * F i)

declarations.name: wsum_mul
declarations.signature: lemma wsum_mul (G : BW) (F : ℕ → BW) : wsum F * G = wsum (fun i => F i * G)

declarations.name: wsum_add
declarations.signature: lemma wsum_add (F G : ℕ → BW) : wsum (fun i => F i + G i) = wsum F + wsum G

declarations.name: wsum_sum
declarations.signature: lemma wsum_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → ℕ → BW) : wsum (fun i => ∑ x ∈ s, F x i) = ∑ x ∈ s, wsum (F x)

declarations.name: wsum_C
declarations.signature: lemma wsum_C (c : ℕ → PowerSeries ℚ) : wsum (fun i => C (c i)) = mk c

declarations.name: wsum_C_mul
declarations.signature: lemma wsum_C_mul (c : ℕ → PowerSeries ℚ) (H : BW) : wsum (fun i => C (c i) * H) = mk c * H

declarations.name: sum_triangle
declarations.signature: lemma sum_triangle {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (g : ℕ → ℕ → M) (n : ℕ) : ∑ m ∈ range (n + 1), ∑ i ∈ range (m + 1), g i m = ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (n - i + 1), g i (i + j)

declarations.name: wsum_antidiag
declarations.signature: lemma wsum_antidiag (F : ℕ → ℕ → BW) : wsum (fun n => ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal n, F p.1 p.2) = wsum (fun i => wsum (fun j => F i j))
declarations.docstring: `∑_n w^n ∑_{i+j=n} F_{i,j} = ∑_i w^i ∑_j w^j F_{i,j}`.

declarations.name: wsum_comm
declarations.signature: lemma wsum_comm (F : ℕ → ℕ → BW) : wsum (fun i => wsum (fun j => F i j)) = wsum (fun j => wsum (fun i => F i j))

declarations.name: wsum_congr
declarations.signature: lemma wsum_congr {F G : ℕ → BW} (h : ∀ i, F i = G i) : wsum F = wsum G

declarations.name: qPochInf
declarations.docstring: `(x;q)_∞ = ∏_{i ≥ 0} (1 - x q^i)` in `ℚ⟦q⟧⟦w⟧`, an infinite product in the product (coefficientwise) topology.

declarations.name: C_pow_dvd_iff
declarations.signature: lemma C_pow_dvd_iff {a : ℕ} {f : BW} : C (qq ^ a) ∣ f ↔ ∀ k, qq ^ a ∣ coeff k f

declarations.name: coeff_coeff_eq_zero_of_dvd
declarations.signature: lemma coeff_coeff_eq_zero_of_dvd {a : ℕ} {f : BW} (h : C (qq ^ a) ∣ f) (k : ℕ) {m : ℕ} (hm : m < a) : coeff m (coeff k f) = 0

declarations.name: eq_zero_of_forall_dvd
declarations.signature: lemma eq_zero_of_forall_dvd {f : BW} (h : ∀ a, C (qq ^ a) ∣ f) : f = 0

declarations.name: multipliable_qPochInf
declarations.signature: lemma multipliable_qPochInf (x : BW) : Multipliable (fun i : ℕ => 1 - x * C (qq ^ i))

declarations.name: hasProd_qPochInf
declarations.signature: lemma hasProd_qPochInf (x : BW) : HasProd (fun i : ℕ => 1 - x * C (qq ^ i)) (qPochInf x)

declarations.name: qPochInf_eq
declarations.signature: lemma qPochInf_eq (x : BW) : qPochInf x = (1 - x) * qPochInf (C qq * x)

declarations.name: dvd_qPochInf_sub_one
declarations.signature: lemma dvd_qPochInf_sub_one (a : ℕ) (y : BW) : C (qq ^ a) ∣ qPochInf (C (qq ^ a) * y) - 1
declarations.docstring: Every factor of `(q^a y; q)_∞` is `1` modulo `q^a`, hence so is the product.

declarations.name: eP_eq
declarations.signature: lemma eP_eq : eP = (1 - ww) * rescale qq eP

declarations.name: eulerP
declarations.signature: def eulerP (a : PowerSeries ℚ) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≠ 0) : BW
declarations.docstring: The explicit series of `(a w^j; q)_∞`.

declarations.name: eulerP_eq
declarations.signature: lemma eulerP_eq (a : PowerSeries ℚ) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≠ 0) : eulerP a j hj = (1 - C a * ww ^ j) * eulerP (qq * a) j hj

declarations.name: coeff_eulerP
declarations.signature: lemma coeff_eulerP (a : PowerSeries ℚ) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) : coeff n (eulerP a j hj) = if j ∣ n then a ^ (n / j) * coeff (n / j) eP else 0

declarations.name: dvd_eulerP_sub_one
declarations.signature: lemma dvd_eulerP_sub_one (M : ℕ) (b : PowerSeries ℚ) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≠ 0) : C (qq ^ M) ∣ eulerP (qq ^ M * b) j hj - 1

declarations.name: qPochInf_C_mul_pow
declarations.signature: theorem qPochInf_C_mul_pow (a : PowerSeries ℚ) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≠ 0) : qPochInf (C a * ww ^ j) = eulerP a j hj
declarations.docstring: Euler's product formula: `(a w^j; q)_∞` is the explicit series `eulerP a j`.

declarations.name: qPochInf_C_mul_w
declarations.signature: lemma qPochInf_C_mul_w (a : PowerSeries ℚ) : qPochInf (C a * ww) = rescale a eP

declarations.name: qPochInf_C_mul_w_sq
declarations.signature: lemma qPochInf_C_mul_w_sq (a : PowerSeries ℚ) : qPochInf (C a * ww ^ 2) = expand 2 two_ne_zero (rescale a eP)

declarations.name: ring_inverse_eq
declarations.signature: lemma ring_inverse_eq {x y : BW} (h : x * y = 1) : Ring.inverse x = y

declarations.name: rescale_eP_mul_eE
declarations.signature: lemma rescale_eP_mul_eE (a : PowerSeries ℚ) : rescale a eP * rescale a eE = 1

declarations.name: sum_range_even
declarations.signature: lemma sum_range_even {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (n : ℕ) (h : ℕ → M) : ∑ a ∈ range (n + 1), (if 2 ∣ a then h (a / 2) else 0) = ∑ f ∈ range (n + 1), (if 2 * f ≤ n then h f else 0)

declarations.name: qbinomial_w
declarations.signature: lemma qbinomial_w (t : ℕ) : expand 2 two_ne_zero (rescale (qq ^ t) eP) * rescale (qq ^ t) eE = wsum (fun j => C (qq ^ (t * j) * ifac j) * wPoch j)
declarations.docstring: `(q^t w^2; q)_∞ / (q^t w; q)_∞ = ∑_j (w;q)_j (q^t w)^j / (q;q)_j`, after Euler's formula: the two sides agree coefficient by coefficient.

declarations.name: eE_mul_qbinomial_w
declarations.signature: lemma eE_mul_qbinomial_w (t : ℕ) : eE * (expand 2 two_ne_zero (rescale (qq ^ t) eP) * rescale (qq ^ t) eE) = wsum (fun j => C (qq ^ (t * j) * ifac j) * rescale (qq ^ j) eE)

declarations.name: wsum_shift
declarations.signature: lemma wsum_shift (t : ℕ) : wsum (fun j => C (qq ^ (t * j) * ifac j) * rescale (qq ^ j) eE) = wsum (fun d => C (ifac d) * rescale (qq ^ (t + d)) eE)
declarations.docstring: `∑_j q^{tj} w^j/(q;q)_j E(q^j w) = ∑_d w^d/(q;q)_d E(q^{t+d} w)`.

declarations.name: momentGenFun
declarations.docstring: The generating function `G_q(w) = (w;q)_∞^{-3} ∑_{t ≥ 0} w^t/(q;q)_t · (q^t w^2;q)_∞ / (q^t w;q)_∞^2` in `ℚ⟦q⟧⟦w⟧`, with the infinite products taken in the product topology.

declarations.name: momentWeight
declarations.docstring: The moment weight `γ_k(q) = [w^k] G_q(w) ∈ ℚ⟦q⟧`.

declarations.name: rogersR
declarations.signature: def rogersR (r k : ℕ) : PowerSeries ℚ
declarations.docstring: `R_k^{(r)}(q) = ∑_{n_1+⋯+n_r=k} (q;q)_k / ∏_{j ≤ r} (q;q)_{n_j}`, the sum over compositions of `k` into `r` nonnegative parts.

declarations.name: momentGenFun_eq
declarations.signature: lemma momentGenFun_eq : momentGenFun = eE ^ 2 * wsum (fun t => wsum (fun d => C (ifac t * ifac d) * (rescale (qq ^ (t + d)) eE * rescale (qq ^ t) eE)))

declarations.name: qD
declarations.docstring: The `q`-derivative `(∂_q f)(w) = (f(w) - f(qw))/w`.

declarations.name: coeff_qD
declarations.signature: lemma coeff_qD (f : BW) (n : ℕ) : coeff n (qD f) = (1 - qq ^ (n + 1)) * coeff (n + 1) f

declarations.name: qD_add
declarations.signature: lemma qD_add (f g : BW) : qD (f + g) = qD f + qD g

declarations.name: qD_C_mul
declarations.signature: lemma qD_C_mul (c : PowerSeries ℚ) (f : BW) : qD (C c * f) = C c * qD f

declarations.name: qD_sum
declarations.signature: lemma qD_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → BW) : qD (∑ i ∈ s, F i) = ∑ i ∈ s, qD (F i)

declarations.name: qD_mul
declarations.signature: lemma qD_mul (f g : BW) : qD (f * g) = qD f * g + rescale qq f * qD g

declarations.name: qD_rescale
declarations.signature: lemma qD_rescale (a : PowerSeries ℚ) (f : BW) : qD (rescale a f) = C a * rescale a (qD f)

declarations.name: qD_iter_eE
declarations.signature: lemma qD_iter_eE (r : ℕ) : qD^[r] eE = eE

declarations.name: coeff_qD_iter
declarations.signature: lemma coeff_qD_iter (f : BW) (r m : ℕ) : coeff m (qD^[r] f) = qfac (m + r) * ifac m * coeff (m + r) f

declarations.name: qD_iter_eE_mul
declarations.signature: lemma qD_iter_eE_mul (g : BW) (r : ℕ) : qD^[r] (eE * g) = ∑ l ∈ range (r + 1), C (gaussBinom qq r l) * (rescale (qq ^ (r - l)) eE * qD^[r - l] g)
declarations.docstring: The `q`-Leibniz rule for a product with `E(w) = 1/(w;q)_∞`: `∂_q^r (E g) = ∑_l [r,l]_q E(q^{r-l} w) ∂_q^{r-l} g`.

declarations.name: sum_antidiagonalTuple_succ
declarations.signature: lemma sum_antidiagonalTuple_succ {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (k n : ℕ) (f : (Fin (k + 1) → ℕ) → M) : ∑ x ∈ Finset.Nat.antidiagonalTuple (k + 1) n, f x = ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal n, ∑ y ∈ Finset.Nat.antidiagonalTuple k p.2, f (Fin.cons p.1 y)

declarations.name: sum_antidiagonalTuple_two
declarations.signature: lemma sum_antidiagonalTuple_two {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin 2 → ℕ) → M) : ∑ x ∈ Finset.Nat.antidiagonalTuple 2 n, f x = ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal n, f ![p.1, p.2]

declarations.name: inv_qfac_mul
declarations.signature: lemma inv_qfac_mul (a b : ℕ) : (qfac a * qfac b)⁻¹ = ifac a * ifac b

declarations.name: rogersR_two
declarations.signature: lemma rogersR_two (n : ℕ) : rogersR 2 n = ∑ r ∈ range (n + 1), qfac n * ifac r * ifac (n - r)

declarations.name: coeff_eE_cube
declarations.signature: lemma coeff_eE_cube (n : ℕ) : coeff n (eE * (eE * eE)) = rogersR 3 n * ifac n

declarations.name: rogersSeries_eq_wsum
declarations.signature: lemma rogersSeries_eq_wsum : rogersSeries = wsum (fun r => C (ifac r) * qD^[r] (eE * (eE * eE)))

declarations.name: rogersSeries_eq
declarations.signature: lemma rogersSeries_eq : rogersSeries = eE ^ 2 * wsum (fun u => wsum (fun v => C (ifac u * ifac v) * (rescale (qq ^ (u + v)) eE * rescale (qq ^ v) eE)))

declarations.name: momentWeight_eq
declarations.signature: theorem momentWeight_eq (k : ℕ) : momentWeight k = rogersR 2 k * rogersR 3 k * (qfac k)⁻¹

declarations.name: rogersPoly2
declarations.docstring: `R_k^{(2)}` as an integer polynomial, `∑_i [k, i]_q`.

declarations.name: rogersPoly3
declarations.docstring: `R_k^{(3)}` as an integer polynomial, `∑_{a+m=k} ∑_{b+c=m} [k, a]_q [m, b]_q`.

declarations.name: toQSeries
declarations.signature: def toQSeries : Polynomial ℤ →+* PowerSeries ℚ
declarations.docstring: The embedding `ℤ[q] → ℚ⟦q⟧`.

declarations.name: toQSeries_apply
declarations.signature: lemma toQSeries_apply (f : Polynomial ℤ) : toQSeries f = ((f.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) : Polynomial ℚ) : PowerSeries ℚ)

declarations.name: toQSeries_gaussBinom
declarations.signature: lemma toQSeries_gaussBinom (n k : ℕ) : toQSeries (gaussBinom Polynomial.X n k) = gaussBinom qq n k

declarations.name: toQSeries_rogersPoly2
declarations.signature: lemma toQSeries_rogersPoly2 (k : ℕ) : toQSeries (rogersPoly2 k) = rogersR 2 k

declarations.name: rogersR_three
declarations.signature: lemma rogersR_three (k : ℕ) : rogersR 3 k = ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal k, ∑ q ∈ antidiagonal p.2, qfac k * ifac p.1 * ifac q.1 * ifac q.2

declarations.name: toQSeries_rogersPoly3
declarations.signature: lemma toQSeries_rogersPoly3 (k : ℕ) : toQSeries (rogersPoly3 k) = rogersR 3 k

declarations.name: coeff_nonneg_mul
declarations.signature: lemma coeff_nonneg_mul {f g : Polynomial ℤ} (hf : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f.coeff n) (hg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ g.coeff n) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ (f * g).coeff n

declarations.name: coeff_nonneg_sum
declarations.signature: lemma coeff_nonneg_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Polynomial ℤ) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ n, 0 ≤ (f i).coeff n) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, f i).coeff n

declarations.name: gaussBinom_coeff_nonneg
declarations.signature: lemma gaussBinom_coeff_nonneg (n k d : ℕ) : 0 ≤ (gaussBinom (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℤ) n k).coeff d

declarations.name: rogersPoly2_coeff_nonneg
declarations.signature: lemma rogersPoly2_coeff_nonneg (k n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ (rogersPoly2 k).coeff n

declarations.name: rogersPoly3_coeff_nonneg

declarations.name: rogers_factorisation
declarations.signature: theorem rogers_factorisation (k : ℕ) : momentWeight k = rogersR 2 k * rogersR 3 k * (qfac k)⁻¹ ∧ qfac k * momentWeight k = rogersR 2 k * rogersR 3 k ∧ (∃ p : Polynomial ℕ, ((p.map (Nat.castRingHom ℚ) : Polynomial ℚ) : PowerSeries ℚ) = rogersR 2 k * rogersR 3 k ∧ p.natDegree = k ^ 2 / 4 + k ^ 2 / 3 ∧ p.eval 1 = 6 ^ k) ∧ (∃ g : Polynomial ℤ, qfac k * momentWeight k = ((g.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) : Polynomial ℚ) : PowerSeries ℚ))
declarations.docstring: `long1049:prop:rogers-factorisation`: the moment weights as a product of two finite sums. Here `q` is an indeterminate: `γ_k(q) = [w^k] G_q(w)` is computed in `ℚ⟦q⟧⟦w⟧` from `G_q(w) = (w;q)_∞^{-3} ∑_{t ≥ 0} w^t/(q;q)_t · (q^t w^2;q)_∞/(q^t w;q)_∞^2`, the infinite products being genuine infinite products in the product topology, and `R_k^{(r)}(q) = ∑_{n_1+⋯+n_r=k} (q;q)_k / ∏_{j ≤ r} (q;q)_{n_j}`. Then * `γ_k(q) = R_k^{(2)}(q) R_k^{(3)}(q) / (q;q)_k` (equivalently `(q;q)_k γ_k(q) = R_k^{(2)}(q) R_k^{(3)}(q)`); * the product `R_k^{(2)} R_k^{(3)}` lies in `ℤ_{≥0}[q]`: it is the image of a polynomial `p ∈ ℕ[q]`, which has degree `⌊k²/4⌋ + ⌊k²/3⌋` and coefficient sum `p(1) = 6^k`; * consequently `(q;q)_k γ_k ∈ ℤ[q]`.

declarations.name: sharp_fixed_base
declarations.signature: theorem sharp_fixed_base {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) (γ : ℕ → ℝ) (hγ : ∀ w : ℝ, 0 ≤ w → w < 1 → HasSum (fun k => γ k * w ^ k) (actualGeneratingFunction q w)) : HasProd (sharpFactor q γ) (∏' k : ℕ, sharpFactor q γ k) ∧ 0 < sharpA q γ ∧ Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (actualMomentHankel q N).det / (sharpK q γ * leadC N * q ^ orderB N * qPochhammerInfinity q q ^ (2 * N) * (N : ℝ) ^ (-8 * lambertL q))) atTop (𝓝 1) ∧ Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => Real.log (actualMomentHankel q N).det - ((orderB N : ℝ) * Real.log q + Real.log (leadC N) + 2 * (N : ℝ) * Real.log (qPochhammerInfinity q q) - 8 * lambertL q * Real.log N + Real.log (sharpK q γ))) atTop (𝓝 0)
declarations.docstring: `long1049:thm:sharp-fixed-base` (the size of `V_N^*` at a fixed base). Let `0 < q < 1` and let `γ_k = [w^k] G_q(w)`, i.e. `∑_k γ_k w^k = G_q(w)` on `0 ≤ w < 1`, with `G_q` the tree's `actualGeneratingFunction q`; put `a_k = P^4 γ_k`. With `L = lambertL q`, `c_k = cK k`, `C_N = leadC N`, `B_N = orderB N` and `V_N^*(q) = det (v^*_{i+j}(q))_{0 ≤ i,j < N}` (`actualMomentHankel`): * the product `∏_{k ≥ 0} (a_k/c_k) e^{8L/(k+1)}` converges (`HasProd`), and `𝓐(q) = e^{-8 γ_E L} ∏_{k ≥ 0} (a_k/c_k) e^{8L/(k+1)}` (`sharpA`) is positive; * with `K(q) = 𝓐(q) 𝓜(q)^3` (`sharpK`), `V_N^*(q) ∼ K(q) C_N q^{B_N} P^{2N} N^{-8L}`: the ratio tends to `1`; * equivalently `log V_N^*(q) = B_N log q + log C_N + 2N log P - 8L log N + log K(q) + o(1)`.

declarations.name: lambertL_eq_lambert
declarations.signature: lemma lambertL_eq_lambert {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) : lambertL q = PaperR16.lambert q
declarations.docstring: The long record's `L = ∑_{r ≥ 1} q^r/(1 - q^r)` is `F(1/q)`, the literal Lambert series at `q`.

declarations.name: six_mul_orderB_succ
declarations.signature: lemma six_mul_orderB_succ (m : ℕ) : 6 * orderB (m + 1) = (m + 1) * m * (2 * m + 1)

declarations.name: orderB_eq_closed_form
declarations.signature: lemma orderB_eq_closed_form (N : ℕ) : N * (N - 1) * (2 * N - 1) / 6 = orderB N

declarations.name: sharp_fixed_base_exists
declarations.signature: theorem sharp_fixed_base_exists {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) : ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (PaperR16.actualMomentHankel q N).det / (K * leadC N * q ^ (N * (N - 1) * (2 * N - 1) / 6) * PaperR10.qPochhammerInfinity q q ^ (2 * N) * (N : ℝ) ^ (-8 * PaperR16.lambert q))) atTop (𝓝 1)
declarations.docstring: `res:sharp-fixed-base` (short paper). For fixed `0 < q < 1` there is `K(q) > 0` with `V_N^*(q) ∼ K(q) C_N q^{B_N} P^{2N} N^{-8F(1/q)}`: the ratio tends to `1`. Here `V_N^*(q) = det (v^*_{i+j}(q))_{0 ≤ i,j < N}` (`actualMomentHankel`), `B_N = N(N-1)(2N-1)/6`, `C_N = (N!)^2 (N+1)!/2^N` (`leadC`), `P = (q;q)_∞` and `F(1/q) = PaperR16.lambert q`.

declarations.name: IsMahler
declarations.docstring: `f` satisfies a `k`-Mahler functional equation: there are polynomials `p 0, …, p d` over `ℚ` with `p 0 ≠ 0` and `∑_{i ≤ d} pᵢ(z) · f(z^{k^i}) = 0`. The nonvanishing of the coefficient of the *unshifted* function is part of the definition, as in Adamczewski–Bell; the paper's proof is written exactly to produce it.

declarations.name: isMahler_subs
declarations.signature: lemma isMahler_subs {k m : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hm : 1 ≤ m) {f : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hf : IsMahler k f) : IsMahler k (subs m f)
declarations.docstring: A `k`-Mahler function stays `k`-Mahler after the substitution `z ↦ z^m`: apply `z ↦ z^m` to the equation, which replaces each polynomial coefficient by its `m`-fold expansion and commutes with the `k`-powers.

declarations.name: mahler_of_stable
declarations.signature: theorem mahler_of_stable {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (V : Submodule (RatFunc ℚ) ℚ⸨X⸩) [Module.Finite (RatFunc ℚ) V] {f : ℚ⸨X⸩} (hf : f ∈ V) (hstab : ∀ g ∈ V, subs k g ∈ V) : ∃ j : ℕ, IsMahler k (subs (k ^ j) f)
declarations.docstring: The paper's first two steps. If a finite-dimensional `ℚ(z)`-subspace `V` contains `f` and is stable under `z ↦ z^k`, then some `z ↦ z^{k^j}` substitute of `f` satisfies a genuine `k`-Mahler equation. `f(z), f(z^k), …, f(z^{k^d})` all lie in `V`, so they are linearly dependent over `ℚ(z)`; clearing denominators gives polynomials `P₀, …, P_d`, not all zero, with `∑ Pᵢ(z) f(z^{k^i}) = 0`. Taking `j` least with `P_j ≠ 0` and writing `f(z^{k^i}) = (f ∘ z^{k^j})(z^{k^{i-j}})` for `i ≥ j` leaves an equation whose unshifted coefficient `P_j` is nonzero.

declarations.signature: theorem divisorReal_partial_lower {s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs1 : s < 1) (N : ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, s ^ (i + 1) / (1 - s ^ (i + 1)) ≤ divisorReal s
declarations.docstring: The Lambert relation in the direction the boundary estimate uses: the partial Lambert sums `∑_{d ≤ N} s^d/(1 - s^d)` are below `ℒ(s) = ∑ₙ τ(n) sⁿ`.

declarations.name: tendsto_lambert_partial
declarations.signature: theorem tendsto_lambert_partial {s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs1 : s < 1) : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, s ^ (i + 1) / (1 - s ^ (i + 1))) atTop (𝓝 (divisorReal s))
declarations.docstring: The Lambert form displayed in the paper: for real `0 < s < 1` the partial sums `∑_{d ≤ N} s^d/(1 - s^d)` converge to `ℒ(s) = ∑ₙ τ(n) sⁿ`. This is the identity behind the paper's display `ℒ(z) = ∑_{n ≥ 1} zⁿ/(1 - zⁿ)`, and it is why `divisorLambert` is the paper's `ℒ`.

declarations.docstring: The lower bound behind `(x-1)F(x) → ∞`: for every `N`, `(1-s)·ℒ(s) ≥ s^N · (1 + 1/2 + ⋯ + 1/N)`.

declarations.name: no_finite_simultaneous_two_three_system

There is no finite-dimensional `ℚ(z)`-subspace of `ℚ((z))` containing the divisor generating series `ℒ(z) = ∑_{n ≥ 1} zⁿ/(1 - zⁿ)` and stable under both `z ↦ z²` and `z ↦ z³`. declarations.docstring: `long1049:res:nomahler`, with no hypothesis. There is no finite-dimensional `ℚ(z)`-subspace of `ℚ((z))` containing the divisor generating series `ℒ(z) = ∑_{n ≥ 1} zⁿ/(1 - zⁿ)` and stable under both `z ↦ z²` and `z ↦ z³`. The statement is that of `no_finite_simultaneous_two_three_system` without its `AdamczewskiBell` hypothesis. Stability under `z ↦ z²` alone already fails, by `no_finite_single_base_system` with `k = 2`.

declarations.name: coefficientPencil_remainder_matrix
declarations.signature: theorem coefficientPencil_remainder_matrix (p : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (hremainder : ∀ i j : Fin N, PaperR12.actualMoment p⁻¹ (i.val + j.val) = coefficientAlpha p (i.val + j.val) * PaperR16.lambert p⁻¹ - coefficientBeta p (i.val + j.val)) : PaperR16.lambert p⁻¹ • coefficientAlphaMatrix p N - coefficientBetaMatrix p N = PaperR16.actualMomentHankel p⁻¹ N

declarations.name: coefficientPencil_splits_and_roots_lt_of_certificates
declarations.signature: theorem coefficientPencil_splits_and_roots_lt_of_certificates {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) (N : ℕ) (hdet : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ N → 0 < k → 0 < (coefficientHankelDetPoly k 0).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom ℝ) p) (hremainder : ∀ i j : Fin N, PaperR12.actualMoment p⁻¹ (i.val + j.val) = coefficientAlpha p (i.val + j.val) * PaperR16.lambert p⁻¹ - coefficientBeta p (i.val + j.val)) : (coefficientAlphaMatrix p N).PosDef ∧ (coefficientPencilPoly p N).Splits ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, (coefficientPencilPoly p N).IsRoot x → x < PaperR16.lambert p⁻¹
declarations.docstring: The complete finite-rank spectral conclusion, conditional only on its explicit determinant and remainder certificates. Splitting asserts that all roots are real; the strict bound applies to every root.

declarations.name: coefficientPencil_interlaces_of_certificates
declarations.signature: theorem coefficientPencil_interlaces_of_certificates {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) (N : ℕ) (hdet : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ N + 1 → 0 < k → 0 < (coefficientHankelDetPoly k 0).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom ℝ) p) : ∃ (large : Fin (N + 1) → ℝ) (small : Fin N → ℝ), Antitone large ∧ Antitone small ∧ (coefficientPencilPoly p (N + 1)).roots = Multiset.map large Finset.univ.val ∧ (coefficientPencilPoly p N).roots = Multiset.map small Finset.univ.val ∧ ∀ i : Fin N, small i ≤ large i.castSucc ∧ large i.succ ≤ small i
declarations.docstring: Consecutive literal coefficient pencils interlace whenever the larger alpha matrix has its positive leading determinant certificates. The root multisets retain every algebraic multiplicity.

declarations.name: determinantPencil_splits_and_roots_lt

declarations.name: coefficientPencil_finitePencil
declarations.signature: theorem coefficientPencil_finitePencil {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 < p) : (∀ N : ℕ, N ≤ 8 → (coefficientAlphaMatrix p N).PosDef ∧ (coefficientPencilPoly p N).Splits ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, (coefficientPencilPoly p N).IsRoot x → x < PaperR16.lambert (1 / p)) ∧ (∀ N : ℕ, N + 1 ≤ 8 → ∃ (large : Fin (N + 1) → ℝ) (small : Fin N → ℝ), Antitone large ∧ Antitone small ∧ (coefficientPencilPoly p (N + 1)).roots = Multiset.map large Finset.univ.val ∧ (coefficientPencilPoly p N).roots = Multiset.map small Finset.univ.val ∧ ∀ i : Fin N, small i ≤ large i.castSucc ∧ large i.succ ≤ small i)
declarations.docstring: The paper's proposition `long1049:res:finite-pencil`, for every real `p > 1`. 1. For every `N ≤ 8`: `A_N` is positive definite, `det(Y A_N − B_N)` splits over `ℝ`, and each of its roots is strictly less than `F(p)`. 2. For every `N` with `N + 1 ≤ 8`: the roots at ranks `N + 1` and `N`, listed in decreasing order with multiplicity, interlace non-strictly.

declarations.name: actualMoment_eq_coefficientLinearForm_of_finite_certificate
declarations.signature: theorem actualMoment_eq_coefficientLinearForm_of_finite_certificate (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p) (m d e : ℕ) (Qbar : BivariatePolynomial) (Qzero : ParameterPolynomial) (Qcoeff : Fin m → ParameterPolynomial) (Cpoly : Fin (m + 1) → ParameterPolynomial) (Cquot : (k : Fin (m + 1)) → Fin (m + k.val) → ParameterPolynomial) (Qquot : Fin m → ParameterPolynomial) (hbalance : (∑ j ∈ range (m + 1), (m + 1 + j)) + d = 4 * (∑ j ∈ range m, (j + 1)) + e) (hQsplit : Qbar = C Qzero + ∑ j : Fin m, C (Qcoeff j) * X ^ (j.val + 1)) (hpartial : clearedMomentNumeratorPoly m e = Qbar * clearedMomentDenominatorPoly m + residueCertificatePoly m d Cpoly) (halpha : ∑ k : Fin (m + 1), Cpoly k = coefficientAlphaPoly m)

declarations.name: coefficientHankelDetPoly_shift0_pos
declarations.signature: theorem coefficientHankelDetPoly_shift0_pos {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ 8) : 0 < (coefficientHankelDetPoly n 0).eval₂ (Int.castRingHom ℝ) p

declarations.name: sum_range_tail_reflect
declarations.signature: private theorem sum_range_tail_reflect {F : Type*} [AddCommGroup F] (m k : ℕ) (f : ℕ → F) : (∑ n ∈ range (m + k), f n) - ∑ n ∈ range k, f n = ∑ s ∈ range m, f (m + k - 1 - s)
declarations.docstring: Reverse the final block of a range sum. This is the index change `n = k + r` to `n + 1 = m + k - s` used by the kernel-zero argument.

declarations.name: kernelZero_correction_identity
declarations.signature: theorem kernelZero_correction_identity {F : Type*} [Field F] (m : ℕ) (p : F) (Q C : ℕ → F) (hden : ∀ j ∈ range m, p ^ (j + 1) ≠ 1) (hzero : ∀ s ∈ range m, (∑ j ∈ range m, Q j * p ^ ((s + 1) * (j + 1))) + ∑ k ∈ range (m + 1), C k / (p ^ (m + k - s) - 1) = 0) : (∑ k ∈ range (m + 1), ∑ n ∈ range (m + k), C k / (p ^ (n + 1) - 1)) - ∑ j ∈ range m, Q j * p ^ (j + 1) / (p ^ (j + 1) - 1) = (∑ k ∈ range (m + 1), ∑ n ∈ range k, C k / (p ^ (n + 1) - 1)) - ∑ j ∈ range m, Q j * p ^ ((m + 1) * (j + 1)) / (p ^ (j + 1) - 1)
declarations.docstring: **Kernel-zero correction lemma.** `Q j` is the coefficient of `X^(j+1)` in the polynomial quotient and `C k` is the `k`th simple-pole residue. The hypothesis is exactly what remains after evaluating the partial-fraction identity at the numerator zeros `X = p^(s+1)` and cancelling its constant term against the sum of residues. The conclusion converts the full residue prefixes and the quotient values at `p` into the short source prefixes and the quotient values at `p^(m+1)`. For the Erdős 1049 kernel, the latter quotient sum is the finite triangular correction obtained from the generating function for `S_(m,l)`.

declarations.name: det_coeff_abs_le_of_majorant
declarations.signature: theorem det_coeff_abs_le_of_majorant {n : ℕ} (A B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ[X]) (hAB : ∀ i j, CoeffMajorant (A i j) (B i j)) (c : Fin n → ℤ) (hc : ∀ i j, (B i j).eval 1 ≤ c j) (k : ℕ) : |(A.det).coeff k| ≤ (n.factorial : ℤ) * ∏ j, c j

declarations.name: eq_zero_of_eval_eq_zero_of_coeff_abs_lt
declarations.signature: theorem eq_zero_of_eval_eq_zero_of_coeff_abs_lt {T : ℤ} (hT : 0 < T) : ∀ (n : ℕ) (R : ℤ[X]), R.natDegree ≤ n → (∀ k, |R.coeff k| < T) → R.eval T = 0 → R = 0

declarations.name: sum_digits_mul_pow

declarations.docstring: The base-`T` digit sum below `T ^ L` recovers `V` modulo `T ^ L`.

declarations.name: coeff_eq_digit_of_eval
declarations.signature: theorem coeff_eq_digit_of_eval (Q : ℤ[X]) (T V L : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (hQ : ∀ k, 2 * |Q.coeff k| < T) (heval : Q.eval (T : ℤ) = V) (hV : V < T ^ L) (hdig : ∀ i < L, 2 * (V / T ^ i % T) < T) : ∀ k, Q.coeff k = ((V / T ^ k % T : ℕ) : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: Coefficients from one evaluation. If `2|Q_k| < T` for every `k`, the value `V = Q(T)` lies below `T ^ L`, and every base-`T` digit `d` of `V` below position `L` satisfies `2d < T`, then the coefficients of `Q` are exactly those digits.

declarations.signature: theorem actualMoment_eq_of_rationalKernel_certificate {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) (m : ℕ) (A : Fin m → ℝ) (C : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (hcertificate : ∀ t : ℕ, momentRationalKernel q m (q ^ t) = finiteRationalKernel q m A C t) : PaperR12.actualMoment q m = (∑ k, C k) * PaperR16.lambert q + ∑ j, A j / (1 - q ^ (j.val + 1)) - ∑ k, C k * finiteLambertPrefix q (m + k.val)

declarations.name: momentRationalKernel_clear
declarations.signature: theorem momentRationalKernel_clear (p : ℝ) (hp : p ≠ 0) (m d e : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (hbalance : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m + 1 + j)) + d = 4 * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (j + 1)) + e) (hden : (∏ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (p ^ (m + 1 + j) - x)) ≠ 0) : p ^ d * momentRationalKernel (p⁻¹) m x * (∏ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (p ^ (m + 1 + j) - x)) = p ^ e * x ^ (m + 1) * (∏ j ∈ Finset.range m, (p ^ (j + 1) - 1)) ^ 3 * (∏ j ∈ Finset.range m, (p ^ (j + 1) - x))
