declarations.signature: theorem forcedQuotient_modEq {index : ℕ} {m a b : ℤ} (h : a ≡ b [ZMOD (index + 2 : ℤ) * m]) (ha : (index + 2 : ℤ) ∣ forcedNumerator index a) (hb : (index + 2 : ℤ) ∣ forcedNumerator index b) : forcedNumerator index a / (index + 2 : ℤ) ≡ forcedNumerator index b / (index + 2 : ℤ) [ZMOD m]
declarations.docstring: One successful update transports congruence from a modulus `d*m` to the shrunk modulus `m`.

declarations.name: forcedSurvives_iff_of_modEq
declarations.signature: theorem forcedSurvives_iff_of_modEq : ∀ {remaining index : ℕ} {a b : ℤ}, a ≡ b [ZMOD (horizonModulus remaining index : ℤ)] → (ForcedSurvives remaining index a ↔ ForcedSurvives remaining index b) | 0, index, a, b, _ =>
declarations.docstring: Survival for a fixed finite horizon depends only on the state modulo the recursive horizon modulus.

declarations.name: forcedSurvives_iff_of_modEq_factorial
declarations.signature: theorem forcedSurvives_iff_of_modEq_factorial {h : ℕ} {a b : ℤ} (hab : a ≡ b [ZMOD ((h + 1).factorial : ℤ)]) : ForcedSurvives h 0 a ↔ ForcedSurvives h 0 b
declarations.docstring: Exact factorial-residue theorem used by the finite search.

declarations.name: cumulativeDigitLcm
declarations.signature: def cumulativeDigitLcm (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ | 0 => q | n + 1 => Nat.lcm (cumulativeDigitLcm q a n) (a n) @[simp] theorem cumulativeDigitLcm_zero (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℕ) : cumulativeDigitLcm q a 0 = q
declarations.docstring: Cumulative least common multiple of the initial denominator and all digits strictly before `n`.

declarations.name: cumulativeDigitLcm_zero
declarations.signature: theorem cumulativeDigitLcm_zero (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℕ) : cumulativeDigitLcm q a 0 = q

declarations.name: cumulativeDigitLcm_succ
declarations.signature: theorem cumulativeDigitLcm_succ (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : cumulativeDigitLcm q a (n + 1) = Nat.lcm (cumulativeDigitLcm q a n) (a n)

declarations.name: digitProductScale
declarations.signature: def digitProductScale (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ | 0 => q | n + 1 => a n * digitProductScale q a n /-- Cumulative product of the irreversible LCM-overlap payments. -/ def cumulativeOverlapDebt (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ | 0 => 1 | n + 1 => cumulativeOverlapDebt q a n * Nat.gcd (cumulativeDigitLcm q a n) (a n) /-- Global overlap is relocation rather than erasure: at every finite horizon, overlap debt times the cumulative LCM is exactly the full product-cleared digit scale. -/
declarations.docstring: Product-cleared denominator scale through the first `n` digits.

declarations.name: cumulativeOverlapDebt
declarations.signature: def cumulativeOverlapDebt (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ | 0 => 1 | n + 1 => cumulativeOverlapDebt q a n * Nat.gcd (cumulativeDigitLcm q a n) (a n) /-- Global overlap is relocation rather than erasure: at every finite horizon, overlap debt times the cumulative LCM is exactly the full product-cleared digit scale. -/ theorem cumulativeOverlapDebt_mul_lcm_eq_productScale (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : cumulativeOverlapDebt q a n * cumulativeDigitLcm q a n = digitProductScale q a n
declarations.docstring: Cumulative product of the irreversible LCM-overlap payments.

declarations.name: cumulativeOverlapDebt_mul_lcm_eq_productScale
declarations.signature: theorem cumulativeOverlapDebt_mul_lcm_eq_productScale (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : cumulativeOverlapDebt q a n * cumulativeDigitLcm q a n = digitProductScale q a n
declarations.docstring: Global overlap is relocation rather than erasure: at every finite horizon, overlap debt times the cumulative LCM is exactly the full product-cleared digit scale.

declarations.name: globalCentered
declarations.signature: def globalCentered (Λ Y b : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: Centered remainder in cumulative-LCM coordinates.

declarations.name: globalLcm_numerator_update
declarations.signature: theorem globalLcm_numerator_update {Λ Y b a ρ YNext : ℕ} {F : ℤ} (hF : F = globalCentered Λ Y b) (ha : a = b + 1) (hraw : (ρ * YNext : ℤ) = (a : ℤ) * Y - Λ) : (ρ * YNext : ℤ) = (Y : ℤ) - F
declarations.docstring: The lifted raw numerator identity is equivalent to the pseudo-Euclidean update once `F = Λ-bY` and `a=b+1`.

declarations.name: globalContent_gcd_split
declarations.signature: theorem globalContent_gcd_split (M Y Λ : ℕ) : Nat.gcd (M * Y) (M * Λ) = M * Nat.gcd Y Λ
declarations.docstring: A common product-cleared scale factors out of the global numerator and cumulative denominator exactly.

declarations.name: reducedCancellation_split_global_local
declarations.signature: theorem reducedCancellation_split_global_local {G GNext M MNext g gNext h ρ : ℕ} (hMpos : 0 < M) (hG : G = M * g) (hGNext : GNext = MNext * gNext) (hMNext : MNext = ρ * M) (hpayment : h * G = GNext) : h * g = ρ * gNext
declarations.docstring: Exact global/local split of a reduced cancellation payment. The factor `ρ` is deposited in the irreversible overlap scale `M`; the remaining change is the local lifted content.

declarations.name: globalNegativeMass_step_bound
declarations.signature: theorem globalNegativeMass_step_bound {K ρ Y YNext : ℕ} {F : ℤ} (hupdate : (ρ * YNext : ℤ) = (Y : ℤ) - F) (hsmall : (K : ℤ) * (-F) ≤ Y) : (K : ℤ) * (ρ * YNext) ≤ (K + 1 : ℤ) * Y
declarations.docstring: Division-free one-step amortization: if negative centered mass is at most `1/K` of the lifted numerator, then overlap payment plus next height is bounded by the corresponding near-unit factor.

declarations.name: globalPositiveCentered_strict_payment_descent
declarations.signature: theorem globalPositiveCentered_strict_payment_descent {ρ Y YNext : ℕ} {F : ℤ} (hupdate : (ρ * YNext : ℤ) = (Y : ℤ) - F) (hF : 0 < F) : (ρ * YNext : ℤ) < Y
declarations.docstring: Positive global centered error strictly decreases lifted height after charging the overlap payment.

declarations.name: returnedError_step
declarations.signature: theorem returnedError_step {x xNext a b bNext Δ z zNext : ℚ} (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hb0 : b ≠ 0) (hbNext0 : bNext ≠ 0) (hxNext : xNext = x - 1 / a) (ha : a = b + 1) (hbNext : bNext = a * b + Δ) (hz : z = x - 1 / b) (hzNext : zNext = xNext - 1 / bNext) : zNext = z + Δ / (a * b * bNext)
declarations.docstring: Exact returned-error telescope. It is an identity over `ℚ`; obtaining well-founded descent still requires arithmetic height information.

declarations.name: no_boundedRise_of_strictRiseAvoidance
declarations.signature: theorem no_boundedRise_of_strictRiseAvoidance (u m : ℕ → ℕ) (N B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B) (hm : ∀ n, N ≤ n → 1 < m n) (hpair : ∀ {i j : ℕ}, N ≤ i → N ≤ j → i ≠ j → Nat.Coprime (m i) (m j)) (havoid : ∀ {i t : ℕ}, N ≤ i → i < t → u t < u (t + 1) → Nat.Coprime (m i) (u t)) (hrise : ∀ n, N ≤ n → u (n + 1) ≤ u n + B) (huTop : Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop Filter.atTop) : False
declarations.docstring: The shifted-CRT obstruction only needs old-modulus avoidance at an upward step. The stronger theorem in `ReciprocalTailRigidity` assumes avoidance at every later state; this is the exact variant used by the LCM-cleared state.

declarations.name: centeredLcm_commonDivisor_dvd_digit
declarations.signature: theorem centeredLcm_commonDivisor_dvd_digit {p D a u : ℕ} {V : ℤ} (hpD : p ∣ D) (hpu : p ∣ u) (hcenter : V = (D : ℤ) - (((a - 1) * u : ℕ) : ℤ)) : p ∣ V.natAbs
declarations.docstring: Every common divisor of the LCM denominator state and the numerator state divides the absolute centered digit. This is the exact arithmetic payment used at strict rises.

declarations.name: lcmState_rise_le
declarations.signature: theorem lcmState_rise_le (u g : ℕ → ℕ) (V : ℕ → ℤ) (N B n : ℕ) (hn : N ≤ n) (hgpos : ∀ k, N ≤ k → 0 < g k) (hstep : ∀ k, N ≤ k → (g k : ℤ) * (u (k + 1) : ℤ) = (u k : ℤ) - V k) (hlower : ∀ k, N ≤ k → -(B : ℤ) ≤ V k) : u (n + 1) ≤ u n + B
declarations.docstring: The LCM recurrence and a lower bound `V ≥ -B` give the bounded-rise inequality required by the CRT consumer.

declarations.name: lcmState_digit_neg_of_strictRise
declarations.signature: theorem lcmState_digit_neg_of_strictRise (u g : ℕ → ℕ) (V : ℕ → ℤ) (N n : ℕ) (hn : N ≤ n) (hgpos : ∀ k, N ≤ k → 0 < g k) (hstep : ∀ k, N ≤ k → (g k : ℤ) * (u (k + 1) : ℤ) = (u k : ℤ) - V k) (hrise : u n < u (n + 1)) : V n < 0
declarations.docstring: At a strict rise the centered LCM digit is negative.

declarations.name: lcmState_strictRise_primeAvoidance
declarations.signature: theorem lcmState_strictRise_primeAvoidance (u g D a : ℕ → ℕ) (V : ℕ → ℤ) (N B p n : ℕ) (hn : N ≤ n) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hpLarge : B < p) (hpD : p ∣ D n) (hgpos : ∀ k, N ≤ k → 0 < g k) (hstep : ∀ k, N ≤ k → (g k : ℤ) * (u (k + 1) : ℤ) = (u k : ℤ) - V k) (hcenter : ∀ k, N ≤ k → V k = (D k : ℤ) - (((a k - 1) * u k : ℕ) : ℤ)) (hlower : ∀ k, N ≤ k → -(B : ℤ) ≤ V k) (hrise : u n < u (n + 1)) : Nat.Coprime p (u n)
declarations.docstring: A prime larger than the negative-digit bound cannot divide the state at a strict rise once it has entered the accumulated LCM denominator.

declarations.name: no_boundedNegative_lcmState_of_oldPrimeSupply
declarations.signature: theorem no_boundedNegative_lcmState_of_oldPrimeSupply (u g D a m : ℕ → ℕ) (V : ℕ → ℤ) (N B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B) (hmPrime : ∀ i, N ≤ i → Nat.Prime (m i)) (hmLarge : ∀ i, N ≤ i → B < m i) (hmPair : ∀ {i j}, N ≤ i → N ≤ j → i ≠ j → Nat.Coprime (m i) (m j)) (hmOld : ∀ {i t}, N ≤ i → i < t → m i ∣ D t) (hgpos : ∀ n, N ≤ n → 0 < g n) (hstep : ∀ n, N ≤ n → (g n : ℤ) * (u (n + 1) : ℤ) = (u n : ℤ) - V n) (hcenter : ∀ n, N ≤ n → V n = (D n : ℤ) - (((a n - 1) * u n : ℕ) : ℤ)) (hlower : ∀ n, N ≤ n → -(B : ℤ) ≤ V n)
declarations.docstring: Kernel-checked arithmetic core of the bounded LCM-negative-part argument. Once infinitely many old large primes are supplied, the exact LCM recurrence, centered-digit identity, bounded negative part, and unbounded state are inconsistent.

declarations.name: lcmBlockWeight
declarations.signature: def lcmBlockWeight (g : ℕ → ℕ) (r : ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ | 0 => 1 | k + 1 => lcmBlockWeight g r k * g (r + k) @[simp] theorem lcmBlockWeight_zero (g : ℕ → ℕ) (r : ℕ) : lcmBlockWeight g r 0 = 1

declarations.name: lcmBlockWeight_zero
declarations.signature: theorem lcmBlockWeight_zero (g : ℕ → ℕ) (r : ℕ) : lcmBlockWeight g r 0 = 1

declarations.name: lcmBlockWeight_succ
declarations.signature: theorem lcmBlockWeight_succ (g : ℕ → ℕ) (r k : ℕ) : lcmBlockWeight g r (k + 1) = lcmBlockWeight g r k * g (r + k)

declarations.name: lcmState_weightedBlock_telescope
declarations.signature: theorem lcmState_weightedBlock_telescope (u g : ℕ → ℕ) (V : ℕ → ℤ) (hstep : ∀ n, (g n : ℤ) * (u (n + 1) : ℤ) = (u n : ℤ) - V n) : ∀ r k, (lcmBlockWeight g r k : ℤ) * (u (r + k) : ℤ) = (u r : ℤ) - ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (lcmBlockWeight g r i : ℤ) * V (r + i)
declarations.docstring: Exact multiplicatively weighted telescope for the LCM state recurrence.

declarations.name: lcmBlockWeight_pos
declarations.signature: theorem lcmBlockWeight_pos (g : ℕ → ℕ) (hgpos : ∀ n, 0 < g n) (r k : ℕ) : 0 < lcmBlockWeight g r k
declarations.docstring: Positive local multipliers give a positive block weight.

declarations.name: lcmState_blockEndpoint_le
declarations.signature: theorem lcmState_blockEndpoint_le (u g : ℕ → ℕ) (V : ℕ → ℤ) (r k : ℕ) (hgpos : ∀ n, 0 < g n) (hstep : ∀ n, (g n : ℤ) * (u (n + 1) : ℤ) = (u n : ℤ) - V n) (hdebt : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (lcmBlockWeight g r i : ℤ) * V (r + i)) : u (r + k) ≤ u r
declarations.docstring: Nonnegative weighted debt over one complete block makes its endpoint state no larger than its initial state.

declarations.name: lcmState_insideBlock_le
declarations.signature: theorem lcmState_insideBlock_le (u g : ℕ → ℕ) (V : ℕ → ℤ) (r k B : ℕ) (hgpos : ∀ n, 0 < g n) (hstep : ∀ n, (g n : ℤ) * (u (n + 1) : ℤ) = (u n : ℤ) - V n) (hdebt : -(∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (lcmBlockWeight g r i : ℤ) * V (r + i)) ≤ (B : ℤ) * lcmBlockWeight g r k) : u (r + k) ≤ u r + B
declarations.docstring: A uniform bound on the negative weighted debt inside a block bounds every state in that block by the initial state plus the same constant.

declarations.name: eventually_zero_of_bounded_lcmState
declarations.signature: theorem eventually_zero_of_bounded_lcmState (u : ℕ → ℕ) (V : ℕ → ℤ) (M : ℕ) (hbound : ∀ n, u n ≤ M) (hvanish : ∀ K, ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → K * (V n).natAbs < u n) : ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → V n = 0

declarations.name: eventually_zero_of_weightedBlockDebt
declarations.signature: theorem eventually_zero_of_weightedBlockDebt (u g cuts : ℕ → ℕ) (V : ℕ → ℤ) (B : ℕ) (hcuts : ∀ j, cuts j ≤ cuts (j + 1)) (hcover : ∀ n, ∃ j k, k ≤ cuts (j + 1) - cuts j ∧ n = cuts j + k) (hgpos : ∀ n, 0 < g n) (hstep : ∀ n, (g n : ℤ) * (u (n + 1) : ℤ) = (u n : ℤ) - V n) (hend : ∀ j, 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (cuts (j + 1) - cuts j), (lcmBlockWeight g (cuts j) i : ℤ) * V (cuts j + i)) (hinside : ∀ j k, k ≤ cuts (j + 1) - cuts j → -(∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (lcmBlockWeight g (cuts j) i : ℤ) * V (cuts j + i)) ≤

declarations.name: covering_of_crt_block
declarations.signature: theorem covering_of_crt_block {B : ℕ} (m : Fin B → ℕ) (x P k : ℕ) (L : ℤ) (hm : ∀ i, B < m i) (hmP : ∀ i, m i ∣ P) (hmL : ∀ i, (m i : ℤ) ∣ L) (hresidue : ∀ i, m i ∣ x + i.1) : ∀ z : ℤ, (x + B + k * P : ℕ) - (B : ℤ) ≤ z → z < (x + B + k * P : ℕ) → ∃ d : ℤ, (B : ℤ) < d ∧ d ∣ L ∧ d ∣ z
declarations.docstring: CRT residues cover every integer immediately below every translated wall, using the same old divisors throughout the progression.

declarations.name: baseline_lt_block_product
declarations.signature: theorem baseline_lt_block_product {B : ℕ} (m : Fin B → ℕ) (hm : ∀ i, B < m i) : B < ∏ i, m i
declarations.docstring: The block product exceeds the baseline, including the empty B=0 block.

declarations.name: exists_crt_covering_progression
declarations.signature: theorem exists_crt_covering_progression {B : ℕ} (m : Fin B → ℕ) (hm : ∀ i, B < m i) (hpair : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Nat.Coprime (m i) (m j)) : ∃ x, B < (∏ i, m i) ∧ (∏ i, m i) ≤ x ∧ x < 2 * ∏ i, m i ∧ ∀ L : ℤ, (∀ i, (m i : ℤ) ∣ L) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ z : ℤ, (x + B + k * (∏ i, m i) : ℕ) - (B : ℤ) ≤ z → z < (x + B + k * (∏ i, m i) : ℕ) → ∃ d : ℤ, (B : ℤ) < d ∧ d ∣ L ∧ d ∣ z
declarations.docstring: One CRT block provides all translated coverings for every later denominator divisible by its old moduli. Neither primality nor any persistence of numerator divisors is assumed.

declarations.name: FirstCrossing
declarations.signature: def FirstCrossing (U : ℕ → ℕ) (t n : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: The step ending at `U (n+1)` first reaches height `t`: every earlier state, including its source, was strictly below that height.

declarations.name: exists_unique_firstCrossing
declarations.signature: theorem exists_unique_firstCrossing (U : ℕ → ℕ) (t N : ℕ) (hzero : U 0 < t) (hN : ∃ j ≤ N, t ≤ U j) : ∃! n, n < N ∧ FirstCrossing U t n
declarations.docstring: Every height above the initial state and reached by time N has exactly one first crossing before N. Arbitrary downward excursions are allowed.

declarations.name: FirstCrossing.is_record
declarations.signature: theorem FirstCrossing.is_record {U : ℕ → ℕ} {t n : ℕ} (h : FirstCrossing U t n) : ∀ j ≤ n, U j < U (n + 1)
declarations.docstring: A first crossing is automatically a strict record, not merely a rise after a drawdown.

declarations.name: sum_firstCrossing_partition
declarations.signature: theorem sum_firstCrossing_partition (s : Finset ℕ) (U t : ℕ → ℕ) (N : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (hzero : ∀ k ∈ s, U 0 < t k) (hN : ∀ k ∈ s, ∃ j ≤ N, t k ≤ U j) : ∑ k ∈ s, w k = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, ∑ k ∈ s, if FirstCrossing U (t k) n then w k else 0
declarations.docstring: Each indexed height contributes exactly once to the finite sum over first-crossing times. No monotonicity or positivity of the weights is needed for this exact partition identity.

declarations.name: crossed_progression_spacing
declarations.signature: theorem crossed_progression_spacing (s : Finset ℕ) (hs : s.Nonempty) (x P U d : ℕ) (hlo : ∀ k ∈ s, U < x + k * P) (hhi : ∀ k ∈ s, x + k * P ≤ U + d) : (s.card - 1) * P < d
declarations.docstring: A finite set of indices in an arithmetic progression has the spacing bound required by the excess lemma, even if some intermediate heights are absent from the set.

declarations.name: crossed_progression_card_le_excess
declarations.signature: theorem crossed_progression_card_le_excess (s : Finset ℕ) (x P U d B : ℕ) (a L : ℤ) (hP : B < P) (hlo : ∀ k ∈ s, U < x + k * P) (hhi : ∀ k ∈ s, x + k * P ≤ U + d) (hfeedback : (d : ℤ) = (a - 1) * U - L) (hcover : ∀ k ∈ s, ∀ z : ℤ, (x + k * P : ℕ) - (B : ℤ) ≤ z → z < (x + k * P : ℕ) → ∃ m : ℤ, (B : ℤ) < m ∧ m ∣ L ∧ m ∣ z) : s.card ≤ d - B
declarations.docstring: The actual crossed heights, together with the arithmetic feedback and the B-integer covering immediately below each height, bound their own count. The covering is supplied by CRT in the ordinary global argument.

declarations.name: crossed_progression_weighted_charge
declarations.signature: theorem crossed_progression_weighted_charge (s : Finset ℕ) (x P U d B : ℕ) (a L : ℤ) (hP : B < P) (hlo : ∀ k ∈ s, U < x + k * P) (hhi : ∀ k ∈ s, x + k * P ≤ U + d) (hfeedback : (d : ℤ) = (a - 1) * U - L) (hcover : ∀ k ∈ s, ∀ z : ℤ, (x + k * P : ℕ) - (B : ℤ) ≤ z → z < (x + k * P : ℕ) → ∃ m : ℤ, (B : ℤ) < m ∧ m ∣ L ∧ m ∣ z) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : Antitone f) (hpos : 0 ≤ f U) : ∑ k ∈ s, f (x + k * P) ≤ ((d - B : ℕ) : ℝ) * f U
declarations.docstring: The full local weighted charge, with no assumed wall-count inequality. The source can lie below the previous record: only the heights crossed by this actual step enter the hypotheses.

declarations.name: finite_record_weighted_bound
declarations.signature: theorem finite_record_weighted_bound (s : Finset ℕ) (U : ℕ → ℕ) (a L : ℕ → ℤ) (x P B N : ℕ) (hP : B < P) (hzero : ∀ k ∈ s, U 0 < x + k * P) (hN : ∀ k ∈ s, ∃ j ≤ N, x + k * P ≤ U j) (hfeedback : ∀ n < N, (∀ j ≤ n, U j < U (n + 1)) → ((U (n + 1) - U n : ℕ) : ℤ) = (a n - 1) * U n - L n) (hcover : ∀ n < N, ∀ k ∈ s, ∀ z : ℤ, (x + k * P : ℕ) - (B : ℤ) ≤ z → z < (x + k * P : ℕ) → ∃ m : ℤ, (B : ℤ) < m ∧ m ∣ L n ∧ m ∣ z) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : Antitone f) (hpos : ∀ u, 0 ≤ f u) : ∑ k ∈ s, f (x + k * P) ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, if (∀ j ≤ n, U j < U (n + 1)) then ((U (n + 1) - U n - B : ℕ) : ℝ) * f (U n) else 0
declarations.docstring: Finite weighted first-crossing bound, restricted to actual record steps. The numerator sequence can move down and finish below an earlier record. Every selected CRT height need only have been reached by time N. Arithmetic feedback is required only at record steps; the charge is derived from actual progression spacing and covering, not assumed as a budget hypothesis.

declarations.name: finite_record_bound_of_old_coprime_moduli
declarations.signature: theorem finite_record_bound_of_old_coprime_moduli (B N : ℕ) (m : Fin B → ℕ) (U : ℕ → ℕ) (a L : ℕ → ℤ) (hm : ∀ i, B < m i) (hpair : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Nat.Coprime (m i) (m j)) (hmOld : ∀ n < N, ∀ i, (m i : ℤ) ∣ L n) (hfeedback : ∀ n < N, (∀ j ≤ n, U j < U (n + 1)) → ((U (n + 1) - U n : ℕ) : ℤ) = (a n - 1) * U n - L n) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : Antitone f) (hpos : ∀ u, 0 ≤ f u) : ∃ x, (∏ i, m i) ≤ x ∧ x < 2 * ∏ i, m i ∧ ∀ s : Finset ℕ, (∀ k ∈ s, U 0 < x + B + k * (∏ i, m i)) → (∀ k ∈ s, ∃ j ≤ N, x + B + k * (∏ i, m i) ≤ U j) → ∑ k ∈ s, f (x + B + k * (∏ i, m i)) ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
declarations.docstring: The finite discrete record bound from explicit pairwise-coprime old moduli. The CRT phase, coverings, first-crossing partition, and weighted charges are all constructed in the proof.

declarations.name: recordExcessWeight
declarations.signature: noncomputable def recordExcessWeight (U : ℕ → ℕ) (B : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ
declarations.docstring: The nonnegative charge at a strict record, zero at every other step.

declarations.name: not_summable_recordExcessWeight_of_progression
declarations.signature: theorem not_summable_recordExcessWeight_of_progression (U : ℕ → ℕ) (a L : ℕ → ℤ) (x P B : ℕ) (hP : B < P) (hzero : U 0 < x) (hunbounded : ∀ t : ℕ, ∃ n, t ≤ U n) (hfeedback : ∀ n, (∀ j ≤ n, U j < U (n + 1)) → ((U (n + 1) - U n : ℕ) : ℤ) = (a n - 1) * U n - L n) (hcover : ∀ n k : ℕ, ∀ z : ℤ, (x + k * P : ℕ) - (B : ℤ) ≤ z → z < (x + k * P : ℕ) → ∃ m : ℤ, (B : ℤ) < m ∧ m ∣ L n ∧ m ∣ z) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : Antitone f) (hpos : ∀ u, 0 ≤ f u) (hdiverges : ¬ Summable (fun k : ℕ => f (x + k * P))) : ¬ Summable (recordExcessWeight U B f)
declarations.docstring: An unbounded sequence satisfying the actual arithmetic covering and feedback cannot have summable record charges when the progression weights are nonsummable. The finite bound supplies the charge; it is not a premise.

declarations.name: rise_is_fresh
declarations.signature: theorem rise_is_fresh {U U' V rho : ℤ} (hU : 0 < U) (hrho : 1 ≤ rho) (hcenter : -U ≤ 2 * V) (hstep : rho * U' = U - V) (hrise : U < U') : rho = 1 ∧ U' - U = -V

declarations.name: covered_wall_forces_excess
declarations.signature: theorem covered_wall_forces_excess {U d L a tau B : ℤ} (hd : 0 < d) (hsource : U < tau) (hcross : tau ≤ U + d) (hfeedback : d = (a - 1) * U - L) (hcover : ∀ z : ℤ, tau - B ≤ z → z < tau → ∃ m : ℤ, B < m ∧ m ∣ L ∧ m ∣ z) : B < d
declarations.docstring: Crossing a wall preceded by B covered integers requires an actual jump larger than B. The source may lie below the previous running maximum.

declarations.name: wall_count_le_excess

declarations.docstring: A step crosses at most its integer excess many walls, whenever the spacing estimate `(h-1)P < d` holds and `P > B`.

declarations.name: weighted_wall_charge

declarations.name: RegularRateConclusion

declarations.name: bounded_nat_ratio_locks
declarations.signature: theorem bounded_nat_ratio_locks (C : ℕ → ℕ) (hpos : ∀ n, 0 < C n) (B : ℕ) (hB : ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → C n ≤ B) (hr : Tendsto (fun n => (C (n + 1) : ℝ) / (C n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 1)) : ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → C (n + 1) = C n

declarations.name: tendsto_div_of_eventually_one_le
declarations.signature: theorem tendsto_div_of_eventually_one_le (e b : ℕ → ℝ) (he : Tendsto e atTop (𝓝 0)) (hb : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, 1 ≤ b n) : Tendsto (fun n => e n / b n) atTop (𝓝 0)

declarations.name: forward_difference_approximation
declarations.signature: theorem forward_difference_approximation (C : ℕ → ℝ) (q : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (e : ℕ → ℝ) (den : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (lam : ℝ) (hq0 : ∀ n, q 0 n = C n) (hrec : ∀ j, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, q j (n + 1) - q j n = (lam - (j : ℝ)) * q (j + 1) n + e n / den j n) (hden : ∀ j, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, 1 ≤ den j n) (he : Tendsto e atTop (𝓝 0)) : ∀ j, Tendsto (fun n => fd j C n - (∏ k ∈ Finset.range j, (lam - (k : ℝ))) * q j n) atTop (𝓝 0)
declarations.docstring: A purely discrete approximation system. The q-recursion is the exact quotient identity for q_j(n)=C_n/(n(n+1)...(n+j-1)). This abstraction isolates an algebraic identity, not an unproved analytic/exclusion endpoint.

declarations.name: cubic_falling_factor_zero

declarations.signature: theorem fourth_difference_eventually_zero (C : ℕ → ℤ) (q : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (e : ℕ → ℝ) (den : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (hq0 : ∀ n, q 0 n = (C n : ℝ)) (hrec : ∀ j, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, q j (n + 1) - q j n = ((3 : ℝ) - (j : ℝ)) * q (j + 1) n + e n / den j n) (hden : ∀ j, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, 1 ≤ den j n) (he : Tendsto e atTop (𝓝 0)) : ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → fd (R

declarations.name: regularRateError
declarations.signature: def regularRateError (C : ℕ → ℕ) (lam : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ
declarations.docstring: The error appearing literally in `RegularRateHypothesis`.

declarations.name: rateResidual_eq_mul_regularRateError
declarations.signature: theorem rateResidual_eq_mul_regularRateError (C : ℕ → ℕ) (lam : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hC : C n ≠ 0) (hn : n ≠ 0) : rateResidual (fun m => (C m : ℝ)) lam n = (C n : ℝ) * regularRateError C lam n
declarations.docstring: Multiplying the relative error by the height gives the additive residual. The exclusions are exactly the two denominators in the displayed identity.

declarations.name: pow_le_rising
declarations.signature: theorem pow_le_rising (j n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : (n : ℝ) ^ j ≤ rising j n
declarations.docstring: The rising denominator dominates the corresponding ordinary power.

declarations.name: inv_rising_isLittleO_rpow_neg
declarations.signature: theorem inv_rising_isLittleO_rpow_neg (lam : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (hj : lam < j) : (fun n : ℕ => (rising j n)⁻¹) =o[atTop] (fun n : ℕ => Real.rpow (n : ℝ) (-lam))
declarations.docstring: Above its real exponent, the reciprocal rising denominator is little-o of `n^{-lambda}`. This is the exact decay needed to consume a sharp `O(n^lambda)` height bound.

declarations.name: residual_tendsto_zero_of_regularRate_growth
declarations.signature: theorem residual_tendsto_zero_of_regularRate_growth (C : ℕ → ℕ) (lam : ℝ) (hreg : Erdos243V6.RegularRateHypothesis C lam) (hgrowth : (fun n : ℕ => (C n : ℝ)) =O[atTop] (fun n : ℕ => Real.rpow (n : ℝ) lam)) : Tendsto (rateResidual (fun n => (C n : ℝ)) lam) atTop (𝓝 0)
declarations.docstring: The exact little-o hypothesis turns into a zero additive residual once the sharp height bound has been supplied.

declarations.name: risingQuotient_tendsto_zero_of_regularRate_growth
declarations.signature: theorem risingQuotient_tendsto_zero_of_regularRate_growth (C : ℕ → ℕ) (lam : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (hj : lam < j) (hgrowth : (fun n : ℕ => (C n : ℝ)) =O[atTop] (fun n : ℕ => Real.rpow (n : ℝ) lam)) : Tendsto (risingQuotient (fun n => (C n : ℝ)) j) atTop (𝓝 0)
declarations.docstring: A sharp height bound also makes every rising quotient of order strictly larger than `lambda` tend to zero.

declarations.name: general_rate_difference_eventually_zero_of_growth
declarations.signature: theorem general_rate_difference_eventually_zero_of_growth (C : ℕ → ℕ) (lam : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (hj : lam < j) (hreg : Erdos243V6.RegularRateHypothesis C lam) (hgrowth : (fun n : ℕ => (C n : ℝ)) =O[atTop] (fun n : ℕ => Real.rpow (n : ℝ) lam)) : ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → fd j (fun m => (C m : ℤ)) n = 0
declarations.docstring: General integral finite-difference consumer. Unlike the cubic consumer, the falling coefficient need not vanish: the quotient itself tends to zero when `j > lambda`.

declarations.name: fd_eq_fwdDiff_iter
declarations.signature: theorem fd_eq_fwdDiff_iter {R : Type*} [AddCommGroup R] (k : ℕ) (f : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) : fd k f n = (fwdDiff 1)^[k] f n
declarations.docstring: The project-local recursive forward difference is the iterate of Mathlib's additive forward-difference operator with step one.

declarations.name: fd_comp_add
declarations.signature: theorem fd_comp_add {R : Type*} [AddCommGroup R] (f : ℕ → R) (N k n : ℕ) : fd k (fun t ↦ f (t + N)) n = fd k f (n + N)
declarations.docstring: Translation commutes with every order of the project-local forward difference.

declarations.name: newtonPolynomialInt

declarations.docstring: The Newton polynomial with coefficients given by the forward differences of an integer-valued sequence at zero.

declarations.name: eval_newtonTermInt
declarations.signature: theorem eval_newtonTermInt (a : ℤ) (k t : ℕ) : (((a : ℚ) / (k.factorial : ℚ)) • descPochhammer ℚ k).eval (t : ℚ) = (t.choose k : ℚ) * (a : ℚ)

declarations.name: fwdDiff_iter_eq_zero_of_ge
declarations.signature: theorem fwdDiff_iter_eq_zero_of_ge (g : ℕ → ℤ) (j : ℕ) (hzero : (fwdDiff 1)^[j] g = 0) : ∀ k, j ≤ k → (fwdDiff 1)^[k] g = 0
declarations.docstring: Once the `j`-th forward difference is identically zero, all higher forward differences are identically zero as well.

declarations.name: newtonPolynomialInt_eval
declarations.signature: theorem newtonPolynomialInt_eval (g : ℕ → ℤ) (j : ℕ) (hzero : (fwdDiff 1)^[j] g = 0) (t : ℕ) : (newtonPolynomialInt g j).eval (t : ℚ) = (g t : ℚ)
declarations.docstring: Gregory--Newton interpolation, truncated using the vanishing tail of forward differences.

declarations.name: newtonPolynomialInt_natDegree_lt
declarations.signature: theorem newtonPolynomialInt_natDegree_lt (g : ℕ → ℤ) (j : ℕ) (hj : 0 < j) : (newtonPolynomialInt g j).natDegree < j
declarations.docstring: For positive truncation order, the Newton polynomial has degree strictly less than that order.

declarations.name: exists_eventual_polynomial_of_fd_zero
declarations.signature: theorem exists_eventual_polynomial_of_fd_zero (f : ℕ → ℤ) (j N : ℕ) (hj : 0 < j) (hzero : ∀ n, N ≤ n → fd j f n = 0) : ∃ Q : ℚ[X], Q.natDegree < j ∧ ∀ n, N ≤ n → Q.eval (n : ℚ) = (f n : ℚ)
declarations.docstring: Eventual vanishing of an integer `j`-th difference gives an eventual rational polynomial in the original index, with the exact degree bound `degree < j`.

declarations.name: regularRate_exists_eventual_rational_polynomial
declarations.signature: theorem regularRate_exists_eventual_rational_polynomial (C : ℕ → ℕ) (lam : ℝ) (hreg : Erdos243V6.RegularRateHypothesis C lam) (j : ℕ) (hj : lam < j) : ∃ Q : ℚ[X], Q.natDegree < j ∧ ∃ N, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → Q.eval (n : ℚ) = (C n : ℚ)
declarations.docstring: Exact C010 composition through the polynomial-extraction stage. The retained ratio hypothesis supplies eventual difference vanishing at every natural order strictly above `lambda`; Newton interpolation then supplies the eventual rational polynomial of degree below that order.

declarations.name: cubic_residual_forces_fourth_difference

declarations.name: regularRateErrorProduct
declarations.signature: def regularRateErrorProduct (C : ℕ → ℕ) (lam : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ
declarations.docstring: The nonnegative finite product which absorbs the ratio error. Including the harmless index `0` makes the induction start at `n = 1` uniform.

declarations.name: summable_abs_regularRateError
declarations.signature: theorem summable_abs_regularRateError (C : ℕ → ℕ) (lam : ℝ) (hreg : Erdos243V6.RegularRateHypothesis C lam) : Summable (fun n : ℕ => |regularRateError C lam n|)
declarations.docstring: The exact little-o error in `RegularRateHypothesis` is absolutely summable. This is where the strict inequality `1 < lambda` is used.

declarations.name: regularRateErrorProduct_eventually_bounded
declarations.signature: theorem regularRateErrorProduct_eventually_bounded (C : ℕ → ℕ) (lam : ℝ) (hreg : Erdos243V6.RegularRateHypothesis C lam) : ∃ M > 0, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, regularRateErrorProduct C lam n ≤ M
declarations.docstring: Absolute summability gives one positive bound for all sufficiently long finite error products.

declarations.name: regularRateBaseline_mul_rpow_le_succ
declarations.signature: theorem regularRateBaseline_mul_rpow_le_succ (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 1 < lam) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : (1 + lam / (n : ℝ)) * Real.rpow (n : ℝ) lam ≤ Real.rpow ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) lam
declarations.docstring: Bernoulli's inequality turns the exact baseline ratio into a telescoping `Real.rpow` comparison.

declarations.name: regularRate_le_rpow_mul_errorProduct
declarations.signature: theorem regularRate_le_rpow_mul_errorProduct (C : ℕ → ℕ) (lam : ℝ) (hreg : Erdos243V6.RegularRateHypothesis C lam) : ∀ n, 1 ≤ n → (C n : ℝ) ≤ (C 1 : ℝ) * Real.rpow (n : ℝ) lam * regularRateErrorProduct C lam n
declarations.docstring: Pointwise sharp comparison with the finite error product.

declarations.name: regularRateHypothesis_isBigO_rpow
declarations.signature: theorem regularRateHypothesis_isBigO_rpow (C : ℕ → ℕ) (lam : ℝ) (hreg : Erdos243V6.RegularRateHypothesis C lam) : (fun n : ℕ => (C n : ℝ)) =O[atTop] (fun n : ℕ => Real.rpow (n : ℝ) lam)
declarations.docstring: The sharp growth supplier needed by `GeneralRateExtractionBridge`. Its exponent is exactly `lambda`; no `lambda + epsilon` loss occurs.

declarations.name: general_rate_difference_eventually_zero
declarations.signature: theorem general_rate_difference_eventually_zero (C : ℕ → ℕ) (lam : ℝ) (hreg : Erdos243V6.RegularRateHypothesis C lam) (j : ℕ) (hj : lam < j) : ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → fd j (fun m => (C m : ℤ)) n = 0
declarations.docstring: Immediate composition with the already adopted finite-difference bridge. This closes the growth premise locally while leaving Newton interpolation and the final rising-factorial classification as the retained C010 residual.

declarations.name: strict_records_cofinal_of_unbounded
declarations.signature: theorem strict_records_cofinal_of_unbounded (U : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : ∀ H : ℕ, ∃ n, H ≤ U n) : ∀ T : ℕ, ∃ n, T ≤ n ∧ IsStrictRecord U n
declarations.docstring: An unbounded natural-valued sequence has strict record steps cofinally. This permits arbitrary drawdowns between records.

declarations.name: strict_record_is_fresh_of_centering
declarations.signature: theorem strict_record_is_fresh_of_centering (q : ℕ) (a U : ℕ → ℕ) (V : ℕ → ℤ) (hq : 0 < q) (ha : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (hU : ∀ n, 0 < U n) (hstate : ∀ n, (lcmOverlap q a n : ℤ) * U (n + 1) = (U n : ℤ) - V n) (hcenter : ∀ n, -(U n : ℤ) ≤ 2 * V n) {n : ℕ} (hr : IsStrictRecord U n) : lcmOverlap q a n = 1 ∧ ((U (n + 1) : ℤ) - U n = -V n)
declarations.docstring: Under the printed centring inequality every strict record is an LCM-fresh step, and its actual source-to-endpoint jump is `-V`.

declarations.name: late_fresh_record_digit_large
declarations.signature: theorem late_fresh_record_digit_large (q : ℕ) (a U : ℕ → ℕ) (V : ℕ → ℤ) (B n : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (ha : ∀ j, 0 < a j) (hU : ∀ j, 0 < U j) (hstate : ∀ j, (lcmOverlap q a j : ℤ) * U (j + 1) = (U j : ℤ) - V j) (herror : ∀ j, V j = (cumulativeDigitLcm q a j : ℤ) - ((a j : ℤ) - 1) * U j) (hcenter : ∀ j, -(U j : ℤ) ≤ 2 * V j) (hn : smallDigitCutoff a B ≤ n) (hr : IsStrictRecord U n) : B < a n
declarations.docstring: Once every small digit that ever appears has entered the old LCM, a fresh strict record digit must exceed the prescribed baseline. The digit `1` is excluded by the positive record jump and the exact centred error identity, so no eventual `a_n ≥ 2` premise is needed.

declarations.name: centred_record_steps_supply_old_moduli
declarations.signature: theorem centred_record_steps_supply_old_moduli (q : ℕ) (a U : ℕ → ℕ) (V : ℕ → ℤ) (B : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (ha : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (hU : ∀ n, 0 < U n) (hstate : ∀ n, (lcmOverlap q a n : ℤ) * U (n + 1) = (U n : ℤ) - V n) (herror : ∀ n, V n = (cumulativeDigitLcm q a n : ℤ) - ((a n : ℤ) - 1) * U n) (hcenter : ∀ n, -(U n : ℤ) ≤ 2 * V n) (hunbounded : ∀ H : ℕ, ∃ n, H ≤ U n) : ∃ T : ℕ, ∃ m : Fin B → ℕ, (∀ i, B < m i) ∧ (∀ i j, i ≠ j → Nat.Coprime (m i) (m j)) ∧ (∀ i n, T ≤ n → m i ∣ cumulativeDigitLcm q a n)
declarations.docstring: On an unbounded centred orbit, the strict record digits themselves supply any finite family of pairwise-coprime old moduli larger than `B`. Every selected modulus remains in the cumulative LCM after the supply time.

declarations.name: centred_actual_lcm_covering
declarations.signature: theorem centred_actual_lcm_covering (q : ℕ) (a U : ℕ → ℕ) (V : ℕ → ℤ) (B : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (ha : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (hU : ∀ n, 0 < U n) (hstate : ∀ n, (lcmOverlap q a n : ℤ) * U (n + 1) = (U n : ℤ) - V n) (herror : ∀ n, V n = (cumulativeDigitLcm q a n : ℤ) - ((a n : ℤ) - 1) * U n) (hcenter : ∀ n, -(U n : ℤ) ≤ 2 * V n) (hunbounded : ∀ H : ℕ, ∃ n, H ≤ U n) : ∃ T x P : ℕ, B < P ∧ runningMax U T < x ∧ ∀ n, T ≤ n → ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ z : ℤ, ((x + k * P : ℕ) : ℤ) - B ≤ z → z < ((x + k * P : ℕ) : ℤ) → ∃ m : ℤ, (B : ℤ) < m ∧ m ∣ (cumulativeDigitLcm q a n : ℤ) ∧ m ∣ z
declarations.docstring: The selected record digits give one permanent CRT covering progression. This is the exact old-modulus supplier used in the paper proof.

declarations.name: mixedCharge_eq_rawCharge_of_centering
declarations.signature: theorem mixedCharge_eq_rawCharge_of_centering (q : ℕ) (a U : ℕ → ℕ) (V : ℕ → ℤ) (B : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (ha : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (hU : ∀ n, 0 < U n) (hstate : ∀ n, (lcmOverlap q a n : ℤ) * U (n + 1) = (U n : ℤ) - V n) (hcenter : ∀ n, -(U n : ℤ) ≤ 2 * V n) : mixedCharge U (lcmOverlap q a) B f = rawCharge U (lcmOverlap q a) B f
declarations.docstring: The paper's centring forces mixed and raw record charges to agree exactly: on a strict record the overlap is one, and off records both are zero.

declarations.name: centred_unbounded_not_summable_raw
declarations.signature: theorem centred_unbounded_not_summable_raw (q : ℕ) (a U : ℕ → ℕ) (V : ℕ → ℤ) (B : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (ha : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (hU : ∀ n, 0 < U n) (hstate : ∀ n, (lcmOverlap q a n : ℤ) * U (n + 1) = (U n : ℤ) - V n) (herror : ∀ n, V n = (cumulativeDigitLcm q a n : ℤ) - ((a n : ℤ) - 1) * U n) (hcenter : ∀ n, -(U n : ℤ) ≤ 2 * V n) (hunbounded : ∀ H : ℕ, ∃ n, H ≤ U n) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : Antitone f) (hpos : ∀ u, 0 ≤ f u) (hdiv : DivergesOnProgressions f) : ¬ Summable (rawCharge U (lcmOverlap q a) B f)
declarations.docstring: Unbounded centred height makes the paper raw record series divergent for every nonnegative antitone weight divergent on arithmetic progressions.

declarations.name: abstract_lcm_eq_cumulative
declarations.signature: theorem abstract_lcm_eq_cumulative (a L : ℕ → ℕ) (hL : ∀ n, L (n + 1) = Nat.lcm (L n) (a n)) : ∀ n, L n = cumulativeDigitLcm (L 0) a n
declarations.docstring: Exact cumulative-LCM identification for an abstract positive sequence satisfying `L_{n+1}=lcm(L_n,a_n)`.

declarations.name: arithmetic_weighted_record_dichotomy
declarations.signature: theorem arithmetic_weighted_record_dichotomy (a L U : ℕ → ℕ) (V : ℕ → ℤ) (ha : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (hLpos : ∀ n, 0 < L n) (hU : ∀ n, 0 < U n) (hL : ∀ n, L (n + 1) = Nat.lcm (L n) (a n)) (hstate : ∀ n, (Nat.gcd (L n) (a n) : ℤ) * U (n + 1) = (U n : ℤ) - V n) (herror : ∀ n, V n = (L n : ℤ) - ((a n : ℤ) - 1) * U n) (hcenter : ∀ n, -(U n : ℤ) ≤ 2 * V n) (B : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : AntitoneOn f (Set.Ici 1)) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ x → 0 ≤ f x) (hdiv : IntegralUnbounded f) : (∃ H : ℕ, ∀ n, U n ≤ H) ↔ Summable (paperRecordCharge U V B f)
declarations.docstring: **Arithmetic weighted-record dichotomy (exact printed endpoint).** Positive integer sequences `a,L,U` and integer errors `V` satisfy the exact LCM update, centred state update, error identity and lower centring bound. For every fixed baseline `B` and every finite nonnegative nonincreasing weight whose improper integral from one is unbounded, bounded height is equivalent to finiteness of the weighted raw record-excess series.

declarations.name: exists_crt_union_residues
declarations.signature: theorem exists_crt_union_residues {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (m : ι → ℕ) (hm : ∀ i, 0 < m i) (hc : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Nat.Coprime (m i) (m j))) (r : ∀ i, ZMod (m i)) : ∃ R : Finset ℕ, (∀ t ∈ R, t < ∏ i, m i) ∧ R.card + ∏ i, (m i - 1) = ∏ i, m i ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, n % (∏ i, m i) ∈ R ↔ ∃ i, (n : ZMod (m i)) = r i)
declarations.docstring: Exact finite CRT union, including natural representatives and the membership dictionary required by the window-counting theorem.

declarations.name: crt_union_card_ratio
declarations.signature: theorem crt_union_card_ratio {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (m : ι → ℕ) (hm : ∀ i, 0 < m i) (R : Finset ℕ) (hcard : R.card + ∏ i, (m i - 1) = ∏ i, m i) : (R.card : ℝ) / ((∏ i, m i : ℕ) : ℝ) = 1 - ∏ i, (1 - 1 / (m i : ℝ))
declarations.docstring: Cast the exact CRT cardinality to its multiplicative complement formula.

declarations.name: crt_window_lower_density
declarations.signature: theorem crt_window_lower_density {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (m : ι → ℕ) (hm : ∀ i, 0 < m i) (hc : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Nat.Coprime (m i) (m j))) (r : ∀ i, ZMod (m i)) (E : Set ℕ) (L T : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (hhit : ∀ i (n : ℕ), T ≤ n → (n : ZMod (m i)) = r i → ∃ j : ℕ, j < L ∧ n + j ∈ E) : LowerDensityAtLeast E ((1 - ∏ i, (1 - 1 / (m i : ℝ))) / (L : ℝ))
declarations.docstring: Exact finite-prime amplification. A hit at every selected residue yields `(1 - product(1 - 1/p))/L`, not just the bound from one selected prime.

declarations.name: doublePower_succ
declarations.signature: theorem doublePower_succ (b k : ℕ) : b ^ (2 ^ (k + 1)) = (b ^ (2 ^ k)) ^ 2
declarations.docstring: The natural double-power identity used without taking logarithms.

declarations.name: strictMono_nat_linear_lower
declarations.signature: theorem strictMono_nat_linear_lower (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) : ∀ n, a 0 + n ≤ a n
declarations.docstring: Strict increase gives the elementary linear lower bound, including a₀=1.

declarations.name: quadratic_brackets_of_limit
declarations.signature: theorem quadratic_brackets_of_limit (a : ℕ → ℕ) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (hgrowth : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (a (n + 1) : ℝ) / (a n : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1)) : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n, N ≤ n → a n ^ 2 ≤ 2 * a (n + 1) ∧ a (n + 1) ≤ 2 * a n ^ 2
declarations.docstring: Fixed rational quadratic brackets are derived from the actual limit.

declarations.name: quadratic_double_exponential_bounds
declarations.signature: theorem quadratic_double_exponential_bounds (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (hgrowth : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (a (n + 1) : ℝ) / (a n : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1)) : ∃ N A : ℕ, 4 ≤ a N ∧ A = 2 * a N ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, 2 * 2 ^ (2 ^ k) ≤ a (N + k) ∧ 2 * a (N + k) ≤ A ^ (2 ^ k)
declarations.docstring: Explicit double-exponential growth on one common tail. The same N works simultaneously for every later index, so growing blocks are allowed.

declarations.name: positive_ratio_one_geometric_envelope
declarations.signature: theorem positive_ratio_one_geometric_envelope (U : ℕ → ℕ) (hU : ∀ n, 0 < U n) (hlim : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (U (n + 1) : ℝ) / (U n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 1)) (r : ℝ) (hr : 1 < r) : ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, (U n : ℝ) ≤ K * r ^ n) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, (runningMax U n : ℝ) ≤ K * r ^ n)
declarations.docstring: An arbitrary positive ratio-one sequence has a global geometric majorant, including its finite prefix.

declarations.name: canonical_numerator_ratio_tendsto_one
declarations.signature: theorem canonical_numerator_ratio_tendsto_one (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hs : HasSum (fun n ↦ 1 / (a n : ℝ)) ((p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))) (hgrowth : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (a (n + 1) : ℝ) / (a n : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1)) : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (canonicalNaturalNumerator a p q (n + 1) : ℝ) / (canonicalNaturalNumerator a p q n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 1)
declarations.docstring: The ratio-one premise in the preceding theorem is itself supplied from the canonical rational reciprocal series.

declarations.name: canonical_runningMax_subexponential_envelope
declarations.signature: theorem canonical_runningMax_subexponential_envelope (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hs : HasSum (fun n ↦ 1 / (a n : ℝ)) ((p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))) (hgrowth : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (a (n + 1) : ℝ) / (a n : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1)) (r : ℝ) (hr : 1 < r) : ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, (canonicalNaturalNumerator a p q n : ℝ) ≤ K * r ^ n) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, (runningMax (canonicalNaturalNumerator a p q) n : ℝ) ≤ K * r ^ n)
declarations.docstring: An arbitrarily slow global envelope for both C and its actual running maximum. This is the required uniform version, not a pointwise estimate at a selected index.

declarations.docstring: The paper's raw record term, with the real weight evaluated at U itself.

declarations.name: strictMono_eventually_ge_two
declarations.signature: theorem strictMono_eventually_ge_two (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hp : ∀ n, 0 < a n) : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n, N ≤ n → 2 ≤ a n

declarations.name: canonical_lcm_data
declarations.signature: theorem canonical_lcm_data (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hs : HasSum (fun n ↦ 1 / (a n : ℝ)) ((p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))) (hgrowth : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (a (n + 1) : ℝ) / (a n : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1)) : let U

declarations.name: rawCharge_eq_paperRecordCharge
declarations.signature: theorem rawCharge_eq_paperRecordCharge (U rho : ℕ → ℕ) (V : ℕ → ℤ) (B : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hU : ∀ n, 0 < U n) (hstep : ∀ n, (rho n : ℤ) * U (n + 1) = (U n : ℤ) - V n) : rawCharge U rho B (natWeight f) = paperRecordCharge U V B f
declarations.docstring: Exact equality of the implementation charge and the printed charge.

declarations.name: sylvester_reciprocal_step
declarations.signature: theorem sylvester_reciprocal_step (x y : ℝ) (hx : 1 < x) (hy : y = x ^ 2 - x + 1) : 1 / x = 1 / (x - 1) - 1 / (y - 1)
declarations.docstring: The finite telescoping identity used for the converse.

declarations.name: reciprocal_pred_tendsto_zero
declarations.signature: theorem reciprocal_pred_tendsto_zero (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hpos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (N : ℕ) : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ ↦ 1 / ((a (N + k) : ℝ) - 1)) atTop (𝓝 0)
declarations.docstring: The vanishing telescoping endpoint requires no growth estimate beyond strict increase of the positive natural denominators.

declarations.name: realTail_eq_of_eventual_sylvester
declarations.signature: theorem realTail_eq_of_eventual_sylvester (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hpos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (hs : Summable (fun n ↦ 1 / (a n : ℝ))) (N : ℕ) (hN : ∀ n, N ≤ n → 2 ≤ a n) (hrec : ∀ n, N ≤ n → (a (n + 1) : ℤ) = (a n : ℤ) ^ 2 - (a n : ℤ) + 1) : ∀ n, N ≤ n → realTail (fun k ↦ 1 / (a k : ℝ)) n = 1 / ((a n : ℝ) - 1)
declarations.docstring: The actual reciprocal tail on a Sylvester tail. The sum is already known to converge, so uniqueness of limits identifies its value.

declarations.name: bounded_of_eventually_nonincreasing
declarations.signature: theorem bounded_of_eventually_nonincreasing (U : ℕ → ℕ) (hdec : ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → U (n + 1) ≤ U n) : ∃ H : ℕ, ∀ n, U n ≤ H
declarations.docstring: A finite prefix followed by a nonincreasing natural orbit is bounded.

declarations.name: canonical_weighted_record_excess
declarations.signature: theorem canonical_weighted_record_excess (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hs : HasSum (fun n ↦ 1 / (a n : ℝ)) ((p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))) (hgrowth : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (a (n + 1) : ℝ) / (a n : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1)) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : AntitoneOn f (Set.Ici 1)) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ x → 0 ≤ f x) (hdiv : IntegralUnbounded f) : (∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → (a (n + 1) : ℤ) = (a n : ℤ) ^ 2 - (a n : ℤ) + 1) ↔ ∃ B : ℕ, Summable (paperRecordCharge (canonicalLcmNumerator a p q) (canonicalLcmDigit a p q) B f)
declarations.docstring: Exact short-paper weighted-record equivalence, stated with the canonical LCM numerator constructed above and the printed raw error weight. The baseline is existential; all previous state theorems work for every fixed B.

declarations.name: quotient_dvd_quotient_of_dvd
declarations.signature: theorem quotient_dvd_quotient_of_dvd (A G d : ℕ) (hA : 0 < A) (hdG : d ∣ G) (hGA : G ∣ A) : A / G ∣ A / d
declarations.docstring: Dividing by a larger divisor leaves a divisor of the smaller quotient.

declarations.name: gcd_prod_dvd_prod_gcd
declarations.signature: theorem gcd_prod_dvd_prod_gcd {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (A : ℕ) (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℕ) : Nat.gcd A (∏ j ∈ s, f j) ∣ ∏ j ∈ s, Nat.gcd A (f j)
declarations.docstring: Gcd with a product divides the product of the individual gcds.

declarations.name: coreDenom

declarations.name: coprimeCore_dvd
declarations.signature: theorem coprimeCore_dvd {B : ℕ} (A : Fin B → ℕ) (i : Fin B) : coprimeCore A i ∣ A i

declarations.name: pair_gcd_dvd_coreDenom

declarations.name: coprimeCore_pairwise
declarations.signature: theorem coprimeCore_pairwise {B : ℕ} (A : Fin B → ℕ) (hA : ∀ i, 0 < A i) : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Nat.Coprime (coprimeCore A i) (coprimeCore A j)
declarations.docstring: Pairwise coprimality does not require that any original pair be coprime.

declarations.name: le_coprimeCore_mul_gcd_bound
declarations.signature: theorem le_coprimeCore_mul_gcd_bound {B : ℕ} (A : Fin B → ℕ) (hA : ∀ i, 0 < A i) (H : ℕ) (hpair : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Nat.gcd (A i) (A j) ≤ H) (i : Fin B) : A i ≤ coprimeCore A i * H ^ (B - 1)
declarations.docstring: Quantified loss: each core loses at most one factor H per other member.

declarations.name: large_coprime_cores
declarations.signature: theorem large_coprime_cores {B : ℕ} (A : Fin B → ℕ) (hA : ∀ i, 0 < A i) (H : ℕ) (hpair : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Nat.gcd (A i) (A j) ≤ H) (hlarge : ∀ i, B * H ^ (B - 1) < A i) : (∀ i, B < coprimeCore A i) ∧ (∀ i j, i ≠ j → Nat.Coprime (coprimeCore A i) (coprimeCore A j)) ∧ (∀ i, coprimeCore A i ∣ A i) ∧ (∏ i, coprimeCore A i) ≤ ∏ i, A i
declarations.docstring: A genuinely constructed large pairwise-coprime family for CRT. The size condition is an explicit finite inequality, not a hidden prime supplier.

declarations.name: coprime_core_record_fence
declarations.signature: theorem coprime_core_record_fence (U : ℕ → ℕ) (D a b : ℕ → ℤ) (T B H : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B) (A : Fin B → ℕ) (hA : ∀ i, 0 < A i) (hC : ∀ n, (U (n + 1) : ℤ) = a n * U n - b n * D n) (hD : ∀ n, D (n + 1) = a n * D n) (hpair : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Nat.gcd (A i) (A j) ≤ H) (hlarge : ∀ i, (max B (runningMax U T)) * H ^ (B - 1) < A i) (hOld : ∀ i n, T ≤ n → (A i : ℤ) ∣ D n) : ∃ x P : ℕ, P ≤ x ∧ x < 2 * P ∧ P ≤ (∏ i, A i) ∧ runningMax U T < x ∧ ((∀ n, T ≤ n → runningMax U n < x + B → runningMax U n < U (n + 1) → U (n + 1) - runningMax U n ≤ B) → ∀ n, U n < x + B)
declarations.docstring: Combining the constructed cores, bounded CRT phase and nonprimitive record fence. The infinite log-log argument must still verify the displayed size and record-cap inequalities; neither is hidden in an existence record.

declarations.name: risingBinomial_pair_dvd_six_multiple
declarations.signature: theorem risingBinomial_pair_dvd_six_multiple (d n k : ℕ) (hphase : n + 1 = 6 * d * k) : (d : ℤ) ∣ risingBinomial n ∧ (d : ℤ) ∣ risingBinomial (n + 1)
declarations.docstring: The two neighbouring binomial values vanish whenever n+1 is a multiple of 6*d. The integer witnesses are produced explicitly.

declarations.name: risingBinomial_pair_dvd_coprime_six
declarations.signature: theorem risingBinomial_pair_dvd_coprime_six (d n : ℕ) (hcop : Nat.Coprime d 6) (hphase : d ∣ n + 1) : (d : ℤ) ∣ risingBinomial n ∧ (d : ℤ) ∣ risingBinomial (n + 1)
declarations.docstring: Away from 2 and 3 the period is d, rather than 6*d.

declarations.name: primitive_pair_profile_hit
declarations.signature: theorem primitive_pair_profile_hit (u : ℕ → ℕ) (P : ℕ → ℤ) (n d : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hcop : Nat.Coprime (u n) (u (n + 1))) (h0 : (d : ℤ) ∣ P n) (h1 : (d : ℤ) ∣ P (n + 1)) : ∃ i : ℕ, i < 2 ∧ (u (n + i) : ℤ) ≠ P (n + i)
declarations.docstring: A common nonunit divisor cannot divide both members of a primitive pair.

declarations.name: primitive_periodic_pair_density
declarations.signature: theorem primitive_periodic_pair_density (u : ℕ → ℕ) (P : ℕ → ℤ) (T d s : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hs : 2 ≤ s) (hcop : ∀ n, T ≤ n → Nat.Coprime (u n) (u (n + 1))) (hdiv : ∀ n k : ℕ, n + 1 = s * k → (d : ℤ) ∣ P n ∧ (d : ℤ) ∣ P (n + 1)) : LowerDensityAtLeast {n : ℕ | (u n : ℤ) ≠ P n} (1 / (s : ℝ))
declarations.docstring: Construct and count the disjoint two-window witnesses on the original tail. Only the elementary profile divisibility lemma is parametrised.

declarations.name: primitive_cubic_constant_divisor_density
declarations.signature: theorem primitive_cubic_constant_divisor_density (u : ℕ → ℕ) (m c : ℤ) (T d : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hdc : (d : ℤ) ∣ c) (hcop : ∀ n, T ≤ n → Nat.Coprime (u n) (u (n + 1))) : LowerDensityAtLeast {n : ℕ | (u n : ℤ) ≠ m * risingBinomial n + c} (1 / ((6 * d : ℕ) : ℝ))
declarations.docstring: Every nonunit divisor of c gives a literal lower-density bound 1/(6*d).

declarations.name: primitive_cubic_coprime_six_divisor_density
declarations.signature: theorem primitive_cubic_coprime_six_divisor_density (u : ℕ → ℕ) (m c : ℤ) (T d : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hdc : (d : ℤ) ∣ c) (hd6 : Nat.Coprime d 6) (hcop : ∀ n, T ≤ n → Nat.Coprime (u n) (u (n + 1))) : LowerDensityAtLeast {n : ℕ | (u n : ℤ) ≠ m * risingBinomial n + c} (1 / (d : ℝ))
declarations.docstring: When the divisor is coprime to 6, the stronger bound is 1/d.

declarations.name: primitive_cubic_two_three_divisor_uniform
declarations.signature: theorem primitive_cubic_two_three_divisor_uniform (u : ℕ → ℕ) (m c : ℤ) (T : ℕ) (hdiv : (2 : ℤ) ∣ c ∨ (3 : ℤ) ∣ c) (hcop : ∀ n, T ≤ n → Nat.Coprime (u n) (u (n + 1))) : LowerDensityAtLeast {n : ℕ | (u n : ℤ) ≠ m * risingBinomial n + c} (1 / 28)
declarations.docstring: A constant with a factor 2 or 3 already gives the universal bound.

declarations.name: primitive_cubic_small_divisor_uniform
declarations.signature: theorem primitive_cubic_small_divisor_uniform (u : ℕ → ℕ) (m c : ℤ) (T d : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hd28 : d ≤ 28) (hdc : (d : ℤ) ∣ c) (hd6 : Nat.Coprime d 6) (hcop : ∀ n, T ≤ n → Nat.Coprime (u n) (u (n + 1))) : LowerDensityAtLeast {n : ℕ | (u n : ℤ) ≠ m * risingBinomial n + c} (1 / 28)
declarations.docstring: All small divisors coprime to 6 are also settled without prime production.

declarations.name: cubic_powerBasis_representation
declarations.signature: theorem cubic_powerBasis_representation {K : Type*} [CommRing K] [Nontrivial K] [Algebra ℚ K] (pb : PowerBasis ℚ K) (hdim : pb.dim = 3) (β : K) : ∃ x y z : ℚ, β = algebraMap ℚ K x * pb.gen^2 + algebraMap ℚ K y * pb.gen + algebraMap ℚ K z
declarations.docstring: Every element of an actual three-dimensional power-basis algebra has three rational coordinates; the coefficients come from its representative.

declarations.name: cubic_powerBasis_square_coordinates
declarations.signature: theorem cubic_powerBasis_square_coordinates {K : Type*} [CommRing K] [Nontrivial K] [Algebra ℚ K] (pb : PowerBasis ℚ K) (hdim : pb.dim = 3) (η : ℚ) (hroot : pb.gen^3 = pb.gen - algebraMap ℚ K η) (β : K) (hsquare : β^2 = pb.gen^2 - 1) : ∃ x y z : ℚ, β = algebraMap ℚ K x * pb.gen^2 + algebraMap ℚ K y * pb.gen + algebraMap ℚ K z ∧ x^2 + 2*x*z + y^2 - 1 = 0 ∧ 2*x*y + 2*y*z - η*x^2 = 0 ∧ z^2 - 2*η*x*y + 1 = 0
declarations.docstring: Coefficient extraction from the field square identity, with all coordinates constructed and the vanishing coefficients proved.

declarations.name: cubic_powerBasis_square_parameter
declarations.signature: theorem cubic_powerBasis_square_parameter {K : Type*} [CommRing K] [Nontrivial K] [Algebra ℚ K] (pb : PowerBasis ℚ K) (hdim : pb.dim = 3) (η : ℚ) (hroot : pb.gen^3 = pb.gen - algebraMap ℚ K η) (hsquare : ∃ β : K, β^2 = pb.gen^2 - 1) : ∃ w : ℚ, w ≠ 0 ∧ ((w^2 + 1)^2 = 8*η*w^3 ∨ (w^2 + 1)^2 = 8*η*w)
declarations.docstring: The two rational parameter relations now follow from an actual square root in a cubic algebra, rather than from a coordinate supplier.

declarations.name: cubic_powerBasis_scale_twelve
declarations.signature: theorem cubic_powerBasis_scale_twelve {K : Type*} [CommRing K] [Nontrivial K] [Algebra ℚ K] (pb : PowerBasis ℚ K) (hdim : pb.dim = 3) (m : ℕ) (c : ℚ) (hm : 0 < m) (hc : c = 1 ∨ c = -1) (hroot : pb.gen^3 = pb.gen - algebraMap ℚ K (6*c/(m : ℚ))) (hsquare : ∃ β : K, β^2 = pb.gen^2 - 1) : m = 12
declarations.docstring: A three-dimensional power basis is enough to compose the complete algebraic scale argument.

declarations.name: cubic_root_field_scale_twelve

declarations.docstring: The actual paper implication: a square in ℚ(α), for an irreducible T³−T+6c/m with c=±1, forces m=12. The ambient field may be arbitrary.

declarations.name: cubic_scale_twelve_of_square_in_adjoin
declarations.signature: theorem cubic_scale_twelve_of_square_in_adjoin {L : Type*} [Field L] [Algebra ℚ L] (m : ℕ) (c : ℚ) (hm : 0 < m) (hc : c = 1 ∨ c = -1) (α β : L) (hirr : Irreducible (cubicScalePolynomial (6*c/(m : ℚ)))) (hroot : α^3 = α - algebraMap ℚ L (6*c/(m : ℚ))) (hβmem : β ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ ({α} : Set L)) (hβ : β^2 = α^2 - 1) : m = 12
declarations.docstring: An ambient-field square root with explicit membership in ℚ(α) is the same paper hypothesis, without requiring the caller to construct a subtype.

declarations.name: cubic_four_agreements_difference
declarations.signature: theorem cubic_four_agreements_difference (C : ℕ → ℕ) (P : ℕ → ℚ) (q A B : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (hclear : ∀ k : ℕ, (q : ℚ) * P k = (A : ℚ) * (k : ℚ) * ((k : ℚ) + 1) * ((k : ℚ) + 2) + (B : ℚ)) (hagree : ∀ j : ℕ, j < 4 → (C (n + j) : ℚ) = P (n + j)) : q * ((C (n + 3) : ℤ) - 3 * (C (n + 2) : ℤ) + 3 * (C (n + 1) : ℤ) - (C n : ℤ)) = 6 * A
declarations.docstring: Four rational-profile agreements give an integer cleared third difference.

declarations.name: common_divisor_dvd_cubic_third_difference
declarations.signature: theorem common_divisor_dvd_cubic_third_difference (C : ℕ → ℕ) (P : ℕ → ℚ) (q A B : ℤ) (n d : ℕ) (hclear : ∀ k : ℕ, (q : ℚ) * P k = (A : ℚ) * (k : ℚ) * ((k : ℚ) + 1) * ((k : ℚ) + 2) + (B : ℚ)) (hagree : ∀ j : ℕ, j < 4 → (C (n + j) : ℚ) = P (n + j)) (hdiv : ∀ j : ℕ, j < 4 → d ∣ C (n + j)) : (d : ℤ) ∣ 6 * A

declarations.name: natural_orbit_common_divisor_tail

declarations.name: cubic_gcd_dvd_of_not_quarter_density

declarations.name: integral_cubic_1920_841_density

declarations.name: integral_cubic_1920_neg841_density

declarations.docstring: The reflected constant is covered too; the two signs are not silently identified by an order-reversing change of the natural index.

declarations.name: quartic_witness_excluded_below_uniform
declarations.signature: theorem quartic_witness_excluded_below_uniform (a u v : ℕ → ℤ) (m c : ℤ) (T p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp : 4 ≤ p) (hp28 : p ≤ 28) (hnum : ∀ j, T ≤ j → u (j + 1) + v j = a j * u j) (hden : ∀ j, T ≤ j → v (j + 1) = a j * v j) (hlow : ¬ LowerDensityAtLeast {n : ℕ | u n ≠ m * risingBinomial n + c} (1 / 28)) (hm : (m : ZMod p) ≠ 0) : ¬ CubicQuarticWitness p ((c : ZMod p) / (m : ZMod p))

declarations.name: four_term_orbit_quartic
declarations.signature: theorem four_term_orbit_quartic {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (x y t d d₁ d₂ a b : R) (h₀ : y + d = a * x) (h₁ : d₁ = b * y) (h₂ : t + d₂ = 0) (hd₀ : d₁ = a * d) (hd₁ : d₂ = b * d₁) : (d * (d + y)) ^ 2 = -x ^ 2 * y * t
declarations.docstring: A four-term word in a reciprocal orbit satisfies this quartic equation.

declarations.name: quartic_equation_remove_scale
declarations.signature: theorem quartic_equation_remove_scale {F : Type*} [Field F] (s x y t d : F) (hs : s ≠ 0) (h : (d * (d + s * y)) ^ 2 = -(s * x) ^ 2 * (s * y) * (s * t)) : ((d / s) * (d / s + y)) ^ 2 = -x ^ 2 * y * t
declarations.docstring: The compatibility equation is homogeneous of degree four.

declarations.name: cubicLeftTwo

declarations.name: CubicQuarticWitness
declarations.signature: def CubicQuarticWitness (p : ℕ) (ρ : ZMod p) : Prop
declarations.docstring: A concrete coefficient ratio is covered when it has an obstructed root.

declarations.name: integral_cubic_scaled_mod_eval
declarations.signature: theorem integral_cubic_scaled_mod_eval (p : ℕ) (m c : ℤ) (n : ℕ) : (6 : ZMod p) * ((m * risingBinomial n + c : ℤ) : ZMod p) = (m : ZMod p) * (((n : ZMod p) + 1) ^ 3 - ((n : ZMod p) + 1)) + 6 * (c : ZMod p)

declarations.name: integral_cubic_quartic_window_hit
declarations.signature: theorem integral_cubic_quartic_window_hit (a u v : ℕ → ℤ) (m c : ℤ) (T n p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hn : T ≤ n) (hnum : ∀ j, T ≤ j → u (j + 1) + v j = a j * u j) (hden : ∀ j, T ≤ j → v (j + 1) = a j * v j) (r : ZMod p) (hm : (m : ZMod p) ≠ 0) (hroot : (m : ZMod p) * (r ^ 3 - r) + ((6 * c : ℤ) : ZMod p) = 0) (hcert : CubicQuarticNonresidue r) (hphase : (n : ZMod p) = r - 3) : ∃ j : ℕ, j < 4 ∧ u (n + j) ≠ m * risingBinomial (n + j) + c
declarations.docstring: A supplied quartic certificate rules out four consecutive agreements. The recurrence is the exact integer recurrence, not a separately postulated modular orbit. All residue-ring equations are derived here.

declarations.name: integral_cubic_quartic_prime_density

declarations.name: integral_cubic_quartic_ratio_density

declarations.name: integral_cubic_quartic_small_prime_uniform

declarations.name: nat_square_difference_ge_sum
declarations.signature: theorem nat_square_difference_ge_sum (s t : ℕ) (hst : s < t) : s + t ≤ t ^ 2 - s ^ 2
declarations.docstring: The difference of squares of distinct positive integer coordinates is at least their sum. This formulation also handles a zero smaller coordinate.

declarations.name: unit_cubic_root_difference_dvd_six
declarations.signature: theorem unit_cubic_root_difference_dvd_six (m s t : ℕ) (hcop : Nat.Coprime s t) (heq : (s < t ∧ m * s * (t ^ 2 - s ^ 2) = 6 * t ^ 3) ∨ (t < s ∧ m * s * (s ^ 2 - t ^ 2) = 6 * t ^ 3)) : (s < t ∧ s * (t ^ 2 - s ^ 2) ∣ 6) ∨ (t < s ∧ s * (s ^ 2 - t ^ 2) ∣ 6)
declarations.docstring: The coprime denominator leaves a divisor of six, on either side of one.

declarations.name: unit_cubic_root_nat_classification
declarations.signature: theorem unit_cubic_root_nat_classification (m s t : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (ht : 0 < t) (hcop : Nat.Coprime s t) (heq : (s < t ∧ m * s * (t ^ 2 - s ^ 2) = 6 * t ^ 3) ∨ (t < s ∧ m * s * (s ^ 2 - t ^ 2) = 6 * t ^ 3)) : (s = 1 ∧ t = 2 ∧ m = 16) ∨ (s = 2 ∧ t = 1 ∧ m = 1)
declarations.docstring: The complete finite integer end of the rational-root argument.

declarations.name: unit_cubic_rational_root_clearing
declarations.signature: theorem unit_cubic_rational_root_clearing (m : ℕ) (c r : ℚ) (hm : 0 < m) (hc : c = 1 ∨ c = -1) (hroot : (m : ℚ) * (r ^ 3 - r) + 6 * c = 0) : (r.num.natAbs < r.den ∧ m * r.num.natAbs * (r.den ^ 2 - r.num.natAbs ^ 2) = 6 * r.den ^ 3) ∨ (r.den < r.num.natAbs ∧ m * r.num.natAbs * (r.num.natAbs ^ 2 - r.den ^ 2) = 6 * r.den ^ 3)
declarations.docstring: Actual root reduction gives the two exact natural-number equations.

declarations.name: unit_cubic_rational_root_scale
declarations.signature: theorem unit_cubic_rational_root_scale (m : ℕ) (c r : ℚ) (hm : 0 < m) (hc : c = 1 ∨ c = -1) (hroot : (m : ℚ) * (r ^ 3 - r) + 6 * c = 0) : m = 1 ∨ m = 16
declarations.docstring: A root of a positive-scale, unit-constant cubic forces precisely these scales; no reducibility classification is supplied as an assumption.

declarations.name: unit_cubic_exists_rational_root_iff
declarations.signature: theorem unit_cubic_exists_rational_root_iff (m : ℕ) (c : ℚ) (hm : 0 < m) (hc : c = 1 ∨ c = -1) : (∃ r : ℚ, (m : ℚ) * (r ^ 3 - r) + 6 * c = 0) ↔ m = 1 ∨ m = 16
declarations.docstring: Both exceptional scales really have rational roots, for either sign.

declarations.name: unit_cubic_irreducible_of_scale
declarations.signature: theorem unit_cubic_irreducible_of_scale (m : ℕ) (c : ℚ) (hm : 0 < m) (hc : c = 1 ∨ c = -1) (hm1 : m ≠ 1) (hm16 : m ≠ 16) : Irreducible (cubicScalePolynomial (6 * c / (m : ℚ)))
declarations.docstring: Irreducibility outside the two completely classified root scales.

declarations.name: integral_cubic_unit_rational_root_density
declarations.signature: theorem integral_cubic_unit_rational_root_density (a u v : ℕ → ℤ) (m : ℕ) (c : ℤ) (T : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hc : c = 1 ∨ c = -1) (hnum : ∀ j, T ≤ j → u (j + 1) + v j = a j * u j) (hden : ∀ j, T ≤ j → v (j + 1) = a j * v j) (r : ℚ) (hroot : (m : ℚ) * (r ^ 3 - r) + 6 * (c : ℚ) = 0) : LowerDensityAtLeast {n : ℕ | u n ≠ (m : ℤ) * risingBinomial n + c} (1 / 5)

declarations.name: integral_cubic_unit_irreducible_below_uniform
declarations.signature: theorem integral_cubic_unit_irreducible_below_uniform (a u v : ℕ → ℤ) (m : ℕ) (c : ℤ) (T : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hc : c = 1 ∨ c = -1) (hnum : ∀ j, T ≤ j → u (j + 1) + v j = a j * u j) (hden : ∀ j, T ≤ j → v (j + 1) = a j * v j) (hlow : ¬ LowerDensityAtLeast {n : ℕ | u n ≠ (m : ℤ) * risingBinomial n + c} (1 / 28)) : Irreducible (cubicScalePolynomial (6 * (c : ℚ) / (m : ℚ)))

declarations.name: rationalBinomialCubic

declarations.name: rationalBinomialCubic_natDegree

declarations.docstring: Nonzero scale gives the literal paper polynomial degree three.

declarations.name: rationalBinomialCubic_root_clearing
declarations.signature: theorem rationalBinomialCubic_root_clearing (m c r : ℚ) (hr : Polynomial.IsRoot (rationalBinomialCubic m c) r) : m * ((r + 1) ^ 3 - (r + 1)) + 6 * c = 0

declarations.name: integral_cubic_unit_unshifted_irreducible_below_uniform
declarations.signature: theorem integral_cubic_unit_unshifted_irreducible_below_uniform (a u v : ℕ → ℤ) (m : ℕ) (c : ℤ) (T : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hc : c = 1 ∨ c = -1) (hnum : ∀ j, T ≤ j → u (j + 1) + v j = a j * u j) (hden : ∀ j, T ≤ j → v (j + 1) = a j * v j) (hlow : ¬ LowerDensityAtLeast {n : ℕ | u n ≠ (m : ℤ) * risingBinomial n + c} (1 / 28)) : Irreducible (rationalBinomialCubic (m : ℚ) (c : ℚ))
declarations.docstring: The literal Q_{m,c}, not only its centred monic associate, is irreducible on the unit branch below the fixed threshold.

declarations.name: rational_abs_reduced_positive
declarations.signature: theorem rational_abs_reduced_positive (w : ℚ) (hw : w ≠ 0) : 0 < w.num.natAbs ∧ 0 < w.den ∧ Nat.Coprime w.num.natAbs w.den ∧ |w| = (w.num.natAbs : ℚ) / (w.den : ℚ)

declarations.name: cubic_rational_parameter_cleared
declarations.signature: theorem cubic_rational_parameter_cleared (m : ℕ) (c w : ℚ) (hm : 0 < m) (hc : c = 1 ∨ c = -1) (heq : (w^2 + 1)^2 = 8 * (6*c/(m : ℚ)) * w^3 ∨ (w^2 + 1)^2 = 8 * (6*c/(m : ℚ)) * w) : m * (w.num.natAbs^2 + w.den^2)^2 = 48 * w.num.natAbs^3 * w.den ∨ m * (w.num.natAbs^2 + w.den^2)^2 = 48 * w.num.natAbs * w.den^3
declarations.docstring: Both reciprocal branches give precisely the positive natural-number identities used by the denominator-divisibility argument.

declarations.name: cubic_scale_rational_classification
declarations.signature: theorem cubic_scale_rational_classification (m : ℕ) (c w : ℚ) (hm : 0 < m) (hc : c = 1 ∨ c = -1) (hw : w ≠ 0) (heq : (w^2 + 1)^2 = 8 * (6*c/(m : ℚ)) * w^3 ∨ (w^2 + 1)^2 = 8 * (6*c/(m : ℚ)) * w) : m = 12
declarations.docstring: The rational parameter itself, in either branch and with either sign, forces the scale twelve.

declarations.name: reciprocal_cubic_coefficient_factor
declarations.signature: theorem reciprocal_cubic_coefficient_factor {K : Type*} [Field K] (b d w : K) (h5 : b * w + d = 0) (h4 : d * w + b * d + b = -w) : (b * w - 1) * (b + w) = 0
declarations.docstring: Coefficient comparison for reciprocal cubic factors, without division.

declarations.name: coprime_sumSquares_square_dvd48
declarations.signature: theorem coprime_sumSquares_square_dvd48 (r s : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (hs : 0 < s) (hcop : Nat.Coprime r s) (hd : (r ^ 2 + s ^ 2) ^ 2 ∣ 48) : r = 1 ∧ s = 1
declarations.docstring: The scale denominator leaves only the primitive pair (1,1).

declarations.name: scale_twelve_of_unit_parameter
declarations.signature: theorem scale_twelve_of_unit_parameter (m : ℕ) (c w : ℤ) (hm : 0 < m) (hc : c = 1 ∨ c = -1) (hw : w = 1 ∨ w = -1) (heq : (m : ℤ) * (w ^ 2 + 1) ^ 2 = 48 * c * w) : m = 12
declarations.docstring: At either surviving rational parameter ±1, η=6c/m has m=12. Signs are handled explicitly; m is required positive.

declarations.name: reciprocal_cubic_scale_relations
declarations.signature: theorem reciprocal_cubic_scale_relations {K : Type*} [Field K] (b d w η : K) (h5 : b * w + d = 0) (h4 : d * w + b * d + b = -w) (h3 : w ^ 2 + 1 + b ^ 2 + d ^ 2 = 8 * η * w) : (w ^ 2 + 1) ^ 2 = 8 * η * w ^ 3 ∨ (w ^ 2 + 1) ^ 2 = 8 * η * w
declarations.docstring: All three coefficient equations imply the two exact cleared scale relations. Neither branch assumes the desired value of the scale.

declarations.name: coprime_sumSquares_coordinates
declarations.signature: theorem coprime_sumSquares_coordinates (r s : ℕ) (hcop : Nat.Coprime r s) : Nat.Coprime (r ^ 2 + s ^ 2) r ∧ Nat.Coprime (r ^ 2 + s ^ 2) s
declarations.docstring: The denominator in the rational parameterisation is coprime to both parameter coordinates, not merely to a selected finite set of primes.

declarations.name: cubic_scale_denominator_dvd48
declarations.signature: theorem cubic_scale_denominator_dvd48 (m r s : ℕ) (hcop : Nat.Coprime r s) (heq : m * (r ^ 2 + s ^ 2) ^ 2 = 48 * r ^ 3 * s ∨ m * (r ^ 2 + s ^ 2) ^ 2 = 48 * r * s ^ 3) : (r ^ 2 + s ^ 2) ^ 2 ∣ 48
declarations.docstring: Clear-denominator integrality supplies the divisibility by 48 used in the scale classification. This was previously only an unproved input to the finite square-divisor theorem.

declarations.name: cubic_scale_nat_classification
declarations.signature: theorem cubic_scale_nat_classification (m r s : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (hs : 0 < s) (hcop : Nat.Coprime r s) (heq : m * (r ^ 2 + s ^ 2) ^ 2 = 48 * r ^ 3 * s ∨ m * (r ^ 2 + s ^ 2) ^ 2 = 48 * r * s ^ 3) : r = 1 ∧ s = 1 ∧ m = 12
declarations.docstring: The entire positive-integer end of the rational scale calculation, including production of the divisor condition, is now one theorem.

declarations.name: cubicCoordinateD
declarations.signature: def cubicCoordinateD (x y z η : ℚ) : ℚ

declarations.signature: def cubicCoordinateW (x y z η : ℚ) : ℚ

declarations.name: cubic_coordinates_first_relation
declarations.signature: theorem cubic_coordinates_first_relation (x y z η : ℚ) (h1 : x^2 + 2*x*z + y^2 - 1 = 0) (h2 : 2*x*y + 2*y*z - η*x^2 = 0) (h3 : z^2 - 2*η*x*y + 1 = 0) : cubicCoordinateD x y z η + cubicCoordinateB x z * cubicCoordinateW x y z η = 0
