declarations.name: cubic_coordinates_second_relation
declarations.signature: theorem cubic_coordinates_second_relation (x y z η : ℚ) (h1 : x^2 + 2*x*z + y^2 - 1 = 0) (h2 : 2*x*y + 2*y*z - η*x^2 = 0) (h3 : z^2 - 2*η*x*y + 1 = 0) : cubicCoordinateD x y z η * cubicCoordinateW x y z η + cubicCoordinateB x z * cubicCoordinateD x y z η + cubicCoordinateB x z + cubicCoordinateW x y z η = 0
declarations.docstring: Exact polynomial certificate 2, over the original three coordinate equations.

declarations.name: cubic_coordinates_middle_relation
declarations.signature: theorem cubic_coordinates_middle_relation (x y z η : ℚ) (h1 : x^2 + 2*x*z + y^2 - 1 = 0) (h2 : 2*x*y + 2*y*z - η*x^2 = 0) (h3 : z^2 - 2*η*x*y + 1 = 0) : (cubicCoordinateW x y z η)^2 + 1 + (cubicCoordinateB x z)^2 + (cubicCoordinateD x y z η)^2 - 8*η*cubicCoordinateW x y z η = 0
declarations.docstring: Exact polynomial certificate 3, over the original three coordinate equations.

declarations.name: cubic_coordinate_parameter_ne_zero
declarations.signature: theorem cubic_coordinate_parameter_ne_zero (x y z η : ℚ) (h1 : x^2 + 2*x*z + y^2 - 1 = 0) (h2 : 2*x*y + 2*y*z - η*x^2 = 0) (h3 : z^2 - 2*η*x*y + 1 = 0) : cubicCoordinateW x y z η ≠ 0
declarations.docstring: A square-root coordinate solution has nonzero norm parameter.

declarations.name: cubic_coordinate_scale_relations
declarations.signature: theorem cubic_coordinate_scale_relations (x y z η : ℚ) (h1 : x^2 + 2*x*z + y^2 - 1 = 0) (h2 : 2*x*y + 2*y*z - η*x^2 = 0) (h3 : z^2 - 2*η*x*y + 1 = 0) : let w
declarations.docstring: Both reciprocal scale equations now follow from the square-root coordinates; the coefficient relations are no longer separate premises.

declarations.name: cubic_profile_integer_clearing
declarations.signature: theorem cubic_profile_integer_clearing (κ η : ℚ) : ∃ q A B : ℤ, 0 < q ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, (q : ℚ) * (κ * (n : ℚ) * ((n : ℚ) + 1) * ((n : ℚ) + 2) + η) = (A : ℚ) * (n : ℚ) * ((n : ℚ) + 1) * ((n : ℚ) + 2) + (B : ℚ)) ∧ (κ ≠ 0 → A ≠ 0)
declarations.docstring: A common integer denominator for every rational cubic profile is CONSTRUCTED from the two canonical rational denominators. Nonzero leading coefficient is preserved; no integrality-of-profile supplier is needed.

declarations.name: cleared_cubic_neighbour_product
declarations.signature: theorem cleared_cubic_neighbour_product {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (A B r : K) (hroot : A * (r ^ 3 - r) + B = 0) : -(A * ((r - 1) ^ 3 - (r - 1)) + B) * (A * ((r + 1) ^ 3 - (r + 1)) + B) = (3 * A * r) ^ 2 * (r ^ 2 - 1)
declarations.docstring: A cleared cubic root gives the exact negative-neighbour-product identity.

declarations.name: cubic_three_window_hit
declarations.signature: theorem cubic_three_window_hit {K : Type*} [Field K] (u v a : ℕ → K) (A B r : K) (T n : ℕ) (hn : T ≤ n) (hnum : ∀ j, T ≤ j → u (j + 1) = a j * u j - v j) (hden : ∀ j, T ≤ j → v (j + 1) = a j * v j) (hroot : A * (r ^ 3 - r) + B = 0) (hfactor : 3 * A * r ≠ 0) (hns : ¬ IsSquare (r ^ 2 - 1)) (hphase : (n : K) = r - 2) : ∃ j : ℕ, j < 3 ∧ u (n + j) ≠ A * ((((n + j : ℕ) : K) + 1) ^ 3 - (((n + j : ℕ) : K) + 1)) + B
declarations.docstring: A root at the middle of a three-point window with nonsquare neighbour ratio forbids agreement at all three indices. The residue specifies the START of the window: it is `r-2`, not the middle index `r-1`.

declarations.name: rational_cubic_residue_window_hit
declarations.signature: theorem rational_cubic_residue_window_hit (a u v : ℕ → ℤ) (P : ℕ → ℚ) (q A B : ℤ) (T n : ℕ) (hn : T ≤ n) (hclear : ∀ k : ℕ, (q : ℚ) * P k = (A : ℚ) * (k : ℚ) * ((k : ℚ) + 1) * ((k : ℚ) + 2) + (B : ℚ)) (hnum : ∀ j, T ≤ j → u (j + 1) + v j = a j * u j) (hden : ∀ j, T ≤ j → v (j + 1) = a j * v j) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (r : ZMod p) (hroot : (A : ZMod p) * (r ^ 3 - r) + (B : ZMod p) = 0) (hfactor : 3 * (A : ZMod p) * r ≠ 0) (hns : ¬ IsSquare (r ^ 2 - 1)) (hphase : (n : ZMod p) = r - 2) : ∃ j : ℕ, j < 3 ∧ (u (n + j) : ℚ) ≠ P (n + j)
declarations.docstring: Agreement with a rational profile is transferred to the residue field only after the equality has been cleared over `ℤ`. The profile need not be integer-valued away from the particular agreement indices.

declarations.name: rational_cubic_finite_prime_density
declarations.signature: theorem rational_cubic_finite_prime_density {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (a u v : ℕ → ℤ) (P : ℕ → ℚ) (q A B : ℤ) (T : ℕ) (hclear : ∀ k : ℕ, (q : ℚ) * P k = (A : ℚ) * (k : ℚ) * ((k : ℚ) + 1) * ((k : ℚ) + 2) + (B : ℚ)) (hnum : ∀ j, T ≤ j → u (j + 1) + v j = a j * u j) (hden : ∀ j, T ≤ j → v (j + 1) = a j * v j) (p : ι → ℕ) (hp : ∀ i, (p i).Prime) (hc : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Nat.Coprime (p i) (p j))) (r : ∀ i, ZMod (p i)) (hroot : ∀ i, (A : ZMod (p i)) * ((r i) ^ 3 - r i) + (B : ZMod (p i)) = 0) (hfactor : ∀ i, 3 * (A : ZMod (p i)) * r i ≠ 0) (hns : ∀ i, ¬ IsSquare ((r i) ^ 2 - 1)) : LowerDensityAtLeast {n : ℕ | (u n : ℚ) ≠ P n} ((1 - ∏ i, (1 - 1 / (p i : ℝ))) / 3)
declarations.docstring: Finite good-prime amplification for an arbitrary denominator-cleared rational cubic profile and the original integer state transitions.

declarations.name: rational_cubic_divergent_prime_density
declarations.signature: theorem rational_cubic_divergent_prime_density (a u v : ℕ → ℤ) (P : ℕ → ℚ) (q A B : ℤ) (T : ℕ) (hclear : ∀ k : ℕ, (q : ℚ) * P k = (A : ℚ) * (k : ℚ) * ((k : ℚ) + 1) * ((k : ℚ) + 2) + (B : ℚ)) (hnum : ∀ j, T ≤ j → u (j + 1) + v j = a j * u j) (hden : ∀ j, T ≤ j → v (j + 1) = a j * v j) (p : ℕ → ℕ) (hp : ∀ i, (p i).Prime) (hc : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Nat.Coprime (p i) (p j))) (r : ∀ i, ZMod (p i)) (hroot : ∀ i, (A : ZMod (p i)) * ((r i) ^ 3 - r i) + (B : ZMod (p i)) = 0) (hfactor : ∀ i, 3 * (A : ZMod (p i)) * r i ≠ 0) (hns : ∀ i, ¬ IsSquare ((r i) ^ 2 - 1)) (hdiv : ¬ Summable (fun i ↦ (1 : ℝ) / (p i : ℝ))) : LowerDensityAtLeast {n : ℕ | (u n : ℚ) ≠ P n} (1 / 3)
declarations.docstring: The nonsquare good-prime branch has a prime-independent one-third bound once its actual reciprocal-prime series is divergent. This is NOT the arbitrary-profile universal theorem: neither prime production nor the other algebraic branches is asserted by this declaration.

declarations.name: ZeroLowerDensity
declarations.docstring: Arbitrarily late prefixes have arbitrarily small exceptional proportion. The strict inequality automatically excludes the zero-length prefix.

declarations.name: ZeroLowerDensity.not_positive_lower_bound
declarations.signature: theorem ZeroLowerDensity.not_positive_lower_bound {E : Set ℕ} (hzero : ZeroLowerDensity E) (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) : ¬ LowerDensityAtLeast E d
declarations.docstring: The zero-lower-density hypothesis excludes every strictly positive lower bound; no convergence of all prefix proportions is required.

declarations.name: zeroLowerDensity_iff_no_positive_lower_bound
declarations.signature: theorem zeroLowerDensity_iff_no_positive_lower_bound (E : Set ℕ) : ZeroLowerDensity E ↔ ∀ d : ℝ, 0 < d → ¬ LowerDensityAtLeast E d
declarations.docstring: Conversely, the absence of a positive eventual-prefix lower bound is precisely the same zero-lower-density condition.

declarations.name: integer_nonunit_has_natural_divisor
declarations.signature: theorem integer_nonunit_has_natural_divisor (c : ℤ) (hc : c ≠ 1 ∧ c ≠ -1) : ∃ d : ℕ, 2 ≤ d ∧ (d : ℤ) ∣ c
declarations.docstring: A nonunit integer, including zero, has a natural divisor >= 2. No prime existence theorem is needed for the unit-constant reduction.

declarations.name: primitive_cubic_unit_constant_of_zero_lower_density
declarations.signature: theorem primitive_cubic_unit_constant_of_zero_lower_density (u : ℕ → ℕ) (m c : ℤ) (T : ℕ) (hcop : ∀ n, T ≤ n → Nat.Coprime (u n) (u (n + 1))) (hzero : ZeroLowerDensity {n : ℕ | (u n : ℤ) ≠ m * risingBinomial n + c}) : c = 1 ∨ c = -1
declarations.docstring: Exact full unit-constant conclusion for a primitive profile at ZERO lower density. This statement cannot be used with a merely small positive exceptional density.

declarations.name: binomial_profile_of_scaled_coefficients
declarations.signature: theorem binomial_profile_of_scaled_coefficients (κ η : ℚ) (g : ℕ) (m c : ℤ) (hg : 0 < g) (hm : (m : ℚ) * (g : ℚ) = 6 * κ) (hc : (c : ℚ) * (g : ℚ) = η) (n : ℕ) : (κ * (n : ℚ) * ((n : ℚ) + 1) * ((n : ℚ) + 2) + η) / (g : ℚ) = ((m * risingBinomial n + c : ℤ) : ℚ)
declarations.docstring: A primitive tail identifies the full rational profile, not only the agreement predicate at selected indices.

declarations.name: rational_cubic_zero_density_primitive_shape
declarations.signature: theorem rational_cubic_zero_density_primitive_shape (a C D : ℕ → ℕ) (κ η : ℚ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hCpos : ∀ n, 0 < C n) (hDpos : ∀ n, 0 < D n) (hC : ∀ n, C (n + 1) + D n = a n * C n) (hD : ∀ n, D (n + 1) = a n * D n) (hzero : ZeroLowerDensity {n : ℕ | (C n : ℚ) ≠ κ * (n : ℚ) * ((n : ℚ) + 1) * ((n : ℚ) + 2) + η}) : ∃ (N g : ℕ) (m c : ℤ), 0 < g ∧ 0 < m ∧ (c = 1 ∨ c = -1) ∧ (m : ℚ) * (g : ℚ) = 6 * κ ∧ (c : ℚ) * (g : ℚ) = η ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, (κ * (n : ℚ) * ((n : ℚ) + 1) * ((n : ℚ) + 2) + η) / (g : ℚ) = ((m * risingBinomial n + c : ℤ) : ℚ)) ∧ ∀ n, N ≤ n → Nat.gcd (C n) (D n) = g ∧ 0 < C n / g ∧ 0 < D n / g ∧
declarations.docstring: Full zero-density construction of the unit primitive cubic shape and its exact original-index tail recurrence. No irreducibility, Chebotarev, signed series convergence or hidden primitive-tail supplier is assumed.

declarations.name: LowerDensityAtLeast.mono_bound
declarations.signature: theorem LowerDensityAtLeast.mono_bound {E : Set ℕ} {a b : ℝ} (h : LowerDensityAtLeast E b) (hab : a ≤ b) : LowerDensityAtLeast E a
declarations.docstring: Lower bounds can be weakened without changing the exceptional set.

declarations.name: exceptionCount_le_of_eventual_subset
declarations.signature: theorem exceptionCount_le_of_eventual_subset (E F : Set ℕ) (T X : ℕ) (hsub : ∀ n, T ≤ n → n ∈ E → n ∈ F) : exceptionCount E X ≤ T + exceptionCount F X
declarations.docstring: Eventual inclusion loses at most the length of the discarded prefix.

declarations.name: LowerDensityAtLeast.of_eventual_subset
declarations.signature: theorem LowerDensityAtLeast.of_eventual_subset {E F : Set ℕ} {d : ℝ} (hE : LowerDensityAtLeast E d) (T : ℕ) (hsub : ∀ n, T ≤ n → n ∈ E → n ∈ F) : LowerDensityAtLeast F d
declarations.docstring: No density is lost when a finite initial segment is discarded.

declarations.name: lowerDensityAtLeast_iff_of_eventual_iff
declarations.signature: theorem lowerDensityAtLeast_iff_of_eventual_iff (E F : Set ℕ) (T : ℕ) (d : ℝ) (heq : ∀ n, T ≤ n → (n ∈ E ↔ n ∈ F)) : LowerDensityAtLeast E d ↔ LowerDensityAtLeast F d
declarations.docstring: In particular, eventual equality of exception predicates preserves every lower-density bound, with their original indices and original prefixes.

declarations.name: disjoint_periodic_lowerDensity
declarations.signature: theorem disjoint_periodic_lowerDensity (E : Set ℕ) (r s L : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hL : L ≤ s) (hhit : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ i : ℕ, i < L ∧ r + s * k + i ∈ E) : LowerDensityAtLeast E (1 / (s : ℝ))
declarations.docstring: Disjoint periodic windows cost one exception per period, not one divided by the window length. This is useful for small-prime primitive obstructions.

declarations.name: fixed_offset_incidence_bound
declarations.signature: theorem fixed_offset_incidence_bound (A : Finset ℕ) (E : Set ℕ) (L X : ℕ) (offset : Fin L → ℕ) (hhit : ∀ n ∈ A, ∃ i : Fin L, n + offset i < X ∧ n + offset i ∈ E) : A.card ≤ L * exceptionCount E X
declarations.docstring: General fixed offsets are charged by their number, not their maximum size. Repeated offsets are allowed. This repairs the inherited mapping of the paper's periodic-obstruction lemma to a theorem that only handled disjoint windows.

declarations.name: fixed_offset_periodic_linear_bound
declarations.signature: theorem fixed_offset_periodic_linear_bound (E : Set ℕ) (r s L H : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (offset : Fin L → ℕ) (hoffset : ∀ i, offset i ≤ H) (hhit : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ i : Fin L, r + s * k + offset i ∈ E) : ∀ X : ℕ, X ≤ s * L * exceptionCount E X + (r + H + s)
declarations.docstring: Boundary-corrected count for arbitrary fixed offsets on one progression. The offset bound H affects only the additive boundary term, not the density.

declarations.name: fixed_offsets_periodic_lowerDensity
declarations.signature: theorem fixed_offsets_periodic_lowerDensity (E : Set ℕ) (s L T r : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hL : 0 < L) (hr : r < s) (offset : Fin L → ℕ) (hhit : ∀ n : ℕ, T ≤ n → n % s = r → ∃ i : Fin L, n + offset i ∈ E) : LowerDensityAtLeast E (1 / ((L : ℝ) * (s : ℝ)))
declarations.docstring: The paper's periodic obstruction principle for arbitrary fixed natural index offsets, with arbitrary overlaps and repeated offsets. The progression starts after the original threshold; its phase is not silently reset.

declarations.name: nonsquare_of_negated_root
declarations.signature: theorem nonsquare_of_negated_root {k E : Type*} [Field k] [Field E] (ι : k →+* E) (F : E →+* E) (hfix : ∀ x : k, F (ι x) = ι x) (β : E) (hβ : β ≠ 0) (h2 : (2 : E) ≠ 0) (hneg : F β = -β) (γ : k) (hsquare : ι γ = β ^ 2) : ¬ IsSquare γ
declarations.docstring: A nonzero square root negated by an automorphism cannot be the square root of a square in its fixed base field (in characteristic different from two).

declarations.name: isSquare_square_mul_iff
declarations.signature: theorem isSquare_square_mul_iff {K : Type*} [Field K] (c γ : K) (hc : c ≠ 0) : IsSquare (c ^ 2 * γ) ↔ IsSquare γ
declarations.docstring: A nonzero square factor does not change the square class.

declarations.name: second_order_numerator_identity
declarations.signature: theorem second_order_numerator_identity {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (u v a : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) (hnum : ∀ j, u (j + 1) = a j * u j - v j) (hden : ∀ j, v (j + 1) = a j * v j) : u (n + 2) = (a n + a (n + 1)) * u (n + 1) - (a n) ^ 2 * u n
declarations.docstring: Eliminating the denominator from two consecutive exact state transitions produces the manuscript's second-order numerator identity. This is valid in any commutative ring and has no positivity or invertibility assumptions.

declarations.name: forced_neighbour_square_of_second_order
declarations.signature: theorem forced_neighbour_square_of_second_order {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (uPrev uMid uNext aPrev aNext : R) (hsecond : uNext = (aPrev + aNext) * uMid - aPrev ^ 2 * uPrev) (hzero : uMid = 0) : IsSquare (-uPrev * uNext)
declarations.docstring: The second-order identity immediately yields the forced-neighbour square when the middle numerator vanishes. This is the exact algebra used after reduction modulo a good prime.

declarations.name: zero_middle_neighbour_square
declarations.signature: theorem zero_middle_neighbour_square {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (w z a d : R) (hzero : a * w - d = 0) (hnext : z = -(a * d)) : IsSquare (-w * z)
declarations.docstring: Two exact transitions through a zero numerator force the negative neighbour product to be a square, with no inversions or residue exclusions.

declarations.name: depressed_cubic_neighbours
declarations.signature: theorem depressed_cubic_neighbours {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (r η : R) (hroot : r ^ 3 - r + η = 0) : ((r - 1) ^ 3 - (r - 1) + η = -3 * r * (r - 1)) ∧ ((r + 1) ^ 3 - (r + 1) + η = 3 * r * (r + 1))
declarations.docstring: Depressed-cubic neighbour identities, valid in every commutative ring.

declarations.name: depressed_cubic_transport_obstruction
declarations.signature: theorem depressed_cubic_transport_obstruction {K : Type*} [Field K] (r η κ : K) (hroot : r ^ 3 - r + η = 0) (hfactor : 3 * κ * r ≠ 0) (hnonsquare : ¬ IsSquare (r ^ 2 - 1)) : ¬ ∃ a d : K, a * (κ * ((r - 1) ^ 3 - (r - 1) + η)) - d = 0 ∧ κ * ((r + 1) ^ 3 - (r + 1) + η) = -(a * d)
declarations.docstring: This is the exact local cubic composition once a good prime with nonsquare r²−1 has been produced. It does not assume that prime supplier.

declarations.name: positivePart_lipschitz
declarations.signature: theorem positivePart_lipschitz (x y : ℝ) : |max x 0 - max y 0| ≤ |x - y|
declarations.docstring: Positive-part truncation is nonexpansive, including both zero cases.

declarations.name: scaled_positivePart
declarations.signature: theorem scaled_positivePart (u w γ B : ℝ) (hu : 0 < u) : u * w * max (γ - B / u) 0 = max (u * γ - B) 0 * w
declarations.docstring: The paper's `U f(U) (γ-B/U)₊` is exactly a scaled positive part.

declarations.name: growth_charge_discrepancy
declarations.signature: theorem growth_charge_discrepancy (u v γ B w ε : ℝ) (hu : 0 < u) (hw : 0 ≤ w) (herror : |γ + v / u| ≤ ε) : |u * w * max (γ - B / u) 0 - max (-v - B) 0 * w| ≤ ε * u * w
declarations.docstring: A pointwise comparison of the exact two printed summands.

declarations.name: paperGrowthCharge
declarations.signature: noncomputable def paperGrowthCharge (a U : ℕ → ℕ) (B : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ
declarations.docstring: Masked sum on precisely the global strict record indices.

declarations.name: paperGrowthCharge_nonneg
declarations.signature: theorem paperGrowthCharge_nonneg (a U : ℕ → ℕ) (B : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hU : ∀ n, 0 < U n) (hf : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ x → 0 ≤ f x) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ paperGrowthCharge a U B f n

declarations.name: paperRecordCharge_nonneg
declarations.signature: theorem paperRecordCharge_nonneg (U : ℕ → ℕ) (V : ℕ → ℤ) (B : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hU : ∀ n, 0 < U n) (hf : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ x → 0 ≤ f x) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ paperRecordCharge U V B f n

declarations.name: canonical_numerator_ratio_eq
declarations.signature: theorem canonical_numerator_ratio_eq (a : ℕ → ℕ) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hs : HasSum (fun n ↦ 1 / (a n : ℝ)) ((p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))) (n : ℕ) : (canonicalNaturalNumerator a p q (n + 1) : ℝ) / (canonicalNaturalNumerator a p q n : ℝ) = (a n : ℝ) * realTail (fun k ↦ 1 / (a k : ℝ)) (n + 1) / realTail (fun k ↦ 1 / (a k : ℝ)) n
declarations.docstring: The real-tail quotient is the canonical integer-numerator quotient.

declarations.name: canonical_numerator_div_digit_summable
declarations.signature: theorem canonical_numerator_div_digit_summable (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hs : HasSum (fun n ↦ 1 / (a n : ℝ)) ((p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))) (hgrowth : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (a (n + 1) : ℝ) / (a n : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1)) : Summable (fun n ↦ (canonicalNaturalNumerator a p q n : ℝ) / (a n : ℝ))
declarations.docstring: A complete supplier for the comparison-error series. It is obtained from the actual rational sum, not assumed as a growth-debt hypothesis.

declarations.name: canonical_lcm_scale_data
declarations.signature: theorem canonical_lcm_scale_data (a : ℕ → ℕ) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hs : HasSum (fun n ↦ 1 / (a n : ℝ)) ((p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))) : let C
declarations.docstring: The exact product/LCM scale identities, including the domination U ≤ C.

declarations.name: canonical_growth_error_bound
declarations.signature: theorem canonical_growth_error_bound (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hs : HasSum (fun n ↦ 1 / (a n : ℝ)) ((p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))) (hgrowth : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (a (n + 1) : ℝ) / (a n : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1)) : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n, N ≤ n → |(a n : ℝ) ^ 2 / (a (n + 1) : ℝ) - 1 + (canonicalLcmDigit a p q n : ℝ) / (canonicalLcmNumerator a p q n : ℝ)| ≤ 16 / (a n : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: Quantitative comparison with constant 16 in the canonical LCM coordinates. This is valid at all sufficiently late indices, not only fresh steps or record indices.

declarations.name: summable_iff_of_nonnegative_discrepancy
declarations.signature: theorem summable_iff_of_nonnegative_discrepancy (F G e : ℕ → ℝ) (hF : ∀ n, 0 ≤ F n) (hG : ∀ n, 0 ≤ G n) (he : ∀ n, 0 ≤ e n) (hse : Summable e) (hbound : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n, N ≤ n → |F n - G n| ≤ e n) : Summable F ↔ Summable G
declarations.docstring: Eventual absolutely summable error preserves summability of the two nonnegative series. The finite prefix is treated explicitly.

declarations.name: canonical_weighted_growth_iff_record
declarations.signature: theorem canonical_weighted_growth_iff_record (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hs : HasSum (fun n ↦ 1 / (a n : ℝ)) ((p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))) (hgrowth : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (a (n + 1) : ℝ) / (a n : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1)) (B : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : AntitoneOn f (Set.Ici 1)) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ x → 0 ≤ f x) : Summable (paperGrowthCharge a (canonicalLcmNumerator a p q) B f) ↔ Summable (paperRecordCharge (canonicalLcmNumerator a p q) (canonicalLcmDigit a p q) B f)
declarations.docstring: Exact weighted-growth / weighted-record equivalence for each baseline. The entire summable majorant is manufactured inside this theorem.

declarations.name: canonical_weighted_growth_excess
declarations.signature: theorem canonical_weighted_growth_excess (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hs : HasSum (fun n ↦ 1 / (a n : ℝ)) ((p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))) (hgrowth : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (a (n + 1) : ℝ) / (a n : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1)) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : AntitoneOn f (Set.Ici 1)) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ x → 0 ≤ f x) (hdiv : IntegralUnbounded f) : (∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → (a (n + 1) : ℤ) = (a n : ℤ) ^ 2 - (a n : ℤ) + 1) ↔ ∃ B : ℕ, Summable (paperGrowthCharge a (canonicalLcmNumerator a p q) B f)
declarations.docstring: **The exact canonical weighted-growth paper endpoint.** No extra convergence, growth-budget, record supply or state-realisation hypothesis is introduced. An initial digit equal to one is allowed.

declarations.name: record_increment_le_negative_part
declarations.signature: theorem record_increment_le_negative_part (U : ℕ → ℕ) (V : ℕ → ℤ) (hstep : ∀ n, (U (n + 1) : ℤ) = (U n : ℤ) - V n) (n : ℕ) : ((U (n + 1) - runningMax U n : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ max (-V n) 0
declarations.docstring: For the additive state equation `U_{n+1}=U_n-V_n`, the increment above the previous running maximum is bounded by the negative part of the error. This remains true across arbitrary drawdowns.

declarations.name: strict_record_negative_error
declarations.signature: theorem strict_record_negative_error (U : ℕ → ℕ) (V : ℕ → ℤ) (hstep : ∀ n, (U (n + 1) : ℤ) = (U n : ℤ) - V n) {n : ℕ} (hr : IsStrictRecord U n) : 0 < -V n ∧ ((U (n + 1) - U n : ℕ) : ℤ) = -V n
declarations.docstring: At a strict record the negative error is strictly positive, and the source-to-endpoint rise is exactly `-V_n`.

declarations.name: strict_record_increment_le_negative_error
declarations.signature: theorem strict_record_increment_le_negative_error (U : ℕ → ℕ) (V : ℕ → ℤ) (hstep : ∀ n, (U (n + 1) : ℤ) = (U n : ℤ) - V n) {n : ℕ} (hr : IsStrictRecord U n) : ((U (n + 1) - runningMax U n : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ -V n
declarations.docstring: Hence on a strict record the record increment itself is bounded by the exact negative error, the finite inequality used to transfer the record boundary theorem to the inclusive error condition.

declarations.name: runningMax_true_increment
declarations.signature: theorem runningMax_true_increment (U : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : runningMax U (n + 1) - runningMax U n = U (n + 1) - runningMax U n
declarations.docstring: The true increment of a running maximum equals the truncated gap above the previous maximum, even across a drawdown.

declarations.name: recordLogLogCharge
declarations.signature: noncomputable def recordLogLogCharge (U : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ
declarations.docstring: The paper's all-index record quotient, before passing to a limsup.

declarations.name: recordTheta
declarations.signature: noncomputable def recordTheta (U : ℕ → ℕ) : EReal
declarations.docstring: The exact extended-real record coefficient Theta.

declarations.name: ereal_limsup_gt_one_of_cofinal
declarations.signature: theorem ereal_limsup_gt_one_of_cofinal (f : ℕ → ℝ) (h : ∃ c : ℝ, 1 < c ∧ ∀ T : ℕ, ∃ n, T ≤ n ∧ c < f n) : (1 : EReal) < limsup (fun n ↦ (f n : EReal)) atTop
declarations.docstring: A cofinally exceeded real coefficient is a lower bound on the extended-real limsup; no boundedness hypothesis on the sequence is used.

declarations.name: canonical_recordTheta_gt_one
declarations.signature: theorem canonical_recordTheta_gt_one (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hs : HasSum (fun n ↦ 1 / (a n : ℝ)) ((p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))) (hgrowth : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (a (n + 1) : ℝ) / (a n : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1)) (hnot : ¬ ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → (a (n + 1) : ℤ) = sylvesterNext (a n : ℤ)) : (1 : EReal) < recordTheta (canonicalNaturalNumerator a p q)
declarations.docstring: Strict coefficient-one boundary in the paper's exact extended-real record observable.

declarations.name: negativeErrorLogLogCharge
declarations.signature: noncomputable def negativeErrorLogLogCharge (U : ℕ → ℕ) (E : ℕ → ℤ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ
declarations.docstring: The error observable in the inclusive corollary. The negative part is formed in integers first, and then cast into the ordinary real quotient.

declarations.name: recordLogLogCharge_le_negativeError
declarations.signature: theorem recordLogLogCharge_le_negativeError (U : ℕ → ℕ) (E : ℕ → ℤ) (hstep : ∀ n, (U (n + 1) : ℤ) = (U n : ℤ) - E n) (n : ℕ) : recordLogLogCharge U n ≤ negativeErrorLogLogCharge U E n
declarations.docstring: The global running maximum in the record denominator is larger than the current numerator. Positivity of the exact normaliser makes the error-to-record comparison valid, including arbitrary drawdowns.

declarations.name: recordTheta_le_negativeError_limsup
declarations.signature: theorem recordTheta_le_negativeError_limsup (U : ℕ → ℕ) (E : ℕ → ℤ) (hstep : ∀ n, (U (n + 1) : ℤ) = (U n : ℤ) - E n) : recordTheta U ≤ limsup (fun n ↦ (negativeErrorLogLogCharge U E n : EReal)) atTop
declarations.docstring: Comparison of the actual extended-real limsups, including +infinity.

declarations.name: canonical_negativeError_limsup_gt_one
declarations.signature: theorem canonical_negativeError_limsup_gt_one (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hs : HasSum (fun n ↦ 1 / (a n : ℝ)) ((p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))) (hgrowth : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (a (n + 1) : ℝ) / (a n : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1)) (hnot : ¬ ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → (a (n + 1) : ℤ) = sylvesterNext (a n : ℤ)) : let C
declarations.docstring: Exact strict contrapositive of the printed inclusive log-log boundary.

declarations.name: canonical_inclusive_logLog_criterion
declarations.signature: theorem canonical_inclusive_logLog_criterion (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hs : HasSum (fun n ↦ 1 / (a n : ℝ)) ((p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))) (hgrowth : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (a (n + 1) : ℝ) / (a n : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1)) (hlim : let C
declarations.docstring: The inclusive inequality is ≤1, not <1. All the original analytic hypotheses are retained; no conditional CRT or prime supplier is assumed.

declarations.name: RecordGrowthOrbit.gcd_monotone
declarations.signature: theorem RecordGrowthOrbit.gcd_monotone (O : RecordGrowthOrbit) : Monotone (fun n ↦ Nat.gcd (O.U n) (O.D n))
declarations.docstring: The exact tail gcd is a positive monotone divisibility chain.

declarations.name: RecordGrowthOrbit.no_inclusive_record_cap
declarations.signature: theorem RecordGrowthOrbit.no_inclusive_record_cap (O : RecordGrowthOrbit) : ∃ c : ℝ, 1 < c ∧ ¬ ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ n, T ≤ n → runningMax O.U n < O.U (n + 1) → ((O.U (n + 1) - runningMax O.U n : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ c * recordLogLog (runningMax O.U n)
declarations.docstring: Full inclusive arithmetic assembly: an unbounded orbit has some fixed coefficient strictly above one for which no eventual record cap exists.

declarations.name: RecordGrowthOrbit.cofinal_inclusive_record
declarations.signature: theorem RecordGrowthOrbit.cofinal_inclusive_record (O : RecordGrowthOrbit) : ∃ c : ℝ, 1 < c ∧ ∀ T : ℕ, ∃ n, T ≤ n ∧ runningMax O.U n < O.U (n + 1) ∧ c * recordLogLog (runningMax O.U n) < ((O.U (n + 1) - runningMax O.U n : ℕ) : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: The strict improvement occurs cofinally at actual global records.

declarations.name: canonical_unbounded_of_not_sylvester
declarations.signature: theorem canonical_unbounded_of_not_sylvester (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hs : HasSum (fun n ↦ 1 / (a n : ℝ)) ((p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))) (hgrowth : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (a (n + 1) : ℝ) / (a n : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1)) (hnot : ¬ ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → (a (n + 1) : ℤ) = sylvesterNext (a n : ℤ)) : ∀ H : ℕ, ∃ n, H ≤ canonicalNaturalNumerator a p q n
declarations.docstring: With normalised integer vanishing, a bounded canonical numerator forces exact eventual Sylvester recursion; no bounded-error assumption is added.

declarations.name: canonicalRecordGrowthOrbit
declarations.signature: noncomputable def canonicalRecordGrowthOrbit (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hs : HasSum (fun n ↦ 1 / (a n : ℝ)) ((p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))) (hgrowth : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (a (n + 1) : ℝ) / (a n : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1)) (hnot : ¬ ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → (a (n + 1) : ℤ) = sylvesterNext (a n : ℤ)) : RecordGrowthOrbit
declarations.docstring: Canonical construction from the paper's original hypotheses alone.

declarations.name: canonical_inclusive_record_boundary
declarations.signature: theorem canonical_inclusive_record_boundary (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hs : HasSum (fun n ↦ 1 / (a n : ℝ)) ((p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))) (hgrowth : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (a (n + 1) : ℝ) / (a n : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1)) (hnot : ¬ ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → (a (n + 1) : ℤ) = sylvesterNext (a n : ℤ)) : ∃ c : ℝ, 1 < c ∧ ∀ T : ℕ, ∃ n, T ≤ n ∧ runningMax (canonicalNaturalNumerator a p q) n < canonicalNaturalNumerator a p q (n + 1) ∧ c * recordLogLog (runningMax (canonicalNaturalNumerator a p q) n) < ((canonicalNaturalNumerator a p q (n + 1) - runningMax (canonicalNaturalNumerator a p q) n : ℕ) : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: The inclusive record theorem in cofinal form, with the canonical cleared numerator, the original global maximum and the exact base-two normaliser. There are no extra arithmetic, growth or block hypotheses.

declarations.name: four_mul_add_one_le_two_pow
declarations.signature: theorem four_mul_add_one_le_two_pow {t : ℕ} (ht : 5 ≤ t) : 4 * t + 1 ≤ 2 ^ t
declarations.docstring: The exponential dominates the precise linear exponent used below.

declarations.name: twice_fourth_power_le_two_pow_two_pow
declarations.signature: theorem twice_fourth_power_le_two_pow_two_pow {t : ℕ} (ht : 5 ≤ t) : 2 * (2 ^ t) ^ 4 ≤ 2 ^ (2 ^ t)
declarations.docstring: Exact domination of the fourth power; no floating-point evaluation is used for the growing parameter.

declarations.name: square_block_exponent_budget
declarations.signature: theorem square_block_exponent_budget (K N t : ℕ) (ht : 5 ≤ t) (hKN : K + N ≤ 2 ^ t) : (K + (N + 2 ^ t + (2 ^ t) ^ 2)) * (2 ^ t) ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ (2 ^ t)
declarations.docstring: The entire gcd-loss exponent fits below the first multiplier's double exponential exponent, even though the block itself grows quadratically.

declarations.name: square_block_core_size
declarations.signature: theorem square_block_core_size (U : ℕ → ℕ) (K N t : ℕ) (ht : 5 ≤ t) (hKN : K + N ≤ 2 ^ t) (hH : runningMax U (N + 2 ^ t + (2 ^ t) ^ 2) ≤ 2 ^ (K + (N + 2 ^ t + (2 ^ t) ^ 2))) (A : Fin ((2 ^ t) ^ 2) → ℕ) (hA : ∀ i, 2 * binaryTower (2 ^ t) ≤ A i) : ∀ i, max ((2 ^ t) ^ 2) (runningMax U (N + 2 ^ t + (2 ^ t) ^ 2)) * (runningMax U (N + 2 ^ t + (2 ^ t) ^ 2)) ^ ((2 ^ t) ^ 2 - 1) < A i
declarations.docstring: The exact size premise of `coprime_core_record_fence` is supplied by one common running-maximum envelope and one common multiplier lower bound.

declarations.name: scaled_crt_height_binaryTower
declarations.signature: theorem scaled_crt_height_binaryTower (g P B h : ℕ) (hP : P ≤ binaryTower h) (hB : B ≤ binaryTower h) : g * (2 * P + B) ≤ binaryTower (h + g + 2)
declarations.docstring: Any fixed integer scale and the complete CRT interval cost only an additive tower-index constant. This avoids an unjustified equality under log-log rescaling.

declarations.name: scaled_crt_height_logLog
declarations.signature: theorem scaled_crt_height_logLog (g P B h : ℕ) (hP : P ≤ binaryTower h) (hB : B ≤ binaryTower h) : recordLogLog (g * (2 * P + B) : ℕ) ≤ (h + g + 2 : ℕ)
declarations.docstring: Exact logarithmic budget for the whole scaled CRT interval.

declarations.name: natWeight
declarations.signature: noncomputable def natWeight (f : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ

declarations.name: IntegralUnbounded
declarations.docstring: For a nonnegative locally integrable function this is the usual statement that the improper integral from one to infinity is +∞.

declarations.name: natWeight_nonneg
declarations.signature: theorem natWeight_nonneg (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ x → 0 ≤ f x) : ∀ n, 0 ≤ natWeight f n

declarations.name: natWeight_antitone
declarations.signature: theorem natWeight_antitone (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : AntitoneOn f (Ici 1)) : Antitone (natWeight f)

declarations.name: sum_range_le_progression
declarations.signature: theorem sum_range_le_progression (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : Antitone f) (x P N : ℕ) : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (x + N * P), f j ≤ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range x, f j) + (P : ℝ) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, f (x + k * P)

declarations.name: summable_of_summable_progression

declarations.docstring: A summable arithmetic progression of a nonnegative antitone sequence forces the entire sequence to be summable. There is no density assumption.

declarations.name: divergesOnProgressions_of_not_summable
declarations.signature: theorem divergesOnProgressions_of_not_summable (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : Antitone f) (hpos : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) (hs : ¬ Summable f) : DivergesOnProgressions f

declarations.name: natWeight_not_summable_of_integral
declarations.signature: theorem natWeight_not_summable_of_integral (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : AntitoneOn f (Ici 1)) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ x → 0 ≤ f x) (hdiv : IntegralUnbounded f) : ¬ Summable (natWeight f)
declarations.docstring: The integral comparison is performed on bounded intervals, where monotonicity supplies integrability. The final passage is an explicit unboundedness contradiction, not an exchange of an integral and an infinite sum.

declarations.name: natWeight_divergesOnProgressions
declarations.signature: theorem natWeight_divergesOnProgressions (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : AntitoneOn f (Ici 1)) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ x → 0 ≤ f x) (hdiv : IntegralUnbounded f) : DivergesOnProgressions (natWeight f)

declarations.name: uncentred_integral_equivalence
declarations.signature: theorem uncentred_integral_equivalence (q : ℕ) (a U : ℕ → ℕ) (b : ℕ → ℤ) (B : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (ha : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n, N ≤ n → 2 ≤ a n) (hstep : ∀ n, (lcmOverlap q a n : ℤ) * U (n + 1) = (a n : ℤ) * U n - b n * (cumulativeDigitLcm q a n : ℤ)) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : AntitoneOn f (Ici 1)) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ x → 0 ≤ f x) (hdiv : IntegralUnbounded f) : ((∃ H : ℕ, ∀ n, U n ≤ H) ↔ Summable (mixedCharge U (lcmOverlap q a) B (natWeight f))) ∧ ((∃ H : ℕ, ∀ n, U n ≤ H) ↔ Summable (rawCharge U (lcmOverlap q a) B (natWeight f)))
declarations.docstring: Full integral-weighted mixed/raw equivalence for the actual LCM state. All arithmetic suppliers and the integral-to-progression passage are constructed in the preceding proofs. At positive U, natWeight f (U n) is exactly the paper's f(U n).

declarations.name: natWeight_eq_at_positive
declarations.signature: theorem natWeight_eq_at_positive (f : ℝ → ℝ) {u : ℕ} (hu : 0 < u) : natWeight f u = f (u : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: Zero-height extension does not alter any weight in a positive orbit.

declarations.name: zero_error_of_summable_raw_integral
declarations.signature: theorem zero_error_of_summable_raw_integral (q : ℕ) (a U : ℕ → ℕ) (b V : ℕ → ℤ) (B : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (ha : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n, N ≤ n → 2 ≤ a n) (hstep : ∀ n, (lcmOverlap q a n : ℤ) * U (n + 1) = (a n : ℤ) * U n - b n * (cumulativeDigitLcm q a n : ℤ)) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : AntitoneOn f (Ici 1)) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ x → 0 ≤ f x) (hdiv : IntegralUnbounded f) (hs : Summable (rawCharge U (lcmOverlap q a) B (natWeight f))) (hvanish : ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → K * (V n).natAbs < U n) : ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → V n = 0
declarations.docstring: Normalised vanishing is used only for discreteness *after* the global height theorem; it is not smuggled into the uncentred charging argument.

declarations.name: weighted_recurrence_of_summable_raw_integral
declarations.signature: theorem weighted_recurrence_of_summable_raw_integral (q : ℕ) (a U : ℕ → ℕ) (b V : ℕ → ℤ) (B : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (ha : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n, N ≤ n → 2 ≤ a n) (hU : ∀ n, 0 < U n) (hstep : ∀ n, (lcmOverlap q a n : ℤ) * U (n + 1) = (U n : ℤ) - V n) (herror : ∀ n, V n = b n * (cumulativeDigitLcm q a n : ℤ) - ((a n : ℤ) - 1) * U n) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : AntitoneOn f (Ici 1)) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ x → 0 ≤ f x) (hdiv : IntegralUnbounded f) (hs : Summable (rawCharge U (lcmOverlap q a) B (natWeight f))) (hvanish : ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → K * (V n).natAbs < U n) : ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → b n * ((a (n + 1) : ℤ) - 1) = b (n + 1) * (a n : ℤ) * ((a n : ℤ) - 1)
declarations.docstring: The weighted recurrence is composed from the global raw-charge endpoint, without dividing by b and without imposing a sign on b.

declarations.name: index_succ_le_two_pow

declarations.name: binaryTower_mono

declarations.name: recordLogLog

declarations.name: one_le_recordLogLog

declarations.name: multiplier_block_product_le_denominator

declarations.name: multiplier_gcd_le_terminal_record

declarations.name: denominator_double_exponential_envelope

declarations.docstring: A uniform multiplier majorant gives the denominator the same double exponential order. The multiplicative initial denominator is retained.

declarations.name: canonical_global_multiplier_envelope
declarations.signature: theorem canonical_global_multiplier_envelope (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (hgrowth : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (a (n + 1) : ℝ) / (a n : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1)) : ∃ A : ℕ, 1 ≤ A ∧ ∀ n, a n ≤ A ^ (2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: The canonical multiplier envelope is global; its finite prefix is not silently discarded before a denominator product is formed.

declarations.name: canonical_denominator_binaryTower_bound
declarations.signature: theorem canonical_denominator_binaryTower_bound (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (q : ℕ) (hgrowth : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (a (n + 1) : ℝ) / (a n : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1)) : ∃ L : ℕ, ∀ n, canonicalDenominator a q n ≤ binaryTower (n + L)
declarations.docstring: No denominator-growth hypothesis is added to the canonical endpoint.

declarations.name: runningMax_binary_exponent_of_real_envelope
declarations.signature: theorem runningMax_binary_exponent_of_real_envelope (U : ℕ → ℕ) (K : ℝ) (hK : ∀ n, (runningMax U n : ℝ) ≤ K * (2 : ℝ) ^ n) : ∃ L : ℕ, ∀ n, runningMax U n ≤ 2 ^ (L + n)
declarations.docstring: The real geometric envelope is converted to an exact natural exponent budget, including the finite prefix.

declarations.name: canonical_runningMax_binary_exponent
declarations.signature: theorem canonical_runningMax_binary_exponent (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hs : HasSum (fun n ↦ 1 / (a n : ℝ)) ((p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))) (hgrowth : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (a (n + 1) : ℝ) / (a n : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1)) : ∃ L : ℕ, ∀ n, runningMax (canonicalNaturalNumerator a p q) n ≤ 2 ^ (L + n)
declarations.docstring: This integer envelope is supplied by the canonical reciprocal series.

declarations.name: presievedOffsets
declarations.signature: def presievedOffsets (W B : ℕ) : Finset ℕ
declarations.docstring: The offsets not already excluded by the old primitive denominator W.

declarations.name: presievedOffsets_card_mul
declarations.signature: theorem presievedOffsets_card_mul (W k : ℕ) : (presievedOffsets W (k * W)).card = k * Nat.totient W
declarations.docstring: One complete residue block contains exactly Euler's totient.

declarations.name: presievedOffsets_card_bounds
declarations.signature: theorem presievedOffsets_card_bounds (W B : ℕ) (hW : 0 < W) : (B / W) * Nat.totient W ≤ (presievedOffsets W B).card ∧ (presievedOffsets W B).card ≤ (B / W + 1) * Nat.totient W
declarations.docstring: Two exact integer bounds, including the empty prefix.

declarations.name: presievedOffsets_card_error
declarations.signature: theorem presievedOffsets_card_error (W B : ℕ) (hW : 0 < W) : |((presievedOffsets W B).card : ℝ) - (Nat.totient W : ℝ) / (W : ℝ) * (B : ℝ)| ≤ (Nat.totient W : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: An explicit uniform real error bound for the coprime offset count.

declarations.name: presievedOffsets_density
declarations.signature: theorem presievedOffsets_density (W : ℕ) (hW : 0 < W) : Tendsto (fun B : ℕ ↦ ((presievedOffsets W B).card : ℝ) / (B : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 ((Nat.totient W : ℝ) / (W : ℝ)))
declarations.docstring: The precise asymptotic proportion used in the strict inclusive constant.

declarations.name: presieved_totient_ratio_gt_one
declarations.signature: theorem presieved_totient_ratio_gt_one (W : ℕ) (hW : 1 < W) : (1 : ℝ) < (W : ℝ) / (Nat.totient W : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: The totient improvement is strictly greater than one whenever W > 1.

declarations.name: exists_presieved_crt_phase
declarations.signature: theorem exists_presieved_crt_phase {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (W : ℕ) (hW : 0 < W) (m offset : ι → ℕ) (hm : ∀ i, 0 < m i) (hpair : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Nat.Coprime (m i) (m j)) (hWm : ∀ i, Nat.Coprime W (m i)) : ∃ x : ℕ, W * (∏ i, m i) ≤ x ∧ x < 2 * (W * (∏ i, m i)) ∧ W ∣ x ∧ ∀ i, m i ∣ x + offset i
declarations.docstring: Bounded CRT with an additional old modulus W and arbitrary assigned (non-consecutive) offsets. No existence of a residue class is assumed.

declarations.name: presieved_phase_covers_admissible
declarations.signature: theorem presieved_phase_covers_admissible (W B x : ℕ) (m : {r // r ∈ presievedOffsets W B} → ℕ) (hWx : W ∣ x) (hphase : ∀ i, m i ∣ x + i.val) (z : ℕ) (hxz : x ≤ z) (hzb : z < x + B) (hcop : Nat.Coprime W z) : ∃ i : {r // r ∈ presievedOffsets W B}, m i ∣ z
declarations.docstring: When x is a multiple of W, an admissible number in its block has a coprime offset and is therefore covered by one of the assigned moduli.

declarations.name: presieved_primitive_record_fence
declarations.signature: theorem presieved_primitive_record_fence (U D : ℕ → ℕ) (W B T x : ℕ) (m : {r // r ∈ presievedOffsets W B} → ℕ) (hm : ∀ i, 1 < m i) (hprimitive : ∀ n, T ≤ n → Nat.Coprime (U n) (D n)) (hWold : ∀ n, T ≤ n → W ∣ D n) (hmOld : ∀ i n, T ≤ n → m i ∣ D n) (hWx : W ∣ x) (hphase : ∀ i, m i ∣ x + i.val) (hprefix : runningMax U T < x) (hcap : ∀ n, T ≤ n → runningMax U n < x + B → runningMax U n < U (n + 1) → U (n + 1) - runningMax U n ≤ B) : ∀ n, U n < x + B
declarations.docstring: A primitive orbit cannot first cross a pre-sieved covered record block with record increments at most B. Arbitrarily deep drawdowns are allowed.

declarations.name: presieved_primitive_record_fence_from_moduli
declarations.signature: theorem presieved_primitive_record_fence_from_moduli (U D : ℕ → ℕ) (W B T : ℕ) (hW : 0 < W) (m : {r // r ∈ presievedOffsets W B} → ℕ) (hm : ∀ i, 1 < m i) (hpair : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Nat.Coprime (m i) (m j)) (hWm : ∀ i, Nat.Coprime W (m i)) (hprimitive : ∀ n, T ≤ n → Nat.Coprime (U n) (D n)) (hWold : ∀ n, T ≤ n → W ∣ D n) (hmOld : ∀ i n, T ≤ n → m i ∣ D n) (hsize : runningMax U T < W * ∏ i, m i) : ∃ x : ℕ, W * (∏ i, m i) ≤ x ∧ x < 2 * (W * (∏ i, m i)) ∧ ((∀ n, T ≤ n → runningMax U n < x + B → runningMax U n < U (n + 1) → U (n + 1) - runningMax U n ≤ B) → ∀ n, U n < x + B)
declarations.docstring: The primitive fence composed with the actual pre-sieved CRT supplier. Its remaining size hypothesis is an explicit finite product comparison.

declarations.name: primitive_multiplier_positive
declarations.signature: theorem primitive_multiplier_positive (a v : ℕ → ℕ) (T : ℕ) (hv : ∀ n, T ≤ n → 0 < v n) (hden : ∀ n, T ≤ n → v (n + 1) = a n * v n) : ∀ n, T ≤ n → 0 < a n
declarations.docstring: Positive next denominators force positive multipliers.

declarations.name: primitive_multiplier_coprime_denominator
declarations.signature: theorem primitive_multiplier_coprime_denominator (a u v : ℕ → ℕ) (T : ℕ) (hnum : ∀ n, T ≤ n → u (n + 1) + v n = a n * u n) (hden : ∀ n, T ≤ n → v (n + 1) = a n * v n) (hcop : ∀ n, T ≤ n → Nat.Coprime (u n) (v n)) : ∀ n, T ≤ n → Nat.Coprime (a n) (v n)
declarations.docstring: A common divisor of a multiplier and its denominator would divide both coordinates at the next state, contradicting the actual primitive tail.

declarations.name: earlier_multiplier_dvd_later_denominator
declarations.signature: theorem earlier_multiplier_dvd_later_denominator (a v : ℕ → ℕ) (T : ℕ) (hden : ∀ n, T ≤ n → v (n + 1) = a n * v n) (i j : ℕ) (hi : T ≤ i) (hij : i < j) : a i ∣ v j
declarations.docstring: Every earlier multiplier divides every later denominator, with the original natural indices retained.

declarations.name: primitive_multipliers_pairwise_coprime
declarations.signature: theorem primitive_multipliers_pairwise_coprime (a u v : ℕ → ℕ) (T : ℕ) (hnum : ∀ n, T ≤ n → u (n + 1) + v n = a n * u n) (hden : ∀ n, T ≤ n → v (n + 1) = a n * v n) (hcop : ∀ n, T ≤ n → Nat.Coprime (u n) (v n)) : ∀ i j, T ≤ i → T ≤ j → i ≠ j → Nat.Coprime (a i) (a j)
declarations.docstring: Actual multipliers at distinct primitive-tail indices are coprime.

declarations.name: multiplier_one_tail_descent
declarations.signature: theorem multiplier_one_tail_descent (a u v : ℕ → ℕ) (T : ℕ) (hnum : ∀ n, T ≤ n → u (n + 1) + v n = a n * u n) (hden : ∀ n, T ≤ n → v (n + 1) = a n * v n) (ha : ∀ n, T ≤ n → a n = 1) : ∀ k : ℕ, u (T + k) + k * v T = u T ∧ v (T + k) = v T
declarations.docstring: Exact descent formula if every multiplier on a tail is one.

declarations.name: primitive_multiplier_arbitrarily_late_nonunit
declarations.signature: theorem primitive_multiplier_arbitrarily_late_nonunit (a u v : ℕ → ℕ) (T : ℕ) (hv : ∀ n, T ≤ n → 0 < v n) (hnum : ∀ n, T ≤ n → u (n + 1) + v n = a n * u n) (hden : ∀ n, T ≤ n → v (n + 1) = a n * v n) (N : ℕ) : ∃ n, max T N ≤ n ∧ 1 < a n
declarations.docstring: Infinitely many actual multipliers exceed one. The argument does not assume growth of the numerator, only positivity of the denominators.

declarations.name: finite_multiplier_divisors_have_bounded_witnesses
declarations.signature: theorem finite_multiplier_divisors_have_bounded_witnesses (a : ℕ → ℕ) (T B : ℕ) : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ p : ℕ, p ≤ B → (∃ i, T ≤ i ∧ p ∣ a i) → ∃ i, T ≤ i ∧ i ≤ N ∧ p ∣ a i
declarations.docstring: For a finite initial segment of possible divisors, all occurring divisors have a bounded-index witness. This finite bound is proved, not postulated.

declarations.name: primitive_multiplier_prime_supply
declarations.signature: theorem primitive_multiplier_prime_supply (a u v : ℕ → ℕ) (T : ℕ) (hv : ∀ n, T ≤ n → 0 < v n) (hnum : ∀ n, T ≤ n → u (n + 1) + v n = a n * u n) (hden : ∀ n, T ≤ n → v (n + 1) = a n * v n) (hcop : ∀ n, T ≤ n → Nat.Coprime (u n) (v n)) (B N : ℕ) : ∃ p j : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ B < p ∧ max T N ≤ j ∧ p ∣ a j
declarations.docstring: Arbitrarily large distinct primes divide arbitrarily late multipliers. Both the size bound and the index bound are independently prescribed.

declarations.name: primitive_zero_density_multiplier_irreducibility
declarations.signature: theorem primitive_zero_density_multiplier_irreducibility (a u v : ℕ → ℕ) (m : ℕ) (c : ℤ) (T : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hv : ∀ n, T ≤ n → 0 < v n) (hnum : ∀ n, T ≤ n → u (n + 1) + v n = a n * u n) (hden : ∀ n, T ≤ n → v (n + 1) = a n * v n) (hcop : ∀ n, T ≤ n → Nat.Coprime (u n) (v n)) (hzero : ZeroLowerDensity {n : ℕ | (u n : ℤ) ≠ (m : ℤ) * risingBinomial n + c}) : (c = 1 ∨ c = -1) ∧ (∀ n, T ≤ n → Nat.Coprime (a n) (v n)) ∧ (∀ i j, T ≤ i → T ≤ j → i ≠ j → Nat.Coprime (a i) (a j)) ∧ (∀ N, ∃ n, max T N ≤ n ∧ 1 < a n) ∧ (∀ B N, ∃ p j : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ B < p ∧ max T N ≤ j ∧ p ∣ a j) ∧ Irreducible (cubicScalePolynomial (6 * (c : ℚ) / (m : ℚ)))
declarations.docstring: The complete multiplier/irreducibility conclusion on the actual primitive zero-density tail. Unit constant and irreducibility are both derived here. The positive scale is a natural number, with its integer cast in the profile.

declarations.name: primitive_zero_density_paper_multiplier_lemma
declarations.signature: theorem primitive_zero_density_paper_multiplier_lemma (a u v : ℕ → ℕ) (m c : ℤ) (T : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hv : ∀ n, T ≤ n → 0 < v n) (hnum : ∀ n, T ≤ n → u (n + 1) + v n = a n * u n) (hden : ∀ n, T ≤ n → v (n + 1) = a n * v n) (hcop : ∀ n, T ≤ n → Nat.Coprime (u n) (v n)) (hzero : ZeroLowerDensity {n : ℕ | (u n : ℤ) ≠ m * risingBinomial n + c}) : (c = 1 ∨ c = -1) ∧ (∀ n, T ≤ n → Nat.Coprime (a n) (v n)) ∧ (∀ i j, T ≤ i → T ≤ j → i ≠ j → Nat.Coprime (a i) (a j)) ∧ (∀ N, ∃ n, max T N ≤ n ∧ 1 < a n) ∧ (∀ B N, ∃ p j : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ B < p ∧ max T N ≤ j ∧ p ∣ a j) ∧ Irreducible (rationalBinomialCubic (m : ℚ) (c : ℚ))
declarations.docstring: Integer-scale form of the full paper lemma, with the exact unshifted polynomial and the original zero-density hypothesis. All scale conversions are performed in the body, and the unit conclusion is proved before use.

declarations.name: twice_index_le_two_pow
declarations.signature: theorem twice_index_le_two_pow (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) : 2 * n ≤ 2 ^ n
declarations.docstring: A convenient elementary bound for a terminal selected multiplier.

declarations.name: primitive_old_factor_coprime
declarations.signature: theorem primitive_old_factor_coprime (a U D : ℕ → ℕ) (hred : ∀ n, Nat.Coprime (U n) (D n)) (hU : ∀ n, U (n + 1) + D n = a n * U n) (hD : ∀ n, D (n + 1) = a n * D n) (W S n : ℕ) (hWS : W ∣ D S) (hSn : S ≤ n) : Nat.Coprime W (a n)
declarations.docstring: An old denominator factor is coprime to every later multiplier of a primitive orbit, with the ordering condition explicitly retained.

declarations.name: no_primitive_totient_record_cap
declarations.signature: theorem no_primitive_totient_record_cap (a U D : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (hUpos : ∀ n, 0 < U n) (hDpos : ∀ n, 0 < D n) (hU : ∀ n, U (n + 1) + D n = a n * U n) (hD : ∀ n, D (n + 1) = a n * D n) (hred : ∀ n, Nat.Coprime (U n) (D n)) (hlower : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ k, 2 * binaryTower k ≤ a (N + k)) (hrecord : ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ n, runningMax U n ≤ 2 ^ (K + n)) (hden : ∃ L : ℕ, ∀ n, D n ≤ binaryTower (n + L)) (hunbounded : ∀ H : ℕ, ∃ n, H ≤ U n) (W S : ℕ) (hW : 1 < W) (hWS : W ∣ D S) (g : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hcW : c * Nat.totient W < W) : ¬ ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ n, T ≤ n → runningMax U n < U (n + 1) → ((U (n + 1) - runningMax U n : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
declarations.docstring: The complete strict boundary for a primitive exact orbit. The coefficient condition is division-free: c*phi(W) < W.

declarations.name: primitive_cofinal_record_exceeds_totient
declarations.signature: theorem primitive_cofinal_record_exceeds_totient (a U D : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (hUpos : ∀ n, 0 < U n) (hDpos : ∀ n, 0 < D n) (hU : ∀ n, U (n + 1) + D n = a n * U n) (hD : ∀ n, D (n + 1) = a n * D n) (hred : ∀ n, Nat.Coprime (U n) (D n)) (hlower : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ k, 2 * binaryTower k ≤ a (N + k)) (hrecord : ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ n, runningMax U n ≤ 2 ^ (K + n)) (hden : ∃ L : ℕ, ∀ n, D n ≤ binaryTower (n + L)) (hunbounded : ∀ H : ℕ, ∃ n, H ≤ U n) (W S : ℕ) (hW : 1 < W) (hWS : W ∣ D S) (g : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hcW : c * Nat.totient W < W) (T : ℕ) : ∃ n, T ≤ n ∧ runningMax U n < U (n + 1) ∧ c * recordLogLog (g * runningMax U n : ℕ) <
declarations.docstring: A fixed old modulus greater than one gives a coefficient strictly above one. This is a statement about every sufficiently late prefix.

declarations.name: ereal_le_limsup_of_cofinal_lt
declarations.signature: theorem ereal_le_limsup_of_cofinal_lt (f : ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (h : ∀ T : ℕ, ∃ n, T ≤ n ∧ c < f n) : (c : EReal) ≤ limsup (fun n ↦ (f n : EReal)) atTop
declarations.docstring: A real threshold exceeded cofinally is below the extended-real limsup.

declarations.name: ereal_le_of_all_real_lt
declarations.signature: theorem ereal_le_of_all_real_lt (x : ℝ) (z : EReal) (h : ∀ c : ℝ, c < x → (c : EReal) ≤ z) : (x : EReal) ≤ z
declarations.docstring: Taking all strict real lower bounds does not require boundedness of the sequence.

declarations.name: ereal_eq_top_of_nonneg_real_bounds
declarations.signature: theorem ereal_eq_top_of_nonneg_real_bounds (z : EReal) (h : ∀ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c → (c : EReal) ≤ z) : z = ⊤
declarations.docstring: The only extended real above every nonnegative real number is positive infinity.

declarations.name: recordLogLogCharge_nonneg
declarations.signature: theorem recordLogLogCharge_nonneg (U : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ recordLogLogCharge U n
declarations.docstring: Nonnegativity of the actual record quotient, also on a drawdown.

declarations.name: recordTheta_nonneg
declarations.signature: theorem recordTheta_nonneg (U : ℕ → ℕ) : (0 : EReal) ≤ recordTheta U

declarations.name: cofinal_charge_of_no_record_cap
declarations.signature: theorem cofinal_charge_of_no_record_cap (U : ℕ → ℕ) (c : ℝ) (h : ¬ ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ n, T ≤ n → runningMax U n < U (n + 1) → ((U (n + 1) - runningMax U n : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ c * recordLogLog (runningMax U n)) : ∀ T : ℕ, ∃ n, T ≤ n ∧ c < recordLogLogCharge U n
declarations.docstring: Absence of an eventual cap gives frequent large values of the original charge.

declarations.name: RecordGrowthOrbit.no_finite_cap_of_unbounded_gcd
declarations.signature: theorem RecordGrowthOrbit.no_finite_cap_of_unbounded_gcd (O : RecordGrowthOrbit) (hG : ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ n, B < Nat.gcd (O.U n) (O.D n)) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) : ¬ ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ n, T ≤ n → runningMax O.U n < O.U (n + 1) → ((O.U (n + 1) - runningMax O.U n : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ c * recordLogLog (runningMax O.U n)
declarations.docstring: Arbitrarily large common divisors exclude every finite nonnegative cap.

declarations.name: RecordGrowthOrbit.recordTheta_eq_top_of_unbounded_gcd
declarations.signature: theorem RecordGrowthOrbit.recordTheta_eq_top_of_unbounded_gcd (O : RecordGrowthOrbit) (hG : ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ n, B < Nat.gcd (O.U n) (O.D n)) : recordTheta O.U = ⊤
declarations.docstring: The unbounded-gcd branch has Theta = positive infinity, not merely Theta > 1.

declarations.name: quotient_dvd_quotient
declarations.signature: theorem quotient_dvd_quotient (d x y : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hdx : d ∣ x) (hxy : x ∣ y) : x / d ∣ y / d
declarations.docstring: Division preserves a divisibility relation when the common factor divides the source.

declarations.name: RecordGrowthOrbit.no_stable_totient_cap
declarations.signature: theorem RecordGrowthOrbit.no_stable_totient_cap (O : RecordGrowthOrbit) (N g : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g) (hstable : ∀ n, N ≤ n → Nat.gcd (O.U n) (O.D n) = g) (T : ℕ) (hNT : N ≤ T) (hW : 1 < O.D T / g) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hcW : c * Nat.totient (O.D T / g) < (g : ℝ) * (O.D T / g : ℕ)) : ¬ ∃ R : ℕ, ∀ n, R ≤ n → runningMax O.U n < O.U (n + 1) → ((O.U (n + 1) - runningMax O.U n : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ c * recordLogLog (runningMax O.U n)
declarations.docstring: Once the gcd stabilises, every old primitive denominator supplies its full coefficient.

declarations.name: RecordGrowthOrbit.stable_totient_le_recordTheta
declarations.signature: theorem RecordGrowthOrbit.stable_totient_le_recordTheta (O : RecordGrowthOrbit) (N g : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g) (hstable : ∀ n, N ≤ n → Nat.gcd (O.U n) (O.D n) = g) (T : ℕ) (hNT : N ≤ T) (hW : 1 < O.D T / g) : (((g : ℝ) * (O.D T / g : ℕ) / Nat.totient (O.D T / g) : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ recordTheta O.U
declarations.docstring: Exact extended-real version of the full stable-gcd lower bound.

declarations.name: RecordGrowthOrbit.late_primitive_denominator_gt_one
declarations.signature: theorem RecordGrowthOrbit.late_primitive_denominator_gt_one (O : RecordGrowthOrbit) (N g : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g) (hstable : ∀ n, N ≤ n → Nat.gcd (O.U n) (O.D n) = g) : ∀ T : ℕ, N + 2 ≤ T → 1 < O.D T / g
declarations.docstring: On a stable-gcd tail the primitive denominator is eventually greater than one.

declarations.name: RecordGrowthOrbit.quantitative_dichotomy
declarations.signature: theorem RecordGrowthOrbit.quantitative_dichotomy (O : RecordGrowthOrbit) : ((∀ B : ℕ, ∃ n, B < Nat.gcd (O.U n) (O.D n)) ∧ recordTheta O.U = ⊤) ∨ ∃ N g : ℕ, 0 < g ∧ (∀ n, N ≤ n → Nat.gcd (O.U n) (O.D n) = g) ∧ (∀ T : ℕ, N + 2 ≤ T → (((g : ℝ) * (O.D T / g : ℕ) / Nat.totient (O.D T / g) : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ recordTheta O.U) ∧ (g : EReal) < recordTheta O.U
declarations.docstring: Both nonterminating arithmetic alternatives, with the every-late-index quantifier.

declarations.name: recordTheta_eq_zero_of_bounded
declarations.signature: theorem recordTheta_eq_zero_of_bounded (U : ℕ → ℕ) (hb : ∃ H : ℕ, ∀ n, U n ≤ H) : recordTheta U = 0
declarations.docstring: Bounded original numerator gives exactly zero record limsup.

declarations.name: canonical_bounded_of_eventual_sylvester
declarations.signature: theorem canonical_bounded_of_eventual_sylvester (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hs : HasSum (fun n ↦ 1 / (a n : ℝ)) ((p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))) (hrec : ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → (a (n + 1) : ℤ) = sylvesterNext (a n : ℤ)) : ∃ H : ℕ, ∀ n, canonicalNaturalNumerator a p q n ≤ H
declarations.docstring: Canonical eventual Sylvester recursion gives a bounded original numerator.

declarations.name: canonical_recordTheta_zero_or_gt_one
declarations.signature: theorem canonical_recordTheta_zero_or_gt_one (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hs : HasSum (fun n ↦ 1 / (a n : ℝ)) ((p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))) (hgrowth : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (a (n + 1) : ℝ) / (a n : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1)) : recordTheta (canonicalNaturalNumerator a p q) = 0 ∨ (1 : EReal) < recordTheta (canonicalNaturalNumerator a p q)
declarations.docstring: The literal zero-versus-strictly-above-one dichotomy, including terminating tails.

declarations.name: canonical_recordTheta_eq_zero_iff
declarations.signature: theorem canonical_recordTheta_eq_zero_iff (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hs : HasSum (fun n ↦ 1 / (a n : ℝ)) ((p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))) (hgrowth : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (a (n + 1) : ℝ) / (a n : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1)) : recordTheta (canonicalNaturalNumerator a p q) = 0 ↔ ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → (a (n + 1) : ℤ) = sylvesterNext (a n : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: Zero record limsup is equivalent to eventual Sylvester recursion under the original hypotheses.

declarations.name: canonical_quantitative_record_dichotomy
declarations.signature: theorem canonical_quantitative_record_dichotomy (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hs : HasSum (fun n ↦ 1 / (a n : ℝ)) ((p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))) (hgrowth : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (a (n + 1) : ℝ) / (a n : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1)) (hnot : ¬ ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → (a (n + 1) : ℤ) = sylvesterNext (a n : ℤ)) : let C
declarations.docstring: The complete quantitative statement on the actual canonical orbit.

declarations.name: sum_mul_product_one_sub_le_one
declarations.signature: theorem sum_mul_product_one_sub_le_one {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (x : ι → ℝ) (h0 : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ x i) (h1 : ∀ i ∈ s, x i ≤ 1) : (1 + ∑ i ∈ s, x i) * (∏ i ∈ s, (1 - x i)) ≤ 1
declarations.docstring: A finite, division-free bound for a product of survival proportions.

declarations.name: sum_div_one_add_sum_le_union
declarations.signature: theorem sum_div_one_add_sum_le_union {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (x : ι → ℝ) (h0 : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ x i) (h1 : ∀ i ∈ s, x i ≤ 1) : (∑ i ∈ s, x i) / (1 + ∑ i ∈ s, x i) ≤ 1 - ∏ i ∈ s, (1 - x i)
declarations.docstring: The complementary union is at least `sum x / (1 + sum x)`.

declarations.name: unbounded_partial_sums_of_nonnegative_not_summable
declarations.signature: theorem unbounded_partial_sums_of_nonnegative_not_summable (x : ℕ → ℝ) (hx : ∀ n, 0 ≤ x n) (hns : ¬ Summable x) : ∀ B : ℝ, ∃ N : ℕ, B < ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, x i
declarations.docstring: Divergence of a nonnegative ordinary series yields explicit finite masses. Here `Summable` is used only for the nonnegative reciprocal-prime series; this lemma is not a replacement for the signed endpoint's ordered hypothesis.

declarations.name: divergent_reciprocal_window_density
declarations.signature: theorem divergent_reciprocal_window_density (p : ℕ → ℕ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 < p i) (hc : Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Nat.Coprime (p i) (p j))) (r : ∀ i, ZMod (p i)) (E : Set ℕ) (L T : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (hdiv : ¬ Summable (fun i ↦ (1 : ℝ) / (p i : ℝ))) (hhit : ∀ i (n : ℕ), T ≤ n → (n : ZMod (p i)) = r i → ∃ j : ℕ, j < L ∧ n + j ∈ E) : LowerDensityAtLeast E (1 / (L : ℝ))
declarations.docstring: A divergent supply of pairwise coprime residue obstructions forces the full `1/L` lower density. No bounded-size-prime premise is required.

declarations.name: runningMax_attained
declarations.signature: theorem runningMax_attained (U : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ∃ j, j ≤ n ∧ U j = runningMax U n
declarations.docstring: The running maximum is an attained value, including at index zero.

declarations.name: common_divisor_persists
declarations.signature: theorem common_divisor_persists (C D a b : ℕ → ℤ) (hC : ∀ n, C (n + 1) = a n * C n - b n * D n) (hD : ∀ n, D (n + 1) = a n * D n) (m : ℤ) {s t : ℕ} (hst : s ≤ t) (hmC : m ∣ C s) (hmD : m ∣ D s) : m ∣ C t ∧ m ∣ D t
declarations.docstring: A common divisor of an exact state survives every subsequent step. The coefficient may be any integer; no positivity is needed.

declarations.name: multiplier_common_divisor_next
declarations.signature: theorem multiplier_common_divisor_next (a C D C' m : ℤ) (hstep : C' = a * C - D) (hma : m ∣ a) (hmD : m ∣ D) : m ∣ C'
declarations.docstring: A divisor of both the old denominator and the current multiplier divides the following numerator. For unit coefficients this gives the pairwise-gcd estimate used in the coprime-core construction.

declarations.name: old_divisor_dvd_record_gap
declarations.signature: theorem old_divisor_dvd_record_gap (U : ℕ → ℕ) (D a b : ℕ → ℤ) (hC : ∀ n, (U (n + 1) : ℤ) = a n * U n - b n * D n) (hD : ∀ n, D (n + 1) = a n * D n) (m : ℤ) {j n : ℕ} (hjn : j ≤ n) (hrecord : U j = runningMax U n) (hmU : m ∣ (U j : ℤ)) (hmD : m ∣ D j) : m ∣ (U (n + 1) : ℤ) - runningMax U n
declarations.docstring: An old divisor found at an *attained previous record* divides the new record gap, even if the source of the new record is far below that record.

declarations.name: first_crossing_record_gap_gt
declarations.signature: theorem first_crossing_record_gap_gt (U : ℕ → ℕ) (D a b : ℕ → ℤ) (T x B n : ℕ) (hC : ∀ k, (U (k + 1) : ℤ) = a k * U k - b k * D k) (hD : ∀ k, D (k + 1) = a k * D k) (hprefix : runningMax U T < x) (hfirst : LcmRecordCrossing.FirstCrossing U (x + B) n) (hcover : ∀ j, T ≤ j → ∀ z : ℕ, x ≤ z → z < x + B → ∃ m : ℤ, (B : ℤ) < m ∧ m ∣ (z : ℤ) ∧ m ∣ D j) : B < U (n + 1) - runningMax U n
declarations.docstring: No first crossing of a covered record block has record increment at most its width. The cover need only hold after the moduli became old.

declarations.name: bounded_by_record_cover
declarations.signature: theorem bounded_by_record_cover (U : ℕ → ℕ) (D a b : ℕ → ℤ) (T x B : ℕ) (hC : ∀ k, (U (k + 1) : ℤ) = a k * U k - b k * D k) (hD : ∀ k, D (k + 1) = a k * D k) (hprefix : runningMax U T < x) (hcover : ∀ j, T ≤ j → ∀ z : ℕ, x ≤ z → z < x + B → ∃ m : ℤ, (B : ℤ) < m ∧ m ∣ (z : ℤ) ∧ m ∣ D j) (hcap : ∀ n, T ≤ n → runningMax U n < x + B → runningMax U n < U (n + 1) → U (n + 1) - runningMax U n ≤ B) : ∀ k, U k < x + B
declarations.docstring: The finite record fence assembled with an actual first crossing. The hypothesis caps record increments, not all source-to-endpoint rises.

declarations.name: runningMax_mul
declarations.signature: theorem runningMax_mul (U : ℕ → ℕ) (g n : ℕ) : runningMax (fun k ↦ g * U k) n = g * runningMax U n
declarations.docstring: Fixed integer scaling commutes with the attained running maximum.

declarations.name: record_increment_mul
declarations.signature: theorem record_increment_mul (U : ℕ → ℕ) (g n : ℕ) : g * U (n + 1) - runningMax (fun k ↦ g * U k) n = g * (U (n + 1) - runningMax U n)
declarations.docstring: Record increments scale exactly; this is independent of an asymptotic normaliser and must precede the analytic log-log rescaling argument.

declarations.name: RecordGrowthOrbit
declarations.docstring: Exact arithmetic and growth data used by both block arguments.

declarations.name: runningMax_mono_index
declarations.signature: theorem runningMax_mono_index (U : ℕ → ℕ) : Monotone (runningMax U)
declarations.docstring: Monotonicity in the index, as distinct from monotonicity of the orbit.

declarations.name: exists_late_attained_record
declarations.signature: theorem exists_late_attained_record (U : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : ∀ H : ℕ, ∃ n, H ≤ U n) (S : ℕ) : ∃ s, S ≤ s ∧ U s = runningMax U s
declarations.docstring: Every index has a later index which attains a global record.

declarations.name: runningMax_shift_at_record
declarations.signature: theorem runningMax_shift_at_record (U : ℕ → ℕ) (s : ℕ) (hs : U s = runningMax U s) (n : ℕ) : runningMax (fun j ↦ U (s + j)) n = runningMax U (s + n)
declarations.docstring: Starting at an attained global record does not reset the past maximum.

declarations.name: runningMax_shift_div_le
declarations.signature: theorem runningMax_shift_div_le (U : ℕ → ℕ) (s g n : ℕ) : runningMax (fun j ↦ U (s + j) / g) n ≤ runningMax U (s + n)
declarations.docstring: A quotient tail's running maximum is bounded by the actual global maximum, without requiring the quotient itself to be monotone.

declarations.name: RecordGrowthOrbit.common_divisor_tail
declarations.signature: theorem RecordGrowthOrbit.common_divisor_tail (O : RecordGrowthOrbit) (s g : ℕ) (hUg : g ∣ O.U s) (hDg : g ∣ O.D s) : ∀ n, g ∣ O.U (s + n) ∧ g ∣ O.D (s + n)
declarations.docstring: Common divisors persist in natural coordinates on the entire tail.

declarations.name: RecordGrowthOrbit.quotientAt
declarations.signature: def RecordGrowthOrbit.quotientAt (O : RecordGrowthOrbit) (s g : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g) (hUg : g ∣ O.U s) (hDg : g ∣ O.D s) : RecordGrowthOrbit
declarations.docstring: The exact quotient orbit, with every positivity and growth property proved from the original orbit.

declarations.name: RecordGrowthOrbit.quotient_record_exact
declarations.signature: theorem RecordGrowthOrbit.quotient_record_exact (O : RecordGrowthOrbit) (s g : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g) (hUg : g ∣ O.U s) (hDg : g ∣ O.D s) (hs : O.U s = runningMax O.U s) (n : ℕ) : runningMax O.U (s + n) = g * runningMax (O.quotientAt s g hg hUg hDg).U n
declarations.docstring: Exact equality of the global record with the scaled quotient record.

declarations.name: RecordGrowthOrbit.quotient_record_cap
declarations.signature: theorem RecordGrowthOrbit.quotient_record_cap (O : RecordGrowthOrbit) (s g : ℕ) (hg : 0 < g) (hUg : g ∣ O.U s) (hDg : g ∣ O.D s) (hs : O.U s = runningMax O.U s) (c : ℝ) (T : ℕ) (hcap : ∀ n, T ≤ n → runningMax O.U n < O.U (n + 1) → ((O.U (n + 1) - runningMax O.U n : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ c * recordLogLog (runningMax O.U n)) : let V
declarations.docstring: An eventual global record cap passes to the quotient with coefficient c/g and with the *scaled* normaliser. No asymptotic scaling identity is assumed.

declarations.name: eventual_quadratic_budget
declarations.signature: theorem eventual_quadratic_budget (c : ℝ) (d e F : ℕ) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hslack : c * d < e) : ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, K ≤ k → c * ((d : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) ^ 2 + k + F) ≤ (e : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) ^ 2
declarations.docstring: One explicit Archimedean choice controls all later quadratic budgets. The finite prefix and the fixed log-log scaling shift occur in `F`.

declarations.name: no_subcritical_record_cap
declarations.signature: theorem no_subcritical_record_cap (a U D : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (hUpos : ∀ n, 0 < U n) (hDpos : ∀ n, 0 < D n) (hU : ∀ n, U (n + 1) + D n = a n * U n) (hD : ∀ n, D (n + 1) = a n * D n) (hlower : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ k, 2 * binaryTower k ≤ a (N + k)) (hrecord : ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ n, runningMax U n ≤ 2 ^ (K + n)) (hden : ∃ L : ℕ, ∀ n, D n ≤ binaryTower (n + L)) (hunbounded : ∀ H : ℕ, ∃ n, H ≤ U n) (g : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c < 1) : ¬ ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ n, T ≤ n → runningMax U n < U (n + 1) → ((U (n + 1) - runningMax U n : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ c * recordLogLog (g * runningMax U n : ℕ)
declarations.docstring: There is no eventual record cap of coefficient less than one on an unbounded exact orbit with the stated, explicit growth estimates.

declarations.name: cofinal_record_exceeds_subcritical_logLog
declarations.signature: theorem cofinal_record_exceeds_subcritical_logLog (a U D : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (hUpos : ∀ n, 0 < U n) (hDpos : ∀ n, 0 < D n) (hU : ∀ n, U (n + 1) + D n = a n * U n) (hD : ∀ n, D (n + 1) = a n * D n) (hlower : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ k, 2 * binaryTower k ≤ a (N + k)) (hrecord : ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ n, runningMax U n ≤ 2 ^ (K + n)) (hden : ∃ L : ℕ, ∀ n, D n ≤ binaryTower (n + L)) (hunbounded : ∀ H : ℕ, ∃ n, H ≤ U n) (g : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c < 1) (T : ℕ) : ∃ n, T ≤ n ∧ runningMax U n < U (n + 1) ∧ c * recordLogLog (g * runningMax U n : ℕ) < ((U (n + 1) - runningMax U n : ℕ) : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: The lower-bound conclusion is cofinal in the original index, not merely an assertion about a newly chosen subsequence of records.

declarations.name: canonical_cofinal_subcritical_record
declarations.signature: theorem canonical_cofinal_subcritical_record (a : ℕ → ℕ) (ha : StrictMono a) (hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hs : HasSum (fun n ↦ 1 / (a n : ℝ)) ((p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))) (hgrowth : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (a (n + 1) : ℝ) / (a n : ℝ) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1)) (hunbounded : ∀ H : ℕ, ∃ n, H ≤ canonicalNaturalNumerator a p q n) (g : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c < 1) (T : ℕ) : ∃ n, T ≤ n ∧ runningMax (canonicalNaturalNumerator a p q) n < canonicalNaturalNumerator a p q (n + 1) ∧ c * recordLogLog (g * runningMax (canonicalNaturalNumerator a p q) n : ℕ) < ((canonicalNaturalNumerator a p q (n + 1) - runningMax (canonicalNaturalNumerator a p q) n : ℕ) : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: Canonical specialisation: neither a block supplier nor a denominator or numerator growth bound is assumed in addition to the actual series.

declarations.name: mixedCharge
declarations.signature: noncomputable def mixedCharge (U rho : ℕ → ℕ) (B : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ

declarations.name: rawCharge
declarations.signature: noncomputable def rawCharge (U rho : ℕ → ℕ) (B : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ

declarations.name: mixedCharge_nonneg
declarations.signature: theorem mixedCharge_nonneg (U rho : ℕ → ℕ) (B : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ u, 0 ≤ f u) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ mixedCharge U rho B f n

declarations.name: rawCharge_nonneg
declarations.signature: theorem rawCharge_nonneg (U rho : ℕ → ℕ) (B : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ u, 0 ≤ f u) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ rawCharge U rho B f n

declarations.name: mixedCharge_le_rawCharge
declarations.signature: theorem mixedCharge_le_rawCharge (U rho : ℕ → ℕ) (B : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ u, 0 ≤ f u) (n : ℕ) (hrho : 1 ≤ rho n) (hlarge : IsStrictRecord U n → B ≤ U (n + 1)) : mixedCharge U rho B f n ≤ rawCharge U rho B f n
declarations.docstring: At overlap records above the baseline, raw error pays the record gain. Fresh records have identical mixed and raw charge.

declarations.name: rawCharge_eq_error
declarations.signature: theorem rawCharge_eq_error (U rho : ℕ → ℕ) (V : ℕ → ℤ) (B : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hstep : (rho n : ℤ) * U (n + 1) = (U n : ℤ) - V n) : rawCharge U rho B f n = if IsStrictRecord U n then ((max (-V n - (B : ℤ)) 0 : ℤ) : ℝ) * f (U n) else 0
declarations.docstring: Identification with the paper's integer positive part, rather than assuming that the source-to-endpoint jump is the raw error.

declarations.name: progression_card_le_record_increment
declarations.signature: theorem progression_card_le_record_increment (s : Finset ℕ) (x P R y : ℕ) (hP : 0 < P) (hlo : ∀ k ∈ s, R < x + k * P) (hhi : ∀ k ∈ s, x + k * P ≤ y) : s.card ≤ y - R
declarations.docstring: Spaced first-crossed walls cost no more than the record increment. This estimate does not charge a repeated crossing after a drawdown.

declarations.name: finite_mixed_record_bound
declarations.signature: theorem finite_mixed_record_bound (s : Finset ℕ) (U rho : ℕ → ℕ) (a b L : ℕ → ℤ) (T x P B N : ℕ) (hP : B < P) (hprefix : runningMax U T < x) (hN : ∀ k ∈ s, ∃ j ≤ N, x + k * P ≤ U j) (hstep : ∀ n, (rho n : ℤ) * U (n + 1) = a n * U n - b n * L n) (hcover : ∀ n, T ≤ n → rho n = 1 → ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ z : ℤ, ((x + k * P : ℕ) : ℤ) - B ≤ z → z < ((x + k * P : ℕ) : ℤ) → ∃ m : ℤ, (B : ℤ) < m ∧ m ∣ L n ∧ m ∣ z) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : Antitone f) (hpos : ∀ u, 0 ≤ f u) : ∑ k ∈ s, f (x + k * P) ≤ ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, mixedCharge U rho B f n
declarations.docstring: The complete finite first-crossing partition for a mixed charge. Old covering is required only at fresh steps and only after its supply time T.

declarations.name: DivergesOnProgressions
declarations.docstring: The exact discrete condition consumed by the global arithmetic proof.

declarations.name: not_summable_mixed_of_cover
declarations.signature: theorem not_summable_mixed_of_cover (U rho : ℕ → ℕ) (a b L : ℕ → ℤ) (T x P B : ℕ) (hP : B < P) (hprefix : runningMax U T < x) (hunbounded : ∀ H : ℕ, ∃ n, H ≤ U n) (hstep : ∀ n, (rho n : ℤ) * U (n + 1) = a n * U n - b n * L n) (hcover : ∀ n, T ≤ n → rho n = 1 → ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ z : ℤ, ((x + k * P : ℕ) : ℤ) - B ≤ z → z < ((x + k * P : ℕ) : ℤ) → ∃ m : ℤ, (B : ℤ) < m ∧ m ∣ L n ∧ m ∣ z) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : Antitone f) (hpos : ∀ u, 0 ≤ f u) (hdiv : ¬ Summable (fun k : ℕ ↦ f (x + k * P))) : ¬ Summable (mixedCharge U rho B f)
declarations.docstring: Summable mixed charges would make every covered progression summable. First crossings are constructed from unboundedness, not supplied as a budget.

declarations.name: fresh_steps_supply_old_moduli
declarations.signature: theorem fresh_steps_supply_old_moduli (q : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℕ) (B : ℕ) (ha : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n, N ≤ n → 2 ≤ a n) (hcofinal : ∀ T : ℕ, ∃ n, T ≤ n ∧ lcmOverlap q a n = 1) : ∃ T : ℕ, ∃ m : Fin B → ℕ, (∀ i, B < m i) ∧ (∀ i j, i ≠ j → Nat.Coprime (m i) (m j)) ∧ (∀ i n, T ≤ n → m i ∣ cumulativeDigitLcm q a n)
declarations.docstring: Cofinal fresh steps supply a finite family of arbitrarily large, pairwise-coprime old divisors. Only an eventual lower bound of two is required; an initial digit of one is allowed.

declarations.name: actual_lcm_covering
declarations.signature: theorem actual_lcm_covering (q : ℕ) (a U : ℕ → ℕ) (B : ℕ) (ha : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n, N ≤ n → 2 ≤ a n) : ∃ T x P : ℕ, B < P ∧ runningMax U T < x ∧ ∀ n, T ≤ n → lcmOverlap q a n = 1 → ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ z : ℤ, ((x + k * P : ℕ) : ℤ) - B ≤ z → z < ((x + k * P : ℕ) : ℤ) → ∃ m : ℤ, (B : ℤ) < m ∧ m ∣ (cumulativeDigitLcm q a n : ℤ) ∧ m ∣ z
declarations.docstring: The old covering required by the finite proof always exists: either fresh steps cease, making its fresh-only condition vacuous, or CRT supplies it from actual fresh digits. This is the global supplier, not a new premise.

declarations.name: unbounded_not_summable_mixed
declarations.signature: theorem unbounded_not_summable_mixed (q : ℕ) (a U : ℕ → ℕ) (b : ℕ → ℤ) (B : ℕ) (ha : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n, N ≤ n → 2 ≤ a n) (hstep : ∀ n, (lcmOverlap q a n : ℤ) * U (n + 1) = (a n : ℤ) * U n - b n * (cumulativeDigitLcm q a n : ℤ)) (hunbounded : ∀ H : ℕ, ∃ n, H ≤ U n) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : Antitone f) (hpos : ∀ u, 0 ≤ f u) (hdiv : DivergesOnProgressions f) : ¬ Summable (mixedCharge U (lcmOverlap q a) B f)
declarations.docstring: Unbounded actual LCM height forces divergent mixed charge for every fixed baseline. This is coefficient-uniform and has no centring condition.

declarations.name: eventually_no_records_of_bounded
declarations.signature: theorem eventually_no_records_of_bounded (U : ℕ → ℕ) (hbounded : ∃ H : ℕ, ∀ n, U n ≤ H) : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n, N ≤ n → ¬ IsStrictRecord U n
declarations.docstring: Bounded integer height has no late strict records. Repeated visits to a height do not create new records, so boundedness really gives finite support.

declarations.name: summable_of_nonneg_of_eventual_le
declarations.signature: theorem summable_of_nonneg_of_eventual_le (f g : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) (hg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ g n) (hgs : Summable g) (hbound : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n, N ≤ n → f n ≤ g n) : Summable f
declarations.docstring: A finite-prefix comparison avoids making an unjustified all-indices claim when raw and mixed charges agree only above a height cutoff.

declarations.name: bounded_iff_summable_mixed
declarations.signature: theorem bounded_iff_summable_mixed (q : ℕ) (a U : ℕ → ℕ) (b : ℕ → ℤ) (B : ℕ) (ha : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n, N ≤ n → 2 ≤ a n) (hstep : ∀ n, (lcmOverlap q a n : ℤ) * U (n + 1) = (a n : ℤ) * U n - b n * (cumulativeDigitLcm q a n : ℤ)) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : Antitone f) (hpos : ∀ u, 0 ≤ f u) (hdiv : DivergesOnProgressions f) : (∃ H : ℕ, ∀ n, U n ≤ H) ↔ Summable (mixedCharge U (lcmOverlap q a) B f)
declarations.docstring: Bounded height is equivalent to summability of mixed charge, for each fixed baseline. The reverse direction constructs the required CRT supply.

declarations.name: bounded_iff_summable_raw
declarations.signature: theorem bounded_iff_summable_raw (q : ℕ) (a U : ℕ → ℕ) (b : ℕ → ℤ) (B : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (ha : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n, N ≤ n → 2 ≤ a n) (hstep : ∀ n, (lcmOverlap q a n : ℤ) * U (n + 1) = (a n : ℤ) * U n - b n * (cumulativeDigitLcm q a n : ℤ)) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : Antitone f) (hpos : ∀ u, 0 ≤ f u) (hdiv : DivergesOnProgressions f) : (∃ H : ℕ, ∀ n, U n ≤ H) ↔ Summable (rawCharge U (lcmOverlap q a) B f)
declarations.docstring: The global raw-charge equivalence, without centring or coefficient sign restrictions. The finitely many record endpoints below B are explicit.

declarations.name: mixed_summable_iff_raw_summable
declarations.signature: theorem mixed_summable_iff_raw_summable (q : ℕ) (a U : ℕ → ℕ) (b : ℕ → ℤ) (B : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (ha : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n, N ≤ n → 2 ≤ a n) (hstep : ∀ n, (lcmOverlap q a n : ℤ) * U (n + 1) = (a n : ℤ) * U n - b n * (cumulativeDigitLcm q a n : ℤ)) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : Antitone f) (hpos : ∀ u, 0 ≤ f u) (hdiv : DivergesOnProgressions f) : Summable (mixedCharge U (lcmOverlap q a) B f) ↔ Summable (rawCharge U (lcmOverlap q a) B f)
declarations.docstring: Mixed and raw charges have the same summability class for actual LCM feedback, even though the two charges need not be asymptotically equal.

declarations.name: LowerDensityAtLeast
declarations.signature: def LowerDensityAtLeast (E : Set ℕ) (d : ℝ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: Literal eventual-prefix formulation of a lower asymptotic density bound.

declarations.name: window_incidence_bound
declarations.signature: theorem window_incidence_bound (A : Finset ℕ) (E : Set ℕ) (L X : ℕ) (hhit : ∀ n ∈ A, ∃ i : ℕ, i < L ∧ n + i < X ∧ n + i ∈ E) : A.card ≤ L * exceptionCount E X
declarations.docstring: Charge each centre to a hit and its offset. This remains valid when the windows overlap arbitrarily. The target prefix is supplied explicitly.

declarations.name: residue_rectangle_card
declarations.signature: theorem residue_rectangle_card (M T K : ℕ) (R : Finset ℕ) (hR : ∀ r ∈ R, r < M) : ((Finset.range K ×ˢ R).image (fun kr ↦ (T + kr.1) * M + kr.2)).card = K * R.card
declarations.docstring: A whole rectangle of residue centres has exactly the expected cardinality. The proof uses the quotient and remainder, not an informal independence claim.

declarations.name: residue_window_linear_bound
declarations.signature: theorem residue_window_linear_bound (E : Set ℕ) (M L T : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M) (R : Finset ℕ) (hR : ∀ r ∈ R, r < M) (hhit : ∀ n : ℕ, T ≤ n → n % M ∈ R → ∃ i : ℕ, i < L ∧ n + i ∈ E) : ∀ X : ℕ, R.card * X ≤ M * L * exceptionCount E X + R.card * (M * T + M + L)
declarations.docstring: Simultaneous residue obstructions give a finite quantitative inequality. Each residue starts one length-`L` obstruction per period `M`. The constant accounts for the initial segment, an incomplete period, and the right edge.

declarations.name: lowerDensityAtLeast_of_linear_bound

declarations.docstring: Convert an explicit real linear counting inequality into lower density.

declarations.name: residue_window_lower_density

declarations.name: zero_lower_density_forces_modular_root_square

declarations.name: summable_cubicRelativeError_of_scaled_tendsto_zero
