Along the exact product-cleared reciprocal-tail orbit, division-free normalized vanishing and summable normalized negative centered mass force the original denominators to satisfy the Sylvester recurrence eventually.

declarations.name: bounded_of_summable_negativeRelativeMass
declarations.signature: theorem bounded_of_summable_negativeRelativeMass (C : ℕ → ℕ) (E : ℕ → ℤ) (hCpos : ∀ n, 0 < C n) (hstep : ∀ n, (C (n + 1) : ℤ) = (C n : ℤ) - E n) (hsum : Summable (negativeRelativeMass C E)) : ∃ M : ℕ, ∀ n, C n ≤ M

declarations.name: eventually_zero_of_summable_negativeRelativeMass_scalar
declarations.signature: theorem eventually_zero_of_summable_negativeRelativeMass_scalar (C : ℕ → ℕ) (E : ℕ → ℤ) (hCpos : ∀ n, 0 < C n) (hstep : ∀ n, (C (n + 1) : ℤ) = (C n : ℤ) - E n) (hsum : Summable (negativeRelativeMass C E)) : ∃ N, ∀ n, N ≤ n → E n = 0
declarations.docstring: Finite negative mass forces an eventually constant positive integer tail, with no normalised-vanishing or multiplier hypothesis.

declarations.name: sylvesterNext_eventually_of_summable_negativeRelativeMass_scalar
declarations.signature: theorem sylvesterNext_eventually_of_summable_negativeRelativeMass_scalar (a D : ℕ → ℤ) (C : ℕ → ℕ) (hD : ∀ n, D (n + 1) = nextDenState (a n) (D n)) (hC : ∀ n, (C (n + 1) : ℤ) = nextTailState (a n) (D n) (C n)) (hCpos : ∀ n, 0 < C n) (hstep : ∀ n, (C (n + 1) : ℤ) = (C n : ℤ) - centeredState (a n) (D n) (C n)) (hsum : Summable (negativeRelativeMass C (fun n ↦ centeredState (a n) (D n) (C n)))) :
declarations.docstring: Exact-orbit consumer: finite negative mass forces the Sylvester recurrence with no normalised-vanishing hypothesis.

declarations.name: nonfresh_record_pays
declarations.signature: theorem nonfresh_record_pays (u R y rho B : ℤ) (huR : u ≤ R) (hy : 0 < y) (hrho : 2 ≤ rho) (hyB : B ≤ y) : y - R ≤ rho * y - u - B
declarations.docstring: An overlap record pays its new height from raw error, once its endpoint is at least the fixed baseline. No centring hypothesis occurs.

declarations.name: raw_error_eq_jump_add_overlap
declarations.signature: theorem raw_error_eq_jump_add_overlap (u y rho : ℤ) : rho * y - u = (y - u) + (rho - 1) * y
declarations.docstring: Separate actual jump from overlap cost.

declarations.name: fresh_crossing_exceeds_baseline
declarations.signature: theorem fresh_crossing_exceeds_baseline (u y L a b tau B : ℤ) (hsource : u < tau) (hcross : tau ≤ y) (hstep : y = a * u - b * L) (hcover : ∀ z : ℤ, tau - B ≤ z → z < tau → ∃ m : ℤ, B < m ∧ m ∣ L ∧ m ∣ z) : B < y - u
declarations.docstring: A covered first crossing at a fresh step has jump above the baseline, independently of the coefficient b.

declarations.name: crossed_heights_card_le_record_increment
declarations.signature: theorem crossed_heights_card_le_record_increment (walls : Finset ℕ) (R y : ℕ) (hmem : ∀ t ∈ walls, R < t ∧ t ≤ y) : walls.card ≤ y - R
declarations.docstring: First-crossed integral heights at an overlap record cost no more than its record increment. The enclosing interval is (R,y], not (u,y].

declarations.name: coefficient_of_divisible_positive_difference
declarations.signature: theorem coefficient_of_divisible_positive_difference (a U v L : ℤ) (hL : 0 < L) (hpos : v < a * U) (hdiv : L ∣ a * U - v) : ∃ b : ℤ, 0 < b ∧ v = a * U - b * L
declarations.docstring: The last step of the local realisation lemma: an integral positive coefficient exists once the congruence and the size inequality are supplied. The prime in the required residue class is an external Dirichlet input.

declarations.name: bounded_of_old_coprime_moduli
declarations.signature: theorem bounded_of_old_coprime_moduli (a b L U rho : ℕ → ℤ) (B : ℕ) (m : Fin B → ℕ) (hm : ∀ i, B < m i) (hpair : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Nat.Coprime (m i) (m j)) (hU : ∀ n, 0 < U n) (hrho : ∀ n, 1 ≤ rho n) (hcap : ∀ n, rho n * U (n + 1) ≤ U n + B) (hstep : ∀ n, rho n * U (n + 1) = a n * U n - b n * L n) (hmL : ∀ n i, (m i : ℤ) ∣ L n) : ∃ H : ℤ, ∀ n, U n < H
declarations.docstring: Compose the already-supplied CRT covering with the already-checked coefficient fence. This discharges the finite covering hypothesis from an actual old pairwise-coprime family; it does not produce that family from an infinite orbit. All hypotheses apply on the chosen shifted tail.

declarations.name: deletionProduct
declarations.signature: def deletionProduct (c : ℕ → ℕ) (s t : ℕ) : ℕ
declarations.docstring: Product of the primitive-denominator factors deleted on `[s,t)`.

declarations.name: scaleProduct
declarations.signature: def scaleProduct (h : ℕ → ℕ) (s t : ℕ) : ℕ
declarations.docstring: Product of the exact common-scale growth factors on `[s,t)`.

declarations.name: repairedAt
declarations.signature: def repairedAt (c : ℕ → ℕ) (s t m : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: An initial modulus is repaired by time `t` when all of its prime-power debt occurs in the deletion product on `[s,t)`.

declarations.name: survivorSteps
declarations.signature: def survivorSteps (c : ℕ → ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ | _, 0, m => m | s, k + 1, m => survivorSteps c (s + 1) k (m / Nat.gcd m (c s)) /-- At one deletion step, the part of `m` not removed
declarations.docstring: Recursive survivor after `k` exact denominator-deletion steps. This is the proof-friendly form of `m / gcd(m, deletionProduct c s (s+k))`.

declarations.name: survivor_oneStep_dvd
declarations.signature: theorem survivor_oneStep_dvd {m c v : ℕ} (hmv : m ∣ v) (hcv : c ∣ v) : m / Nat.gcd m c ∣ v / c
declarations.docstring: At one deletion step, the part of `m` not removed by `c` still divides the quotient denominator.

declarations.name: survivor_interval_dvd_denominator
declarations.signature: theorem survivor_interval_dvd_denominator (c α v : ℕ → ℕ) (hcdvd : ∀ n, c n ∣ v n) (hstep : ∀ n, v (n + 1) = α n * (v n / c n)) : ∀ {s k m}, m ∣ v s → survivorSteps c s k m ∣ v (s + k)
declarations.docstring: Iterating the one-step survivor lemma preserves a divisor of every later primitive denominator.

declarations.name: deletionProduct_sq_dvd_scaleProduct
declarations.signature: theorem deletionProduct_sq_dvd_scaleProduct (c h : ℕ → ℕ) (s t : ℕ) (hsq : ∀ n ∈ Finset.Ico s t, c n ^ 2 ∣ h n) : deletionProduct c s t ^ 2 ∣ scaleProduct h s t
declarations.docstring: Squared local deletion charges multiply without loss over an interval.

declarations.name: repairedFamily_lcm_dvd_deletionProduct
declarations.signature: theorem repairedFamily_lcm_dvd_deletionProduct {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (R : Finset ι) (m : ι → ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℕ) (s t : ℕ) (hrepair : ∀ r ∈ R, repairedAt c s t (m r)) : R.lcm m ∣ deletionProduct c s t
declarations.docstring: The lcm of any finite repaired family divides the total deletion product. Overlapping prime demands are therefore charged by a maximum valuation, exactly as lcm requires.

declarations.name: repairedFamily_lcm_sq_dvd_scaleGrowth
declarations.signature: theorem repairedFamily_lcm_sq_dvd_scaleGrowth {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (R : Finset ι) (m : ι → ℕ) (c h : ℕ → ℕ) (s t : ℕ) (hrepair : ∀ r ∈ R, repairedAt c s t (m r)) (hsq : ∀ n ∈ Finset.Ico s t, c n ^ 2 ∣ h n) : (R.lcm m) ^ 2 ∣ scaleProduct h s t
declarations.docstring: A repaired family pays the square of its transversal lcm into exact scale growth.

declarations.name: blockRepair_product_sq_dvd
declarations.signature: theorem blockRepair_product_sq_dvd (M Λ : ℕ → ℕ) (episodes : Finset ℕ) (hpay : ∀ i ∈ episodes, M i ^ 2 ∣ Λ i) : (∏ i ∈ episodes, M i) ^ 2 ∣ ∏ i ∈ episodes, Λ i
declarations.docstring: Square repair payments also compose over disjoint episodes; no coprimality between episode lcms is needed.

declarations.name: CRTBarrier
declarations.docstring: A finite CRT barrier attached to the primitive numerator/denominator coordinates at one state.

declarations.name: jumpBound
declarations.signature: def jumpBound (u : ℕ → ℕ) (s τ J : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: A uniform upper bound on positive one-step motion before a crossing.

declarations.name: firstCrossing_repairTransversal
declarations.signature: theorem firstCrossing_repairTransversal (u v c : ℕ → ℕ) (B : CRTBarrier u v) (τ J K : ℕ) (hstart : B.start < τ) (hcross : B.x + B.length ≤ u τ) (hjump : jumpBound u B.start τ J) (hblocks : K * J ≤ B.length) (hforbidden : ∀ (r : Fin B.length) t, B.start < t → t < τ → ¬ repairedAt c B.start (τ - 1) (B.modulus r) → u t ≠ B.x + r.1) : ∃ r : Fin K → Fin B.length, (∀ q, q.1 * J ≤ (r q).1 ∧ (r q).1 < (q.1 + 1) * J) ∧ ∀ q, repairedAt c B.start (τ - 1) (B.modulus (r q))
declarations.docstring: The combinatorial core of the repaired-transversal theorem. At a first crossing, every complete `J`-block contains a visited slot. If unrepaired slots are forbidden, each selected slot is repaired before the crossing.

declarations.name: firstCrossing_repairTransversal_floor
declarations.signature: theorem firstCrossing_repairTransversal_floor (u v c : ℕ → ℕ) (B : CRTBarrier u v) (τ J : ℕ) (hstart : B.start < τ) (hcross : B.x + B.length ≤ u τ) (hjump : jumpBound u B.start τ J) (hforbidden : ∀ (r : Fin B.length) t, B.start < t → t < τ → ¬ repairedAt c B.start (τ - 1) (B.modulus r) → u t ≠ B.x + r.1) : ∃ r : Fin (B.length / J) → Fin B.length, (∀ q, q.1 * J ≤ (r q).1 ∧ (r q).1 < (q.1 + 1) * J) ∧ ∀ q, repairedAt c B.start (τ - 1) (B.modulus (r q))
declarations.docstring: Floor-count form of `firstCrossing_repairTransversal`: the complete blocks are exactly the first `length / J` jump-width blocks.

declarations.name: prefixMultiplierProduct_le_cube
declarations.signature: theorem prefixMultiplierProduct_le_cube (a : ℕ → ℕ) (N : ℕ) (hpos : ∀ n, N ≤ n → 0 < a n) (hgrowth : ∀ n, N ≤ n → a n ^ 3 ≤ a (n + 1) ^ 2) : ∀ k, (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), a (N + i)) ≤ a (N + k) ^ 3
declarations.docstring: Whole-multiplier lacunarity bounds the product of every initial segment by the cube of its final multiplier.

declarations.name: trueDeletion_sq_mul_next_lt_two_mul_current
declarations.signature: theorem trueDeletion_sq_mul_next_lt_two_mul_current {b c uNext u paid : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hstep : b * c ^ 2 * uNext = paid) (hcenter : paid < 2 * u) : c ^ 2 * uNext < 2 * u
declarations.docstring: Exact normal-form data imply the square deletion inequality.

declarations.name: trueDeletion_halves_primitiveNumerator
declarations.signature: theorem trueDeletion_halves_primitiveNumerator {c uNext u : ℕ} (hc : 2 ≤ c) (hdelete : c ^ 2 * uNext < 2 * u) : 2 * uNext < u
declarations.docstring: Every genuine deletion more than halves the primitive numerator.

declarations.name: mersenneLayer
declarations.docstring: The cyclotomic layer for the exact polynomial `X - 2`.

declarations.name: prime_index_dvd_pred
declarations.signature: theorem prime_index_dvd_pred {q p : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (hp : p.Prime) (hdiv : p ∣ mersenneLayer q) : q ∣ p - 1
declarations.docstring: A prime divisor of the prime-index Mersenne layer has exact order `q` for the residue of `2`, and hence is congruent to `1` modulo `q`.

declarations.name: mersenneLayer_orderConsumer
declarations.docstring: Exact degree-one order consumer for the polynomial `X - 2`.

declarations.name: mersenneLayer_layerSupply
declarations.docstring: Prime-index Mersenne layers are nontrivial and coprime to their index.

declarations.name: mersenneLayer_unboundedPrimeDivisorSupply
declarations.docstring: **Unconditional unbounded prime support for the exact `X - 2` layers.** For every size bound and every lower bound on the prime index, a remote prime-index Mersenne layer has a prime divisor exceeding the size bound.

declarations.name: totientBlock
declarations.docstring: The first `H` totient-tail letters at `N`, cleared by `2^H`.

declarations.name: mersenne_mul_tail_eq_block_add_diff
declarations.signature: theorem mersenne_mul_tail_eq_block_add_diff (H N : ℕ) : ((2 : ℝ) ^ H - 1) * totientTail N = (totientBlock H N : ℝ) + (totientTail (N + H) - totientTail N)
declarations.docstring: Exact finite-block identity: `(2^H-1) R_N = Q_(H,N) + (R_(N+H)-R_N)`.

declarations.name: totientBlock_succ
declarations.signature: theorem totientBlock_succ (H N : ℕ) : totientBlock H (N + 1) = 2 * totientBlock H N - ((2 : ℤ) ^ H - 1) * (Nat.totient (N + 1) : ℤ) + deltaTotient H (N + 1)
declarations.docstring: Sliding the finite Mersenne block by one obeys the same affine recurrence as the carry, up to the exact multiple `(2^H-1) * φ(N+1)`.

declarations.name: carryOrbit_modEq_neg_totientBlock_shift
declarations.signature: theorem carryOrbit_modEq_neg_totientBlock_shift {H N p : ℕ} {d : ℤ} (hpM : p ∣ 2 ^ H - 1) (hmod : Int.ModEq (p : ℤ) d (-totientBlock H N)) : ∀ i : ℕ, Int.ModEq (p : ℤ) (carryOrbit H N d i) (-totientBlock H (N + i))
declarations.docstring: The prime-filtered residue propagates at every carry depth. Thus the endpoint is simultaneously constrained modulo the Mersenne prime and, through the ordinary carry reset, modulo the relevant power of two.

declarations.name: primeBasepointFiltered_survivor_at_three_unique
declarations.signature: theorem primeBasepointFiltered_survivor_at_three_unique {H N p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hNp : N < p) (hH : H ≤ p - 1) {z w : ℤ} (hzMod : Int.ModEq (p : ℤ) z (-totientBlock H N)) (hwMod : Int.ModEq (p : ℤ) w (-totientBlock H N)) (hzSurv : |carryOrbit H N z 3| ≤ (N + H + 4 : ℤ)) (hwSurv : |carryOrbit H N w 3| ≤ (N + H + 4 : ℤ)) : z = w
declarations.docstring: **Product-modulus four-to-one collapse at a free basepoint.** Under the large-prime geometry `N < p` and `H ≤ p-1`, two states in the same prime-filtered class cannot both remain in the sharp strip through depth three. Their initial spacing is a nonzero multiple of `p`; the dyadic carry multiplies it by `8`, beyond the combined width of the two endpoint strips.

declarations.name: modulusFiltered_survivor_unique
declarations.signature: theorem modulusFiltered_survivor_unique {H N M K : ℕ} (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hM : 0 < M) {z w : ℤ} (hzMod : Int.ModEq (M : ℤ) z w) (hzSurv : |carryOrbit H N z K| ≤ (N + H + K + 1 : ℤ)) (hwSurv : |carryOrbit H N w K| ≤ (N + H + K + 1 : ℤ)) (hwidth : (N + H + K + 1 : ℤ) < (2 : ℤ) ^ (K - 1) * (M : ℤ)) : z = w
declarations.docstring: **General product-modulus spacing.** At depth `K`, two launches in one class modulo `M` are separated by a multiple of `2^K M`. Hence a strip of radius strictly below `2^(K-1) M` contains at most one surviving state. This isolates the quantitative fact behind both the clean-prime collapse and any later full-Mersenne-quotient filter.

declarations.name: PrimeFilteredCarryKill
declarations.signature: def PrimeFilteredCarryKill (H p K : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: Every denominator-compatible integer carry at a clean prime anchor must leave the exact tail strip within `K` steps. The congruence reduces the unfiltered interval of `O(p)` candidates to at most four states.

declarations.name: primeFilteredResidue
declarations.docstring: Least nonnegative representative of the denominator-forced carry class.

declarations.name: primeFiltered_candidate_eq_one_of_four
declarations.signature: theorem primeFiltered_candidate_eq_one_of_four {H p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hH : H ≤ p - 1) {z : ℤ} (hbox : |z| ≤ (p + H : ℤ)) (hmod : Int.ModEq (p : ℤ) z (-totientBlock H (p - 1))) : z = primeFilteredResidue H p - 2 * p ∨ z = primeFilteredResidue H p - p ∨ z = primeFilteredResidue H p ∨ z = primeFilteredResidue H p + p
declarations.docstring: Exact four-state normal form. If `H ≤ p-1`, every filtered candidate in the analytic initial box is one of `r-2p, r-p, r, r+p`, where `r` is the least nonnegative filtered residue.

declarations.name: primeFourCarryCandidates
declarations.signature: def primeFourCarryCandidates (H p : ℕ) : Finset ℤ
declarations.docstring: The four explicit representatives which can meet the analytic candidate box at a clean anchor.

declarations.name: primeFourCarryCandidate_modEq_residue
declarations.signature: theorem primeFourCarryCandidate_modEq_residue {H p : ℕ} {z : ℤ} (hz : z ∈ primeFourCarryCandidates H p) : Int.ModEq (p : ℤ) z (primeFilteredResidue H p)
declarations.docstring: Every one of the four explicit states has the filtered residue.

declarations.name: primeFourCarry_survivor_at_three_unique
declarations.signature: theorem primeFourCarry_survivor_at_three_unique {H p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hH : H ≤ p - 1) {z w : ℤ} (hz : z ∈ primeFourCarryCandidates H p) (hw : w ∈ primeFourCarryCandidates H p) (hzSurv : |carryOrbit H (p - 1) z 3| ≤ (p + H + 3 : ℤ)) (hwSurv : |carryOrbit H (p - 1) w 3| ≤ (p + H + 3 : ℤ)) : z = w
declarations.docstring: **Four-to-one collapse in three steps.** Two distinct filtered states cannot both survive through carry depth three. Their difference is a nonzero multiple of `p`, hence grows by a factor `8`, while both sharp analytic strips together have width less than `8p`.

declarations.name: PrimeFourCarryKill
declarations.signature: def PrimeFourCarryKill (H p K : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: Literal four-state version of the denominator-filtered carry search.

declarations.name: primeFourCarryLockedThrough
declarations.signature: def primeFourCarryLockedThrough (H p K : ℕ) : Finset ℤ
declarations.docstring: Four-state launches which stay in every sharp integer strip through depth `K`.

declarations.name: mem_primeFourCarryLockedThrough_iff
declarations.signature: theorem mem_primeFourCarryLockedThrough_iff {H p K : ℕ} {z : ℤ} : z ∈ primeFourCarryLockedThrough H p K ↔ z ∈ primeFourCarryCandidates H p ∧ |z| ≤ (p + H : ℤ) ∧ ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (K + 1), |carryOrbit H (p - 1) z i| ≤ (p + H + i : ℤ)

declarations.name: primeFourCarryKill_iff_lockedThrough_eq_empty
declarations.signature: theorem primeFourCarryKill_iff_lockedThrough_eq_empty {H p K : ℕ} : PrimeFourCarryKill H p K ↔ primeFourCarryLockedThrough H p K = ∅
declarations.docstring: A four-state kill says exactly that no four-state launch remains locked through the checked depth.

declarations.name: primeFourCarryLockedThrough_three_card_le_one
declarations.signature: theorem primeFourCarryLockedThrough_three_card_le_one {H p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hH : H ≤ p - 1) : (primeFourCarryLockedThrough H p 3).card ≤ 1
declarations.docstring: After three steps the locked-state set has cardinality at most one.

declarations.name: PrimeSingleLockedCarryKill
declarations.signature: def PrimeSingleLockedCarryKill (H p K : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: Once the first three carry steps have collapsed the four possible launches to at most one, it suffices to test only that locked state. The depth lower bound makes the reduction back to the four-state predicate lossless.

declarations.name: primeFourCarryKill_mono
declarations.signature: theorem primeFourCarryKill_mono {H p K K' : ℕ} (hKK' : K ≤ K') (hkill : PrimeFourCarryKill H p K) : PrimeFourCarryKill H p K'
declarations.docstring: Carry-kill certificates are monotone in the checked depth.

declarations.name: primeSingleLockedCarryKill_of_primeFourCarryKill
declarations.signature: theorem primeSingleLockedCarryKill_of_primeFourCarryKill {H p K : ℕ} (hK : 3 ≤ K) (hkill : PrimeFourCarryKill H p K) : PrimeSingleLockedCarryKill H p K
declarations.docstring: A four-state certificate of depth at least three kills the sole three-step locked state, if that state exists.

declarations.name: primeFourCarryKill_of_primeSingleLockedCarryKill
declarations.signature: theorem primeFourCarryKill_of_primeSingleLockedCarryKill {H p K : ℕ} (hkill : PrimeSingleLockedCarryKill H p K) : PrimeFourCarryKill H p K
declarations.docstring: Testing the state locked through depth three recovers the full four-state kill: every state omitted from the locked set already escaped in one of those first three steps.

declarations.name: primeSingleLockedCarryKill_iff_primeFourCarryKill
declarations.signature: theorem primeSingleLockedCarryKill_iff_primeFourCarryKill {H p K : ℕ} (hK : 3 ≤ K) : PrimeSingleLockedCarryKill H p K ↔ PrimeFourCarryKill H p K
declarations.docstring: At every checked depth at least three, the four-state predicate is equivalent to testing only the state which survived those first steps.

declarations.name: primeFourCarryKill_iff_primeFilteredCarryKill
declarations.signature: theorem primeFourCarryKill_iff_primeFilteredCarryKill {H p K : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hH : H ≤ p - 1) : PrimeFourCarryKill H p K ↔ PrimeFilteredCarryKill H p K
declarations.docstring: Four-state and residue-filtered certificates are equivalent at a clean size-compatible anchor.

declarations.name: tail_diff_notMem_int_of_primeFilteredCarryKill
declarations.signature: theorem tail_diff_notMem_int_of_primeFilteredCarryKill {H p K : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hkill : PrimeFilteredCarryKill H p K) (hfilter : ∀ z : ℤ, (z : ℝ) = totientTail (p - 1 + H) - totientTail (p - 1) → Int.ModEq (p : ℤ) z (-totientBlock H (p - 1))) : totientTail (p - 1 + H) - totientTail (p - 1) ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: Soundness of the filtered finite search, separated from the rational-denominator argument which supplies its initial congruence.

declarations.name: exists_primeFilteredCarryKill_of_tail_diff_notMem_int
declarations.signature: theorem exists_primeFilteredCarryKill_of_tail_diff_notMem_int {H p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hnon : totientTail (p - 1 + H) - totientTail (p - 1) ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)) : ∃ K : ℕ, PrimeFilteredCarryKill H p K
declarations.docstring: Pointwise completeness of the finite carry search. If the true tail difference is not integral, no integer launch can stay forever in the sharp linear strip; finiteness of the initial candidate interval then supplies one uniform escape depth. The residue filter may only discard candidates.

declarations.name: PrimeBasepointFilteredCarryKill
declarations.signature: def PrimeBasepointFilteredCarryKill (H N p K : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: Basepoint-decoupled denominator-filtered carry search. The modulus prime need not also determine the left endpoint: this is the form needed to combine a large divisor of `2^H - 1` with an independently engineered short totient window.

declarations.name: primeBasepointFilteredLockedThrough
declarations.signature: def primeBasepointFilteredLockedThrough (H N p K : ℕ) : Finset ℕ
declarations.docstring: Prime-filtered launch indices which remain in every sharp integer strip through depth `K` at an arbitrary basepoint. Storing the indices rather than the translated integer states makes membership in the finite analytic launch interval structural.

declarations.name: mem_primeBasepointFilteredLockedThrough_iff
declarations.signature: theorem mem_primeBasepointFilteredLockedThrough_iff {H N p K j : ℕ} : j ∈ primeBasepointFilteredLockedThrough H N p K ↔ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * (N + H + 1) + 1) ∧ Int.ModEq (p : ℤ) ((j : ℤ) - (N + H + 1 : ℤ)) (-totientBlock H N) ∧ ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (K + 1), |carryOrbit H N ((j : ℤ) - (N + H + 1 : ℤ)) i| ≤ (N + H + i + 1 : ℤ)

declarations.name: primeBasepointFilteredLockedThrough_three_card_le_one
declarations.signature: theorem primeBasepointFilteredLockedThrough_three_card_le_one {H N p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hNp : N < p) (hH : H ≤ p - 1) : (primeBasepointFilteredLockedThrough H N p 3).card ≤ 1
declarations.docstring: The entire free-basepoint filtered launch interval has at most one state which survives through depth three.

declarations.name: modulusFilteredLockedThrough_three_card_le_one
declarations.signature: theorem modulusFilteredLockedThrough_three_card_le_one {H N M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hwidth : N + H + 2 < M) : (primeBasepointFilteredLockedThrough H N M 3).card ≤ 1
declarations.docstring: If a composite modulus already exceeds the initial analytic radius, the filtered launch set locked through depth three has cardinality at most one. This is the form used by the full Mersenne quotient after the odd denominator has been divided out.

declarations.name: PrimeBasepointSingleLockedCarryKill
declarations.signature: def PrimeBasepointSingleLockedCarryKill (H N p K : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: Once the full filtered interval has collapsed through depth three, the basepoint certificate needs to test only its at-most-one locked index.

declarations.name: primeBasepointFilteredCarryKill_mono
declarations.signature: theorem primeBasepointFilteredCarryKill_mono {H N p K K' : ℕ} (hKK' : K ≤ K') (hkill : PrimeBasepointFilteredCarryKill H N p K) : PrimeBasepointFilteredCarryKill H N p K'
declarations.docstring: Free-basepoint filtered certificates are monotone in the checked depth.

declarations.name: primeBasepointSingleLockedCarryKill_of_filtered
declarations.signature: theorem primeBasepointSingleLockedCarryKill_of_filtered {H N p K : ℕ} (hK : 3 ≤ K) (hkill : PrimeBasepointFilteredCarryKill H N p K) : PrimeBasepointSingleLockedCarryKill H N p K
declarations.docstring: A full free-basepoint certificate of depth at least three kills the sole three-step locked state, if it exists.

declarations.name: primeBasepointFilteredCarryKill_of_singleLocked
declarations.signature: theorem primeBasepointFilteredCarryKill_of_singleLocked {H N p K : ℕ} (hkill : PrimeBasepointSingleLockedCarryKill H N p K) : PrimeBasepointFilteredCarryKill H N p K
declarations.docstring: Testing only the free-basepoint state locked through depth three recovers the full filtered kill: every omitted index already escaped during those first three steps.

declarations.name: primeBasepointSingleLockedCarryKill_iff_filtered
declarations.signature: theorem primeBasepointSingleLockedCarryKill_iff_filtered {H N p K : ℕ} (hK : 3 ≤ K) : PrimeBasepointSingleLockedCarryKill H N p K ↔ PrimeBasepointFilteredCarryKill H N p K
declarations.docstring: At every checked depth at least three, the full free-basepoint predicate is equivalent to testing its at-most-one locked state.

declarations.name: primeBasepointFilteredCarryKill_pred_iff
declarations.signature: theorem primeBasepointFilteredCarryKill_pred_iff {H p K : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : PrimeBasepointFilteredCarryKill H (p - 1) p K ↔ PrimeFilteredCarryKill H p K
declarations.docstring: The original prime-predecessor predicate is exactly the general basepoint predicate at `N = p-1`.

declarations.name: tail_diff_notMem_int_of_primeBasepointFilteredCarryKill
declarations.signature: theorem tail_diff_notMem_int_of_primeBasepointFilteredCarryKill {H N p K : ℕ} (hkill : PrimeBasepointFilteredCarryKill H N p K) (hfilter : ∀ z : ℤ, (z : ℝ) = totientTail (N + H) - totientTail N → Int.ModEq (p : ℤ) z (-totientBlock H N)) : totientTail (N + H) - totientTail N ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: Soundness at an arbitrary basepoint. A filtered candidate which escaped the sharp integer strip cannot represent the true tail difference.

declarations.name: exists_primeBasepointFilteredCarryKill_of_tail_diff_notMem_int
declarations.signature: theorem exists_primeBasepointFilteredCarryKill_of_tail_diff_notMem_int {H N p : ℕ} (hnon : totientTail (N + H) - totientTail N ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)) : ∃ K : ℕ, PrimeBasepointFilteredCarryKill H N p K
declarations.docstring: Pointwise completeness also survives basepoint decoupling: a nonintegral tail difference supplies a uniform finite escape depth for the finite filtered launch interval.

declarations.name: tail_diff_modEq_neg_totientBlock_of_scaled_tail
declarations.signature: theorem tail_diff_modEq_neg_totientBlock_of_scaled_tail {H N p v : ℕ} {d u : ℤ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpM : p ∣ 2 ^ H - 1) (hcop : Nat.Coprime p v) (hd : (d : ℝ) = totientTail (N + H) - totientTail N) (hu : (u : ℝ) = (v : ℝ) * totientTail N) : Int.ModEq (p : ℤ) d (-totientBlock H N)
declarations.docstring: The denominator filter in its algebraic core. If `v R_N` is an integer and a prime `p ∤ v` divides `2^H-1`, then every integral `H`-step tail difference is congruent to the negative cleared finite block modulo `p`.

declarations.name: tail_diff_modEq_neg_totientBlock_of_scaled_tail_factor
declarations.signature: theorem tail_diff_modEq_neg_totientBlock_of_scaled_tail_factor {H N v M : ℕ} {d u : ℤ} (hv : 0 < v) (hfactor : v * M = 2 ^ H - 1) (hd : (d : ℝ) = totientTail (N + H) - totientTail N) (hu : (u : ℝ) = (v : ℝ) * totientTail N) : Int.ModEq (M : ℤ) d (-totientBlock H N)
declarations.docstring: **Full Mersenne-factor filter.** Primality is not needed when the odd denominator factor itself has been divided from `2^H-1`. If `v * M = 2^H-1` and `v R_N` is integral, then every integral tail difference lies in the single class `-Q_(H,N) mod M`. Unlike a lone cyclotomic prime, this modulus can retain essentially the entire exponential Mersenne size.

declarations.name: scaled_tail_near_int_of_mersenne_factor_candidate
declarations.signature: theorem scaled_tail_near_int_of_mersenne_factor_candidate {H N v M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hfactor : v * M = 2 ^ H - 1) {z : ℤ} (hbox : |z| ≤ (N + H + 1 : ℤ)) (hmod : Int.ModEq (M : ℤ) z (-totientBlock H N)) : ∃ k : ℤ, |(v : ℝ) * totientTail N - (k : ℝ)| < (2 * (N + H + 2 : ℝ)) / (M : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: **Initial candidate as a near-integer witness.** Retaining the full Mersenne quotient changes the geometry qualitatively. Any filtered integer in the initial analytic box forces the fixed scaled tail `v R_N` to lie within `2(N+H+2)/M` of an integer. For denominator-compatible shifts this error tends to zero exponentially, while `v R_N` is fixed.

declarations.name: exists_uniform_int_gap_of_notMem_int
declarations.signature: theorem exists_uniform_int_gap_of_notMem_int {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)) : ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ z : ℤ, δ ≤ |x - (z : ℝ)|
declarations.docstring: Every noninteger real has a positive uniform distance from the integer lattice. This reusable floor-gap form is the topological half of the full-Mersenne initial-residue argument.

declarations.name: no_mersenne_factor_candidate_of_scaled_tail_gap
declarations.signature: theorem no_mersenne_factor_candidate_of_scaled_tail_gap {H N v M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hfactor : v * M = 2 ^ H - 1) {δ : ℝ} (hgap : ∀ k : ℤ, δ ≤ |(v : ℝ) * totientTail N - (k : ℝ)|) (hratio : (2 * (N + H + 2 : ℝ)) / (M : ℝ) < δ) : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (2 * (N + H + 1) + 1), ¬Int.ModEq (M : ℤ) ((j : ℤ) - (N + H + 1 : ℤ)) (-totientBlock H N)
declarations.docstring: Once the full-Mersenne approximation error is below the lattice gap of `v R_N`, the initial analytic interval contains no filtered launch at all.

declarations.name: scaled_totientTail_notMem_int_of_irrational
declarations.signature: theorem scaled_totientTail_notMem_int_of_irrational (hirr : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)) {N v : ℕ} (hv : 0 < v) : (v : ℝ) * totientTail N ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: Irrationality of the full series makes every positive integral scaling of every shifted tail nonintegral. Otherwise the shift identity would write the original series as an explicit rational number.

declarations.name: exists_int_scaled_tail_of_rat_den_eq
declarations.signature: theorem exists_int_scaled_tail_of_rat_den_eq (r : ℚ) (hS : (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n) = (r : ℝ)) {c v N : ℕ} (hden : 2 ^ c * v = r.den) (hN : c ≤ N) : ∃ u : ℤ, (u : ℝ) = (v : ℝ) * totientTail N
declarations.docstring: Clearing the dyadic part of a rational denominator leaves an integral multiple of every sufficiently shifted tail.

declarations.name: exists_int_scaled_tail_of_rat_den_dvd
declarations.signature: theorem exists_int_scaled_tail_of_rat_den_dvd (r : ℚ) (hS : (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n) = (r : ℝ)) {c v N : ℕ} (hden : r.den ∣ 2 ^ c * v) (hN : c ≤ N) : ∃ u : ℤ, (u : ℝ) = (v : ℝ) * totientTail N
declarations.docstring: A multiplier whose dyadic scaling is merely divisible by the reduced denominator already clears every sufficiently shifted rational tail. This is the divisor-strengthening of `exists_int_scaled_tail_of_rat_den_eq`.

declarations.name: binaryCyclotomicLayer
declarations.docstring: The unsigned binary cyclotomic layer `|Φ_n(2)|`.

declarations.name: binaryCyclotomicLayer_dvd_mersenneLayer
declarations.signature: theorem binaryCyclotomicLayer_dvd_mersenneLayer (n : ℕ) : binaryCyclotomicLayer n ∣ mersenneLayer n
declarations.docstring: Every binary cyclotomic layer divides the corresponding Mersenne number.

declarations.name: binaryCyclotomicLayer_prime_order_decomposition
declarations.signature: theorem binaryCyclotomicLayer_prime_order_decomposition {n p : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hp : p.Prime) (hpdvd : p ∣ binaryCyclotomicLayer n) : ∃ a : ℕ, n = p ^ a * orderOf ((2 : ℕ) : ZMod p)
declarations.docstring: A prime divisor of `Φ_n(2)` supplies the characteristic-free order decomposition `n = p^a * ord_p(2)`. The decomposition remains valid in the exceptional characteristic case; cleanliness below is exactly what forces `a = 0`.

declarations.name: two_ne_zero_of_prime_dvd_binaryCyclotomicLayer
declarations.signature: theorem two_ne_zero_of_prime_dvd_binaryCyclotomicLayer {n p : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n) (hp : p.Prime) (hpdvd : p ∣ binaryCyclotomicLayer n) : ((2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ≠ 0
declarations.docstring: The residue of `2` is nonzero at every prime divisor of a positive binary cyclotomic layer.

declarations.name: prime_dvd_binaryCyclotomicLayer_clean_order
declarations.signature: theorem prime_dvd_binaryCyclotomicLayer_clean_order {h q p : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hq : q.Prime) (hqh : h < q) (hqpow : 2 ^ h < q) (hp : p.Prime) (hpLayer : p ∣ binaryCyclotomicLayer (h * q)) : Nat.Coprime p (h * q) ∧ h * q ∣ p - 1
declarations.docstring: Past the explicit exceptional range, every prime divisor of the binary cyclotomic layer is clean and supplies exact order `h*q`. The two bounds have different roles: `q > h` excludes characteristics dividing the fixed ray multiplier, while `q > 2^h` excludes the moving characteristic `p = q`.

declarations.name: exists_clean_binaryCyclotomicAnchor
declarations.signature: theorem exists_clean_binaryCyclotomicAnchor (h N₀ : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) : ∃ q p : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ p.Prime ∧ Nat.Coprime p (h * q) ∧ p ∣ binaryCyclotomicLayer (h * q) ∧ h * q ∣ p - 1 ∧ N₀ ≤ p - 1
declarations.docstring: **Unconditional clean composite-ray producer.** For every positive period `h` and every threshold, a prime-index multiplier `q` and a prime factor `p` of `Φ_(h*q)(2)` can be chosen so that the factor is clean, `ord_p(2) = h*q`, and hence `h*q ∣ p-1`. The characteristic-prime case is eliminated directly from the exact cyclotomic order decomposition. Choosing `q > 2^h` rules out `p = q`; choosing `q > h` rules out every `p ∣ h`.

declarations.name: binaryCyclotomicLayer_layerSupply
declarations.signature: theorem binaryCyclotomicLayer_layerSupply (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) : PrimeRayLayerSupply binaryCyclotomicLayer h
declarations.docstring: The actual binary cyclotomic layers are eventually nontrivial and clean on every positive prime ray.

declarations.name: binaryCyclotomicLayer_eventualOrderConsumer
declarations.signature: theorem binaryCyclotomicLayer_eventualOrderConsumer (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) : EventualBoundedDegreeOrderConsumer binaryCyclotomicLayer h 1
declarations.docstring: The actual binary cyclotomic layer has degree-one order witnesses beyond the same explicit exceptional range.

declarations.name: binaryCyclotomicLayer_unboundedPrimeDivisorSupply
declarations.signature: theorem binaryCyclotomicLayer_unboundedPrimeDivisorSupply (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) : UnboundedPrimeDivisorSupply binaryCyclotomicLayer h
declarations.docstring: Unbounded prime support is unconditional for every positive binary cyclotomic prime ray. This remains an arithmetic support statement, not a carry/phase escape theorem and not an irrationality theorem for Erdős #249.

declarations.name: exists_unbounded_binaryCyclotomicSupport_with_periodLock_of_not_irrational
declarations.signature: theorem exists_unbounded_binaryCyclotomicSupport_with_periodLock_of_not_irrational (hrat : ¬ Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)) : ∃ h : ℕ, 0 < h ∧ UnboundedPrimeDivisorSupply binaryCyclotomicLayer h ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N, N₀ ≤ N → totientTail (N + h) - totientTail N ∈ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: **Exact obstruction to a support-only proof of Erdős #249.** If the totient series were rational, its eventual integral tail-period law would hold on some positive period ray. The actual binary cyclotomic layers still have unbounded prime divisors on that same ray. Thus unbounded prime support is compatible with the precise period lock supplied by hypothetical rationality; an additional carry or phase-escape bridge is indispensable.

declarations.name: binaryCyclotomicLayer_not_globalOrderConsumer
declarations.docstring: The original global order-consumer predicate is genuinely too strong for composite cyclotomic rays: at `h = 2`, `q = 3`, the layer is `Φ₆(2) = 3`, whose characteristic prime cannot realise order six.

declarations.name: tail_diff_int_of_period_mul
declarations.signature: lemma tail_diff_int_of_period_mul {h N₀ : ℕ} (hint : ∀ N, N₀ ≤ N → totientTail (N + h) - totientTail N ∈ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)) : ∀ k N, N₀ ≤ N → totientTail (N + h * k) - totientTail N ∈ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: An eventual `h`-period tail-integrality law also holds for every positive or zero multiple `h * k`, by telescoping `k` adjacent differences.

declarations.name: CleanCyclotomicAnchorSupply
declarations.docstring: Cofinal clean cyclotomic provenance, without any certificate field.

declarations.name: cleanCyclotomicAnchorSupply_binaryCyclotomicLayer
declarations.docstring: The actual binary cyclotomic layers have unconditional cofinal clean anchors.

declarations.name: CyclotomicPrimeFilteredCarryKillSupply
declarations.docstring: The exact denominator-filtered residual. At a cofinal clean cyclotomic anchor, only the carry candidates in one forced residue class modulo `p` must be expelled. Since `H ∣ p-1`, the initial interval contains at most four such candidates.

declarations.name: CyclotomicPrimeFourCarryKillSupply
declarations.docstring: The same cofinal residual with the carry search literally restricted to the four possible representatives.

declarations.name: CyclotomicPrimeSingleLockedCarryKillSupply

declarations.signature: def fullMersenneBlockResidue (H N M : ℕ) : ℤ

declarations.signature: def FullMersenneCenteredResidueGap (H N M : ℕ) : Prop
declarations.docstring: The forced block residue lies in the central open arc left after removing the complete initial analytic interval from both ends of a modulus.

declarations.name: fullMersenneBlockResidue_succ
declarations.signature: theorem fullMersenneBlockResidue_succ {H N M : ℕ} (hM : M ∣ 2 ^ H - 1) : fullMersenneBlockResidue H (N + 1) M = (2 * fullMersenneBlockResidue H N M - deltaTotient H (N + 1)) % (M : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: **Exact centered-residue dynamics.** Once `M` divides the height-`H` Mersenne number, sliding the basepoint doubles the current residue and subtracts the new totient-difference letter. The large endpoint term in `totientBlock_succ` disappears modulo `M`; no analytic tail or carry lift remains in this recurrence.

declarations.name: fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift
declarations.signature: def fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift (H N M : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: The canonical signed representative of the forced full-Mersenne block class. Unlike the least nonnegative residue, this lives in the closed signed half-cell around zero.

declarations.name: fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift_emod
declarations.signature: theorem fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift_emod (H N M : ℕ) : fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift H N M % (M : ℤ) = fullMersenneBlockResidue H N M
declarations.docstring: Centering preserves exactly the least nonnegative full-Mersenne block residue.

declarations.name: fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift_succ_modEq
declarations.signature: theorem fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift_succ_modEq {H N M : ℕ} (hM : M ∣ 2 ^ H - 1) : Int.ModEq (M : ℤ) (fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift H (N + 1) M) (2 * fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift H N M - deltaTotient H (N + 1))
declarations.docstring: Signed centered lifts obey the same affine recurrence modulo every divisor of `2^H-1`. This is the signed version of `fullMersenneBlockResidue_succ`, suitable for a later no-wrap argument.

declarations.name: fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift_succ_eq_of_abs_add_abs_lt
declarations.signature: theorem fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift_succ_eq_of_abs_add_abs_lt {H N M : ℕ} (hM : M ∣ 2 ^ H - 1) (hsmall : |fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift H (N + 1) M| + |2 * fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift H N M - deltaTotient H (N + 1)| < (M : ℤ)) : fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift H (N + 1) M = 2 * fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift H N M - deltaTotient H (N + 1)
declarations.docstring: Quantitative no-wrap principle for the centered residue dynamics. If the two signed sides together fit strictly inside one modulus, their modular affine recurrence is an actual equality in `ℤ`.

declarations.name: fullMersenneCenteredResidueGap_iff_abs_centeredLift
declarations.signature: theorem fullMersenneCenteredResidueGap_iff_abs_centeredLift {H N M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hroom : 2 * (N + H + 2) ≤ M) : FullMersenneCenteredResidueGap H N M ↔ ((N + H + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) < |fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift H N M|
declarations.docstring: With one unit of room for strict integer inequalities, the open central residue arc is exactly escape of the signed centered lift from the analytic radius `N+H+1`. This turns the remaining Euclidean two-sided band into one absolute-value inequality.

declarations.name: fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift_succ_eq_of_two_edge_locks
declarations.signature: theorem fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift_succ_eq_of_two_edge_locks {H N M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hMersenne : M ∣ 2 ^ H - 1) (hlarge : 4 * (N + H + 3) < M) (hlock : ¬FullMersenneCenteredResidueGap H N M) (hlockSucc : ¬FullMersenneCenteredResidueGap H (N + 1) M) : fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift H (N + 1) M = 2 * fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift H N M - deltaTotient H (N + 1)
declarations.docstring: **Two-edge-lock rigidity.** When the modulus is wider than four successive analytic radii, failure of the central gap at two adjacent basepoints removes every possible modular wrap. The signed representatives must then follow the literal affine totient-difference recurrence in `ℤ`. Thus a long edge-locked residue orbit is not merely congruent to a carry orbit: in the large-modulus regime it *is* that orbit.

declarations.name: fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift_add_eq_carryOrbit_of_edge_locks
declarations.signature: theorem fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift_add_eq_carryOrbit_of_edge_locks {H N M L : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hMersenne : M ∣ 2 ^ H - 1) (hlarge : 4 * (N + L + H + 3) < M) (hlock : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ L → ¬FullMersenneCenteredResidueGap H (N + i) M) : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ L → fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift H (N + i) M = carryOrbit H N (fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift H N M) i
declarations.docstring: **Interval edge-lock rigidity.** If the central full-Mersenne gap fails through a whole interval and the modulus has room for the final analytic radius, then every centered block lift on that interval is literally the ordinary integer carry orbit launched from the first lift. This is the iterated form of `fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift_succ_eq_of_two_edge_locks`; there is no modular ambiguity left anywhere in the interval.

declarations.name: exists_fullMersenneCenteredResidueGap_of_carryOrbit_escape
declarations.signature: theorem exists_fullMersenneCenteredResidueGap_of_carryOrbit_escape {H N M L : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hMersenne : M ∣ 2 ^ H - 1) (hlarge : 4 * (N + L + H + 3) < M) (hescape : ∃ i : ℕ, i ≤ L ∧ (((N + i + H + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) < |carryOrbit H N (fullMersenneBlockCenteredLift H N M) i|)) : ∃ i : ℕ, i ≤ L ∧ FullMersenneCenteredResidueGap H (N + i) M
declarations.docstring: **Finite full-Mersenne escape certificate.** Under the same large-modulus geometry, it is enough to find one depth at which the ordinary carry orbit launched from the canonical signed block lift exceeds the local analytic radius. Some central full-Mersenne residue gap must then already occur at or before that depth. This is the exact contrapositive consumer of interval edge-lock rigidity.

declarations.name: exists_fullMersenneCenteredResidueGap_of_survivorKill

declarations.docstring: The ordinary finite survivor certificate can now be consumed directly against the canonical full-Mersenne residue. If every integer launch in the initial analytic box escapes by depth `L`, then a modulus large enough to prevent wrapping cannot remain edge-locked throughout that interval.

declarations.name: survivorKill_of_certifiedKill
declarations.signature: theorem survivorKill_of_certifiedKill {H N L : ℕ} (hcert : certifiedKill H N L) : survivorKill H N L
declarations.docstring: A central dyadic endpoint certificate kills every launch in the initial analytic box at its certified depth. This packages the endpoint-fibre interpretation of `certifiedKill` in the `survivorKill` interface used by the full-Mersenne dynamics.

declarations.docstring: Every ordinary dyadic central-arc certificate therefore forces a genuine central gap for any sufficiently large divisor of the same Mersenne layer. This lets the existing checked certificate bank feed the exact full-Mersenne quotient geometry without another launch enumeration.

declarations.name: CyclotomicAnchoredKillSupply
declarations.docstring: The exact remaining producer after prime support is discharged. Besides the certified discrepancy itself, the fields retain the cyclotomic provenance: `p` is a clean prime divisor of the `h*q` layer and `h*q ∣ p-1`. The irrationality consumer below needs only the cofinal location and the certificate. The additional fields state the intended arithmetic route and prevent the residual from silently weakening into an unrelated certificate search.

declarations.name: CyclotomicGuardCylinderSupply
declarations.docstring: The cyclotomic producer written in its exact finite normal form. The arbitrary certificate depth in `CyclotomicAnchoredKillSupply` is replaced by one translated logarithmic socket or one translated mixed two-bit guard. All prime-layer provenance is retained verbatim.

declarations.name: cyclotomicGuardCylinderSupply_iff_anchoredKillSupply
declarations.signature: theorem cyclotomicGuardCylinderSupply_iff_anchoredKillSupply {C : ℕ → ℕ} : CyclotomicGuardCylinderSupply C ↔ CyclotomicAnchoredKillSupply C
declarations.docstring: The guard-cylinder formulation loses no arithmetic information: it is exactly the existing cyclotomic anchored-kill supply.

declarations.name: irrational_totient_series_of_cyclotomicAnchoredKillSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totient_series_of_cyclotomicAnchoredKillSupply {C : ℕ → ℕ} (hsupply : CyclotomicAnchoredKillSupply C) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: **Complete conditional closure of Erdős #249.** Cofinal cyclotomic-anchored discrepancy kills contradict every eventual rational period, because rational periods remain periods after multiplication.

declarations.name: cyclotomicAnchoredKillSupply_of_irrational_of_cleanAnchorSupply
declarations.signature: theorem cyclotomicAnchoredKillSupply_of_irrational_of_cleanAnchorSupply {C : ℕ → ℕ} (hclean : CleanCyclotomicAnchorSupply C) (hirr : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)) : CyclotomicAnchoredKillSupply C
declarations.docstring: Under clean anchor supply, irrationality itself repopulates the cyclotomic anchored-kill fields by pointwise certificate completeness.

declarations.name: cyclotomicAnchoredKillSupply_iff_irrational_of_cleanAnchorSupply
declarations.signature: theorem cyclotomicAnchoredKillSupply_iff_irrational_of_cleanAnchorSupply {C : ℕ → ℕ} (hclean : CleanCyclotomicAnchorSupply C) : CyclotomicAnchoredKillSupply C ↔ Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: Once clean anchors are present, the anchored-kill supply is equivalent to Erdős #249 itself. Thus prime production is completely discharged and the remaining content is exactly terminal anti-locking of the totient word.

declarations.name: binaryCyclotomicAnchoredKillSupply_iff_irrational
declarations.signature: theorem binaryCyclotomicAnchoredKillSupply_iff_irrational : CyclotomicAnchoredKillSupply binaryCyclotomicLayer ↔ Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: Exact claim ceiling for the concrete layers `|Φ_n(2)|`.

declarations.name: irrational_totient_series_of_cyclotomicGuardCylinderSupply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_totient_series_of_cyclotomicGuardCylinderSupply {C : ℕ → ℕ} (hsupply : CyclotomicGuardCylinderSupply C) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: **Guard-cylinder closure of Erdős #249.** It suffices to force, at cofinally remote clean cyclotomic anchors, either the terminal socket or the mixed two-bit guard from the exact certificate normal form.

declarations.name: binaryCyclotomicGuardCylinderSupply_iff_irrational
declarations.signature: theorem binaryCyclotomicGuardCylinderSupply_iff_irrational : CyclotomicGuardCylinderSupply binaryCyclotomicLayer ↔ Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: Exact guard-cylinder claim ceiling for the concrete binary cyclotomic layers.

declarations.name: certifiedKill_cyclotomic_30_331_natural
declarations.docstring: The natural `331`-layer certificate at period `30` and start `300`. Its exact discrepancy is `385374`, with residue `350` modulo `8192` and certificate radius `345`.

declarations.name: certifiedKill_cyclotomic_30_331_anchor
declarations.docstring: The prime-anchored `331` certificate at period `30` and start `330`. Its exact discrepancy is `10864`, with residue `624` modulo `1024` and certificate radius `372`.

declarations.name: windowDiscrepancy_30_300_16_mod
declarations.docstring: At the deeper phase-comparison depth `16`, the same natural anchor has residue `2928` modulo `65536`. This is the exact finite datum behind the strict-`9/10` non-implication calculation in the packet.

declarations.name: totient_series_ne_rat_of_den_dvd_30_300
declarations.signature: theorem totient_series_ne_rat_of_den_dvd_30_300 (r : ℚ) (hdvd : (r.den : ℕ) ∣ 2 ^ 300 * (2 ^ 30 - 1)) : (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n) ≠ (r : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: Exact denominator exclusion delivered by the natural `331` certificate: the binary totient series equals no rational whose denominator divides `2^300 * (2^30 - 1)`.

declarations.name: muSqLocal
declarations.signature: def muSqLocal : ℕ → ℤ | 0 => 1 | 1 => -2 | 2 => 1 | _ => 0 /-- The finite geometric sum `1 + p + ... + p^e` over the integers. -/ def sigmaPrimePow (p e : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: Local coefficients of the squared Möbius Euler factor.

declarations.name: sigmaPrimePow
declarations.docstring: The finite geometric sum `1 + p + ... + p^e` over the integers.

declarations.name: muSqEulerFactor_one
declarations.signature: theorem muSqEulerFactor_one (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) : (1 : ℚ) - 2 / (p : ℚ) + 1 / (p : ℚ) ^ 2 = (1 - 1 / (p : ℚ)) ^ 2
declarations.docstring: The `s = 1` Euler factor controlling finite-stage quasimodular depth.

declarations.name: muSqEulerFactor_two
declarations.signature: theorem muSqEulerFactor_two (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) : (1 : ℚ) - 2 / (p : ℚ) ^ 2 + 1 / (p : ℚ) ^ 4 = (1 - 1 / (p : ℚ) ^ 2) ^ 2
declarations.docstring: The `s = 2` Euler factor controlling the finite-stage radial coefficient.

declarations.name: sigmaPrimePow_firstDiff
declarations.signature: theorem sigmaPrimePow_firstDiff (p : ℕ) : sigmaPrimePow p 1 - 2 * sigmaPrimePow p 0 = (p : ℤ) - 1
declarations.docstring: The first nontrivial local convolution coefficient.

declarations.name: sigmaPrimePow_secondDiff
declarations.signature: theorem sigmaPrimePow_secondDiff (p e : ℕ) : sigmaPrimePow p (e + 2) - 2 * sigmaPrimePow p (e + 1) + sigmaPrimePow p e = (p : ℤ) ^ (e + 1) * ((p : ℤ) - 1)
declarations.docstring: The `μ * μ` second difference converts the divisor-sum prime-power row to the prime-power totient row.

declarations.name: shift
declarations.signature: noncomputable def shift (h N : ℕ) : ℝ
declarations.docstring: The `h`-shift of the local totient tail at basepoint `N`.

declarations.name: abs_pow_mul_shift_sub_windowDiscrepancy_le
declarations.signature: theorem abs_pow_mul_shift_sub_windowDiscrepancy_le (h N L : ℕ) : |(2 : ℝ) ^ L * shift h N - (windowDiscrepancy h N L : ℝ)| ≤ (N : ℝ) + h + L + 2
declarations.docstring: **Coarea bound.** The depth-`L` window integer approximates the scaled shift to within the arc radius. This is the analytic content of certificate soundness, isolated as a two-sided estimate.

declarations.name: add_one_le_abs_sub_mul_of_certifiedKill
declarations.signature: theorem add_one_le_abs_sub_mul_of_certifiedKill {h N L : ℕ} (hcert : certifiedKill h N L) (k : ℤ) : (N : ℤ) + h + L + 2 + 1 ≤ |windowDiscrepancy h N L - k * 2 ^ L|
declarations.docstring: Integer separation supplied by a certificate: the window integer is at least `radius + 1` away from every multiple of the modulus.

declarations.name: exists_abs_sub_mul_le_of_not_certifiedKill
declarations.signature: theorem exists_abs_sub_mul_le_of_not_certifiedKill (h N L : ℕ) (hnot : ¬ certifiedKill h N L) : ∃ k : ℤ, |windowDiscrepancy h N L - k * 2 ^ L| ≤ (N : ℤ) + h + L + 2
declarations.docstring: Absence of a certificate pins the window integer inside the arc radius of some multiple of the modulus.

declarations.name: one_le_pow_mul_abs_shift_sub_int
declarations.signature: theorem one_le_pow_mul_abs_shift_sub_int {h N L : ℕ} (hcert : certifiedKill h N L) (k : ℤ) : 1 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ L * |shift h N - (k : ℝ)|
declarations.docstring: **Quantitative certificate soundness.** A certified kill separates the shift from *every* integer by the reciprocal of its own depth.

declarations.name: certifiedKill_of_forall_dist
declarations.signature: theorem certifiedKill_of_forall_dist {h N L : ℕ} (hsep : ∀ k : ℤ, 2 * ((N : ℝ) + h + L + 2) < (2 : ℝ) ^ L * |shift h N - (k : ℝ)|) : certifiedKill h N L
declarations.docstring: **Exact converse.** A shift separated from every integer by more than twice the arc radius over the modulus is certified at that depth.

declarations.name: shift_eq_series
declarations.signature: theorem shift_eq_series (h N : ℕ) : shift h N = (2 : ℝ) ^ N * (2 ^ h - 1) * (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n) - ((totientPrefix (N + h) : ℝ) - (totientPrefix N : ℝ))
declarations.docstring: The shift is an affine function of the series with an integer offset.

declarations.name: exists_int_shift_concat
declarations.signature: theorem exists_int_shift_concat (a b N : ℕ) : ∃ z : ℤ, shift (a + b) N = (2 : ℝ) ^ b * shift a N + shift b N + (z : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: **Shift concatenation.** Consecutive blocks along a ray are not independent: they differ by an integer after one dyadic scaling.

declarations.name: exists_int_shift_mul_of_exists_int_shift
declarations.signature: theorem exists_int_shift_mul_of_exists_int_shift {d N : ℕ} (hd : ∃ k : ℤ, shift d N = (k : ℝ)) (t : ℕ) : ∃ k : ℤ, shift (t * d) N = (k : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: Integrality of one step propagates to every multiple along its ray.

declarations.name: forall_dist_adjacent_of_seed
declarations.signature: theorem forall_dist_adjacent_of_seed {d N : ℕ} {c : ℝ} (hseed : ∀ k : ℤ, c ≤ |shift d N - (k : ℝ)|) (t : ℕ) : (∀ k : ℤ, c / (1 + 2 ^ d) ≤ |shift (t * d) N - (k : ℝ)|) ∨ (∀ k : ℤ, c / (1 + 2 ^ d) ≤ |shift ((t + 1) * d) N - (k : ℝ)|)
declarations.docstring: **The two-of-adjacent separation.** A fixed separation of the seed forces a fixed (smaller) separation on at least one of every adjacent pair of multiples.

declarations.name: eventually_affine_mul_half_pow_lt
declarations.signature: private theorem eventually_affine_mul_half_pow_lt {α β c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) : ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, T ≤ m → (α + β * (m : ℝ)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m < c

declarations.name: exists_adjacent_fullDepthKill_of_seed
declarations.signature: theorem exists_adjacent_fullDepthKill_of_seed {d N L : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hseed : certifiedKill d N L) : ∃ T : ℕ, 0 < T ∧ ∀ t : ℕ, T ≤ t → certifiedKill (t * d) N (t * d) ∨ certifiedKill ((t + 1) * d) N ((t + 1) * d)
declarations.docstring: **The full-depth ray amplifier.** One certificate anywhere on a ray forces a **depth = period** certificate in every adjacent pair of multiples beyond an explicit threshold: the successful multipliers are eventually `2`-syndetic.

declarations.name: fullDepthKillMultipliers
declarations.signature: def fullDepthKillMultipliers (d N : ℕ) : Set ℕ
declarations.docstring: Multipliers whose ray shifts admit a certificate at their own depth.

declarations.name: eventually_twoSyndetic_fullDepthKillMultipliers_of_seed
declarations.signature: theorem eventually_twoSyndetic_fullDepthKillMultipliers_of_seed {d N L : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hseed : certifiedKill d N L) : ∃ T : ℕ, 0 < T ∧ ∀ t : ℕ, T ≤ t → ∃ m : ℕ, m ∈ fullDepthKillMultipliers d N ∧ t ≤ m ∧ m ≤ t + 1
declarations.docstring: **Eventual 2-syndeticity.** A single seed certificate makes the full-depth multiplier set meet every adjacent pair on a tail. This set-valued form is the reusable interface for density and renewal consumers.

declarations.name: exists_fullDepthKill_on_ray_of_seed
declarations.signature: theorem exists_fullDepthKill_on_ray_of_seed {d N L : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hseed : certifiedKill d N L) : ∃ t : ℕ, 0 < t ∧ certifiedKill (t * d) N (t * d)
declarations.docstring: One seed yields one **depth = period** certificate on the same ray.

declarations.name: exists_fullDepthKill_on_ray_iff_shift_notMem_int
declarations.signature: theorem exists_fullDepthKill_on_ray_iff_shift_notMem_int {d N : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) : (∃ t : ℕ, 0 < t ∧ certifiedKill (t * d) N (t * d)) ↔ totientTail (N + d) - totientTail N ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: **Pointwise equivalence.** Depth-locked certificates on a ray exist exactly when the ray's own shift is non-integral.

declarations.name: apFullDepthEscape_iff_irrational
declarations.signature: theorem apFullDepthEscape_iff_irrational : ApFullDepthEscape ↔ Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: **The depth lock costs nothing.** `ApFullDepthEscape` — depth locked to the period — is *equivalent* to irrationality, not merely sufficient for it. This closes the "not known necessary" gap recorded in `PeriodMultipleEscape`.

declarations.name: CofinalFullDepthKillSupply
declarations.docstring: The depth-locked cofinal supply.

declarations.name: cofinalFullDepthKillSupply_iff_periodMultipleKillSupply
declarations.docstring: **The depth parameter can be deleted from the exact supply.** Demanding depth = period cofinally is the same demand as the original arbitrary-depth period-multiple supply.

declarations.name: cofinalFullDepthKillSupply_iff_irrational

declarations.docstring: The full chain, in one statement: depth-locked cofinal supply is exactly irrationality.

declarations.name: periodLcm_jump_eq_height_at_one
declarations.docstring: At `t + 1 = 2^k` the lcm height exactly doubles, so the jump length equals the starting height and the jump shift *is* the diagonal shift. Stated for the concrete scales at which the corpus holds diagonal deposits; `decide` settles each by evaluating `lcm (1, ..., t)`.

declarations.name: certifiedKill_lcm_jump_at_seven
declarations.docstring: **A kill at an lcm-jump shift, at `t = 7`.** The diagonal deposit at `lcm (1, ..., 7) = 420`, depth `14`, read at the jump shift.

declarations.name: certifiedKill_lcm_jump_at_one
declarations.docstring: **Kills at lcm-jump shifts, at `t = 1` and `t = 3`.** Read off the `1 <= t <= 6` diagonal deposit at the two scales in that range where the jump coincides with the height.

declarations.name: certifiedKill_lcm_jump_at_thirtyone
declarations.docstring: **A kill at an lcm-jump shift, at `t = 31`.** The wave-31 diagonal certificate at `lcm (1, ..., 31) = 72201776446800`, depth `49`, read at the jump shift `periodLcm 32 - periodLcm 31`. The underlying certificate already evaluates totients in both the block above `periodLcm 31` and the block above `periodLcm 32`, because the diagonal window at `h = N = periodLcm 31` reaches `N + h = periodLcm 32`. So this is the same kernel computation, not a new one.

declarations.name: upper_half_product_denominator_bounds
declarations.signature: theorem upper_half_product_denominator_bounds {t : ℕ} (ht : 5 ≤ t) : 2 ^ (t / 2) ≤ (∏ p ∈ upperHalfPrimes t, RadicalMobiusShadow.mersenne p) ∧ (∏ p ∈ upperHalfPrimes t, RadicalMobiusShadow.mersenne p) ≤ ((lcmHeight t : ℚ) * RadicalMobiusShadow.numericMobiusShadow (lcmHeight t)).den

declarations.name: dyadic_sub_reciprocal_denominator

declarations.name: scaled_tail_split

declarations.name: discrepancy_eq

declarations.name: scaled_difference
declarations.signature: theorem scaled_difference (c : ℕ → ℕ) (hc : ∀ n, c n ≤ n) (h N L : ℕ) : (2 : ℝ) ^ L * (binaryCoeffTail c (N + h) - binaryCoeffTail c N) - (discrepancy c h N L : ℝ) = binaryCoeffTail c (N + h + L) - binaryCoeffTail c (N + L)

declarations.name: certificate_sound
declarations.signature: theorem certificate_sound (c : ℕ → ℕ) (hc : ∀ n, c n ≤ n) (h N L : ℕ) (hcert : certificate c h N L) : binaryCoeffTail c (N + h) - binaryCoeffTail c N ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)

declarations.name: generic_tail_period

declarations.docstring: The stated generic tail-period law; oddness of m is unnecessary once its divisibility into the Mersenne factor is supplied.

declarations.name: lcm_grid_fractional_parts

declarations.name: clean_lcm_ray_factorisation
declarations.signature: theorem clean_lcm_ray_factorisation (t j q : ℕ) (hdvd : j ∣ periodLcm t) (hclean : ∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ j → p ∣ (periodLcm t / j)) : q * periodLcm t + j = j * (q * (periodLcm t / j) + 1) ∧ Nat.Coprime j (q * (periodLcm t / j) + 1) ∧ Nat.totient (q * periodLcm t + j) = Nat.totient j * Nat.totient (q * (periodLcm t / j) + 1)

declarations.name: unclean_lcm_ray_counterexample
declarations.signature: theorem unclean_lcm_ray_counterexample : 2 ∣ periodLcm 2 ∧ Nat.totient (periodLcm 2 + 2) = 2 ∧ Nat.totient 2 * Nat.totient (periodLcm 2 / 2 + 1) = 1 ∧ ¬ (∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ 2 → p ∣ (periodLcm 2 / 2))

declarations.name: mobius_square_reduction
declarations.signature: theorem mobius_square_reduction : totientSeries = (1 : ℝ) / 2 + ∑' d : ℕ+, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (d : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((2 : ℝ) ^ (d : ℕ) - 1) ^ 2

declarations.name: irrational_totient_iff_mobius_square

declarations.name: moebius_three_values
declarations.signature: theorem moebius_three_values (d : ℕ) : ArithmeticFunction.moebius d = -1 ∨ ArithmeticFunction.moebius d = 0 ∨ ArithmeticFunction.moebius d = 1

declarations.name: eval_spacedRepunit_two
declarations.signature: private theorem eval_spacedRepunit_two {r d : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hd : d ∣ r) : (spacedRepunit d (r / d)).eval 2 = (((RadicalMobiusShadow.mersenne r / RadicalMobiusShadow.mersenne d : ℕ) : ℤ))

declarations.name: numerator_eval_two_divisors

declarations.name: integerAffineValue
declarations.signature: def integerAffineValue {ι : Type*} (a : ι → ℕ) (b : ι → ℤ) (i : ι) (n : ℕ) : ℕ
declarations.docstring: The natural argument of an integer-intercept affine form. Its values before the form becomes nonnegative are irrelevant to an eventual relation.

declarations.name: periodic_freezing_integer_affine
declarations.signature: theorem periodic_freezing_integer_affine {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (a : ι → ℕ) (b : ι → ℤ) (ha : ∀ i, 0 < a i) (hcross : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → (a i : ℤ) * b j ≠ (a j : ℤ) * b i) (w : ι → ℕ → ℚ) (hperiodic : ∀ i, ∃ q : ℕ, 0 < q ∧ ∀ n, w i (n + q) = w i n) (hrel : ∃ N₀, ∀ n, N₀ ≤ n → ∑ i, w i n * (Nat.totient (integerAffineValue a b i n) : ℚ) = 0) : ∀ i n, w i n = 0
declarations.docstring: Exact integer-intercept version of the paper's periodic-freezing corollary.

declarations.name: moebius_subset
declarations.signature: private theorem moebius_subset (r : ℕ) {s : Finset ℕ} (hs : s ⊆ r.primeFactors) : ArithmeticFunction.moebius (s.prod id) = (-1 : ℤ) ^ s.card
declarations.docstring: The subset calculation only needs distinct primes, not squarefreeness of the ambient index. Recover the original argument on its radical.

declarations.name: numerator_eval_two_all_positive
declarations.signature: theorem numerator_eval_two_all_positive {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) : (mobiusNumeratorPolynomial r).eval 2 = mobiusNumerator r
declarations.docstring: Extend the recovered numerator evaluation to every positive index; non-squarefree divisor terms vanish, rather than being assumed absent.

declarations.name: radical_decomposition
declarations.signature: theorem radical_decomposition (H r : ℕ) (hH : 0 < H) (hr : 0 < r) : (H : ℚ) * numericMobiusShadow H = ((H / squarefreeKernel H : ℕ) : ℚ) * baseMobiusShadow (squarefreeKernel H) ∧ (baseMobiusShadow r).den = mersenne r / ((mobiusNumeratorPolynomial r).eval 2).natAbs.gcd (mersenne r)

declarations.name: rational_difference_exact
declarations.signature: theorem rational_difference_exact (u v : ℚ) : (v : ℝ) - u = ((v.num * (u.den : ℤ) - u.num * (v.den : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) / ((v.den : ℝ) * u.den)

declarations.name: rational_cross_numerator_positive
declarations.signature: theorem rational_cross_numerator_positive {u v : ℚ} (h : u < v) : 1 ≤ v.num * (u.den : ℤ) - u.num * (v.den : ℤ)

declarations.name: rational_error_denominator_bound
declarations.signature: theorem rational_error_denominator_bound {u v : ℚ} {ε : ℝ} (h : u < v) (he : (v : ℝ) - u ≤ ε) : 1 / ((u.den : ℝ) * ε) ≤ v.den

declarations.name: signed_dyadic_clearing
declarations.signature: theorem signed_dyadic_clearing {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (u : α → ℤ) (e : α → ℕ) (m : α) (hmax : ∀ i ∈ s, i ≠ m → e i < e m) : (2 : ℚ) ^ e m * (∑ i ∈ s, (u i : ℚ) / 2 ^ e i) = ((∑ i ∈ s, u i * (2 : ℤ) ^ (e m - e i) : ℤ) : ℚ)

declarations.name: signed_dyadic_sum_ne_zero
declarations.signature: theorem signed_dyadic_sum_ne_zero {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (u : α → ℤ) (e : α → ℕ) (m : α) (hm : m ∈ s) (hu : ¬ Even (u m)) (hmax : ∀ i ∈ s, i ≠ m → e i < e m) : (∑ i ∈ s, (u i : ℚ) / 2 ^ e i) ≠ 0

declarations.name: tail_diff_int_of_displayed_denominator
declarations.signature: theorem tail_diff_int_of_displayed_denominator (a : ℤ) (c v h N : ℕ) (hv : 0 < v) (hN : c ≤ N) (hdiv : v ∣ 2 ^ h - 1) (hS : (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n) = (a : ℝ) / ((2 : ℝ) ^ c * (v : ℝ))) : totientTail (N + h) - totientTail N ∈ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: A displayed denominator gives the exact tail-integrality range.

declarations.name: specified_euler_tail_period
declarations.signature: theorem specified_euler_tail_period (a : ℤ) (c v : ℕ) (hv : 0 < v) (hodd : Odd v) (hS : (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n) = (a : ℝ) / ((2 : ℝ) ^ c * (v : ℝ))) : 0 < Nat.totient v ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, c ≤ N → totientTail (N + Nat.totient v) - totientTail N ∈ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: The complete paper assertion: h = φ(v) is positive, and every N ≥ c works.

declarations.name: prefix_fractional_part
declarations.signature: theorem prefix_fractional_part (N : ℕ) : Int.fract ((2 : ℝ)^N * (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2^n)) = Int.fract (totientTail N)

declarations.name: totient_scaled_truncation_error
declarations.signature: theorem totient_scaled_truncation_error (h N L : ℕ) : |(2 : ℝ)^L * (totientTail (N+h) - totientTail N) - (windowDiscrepancy h N L : ℝ)| ≤ (N : ℝ)+h+L+2

declarations.name: certificate_logarithmic_depth
declarations.signature: theorem certificate_logarithmic_depth {h N L : ℕ} (hc : certifiedKill h N L) : 1 + Real.logb 2 ((N : ℝ)+h+L+2) < L

declarations.name: fixed_depth_bounds_indices
declarations.signature: theorem fixed_depth_bounds_indices {h N L : ℕ} (hc : certifiedKill h N L) : N + h < 2^L

declarations.name: irrational_iff_diagonal_orbit_nonintegrality
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_iff_diagonal_orbit_nonintegrality : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n) ↔ ∀ a₀ : ℕ, ∃ a, a₀ ≤ a ∧ totientTail (2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a)) - totientTail (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)
declarations.docstring: **An equivalent diagonal nonintegrality condition.** `S ∉ ℚ ↔ ∀ a₀, ∃ a ≥ a₀, Ω_a ∉ ℤ`.

declarations.name: diagonal_certificate_unfolded
declarations.signature: theorem diagonal_certificate_unfolded (a L : ℕ) : certifiedKill (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) L ↔ (((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + L + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) < windowDiscrepancy (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) L % 2 ^ L ∧ windowDiscrepancy (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) L % 2 ^ L < 2 ^ L - ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + L + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ))
declarations.docstring: The diagonal certificate written out: at `h = N = H(2^a)` the excluded radius is `2H + L + 2`.

declarations.name: irrational_of_short_window_diagonal_supply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_of_short_window_diagonal_supply (hsupply : ∀ a₀ : ℕ, ∃ a L : ℕ, a₀ ≤ a ∧ L < 2 * 2 ^ a ∧ certifiedKill (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) L) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: **A sufficient short-window condition.** If for every `a₀` there are `a ≥ a₀` and `L < 2·2^a` with `C(H_{2^a}, H_{2^a}, L)`, then `S ∉ ℚ`.

declarations.name: pointwise_completeness_supplies_some_depth
declarations.signature: theorem pointwise_completeness_supplies_some_depth (h N : ℕ) (hnon : totientTail (N + h) - totientTail N ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℤ → ℝ)) : ∃ L : ℕ, certifiedKill h N L
declarations.docstring: Pointwise completeness allows a sufficiently large depth: a non-integral tail difference always has some certificate depth. (It supplies no bound below `2·2^a`, which is what the short-window condition adds.)

declarations.name: prescribedOddIndex
declarations.docstring: The paper's prescribed index `q_a = ⌊(⌊log₂ H⌋ + 10)/2⌋`, so that `2q_a + 1` is the least odd integer at least `⌊log₂ H⌋ + 10`.

declarations.name: oddGuarded_depth_eq_prescribed
declarations.signature: theorem oddGuarded_depth_eq_prescribed (a : ℕ) : oddGuardedCanonicalAdjacentSuffixDepth (2 ^ a) = 2 * prescribedOddIndex a + 1
declarations.docstring: The prescribed odd depth is the tree's odd-guarded canonical depth.

declarations.name: abs_orbit_sub_rawApprox_lt
declarations.signature: theorem abs_orbit_sub_rawApprox_lt (a q : ℕ) : |(totientTail (2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a)) - totientTail (periodLcm (2 ^ a))) - ((windowDiscrepancy (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) (2 * q + 1) + diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 2) : ℤ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * q + 1)| < ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + 2 * q + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * q + 1)
declarations.docstring: **The approximation estimate.** The normalised block `ρ_{a,q} = (D(H,H,2q+1) + δ_{2^a}(2q+2))/2^{2q+1}` approximates `Ω_a` to within `ε_{a,q} = (2H + 2q + 3)/2^{2q+1}`.

declarations.name: rawApprox_separation_of_orbit_separation
declarations.signature: theorem rawApprox_separation_of_orbit_separation {a q : ℕ} (hsep : ∀ z : ℤ, (1 : ℝ) / 32 + ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + 2 * q + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * q + 1) ≤ |(totientTail (2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a)) - totientTail (periodLcm (2 ^ a))) - (z : ℝ)|) (z : ℤ) : (1 : ℝ) / 32 < |((windowDiscrepancy (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) (2 * q + 1) + diagonalWindowIncrement (2 ^ a) (2 * q + 2) : ℤ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * q + 1) - (z : ℝ)|
declarations.docstring: **The stated consequence.** The estimate `|Ω_a - ρ_{a,q}| < ε_{a,q}` turns the hypothesis of the proposition into `|ρ_{a,q} - z| > 1/32` for every integer `z`, which is the finite residue separation the implication uses.

declarations.name: irrational_of_diagonal_orbit_separation_supply
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_of_diagonal_orbit_separation_supply (hsupply : ∀ a₀ : ℕ, ∃ a : ℕ, max 2 a₀ ≤ a ∧ ∀ z : ℤ, (1 : ℝ) / 32 + ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + 2 * prescribedOddIndex a + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * prescribedOddIndex a + 1) ≤ |(totientTail (2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a)) - totientTail (periodLcm (2 ^ a))) - (z : ℝ)|) : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)
declarations.docstring: **A sufficient approximation condition.** If for every `a₀` there is `a ≥ max(2, a₀)` with `|Ω_a - z| ≥ 1/32 + ε_{a,q_a}` for every integer `z`, then `S ∉ ℚ`. Here `ε_{a,q} = (2H + 2q + 3)/2^{2q+1}`.

declarations.name: short_window_diagonal_through_six
declarations.signature: theorem short_window_diagonal_through_six (a₀ : ℕ) (ha₀ : a₀ ≤ 6) : ∃ a L : ℕ, a₀ ≤ a ∧ L < 2 * 2 ^ a ∧ certifiedKill (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) L
declarations.docstring: **A sufficient extension of the examples through exponent 6.** `∀ a₀ ≤ 6, ∃ a, L, a ≥ a₀ ∧ L < 2·2^a ∧ C(H_{2^a}, H_{2^a}, L)`.

declarations.name: short_window_diagonal_witnesses
declarations.signature: theorem short_window_diagonal_witnesses : certifiedKill (periodLcm (2 ^ 4)) (periodLcm (2 ^ 4)) 23 ∧ (23 : ℕ) < 2 * 2 ^ 4 ∧ certifiedKill (periodLcm (2 ^ 6)) (periodLcm (2 ^ 6)) 93 ∧ (93 : ℕ) < 2 * 2 ^ 6
declarations.docstring: The two witnesses `(a,L) = (4,23)` and `(6,93)` giving the bounded family.

declarations.name: actualLcmTailOrbit_global_to_local
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTailOrbit_global_to_local (a : ℕ) : totientTail (2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a)) - totientTail (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) = (2 : ℝ) ^ periodLcm (2 ^ a) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ periodLcm (2 ^ a) - 1) * (∑' n : ℕ, (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / 2 ^ n) - ((totientPrefix (2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a)) : ℝ) - (totientPrefix (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) : ℝ))
declarations.docstring: **A global-to-local identity** (`prop:SEP-01-inv`). `Ω_a = 2^H(2^H-1)·S - (Φ_{2H} - Φ_H)` with `H = H(2^a)`, so a separation estimate for `Ω_a` is an estimate for this integer translate of a multiple of `S`.

declarations.name: abs_actualLcmTailOrbit_sub_rawApprox_lt_explicit
declarations.signature: theorem abs_actualLcmTailOrbit_sub_rawApprox_lt_explicit (a q : ℕ) : |(totientTail (2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a)) - totientTail (periodLcm (2 ^ a))) - actualLcmRawApprox a q| < ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + 2 * q + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * q + 1)
declarations.docstring: **A rational approximation with an error bound** (`prop:SEP-02-inv`). For all `a, q`, with `H = H(2^a)` and the finite `ρ_{a,q}`, `|Ω_a - ρ_{a,q}| < ε_{a,q} = (2H + 2q + 3)/2^(2q+1)`. The bound tends to zero with `q` for fixed `a`; no optimality is asserted.

declarations.name: tendsto_actualLcmRawErrorRadius_atTop_nhds_zero
declarations.signature: theorem tendsto_actualLcmRawErrorRadius_atTop_nhds_zero (a : ℕ) : Filter.Tendsto (fun q : ℕ => ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + 2 * q + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * q + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
declarations.docstring: **A rational approximation with an error bound** (`prop:SEP-02-inv`), second clause: for fixed `a` the error bound `ε_{a,q} = (2H+2q+3)/2^(2q+1)` tends to zero as `q → ∞`. No optimality is asserted.

declarations.name: actualLcm_tailDiff_shift_pos_paper
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcm_tailDiff_shift_pos_paper {a J : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : J + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) : 0 < totientTail (2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J) - totientTail (periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J)
declarations.docstring: **Unconditional positivity** (`prop:SGN-01`). For `a ≥ 8` and `J + (a+6) < 2·2^a`, the true infinite translated tail difference satisfies `0 < R_{2H+J} - R_{H+J}` with `H = H(2^a)`, with no irrationality hypothesis. Specialised at `J = 0` this gives `0 < Ω_a`.

declarations.name: actualLcmTailOrbit_pos
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcmTailOrbit_pos {a : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) : 0 < totientTail (2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a)) - totientTail (periodLcm (2 ^ a))
declarations.docstring: **Unconditional positivity** (`prop:SGN-01`) at `J = 0`: `0 < Ω_a`.

declarations.name: actualLcm_integral_forces_topEdgeResidue_paper
declarations.signature: theorem actualLcm_integral_forces_topEdgeResidue_paper {a J K : ℕ} (ha : 8 ≤ a) (hshort : J + K + (a + 6) < 2 * 2 ^ a) (hroom : ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J + K + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) < (2 : ℤ) ^ K) (hint : ∃ d : ℤ, (d : ℝ) = totientTail (2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J) - totientTail (periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J)) : ∃ e : ℤ, ((e : ℝ) = totientTail (2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J + K) - totientTail (periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J + K)) ∧ windowDiscrepancy (periodLcm (2 ^ a)) (periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J) K % (2 : ℤ) ^ K = (2 : ℤ) ^ K - e ∧ 0 < e ∧ e < ((2 * periodLcm (2 ^ a) + J + K + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: **The residue forced by integrality** (`prop:SGN-03`). Let `a, J, K` with `a ≥ 8`, `H = H(2^a)`, `J+K+(a+6) < 2·2^a` and `2H+J+K+2 < 2^K`. If `R_{2H+J} - R_{H+J} ∈ ℤ`, then `D(H, H+J, K) mod 2^K = 2^K - (R_{2H+J+K} - R_{H+J+K})` and `0 < R_{2H+J+K} - R_{H+J+K} < 2H+J+K+2`. The later tail difference is a positive integer; its negative is the representative of `D` near zero (final clause), while the least nonnegative residue lies near `2^K` (penultimate clause). Positivity alone therefore does not prove nonintegrality.

declarations.name: gcd_pos_of_left_pos
declarations.signature: private lemma gcd_pos_of_left_pos {j : ℕ} (x : ℕ) (hj : 0 < j) : 0 < Nat.gcd j x
declarations.docstring: The integral overlap factor, written with an exact rational division: `totientOverlapFactor j x = gcd(j,x)·φ(j)/φ(gcd(j,x))`.

declarations.name: cast_totientOverlapFactor
declarations.signature: private lemma cast_totientOverlapFactor {j : ℕ} (x : ℕ) (hj : 0 < j) : ((totientOverlapFactor j x : ℕ) : ℚ) = (Nat.gcd j x : ℚ) * (Nat.totient j : ℚ) / (Nat.totient (Nat.gcd j x) : ℚ)

declarations.name: gcd_succ_eq_one_of_forall_prime_dvd
declarations.signature: private lemma gcd_succ_eq_one_of_forall_prime_dvd {j x : ℕ} (hx : ∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ j → p ∣ x) : Nat.gcd j (x + 1) = 1
declarations.docstring: If every prime divisor of `j` divides `x`, then `j` is coprime to `x+1`.

declarations.name: lcmRayArithmeticLetter_eq_totient_difference
declarations.signature: theorem lcmRayArithmeticLetter_eq_totient_difference (t j : ℕ) : lcmRayArithmeticLetter t j = (Nat.totient (2 * periodLcm t + j) : ℤ) - (Nat.totient (periodLcm t + j) : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: The arithmetic LCM-ray letter is the literal totient difference `δ_t(j) = φ(2H+j) - φ(H+j)`.

declarations.name: totient_mul_eq_totient_mul_gcd_div_totient_gcd
declarations.signature: theorem totient_mul_eq_totient_mul_gcd_div_totient_gcd {j x : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) (hx : 0 < x) : (Nat.totient (j * x) : ℚ) = (Nat.totient j : ℚ) * (Nat.totient x : ℚ) * (Nat.gcd j x : ℚ) / (Nat.totient (Nat.gcd j x) : ℚ)
declarations.docstring: **The exact totient difference on an LCM progression** (`prop:AR-04-inv`), the product law the identity follows from: `φ(jx) = φ(j)φ(x)gcd(j,x)/φ(gcd(j,x))`, which retains all primes shared by `j` and `x`.

declarations.name: lcmRay_divisor_denominators_pos
declarations.signature: theorem lcmRay_divisor_denominators_pos {t j : ℕ} (hjdvd : j ∣ periodLcm t) : 0 < j ∧ 0 < Nat.totient (Nat.gcd j (periodLcm t / j + 1)) ∧ 0 < Nat.totient (Nat.gcd j (2 * (periodLcm t / j) + 1))
declarations.docstring: **The exact totient difference on an LCM progression** (`prop:AR-04-inv`), well-formedness of the product formula: for a divisor offset `j ∣ H` we have `j ≥ 1` because `H > 0`, so both denominators `φ(g₁)` and `φ(g₂)` are nonzero.

declarations.name: lcmRay_divisor_product_formula
declarations.signature: theorem lcmRay_divisor_product_formula {t j : ℕ} (hjdvd : j ∣ periodLcm t) : ((Nat.totient (2 * periodLcm t + j) : ℚ) - (Nat.totient (periodLcm t + j) : ℚ)) = (Nat.totient j : ℚ) * ((Nat.gcd j (2 * (periodLcm t / j) + 1) : ℚ) * (Nat.totient (2 * (periodLcm t / j) + 1) : ℚ) / (Nat.totient (Nat.gcd j (2 * (periodLcm t / j) + 1)) : ℚ) - (Nat.gcd j (periodLcm t / j + 1) : ℚ) * (Nat.totient (periodLcm t / j + 1) : ℚ) / (Nat.totient (Nat.gcd j (periodLcm t / j + 1)) : ℚ))
declarations.docstring: **The exact totient difference on an LCM progression** (`prop:AR-04-inv`), divisor case. With `H = H(t)`, `j ∣ H`, `a = H/j`, `g₁ = gcd(j,a+1)` and `g₂ = gcd(j,2a+1)`, `δ_t(j) = φ(j)·(g₂φ(2a+1)/φ(g₂) - g₁φ(a+1)/φ(g₁))`. Here `j ≥ 1` because `H > 0`, so both denominators are nonzero.

declarations.name: lcmRay_nondivisor_literal
declarations.signature: theorem lcmRay_nondivisor_literal {t j : ℕ} (hjdvd : ¬ j ∣ periodLcm t) : lcmRayArithmeticLetter t j = (Nat.totient (2 * periodLcm t + j) : ℤ) - (Nat.totient (periodLcm t + j) : ℤ) ∧ lcmRayArithmeticLetter t j = deltaTotient (periodLcm t) (periodLcm t + j)
