declarations.signature: theorem ready_invariant (f : ℕ → ℝ) (start : ℕ) (hstart : Ready f start 0) : ∀ j, Ready f (centre f start j) (level f start j)

declarations.name: level_cofinal
declarations.signature: theorem level_cofinal (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : Tendsto f atTop atTop) (start : ℕ) : ∀ k, ∃ j, k ≤ level f start j
declarations.docstring: The level really reaches every integer; a perpetually stalled level would contradict the envelope's eventual readiness.

declarations.name: level_tendsto_atTop
declarations.signature: theorem level_tendsto_atTop (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : Tendsto f atTop atTop) (start : ℕ) : Tendsto (level f start) atTop atTop

declarations.name: eventual_spacing
declarations.signature: theorem eventual_spacing (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : Tendsto f atTop atTop) (start R : ℕ) : ∃ J, ∀ j, J ≤ j → R ≤ centre f start (j + 1) - centre f start j
declarations.docstring: Eventually every spacing is at least any prescribed R.

declarations.name: capacity
declarations.signature: def capacity (f : ℕ → ℝ) (start j : ℕ) : ℕ
declarations.docstring: Capacity and outgoing look-ahead modulus on the generated centres.

declarations.name: modulus
declarations.signature: def modulus (f : ℕ → ℝ) (start j : ℕ) : ℕ

declarations.name: capacity_budget
declarations.signature: theorem capacity_budget (f : ℕ → ℝ) (start : ℕ) (hstart : Ready f start 0) (j : ℕ) : (capacity f start j : ℝ) ≤ f (centre f start j) ∧ capacity f start j ≤ centre f start j + 1

declarations.name: modulus_pos
declarations.signature: theorem modulus_pos (f : ℕ → ℝ) (start j : ℕ) : 0 < modulus f start j

declarations.name: modulus_dvd_next
declarations.signature: theorem modulus_dvd_next (f : ℕ → ℝ) (start j : ℕ) : modulus f start j ∣ modulus f start (j + 1)

declarations.name: modulus_upper
declarations.signature: theorem modulus_upper (f : ℕ → ℝ) (start j : ℕ) : modulus f start j ≤ (level f start j + 2).factorial

declarations.name: next_modulus_upper
declarations.signature: theorem next_modulus_upper (f : ℕ → ℝ) (start j : ℕ) : modulus f start (j + 1) ≤ (level f start j + 3).factorial

declarations.name: next_capacity_overlap
declarations.signature: theorem next_capacity_overlap (f : ℕ → ℝ) (start j : ℕ) : modulus f start j * 2 ^ gap (level f start j) + 2 * modulus f start (j + 1) ≤ capacity f start (j + 1)
declarations.docstring: Division-free, next-site overlap. This is proved for the actual schedule, not passed as a capacity hypothesis to the digit selector.

declarations.name: twice_modulus_le_capacity
declarations.signature: theorem twice_modulus_le_capacity (f : ℕ → ℝ) (start j : ℕ) : 2 * modulus f start j ≤ capacity f start j

declarations.name: every_modulus_eventually
declarations.signature: theorem every_modulus_eventually (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : Tendsto f atTop atTop) (start q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) : ∃ J, ∀ j, J ≤ j → q ∣ modulus f start j
declarations.docstring: Every fixed positive modulus divides all outgoing moduli eventually.

declarations.name: exists_budgeted_schedule
declarations.signature: theorem exists_budgeted_schedule (f : ℕ → ℝ) (hf : Tendsto f atTop atTop) (K : ℕ) : ∃ start : ℕ, K ≤ start ∧ Ready f start 0 ∧ StrictMono (centre f start) ∧ (∀ j, (capacity f start j : ℝ) ≤ f (centre f start j) ∧ capacity f start j ≤ centre f start j + 1) ∧ (∀ R, ∃ J, ∀ j, J ≤ j → R ≤ centre f start (j + 1) - centre f start j) ∧ (∀ j, 2 * modulus f start j ≤ capacity f start j) ∧ (∀ j, modulus f start j * 2 ^ gap (level f start j) + 2 * modulus f start (j + 1) ≤ capacity f start (j + 1))
declarations.docstring: Package for the arbitrary-envelope schedule. The remaining analytic steps, in particular its sharper polylogarithmic count, are not hidden here.

declarations.name: exists_repair_in_sqrt_window
declarations.signature: theorem exists_repair_in_sqrt_window (Q : ℕ → ℕ) (hQ : ∀ N, (Q N : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) + 4) (K : ℕ) : ∃ N, K ≤ N ∧ N < K + 2 * Nat.sqrt K + 12 ∧ Q (N + 1) ≤ Q N
declarations.docstring: A natural sequence in the square-root strip cannot strictly increase through a window of length `2 * sqrt K + 12`. No recurrence is assumed.

declarations.name: fourNinthsGreedyDefect_le_sqrt_of_mem
declarations.signature: theorem fourNinthsGreedyDefect_le_sqrt_of_mem (hmem : (4 / 9 : ℝ) ∈ mersenneAchievementSet) (N : ℕ) : (fourNinthsGreedyDefect N : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) + 4
declarations.docstring: Under actual membership the floor defect lies in the support-uniform square-root strip at every rank, including selected ranks.

declarations.name: fourNinths_repair_sqrt_window_of_mem
declarations.signature: theorem fourNinths_repair_sqrt_window_of_mem (hmem : (4 / 9 : ℝ) ∈ mersenneAchievementSet) (K : ℕ) : ∃ N, K ≤ N ∧ N < K + 2 * Nat.sqrt K + 12 ∧ FourNinthsOneStepRepairSucc N
declarations.docstring: A stronger necessary condition than cofinality: there is a repair in every explicit square-root window.

declarations.name: four_ninths_mem_iff_repairCofinal
declarations.docstring: The old sufficient producer is also necessary. The equivalence is target-specific and does not promote 4/9 membership to universal #257.

declarations.name: four_ninths_mem_iff_repair_sqrt_windows
declarations.signature: theorem four_ninths_mem_iff_repair_sqrt_windows : (4 / 9 : ℝ) ∈ mersenneAchievementSet ↔ ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ N, K ≤ N ∧ N < K + 2 * Nat.sqrt K + 12 ∧ FourNinthsOneStepRepairSucc N
declarations.docstring: A finite-window formulation exactly equivalent to 4/9 membership.

declarations.name: four_ninths_not_mem_of_strict_sqrt_window
declarations.signature: theorem four_ninths_not_mem_of_strict_sqrt_window (K : ℕ) (h : ∀ N, K ≤ N → N < K + 2 * Nat.sqrt K + 12 → fourNinthsGreedyDefect N < fourNinthsGreedyDefect (N + 1)) : (4 / 9 : ℝ) ∉ mersenneAchievementSet
declarations.docstring: One certified window of strict increases excludes the target.

declarations.name: card_Icc_one_filter_dvd
declarations.signature: theorem card_Icc_one_filter_dvd {d X : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) : ((Icc 1 X).filter (fun n => d ∣ n)).card = X / d
declarations.docstring: Multiples of `d` in `{1, …, X}` number exactly `X / d`.

declarations.name: divisorMajorantCost
declarations.signature: noncomputable def divisorMajorantCost (D : Finset ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ
declarations.docstring: Cost of a finitely supported nonnegative divisor majorant.

declarations.name: cesaro_le_divisorMajorantCost
declarations.signature: theorem cesaro_le_divisorMajorantCost (g : ℕ → ℝ) (D : Finset ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (X : ℕ) (hX : 0 < X) (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, 0 < d) (hc : ∀ d ∈ D, 0 ≤ c d) (hg0 : ∀ n, 0 ≤ g n) (hmaj : ∀ n, 0 < n → g n ≤ ∑ d ∈ D.filter (fun d => d ∣ n), c d) : (∑ n ∈ Icc 1 X, g n) / X ≤ divisorMajorantCost D c
declarations.docstring: Cover-independent Cesàro bound: if `0 ≤ g n ≤ ∑_{d∣n} c_d` then the average of `g` on `{1, …, X}` is at most the majorant cost.

declarations.name: divisorMajorantCost_one
declarations.signature: theorem divisorMajorantCost_one (E : Finset ℕ) : divisorMajorantCost E (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) = ∑ a ∈ E, (1 : ℝ) / a
declarations.docstring: Trivial coprime cover: putting mass `1` on each modulus costs the reciprocal sum. Type B Theorem B.1 compares every cover against a stronger periodic-density lower bound recorded ordinarily.

declarations.name: exists_common_sample_of_weighted_sum_lt_one
declarations.signature: theorem exists_common_sample_of_weighted_sum_lt_one {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (μ f g : ι → ℝ) (hμ : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ μ i) (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i) (hg : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ g i) (hprob : ∑ i ∈ s, μ i = 1) (hmean : ∑ i ∈ s, μ i * (f i + g i) < 1) : ∃ i ∈ s, f i < 1 ∧ g i < 1
declarations.docstring: Two nonnegative error budgets whose combined probability mean is below one admit a common sample where both errors are below one.

declarations.name: finite_average_le_of_two_error_budgets
declarations.signature: theorem finite_average_le_of_two_error_budgets {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hcard : s.card = m) (L a : ℝ) (u near transition : ι → ℝ) (hpoint : ∀ i ∈ s, u i ≤ a + near i + transition i) (hnear : ∑ i ∈ s, near i ≤ 2 * L * a) (htransition : ∑ i ∈ s, transition i ≤ 2 * L * a) : (∑ i ∈ s, u i) / (m : ℝ) ≤ (1 + 4 * L / m) * a
declarations.docstring: The arithmetic end of the three-regime argument. Once the near and transition errors each have total mass at most `2 * L * a`, averaging over `m` lengths gives `(1 + 4 * L / m) * a`.

declarations.name: transition_index_unique
declarations.signature: theorem transition_index_unique (T : ℕ → ℝ) (L d : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hdouble : ∀ i j : ℕ, i < j → 2 * T i ≤ T j) {i j : ℕ} (hi₁ : L * T i < d) (hi₂ : d ≤ 2 * L * T i) (hj₁ : L * T j < d) (hj₂ : d ≤ 2 * L * T j) : i = j
declarations.docstring: A sequence which at least doubles between distinct indices has at most one transition length `L*T < d ≤ 2*L*T`. Dyadic lengths are the intended instance; their growth hypothesis is not hidden in the statement.

declarations.name: fourNinthsBinaryFloor
declarations.docstring: Integral dyadic floor of the target `4/9`.

declarations.name: fourNinthsGreedyPrefixNumerator_le_floor
declarations.signature: theorem fourNinthsGreedyPrefixNumerator_le_floor (N : ℕ) : binaryCoeffPrefixNumerator (supportCoeff (greedyMersenneSupport (4 / 9 : ℝ))) N ≤ fourNinthsBinaryFloor N
declarations.docstring: The actual greedy Lambert prefix lies below the integral `4/9` floor.

declarations.name: fourNinthsGreedyDefect
declarations.docstring: Natural defect after removing the periodic floor orbit of `4/9`.

declarations.name: fourNinthsFloorBit
declarations.docstring: The next digit of the dyadic floor orbit of `4/9`.

declarations.name: fourNinthsGreedyDefect_cast_eq
declarations.signature: theorem fourNinthsGreedyDefect_cast_eq (N : ℕ) : (fourNinthsGreedyDefect N : ℤ) = (fourNinthsBinaryFloor N : ℤ) - (binaryCoeffPrefixNumerator (supportCoeff (greedyMersenneSupport (4 / 9 : ℝ))) N : ℤ)

declarations.name: fourNinthsGreedyDefect_succ
declarations.signature: theorem fourNinthsGreedyDefect_succ (N : ℕ) : (fourNinthsGreedyDefect (N + 1) : ℤ) = 2 * (fourNinthsGreedyDefect N : ℤ) + fourNinthsFloorBit N - (supportCoeff (greedyMersenneSupport (4 / 9 : ℝ)) (N + 1) : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: Exact one-step recurrence; the only nonperiodic input is the actual greedy divisor load.

declarations.name: fourNinthsFloorBit_eq_two_mul_mod_div
declarations.signature: theorem fourNinthsFloorBit_eq_two_mul_mod_div (N : ℕ) : fourNinthsFloorBit N = ((2 * ((4 * 2 ^ N) % 9) / 9 : ℕ) : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: Quotient-remainder form of the target floor bit.

declarations.name: fourNinthsGreedyFinitePrefixTail
declarations.docstring: Scaled future-multiple tail generated by the already selected prefix.

declarations.name: fourNinths_targetCarry_eq_scaled_remainder_add_tail
declarations.signature: theorem fourNinths_targetCarry_eq_scaled_remainder_add_tail (N : ℕ) : (4 * (2 : ℝ) ^ N - 9 * (binaryCoeffPrefixNumerator (supportCoeff (greedyMersenneSupport (4 / 9 : ℝ))) N : ℝ)) = 9 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ N * greedyMersenneRemainder (4 / 9 : ℝ) N + fourNinthsGreedyFinitePrefixTail N)
declarations.docstring: Exact real bridge from the integral target carry to the actual greedy remainder and the finite-prefix divisor tail.

declarations.name: fourNinths_scaled_greedyRemainder_le_defect_add_one
declarations.signature: theorem fourNinths_scaled_greedyRemainder_le_defect_add_one (N : ℕ) : (2 : ℝ) ^ N * greedyMersenneRemainder (4 / 9 : ℝ) N ≤ (fourNinthsGreedyDefect N : ℝ) + 1
declarations.docstring: The scaled actual remainder is bounded by the natural defect plus one.

declarations.name: fourNinthsGreedyDefect_geometricLower_of_not_mem
declarations.signature: theorem fourNinthsGreedyDefect_geometricLower_of_not_mem (hnot : (4 / 9 : ℝ) ∉ mersenneAchievementSet) : ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + k) * δ ≤ (fourNinthsGreedyDefect (n + k) : ℝ) + 1
declarations.docstring: A fatal `4/9` state forces geometric growth in the defect.

declarations.name: fourNinthsDefect_eventually_gt_add_two_of_not_mem
declarations.signature: theorem fourNinthsDefect_eventually_gt_add_two_of_not_mem (hnot : (4 / 9 : ℝ) ∉ mersenneAchievementSet) : ∃ M : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, M ≤ m → m + 2 < fourNinthsGreedyDefect m
declarations.docstring: On non-membership the defect eventually dominates the identity.

declarations.name: fourNinthsGreedyDefect_strictSucc_of_gt
declarations.signature: theorem fourNinthsGreedyDefect_strictSucc_of_gt {N : ℕ} (hbig : N + 2 < fourNinthsGreedyDefect N) : fourNinthsGreedyDefect (N + 1) > fourNinthsGreedyDefect N
declarations.docstring: Once the defect dominates the identity, every later step strictly rises.

declarations.name: FourNinthsOneStepRepairSucc
declarations.docstring: A one-step repair means that the defect fails to rise.

declarations.name: FourNinthsOneStepRepairCofinal
declarations.docstring: Repairs occur beyond every cutoff, without a periodicity requirement.

declarations.name: four_ninths_mem_mersenneAchievementSet_of_repairCofinal
declarations.docstring: **Weakest-form four-ninths endpoint.** Cofinal one-step repairs force `4/9` into the Mersenne achievement set.

declarations.name: FourNinthsMultiple120RepairSupply
declarations.docstring: The surviving periodic producer asks for an actual repair at every positive multiple of `120`. The argument below uses only its cofinality; the all-depth arithmetic statement itself remains open.

declarations.name: finiteErdosSum_ne_four_div_nine
declarations.signature: theorem finiteErdosSum_ne_four_div_nine (F : Finset ℕ) (hF : ∀ n ∈ F, 2 ≤ n) : finiteErdosSum F 2 ≠ (4 : ℚ) / 9
declarations.docstring: No finite Boolean support using ranks at least two sums to `4/9`. The reduced-denominator order theorem makes the support lcm divide six, so every selected rank is `2`, `3`, or `6`; exact arithmetic excludes all eight subsets.

declarations.name: exists_infinite_four_ninths_counterexample_of_repairCofinal
declarations.signature: theorem exists_infinite_four_ninths_counterexample_of_repairCofinal (hrep : FourNinthsOneStepRepairCofinal) : ∃ A : Set ℕ, A.Infinite ∧ erdosSupportSeries 2 A = (4 : ℝ) / 9
declarations.docstring: Cofinal repairs produce an infinite support whose reciprocal-Mersenne series is exactly `4/9`.

declarations.name: not_universal_of_fourNinths_repairCofinal
declarations.docstring: **Full conditional endpoint.** Cofinal one-step repairs give an infinite rational Mersenne subseries and therefore refute Erdős #257's universal irrationality assertion.

declarations.name: greedyBinaryPrefix_le_floor
declarations.signature: theorem greedyBinaryPrefix_le_floor {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (N : ℕ) : binaryCoeffPrefixNumerator (supportCoeff (greedyMersenneSupport x)) N ≤ ⌊(2 : ℝ) ^ N * x⌋₊

declarations.name: greedyBinaryDefect_cast
declarations.signature: theorem greedyBinaryDefect_cast {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (N : ℕ) : (greedyBinaryDefect x N : ℝ) = (⌊(2 : ℝ) ^ N * x⌋₊ : ℝ) - (binaryCoeffPrefixNumerator (supportCoeff (greedyMersenneSupport x)) N : ℝ)

declarations.name: greedyBinaryDefect_succ_lower
declarations.signature: theorem greedyBinaryDefect_succ_lower {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (N : ℕ) : 2 * (greedyBinaryDefect x N : ℝ) - supportCoeff (greedyMersenneSupport x) (N + 1) ≤ (greedyBinaryDefect x (N + 1) : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: The next floor digit is nonnegative; its periodicity is irrelevant.

declarations.name: greedyBinaryDefect_le_load_of_repair
declarations.signature: theorem greedyBinaryDefect_le_load_of_repair {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (N : ℕ) (hr : greedyBinaryDefect x (N + 1) ≤ greedyBinaryDefect x N) : greedyBinaryDefect x N ≤ supportCoeff (greedyMersenneSupport x) (N + 1)
declarations.docstring: A repair bounds the actual defect by the actual next divisor load.

declarations.name: greedy_scaled_remainder_le_defect_add_one
declarations.signature: theorem greedy_scaled_remainder_le_defect_add_one {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (N : ℕ) : (2 : ℝ) ^ N * greedyMersenneRemainder x N ≤ (greedyBinaryDefect x N : ℝ) + 1
declarations.docstring: Removing the finite Lambert prefix leaves the scaled actual greedy remainder and a nonnegative future-multiple tail.

declarations.name: greedyBinaryDefect_le_sqrt_of_mem
declarations.signature: theorem greedyBinaryDefect_le_sqrt_of_mem {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hm : x ∈ mersenneAchievementSet) (N : ℕ) : (greedyBinaryDefect x N : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) + 4
declarations.docstring: The support-uniform strip holds at every rank of a represented target.

declarations.name: mem_of_greedyBinaryDefect_cofinal_linear_bound
declarations.signature: theorem mem_of_greedyBinaryDefect_cofinal_linear_bound {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hb : ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ N : ℕ, K ≤ N ∧ greedyBinaryDefect x N ≤ N + 1) : x ∈ mersenneAchievementSet
declarations.docstring: A cofinal linear bound already rules out the geometric growth of an actual fatal greedy remainder.

declarations.name: mem_iff_greedyBinaryDefect_cofinal_repairs
declarations.signature: theorem mem_iff_greedyBinaryDefect_cofinal_repairs {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : x ∈ mersenneAchievementSet ↔ ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ N : ℕ, K ≤ N ∧ greedyBinaryDefect x (N + 1) ≤ greedyBinaryDefect x N
declarations.docstring: Cofinal nonincreases characterise membership for every nonnegative real target, with no rationality or periodic-digit hypothesis.

declarations.name: mem_iff_greedyBinaryDefect_sqrt_windows
declarations.signature: theorem mem_iff_greedyBinaryDefect_sqrt_windows {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : x ∈ mersenneAchievementSet ↔ ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ N : ℕ, K ≤ N ∧ N < K + 2 * Nat.sqrt K + 12 ∧ greedyBinaryDefect x (N + 1) ≤ greedyBinaryDefect x N
declarations.docstring: The explicit square-root deadline is uniform in the represented value.

declarations.name: mem_iff_greedyBinaryDefect_cofinal_load_bound
declarations.signature: theorem mem_iff_greedyBinaryDefect_cofinal_load_bound {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : x ∈ mersenneAchievementSet ↔ ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ N : ℕ, K ≤ N ∧ greedyBinaryDefect x N ≤ supportCoeff (greedyMersenneSupport x) (N + 1)
declarations.docstring: A cofinal bound by the actual next divisor load is an equivalent producer.

declarations.name: mem_iff_greedyBinaryDefect_cofinal_linear_bound
declarations.signature: theorem mem_iff_greedyBinaryDefect_cofinal_linear_bound {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : x ∈ mersenneAchievementSet ↔ ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ N : ℕ, K ≤ N ∧ greedyBinaryDefect x N ≤ N + 1
declarations.docstring: The linear comparison suffices at cofinally many ranks.

declarations.name: not_mem_of_greedyBinaryDefect_strict_sqrt_window
declarations.signature: theorem not_mem_of_greedyBinaryDefect_strict_sqrt_window {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (K : ℕ) (hstrict : ∀ N : ℕ, K ≤ N → N < K + 2 * Nat.sqrt K + 12 → greedyBinaryDefect x N < greedyBinaryDefect x (N + 1)) : x ∉ mersenneAchievementSet
declarations.docstring: One finite strict-increase window excludes the actual target.

declarations.name: UniversalMersenneSubseriesIrrationality
declarations.docstring: The universal irrationality assertion in Erdős #257.

declarations.name: exists_rational_half_counterexample_of_terminalScaledVanishing
declarations.signature: theorem exists_rational_half_counterexample_of_terminalScaledVanishing (S : HalfTerminalOnlyScaledVanishingSequence) : ∃ A : Set ℕ, A.Infinite ∧ erdosSupportSeries 2 A = (1 : ℝ) / 2
declarations.docstring: Any terminal scaled-vanishing sequence supplies an infinite rational counterexample of exact value `1/2`.

declarations.name: not_universal_of_terminalScaledVanishing
declarations.docstring: The same conditional hypothesis negates the universal irrationality claim.

declarations.name: finiteErdosSum_ne_one_div_twenty_one
declarations.signature: theorem finiteErdosSum_ne_one_div_twenty_one (F : Finset ℕ) (hF : ∀ n ∈ F, 2 ≤ n) : finiteErdosSum F 2 ≠ (1 : ℚ) / 21
declarations.docstring: No finite Boolean support on the genuine reciprocal-Mersenne ranks can sum to `1/21`. The reduced-denominator order theorem forces the support lcm to be six, hence every selected rank is one of `2`, `3`, or `6`; the eight remaining finite possibilities are then exact arithmetic. Consequently, if a representation of `1/21` is first reduced to Boolean support using only ranks at least two, this theorem rules out finite support. The existence of such a representation is not proved here.

declarations.name: selectedMersenneTail
declarations.signature: noncomputable def selectedMersenneTail (J : Set ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ
declarations.docstring: Mersenne tails restricted to an arbitrary set of future offsets.

declarations.name: summable_selectedMersenneTail
declarations.signature: theorem summable_selectedMersenneTail (J : Set ℕ) (n : ℕ) : Summable (J.indicator (fun k => mersenneWeight (n + k + 1)))

declarations.name: selectedMersenneTail_lt_weight
declarations.signature: theorem selectedMersenneTail_lt_weight (J : Set ℕ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : selectedMersenneTail J n < mersenneWeight n
declarations.docstring: Strict superincreasingness is hereditary under deleting any collection of future Mersenne weights.

declarations.name: SupportedMersenneDigits
declarations.docstring: Binary digit strings supported on `J`.

declarations.name: supportedMersenneDigitValue
declarations.signature: noncomputable def supportedMersenneDigitValue (J : Set ℕ) (b : SupportedMersenneDigits J) : ℝ
declarations.docstring: The ordinary Mersenne digit map restricted to a chosen support.

declarations.name: supportedMersenneDigitValue_injective
declarations.signature: theorem supportedMersenneDigitValue_injective (J : Set ℕ) : Function.Injective (supportedMersenneDigitValue J)
declarations.docstring: Every Mersenne subseries retains unique binary coding.

declarations.name: supportedMersenneDigitSet
declarations.signature: def supportedMersenneDigitSet (J : Set ℕ) : Set (ℕ → Fin 2)
declarations.docstring: Supported binary strings as a closed subset of the full product space.

declarations.name: isClosed_supportedMersenneDigitSet
declarations.signature: theorem isClosed_supportedMersenneDigitSet (J : Set ℕ) : IsClosed (supportedMersenneDigitSet J)

declarations.name: supportedMersenneAchievementSet
declarations.signature: def supportedMersenneAchievementSet (J : Set ℕ) : Set ℝ
declarations.docstring: The achievement set obtained by allowing digits only on `J`.

declarations.name: supportedMersenneAchievementSet_eq_image
declarations.signature: theorem supportedMersenneAchievementSet_eq_image (J : Set ℕ) : supportedMersenneAchievementSet J = positiveMersenneDigitValue '' supportedMersenneDigitSet J

declarations.name: isCompact_supportedMersenneAchievementSet
declarations.signature: theorem isCompact_supportedMersenneAchievementSet (J : Set ℕ) : IsCompact (supportedMersenneAchievementSet J)
declarations.docstring: Every support-restricted Mersenne achievement set is compact.

declarations.name: isClosed_supportedMersenneAchievementSet
declarations.signature: theorem isClosed_supportedMersenneAchievementSet (J : Set ℕ) : IsClosed (supportedMersenneAchievementSet J)

declarations.name: supportedMersenneAchievementSet_subset
declarations.signature: theorem supportedMersenneAchievementSet_subset (J : Set ℕ) : supportedMersenneAchievementSet J ⊆ mersenneAchievementSet
declarations.docstring: Deleting coordinates really produces a subset of the full Mersenne achievement set; unique coding prevents any hidden re-entry through another digit string.

declarations.name: isNowhereDense_supportedMersenneAchievementSet
declarations.docstring: Nowhere density is hereditary for every selected support, finite or infinite. In particular no support-restricted Mersenne achievement set can contain an interval.

declarations.name: preperfect_supportedMersenneDigitSet
declarations.signature: theorem preperfect_supportedMersenneDigitSet {J : Set ℕ} (hJ : J.Infinite) : Preperfect (supportedMersenneDigitSet J)
declarations.docstring: If the selected support is infinite, its closed digit subspace has no isolated point: every basic product neighbourhood leaves some selected coordinate free to flip.

declarations.name: preperfect_supportedMersenneAchievementSet
declarations.signature: theorem preperfect_supportedMersenneAchievementSet {J : Set ℕ} (hJ : J.Infinite) : Preperfect (supportedMersenneAchievementSet J)

declarations.name: perfect_supportedMersenneAchievementSet
declarations.signature: theorem perfect_supportedMersenneAchievementSet {J : Set ℕ} (hJ : J.Infinite) : Perfect (supportedMersenneAchievementSet J)
declarations.docstring: Every infinite selected support produces a compact perfect nowhere-dense set with unique coding.

declarations.name: summable_mersenneDigitTerm
declarations.signature: theorem summable_mersenneDigitTerm (b : ℕ → Fin 2) : Summable (fun k => mersenneDigitTerm k b)

declarations.name: positiveMersenneDigitValue_update
declarations.signature: theorem positiveMersenneDigitValue_update (b : ℕ → Fin 2) (k : ℕ) (a : Fin 2) : positiveMersenneDigitValue (Function.update b k a) = ((((a : ℕ) : ℝ) - ((b k : ℕ) : ℝ)) * mersenneWeight (k + 1)) + positiveMersenneDigitValue b
declarations.docstring: Updating one binary coordinate changes the coded value by exactly the corresponding signed Mersenne weight.

declarations.name: supportedMersenneAchievementSet_insert
declarations.signature: theorem supportedMersenneAchievementSet_insert {J : Set ℕ} {k : ℕ} (hk : k ∉ J) : supportedMersenneAchievementSet (insert k J) = supportedMersenneAchievementSet J ∪ (fun x : ℝ => mersenneWeight (k + 1) + x) '' supportedMersenneAchievementSet J
declarations.docstring: Adding one previously forbidden coordinate splits the achievement set into its zero face and a translate of that face.

declarations.name: disjoint_supportedMersenneAchievementSet_translate
declarations.signature: theorem disjoint_supportedMersenneAchievementSet_translate {J : Set ℕ} {k : ℕ} (hk : k ∉ J) : Disjoint (supportedMersenneAchievementSet J) ((fun x : ℝ => mersenneWeight (k + 1) + x) '' supportedMersenneAchievementSet J)
declarations.docstring: The two faces in the one-coordinate split are disjoint. This is exactly where unique coding is spent.

declarations.name: volume_supportedMersenneAchievementSet_insert
declarations.signature: theorem volume_supportedMersenneAchievementSet_insert {J : Set ℕ} {k : ℕ} (hk : k ∉ J) : volume (supportedMersenneAchievementSet (insert k J)) = 2 * volume (supportedMersenneAchievementSet J)
declarations.docstring: Allowing one new coordinate doubles Lebesgue measure: the two faces are disjoint translates of the same compact measurable set.

declarations.name: volume_supportedMersenneAchievementSet_finset_compl_scaled
declarations.signature: theorem volume_supportedMersenneAchievementSet_finset_compl_scaled (F : Finset ℕ) : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ F.card * volume (supportedMersenneAchievementSet ((↑F : Set ℕ)ᶜ)) = 1
declarations.docstring: Finite-coordinate face volume in a division-free form. Deleting the coordinates in `F` and then multiplying by `2^|F|` recovers the full measure-one Mersenne achievement set.

declarations.name: volume_supportedMersenneAchievementSet_finset_compl
declarations.signature: theorem volume_supportedMersenneAchievementSet_finset_compl (F : Finset ℕ) : volume (supportedMersenneAchievementSet ((↑F : Set ℕ)ᶜ)) = ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ F.card)⁻¹
declarations.docstring: Exact finite-codimension volume. Forbidding exactly the coordinates in `F` leaves a face of Lebesgue measure `2^(-|F|)`.

declarations.name: supportedMersenneAchievementSet_mono
declarations.signature: theorem supportedMersenneAchievementSet_mono {J K : Set ℕ} (hJK : J ⊆ K) : supportedMersenneAchievementSet J ⊆ supportedMersenneAchievementSet K
declarations.docstring: Enlarging the set of allowed coordinates enlarges its achievement set.

declarations.name: volume_supportedMersenneAchievementSet_eq_zero_of_compl_infinite
declarations.signature: theorem volume_supportedMersenneAchievementSet_eq_zero_of_compl_infinite {J : Set ℕ} (hJ : Jᶜ.Infinite) : volume (supportedMersenneAchievementSet J) = 0
declarations.docstring: If infinitely many binary coordinates are forbidden, the supported Mersenne achievement set has Lebesgue measure zero. The proof traps it below finite-codimension faces of arbitrarily small dyadic measure.

declarations.name: volume_supportedMersenneAchievementSet_dichotomy
declarations.signature: theorem volume_supportedMersenneAchievementSet_dichotomy (J : Set ℕ) : (∃ F : Finset ℕ, J = (↑F : Set ℕ)ᶜ ∧ volume (supportedMersenneAchievementSet J) = ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ F.card)⁻¹) ∨ (Jᶜ.Infinite ∧ volume (supportedMersenneAchievementSet J) = 0)
declarations.docstring: Complete Lebesgue-measure classification of supported Mersenne achievement sets. Either only the finite set `F` of coordinates is omitted, in which case the volume is exactly `2^(-|F|)`, or infinitely many coordinates are omitted and the volume is zero.

declarations.name: support_value_bounds
declarations.signature: private theorem support_value_bounds (A : Set ℕ) : positiveMersenneSupportValue A ∈ Icc 0 erdosBorweinMersenneConstant

declarations.name: convexHull_achievementSet
declarations.signature: theorem convexHull_achievementSet : convexHull ℝ mersenneAchievementSet = Icc 0 erdosBorweinMersenneConstant

declarations.name: unique_positive_support
declarations.signature: theorem unique_positive_support {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ mersenneAchievementSet) : ∃! A : Set ℕ, 0 ∉ A ∧ positiveMersenneSupportValue A = x

declarations.name: paper_achievement_geometry
declarations.signature: theorem paper_achievement_geometry : IsCompact mersenneAchievementSet ∧ IsClosed mersenneAchievementSet ∧ Perfect mersenneAchievementSet ∧ IsTotallyDisconnected mersenneAchievementSet ∧ IsNowhereDense mersenneAchievementSet ∧ volume mersenneAchievementSet = 1 ∧ convexHull ℝ mersenneAchievementSet = Icc 0 erdosBorweinMersenneConstant ∧ Function.Injective positiveMersenneDigitValue ∧ ∀ x ∈ mersenneAchievementSet, ∃! A : Set ℕ, 0 ∉ A ∧ positiveMersenneSupportValue A = x
declarations.docstring: All geometric and coding assertions of long `thm:geometry`.

declarations.name: square_depth_witness
declarations.signature: theorem square_depth_witness (A : Set ℕ) (hone : 1 ∉ A) (hhalf : erdosSupportSeries 2 A = (1 : ℝ) / 2) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : (integerHalfCarry A (k^2-1) : ℝ) = binaryCoeffTail (supportCoeff A) (k^2) ∧ binaryCoeffTail (supportCoeff A) (k^2) ≤ 2*(k : ℝ)+4 ∧ (halfStripBound (k^2) : ℝ) = 2*(k : ℝ)+4
declarations.docstring: At every positive square depth the analytic tail bound is exactly the integer strip, with constant four and no rounding slack.

declarations.name: achieving_support_cofinal_strip
declarations.signature: theorem achieving_support_cofinal_strip (A : Set ℕ) (hone : 1 ∉ A) (hhalf : erdosSupportSeries 2 A = (1 : ℝ)/2) : ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ N : ℕ, K ≤ N ∧ (integerHalfCarry A N : ℝ) ≤ (halfStripBound (N+1) : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: An achieving support has cofinally many carries inside the original integer strip; this does not assert achievement for an arbitrary support.

declarations.name: zero_of_cofinal_linear_pow_bound
declarations.signature: theorem zero_of_cofinal_linear_pow_bound (d a b : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (h : ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ N : ℕ, K ≤ N ∧ (2 : ℝ)^(N+1)*d ≤ a*(N : ℝ)+b) : d = 0
declarations.docstring: A fixed nonnegative exponential coefficient cannot have cofinally many values below a fixed affine bound.

declarations.name: sqrt_affine_majorant
declarations.signature: theorem sqrt_affine_majorant (C D : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : C*Real.sqrt ((N : ℝ)+1)+D ≤ |C| *((N : ℝ)+2)+|D|
declarations.docstring: The paper permits arbitrary real constants; absolute values provide a nonnegative linear majorant without strengthening its hypotheses.

declarations.name: half_of_cofinal_absolute_carry
declarations.signature: theorem half_of_cofinal_absolute_carry (A : Set ℕ) (hone : 1 ∉ A) (C D : ℝ) (h : ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ N : ℕ, K ≤ N ∧ |(integerHalfCarry A N : ℝ)| ≤ C*Real.sqrt ((N : ℝ)+1)+D) : erdosSupportSeries 2 A = (1 : ℝ)/2
declarations.docstring: Full arbitrary-support clause of long `prop:collapse`.

declarations.name: half_of_cofinal_upper_carry
declarations.signature: theorem half_of_cofinal_upper_carry (A : Set ℕ) (hone : 1 ∉ A) (hle : erdosSupportSeries 2 A ≤ (1 : ℝ)/2) (C D : ℝ) (h : ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ N : ℕ, K ≤ N ∧ (integerHalfCarry A N : ℝ) ≤ C*Real.sqrt ((N : ℝ)+1)+D) : erdosSupportSeries 2 A = (1 : ℝ)/2
declarations.docstring: One-sided bounds suffice whenever the support value does not overshoot.

declarations.name: greedy_half_of_cofinal_upper_carry
declarations.signature: theorem greedy_half_of_cofinal_upper_carry (C D : ℝ) (h : ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ N : ℕ, K ≤ N ∧ (integerHalfCarry (greedyMersenneSupport (1/2 : ℝ)) N : ℝ) ≤ C*Real.sqrt ((N : ℝ)+1)+D) : erdosSupportSeries 2 (greedyMersenneSupport (1/2 : ℝ)) = (1 : ℝ)/2
declarations.docstring: Full greedy one-sided clause of long `prop:collapse`.

declarations.name: paperIntegerDefect
declarations.signature: noncomputable def paperIntegerDefect (x : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : ℤ

declarations.name: paperIntegerDefect_eq
declarations.signature: theorem paperIntegerDefect_eq {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (N : ℕ) : paperIntegerDefect x N = (greedyBinaryDefect x N : ℤ)

declarations.name: paper_general_repair_criteria
declarations.signature: theorem paper_general_repair_criteria {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : (x ∈ mersenneAchievementSet ↔ ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ N, K ≤ N ∧ paperIntegerDefect x (N+1) ≤ paperIntegerDefect x N) ∧ (x ∈ mersenneAchievementSet ↔ ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ N, K ≤ N ∧ N < K+2*Nat.sqrt K+12 ∧ paperIntegerDefect x (N+1) ≤ paperIntegerDefect x N)

declarations.name: straddle_agrees_greedy
declarations.signature: theorem straddle_agrees_greedy {t : ℝ} {u : Finset ℕ} {d : ℕ} (hu : IsStraddlePrefix t u d) : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → n ≤ d → (n ∈ u ↔ n ∈ greedyMersenneSupport t)

declarations.name: InternalMersenneGap
declarations.docstring: Literal finite internal gap over a positive finite prefix.

declarations.name: internal_gap_excludes_membership
declarations.signature: theorem internal_gap_excludes_membership {x : ℝ} (h : InternalMersenneGap x) : x ∉ mersenneAchievementSet

declarations.name: general_target_gap_iff
declarations.signature: theorem general_target_gap_iff {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hE : x ≤ erdosBorweinMersenneConstant) : x ∉ mersenneAchievementSet ↔ InternalMersenneGap x

declarations.name: internal_gap_endpoints
declarations.signature: theorem internal_gap_endpoints (D : Finset ℕ) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hD : ∀ n ∈ D, 0 < n ∧ n < m) : (positiveMersenneSupportValue (D : Set ℕ)+mersenneTail m) ∈ mersenneAchievementSet ∧ (positiveMersenneSupportValue (D : Set ℕ)+mersenneWeight m) ∈ mersenneAchievementSet
declarations.docstring: Both endpoints of every positive finite-prefix gap are achievable.

declarations.name: paper_general_target_gap
declarations.signature: theorem paper_general_target_gap : (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ erdosBorweinMersenneConstant → (x ∉ mersenneAchievementSet ↔ InternalMersenneGap x)) ∧ (∀ (D : Finset ℕ) (m : ℕ), 1 ≤ m → (∀ n ∈ D, 0 < n ∧ n < m) → (positiveMersenneSupportValue (D : Set ℕ)+mersenneTail m) ∈ mersenneAchievementSet ∧ (positiveMersenneSupportValue (D : Set ℕ)+mersenneWeight m) ∈ mersenneAchievementSet)
declarations.docstring: Entire general-target finite-gap observation, including achievable endpoints.

declarations.name: paper_greedy_survival
declarations.signature: theorem paper_greedy_survival : (∀ x : ℝ, x ∈ mersenneAchievementSet ↔ 0 ≤ x ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, greedyMersenneRemainder x n ≤ mersenneTail n) ∧ (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ erdosBorweinMersenneConstant → (x ∉ mersenneAchievementSet ↔ InternalMersenneGap x))
declarations.docstring: Both clauses of the long paper's greedy-survival theorem.

declarations.name: mersenne_constant_decimal
declarations.signature: theorem mersenne_constant_decimal : (1066951524152917 : ℝ)/10^16 < erdosBorweinMersenneConstant-3/2 ∧ erdosBorweinMersenneConstant-3/2 < (1066951524152918 : ℝ)/10^16
declarations.docstring: Exact interval certifying the printed 16-place truncation of E-3/2.

declarations.name: mersenne_topology_quantitative
declarations.signature: theorem mersenne_topology_quantitative : |erdosBorweinMersenneConstant-(16067 : ℝ)/10000| < 1/20000 ∧ 1 < erdosBorweinMersenneConstant ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ (2 : ℝ)^n*mersenneTail n) Filter.atTop (nhds 1)
declarations.docstring: Quantitative ambient-span and cylinder-limit clauses in the topology theorem.

declarations.name: infinite_of_positive_periodic_support
declarations.signature: theorem infinite_of_positive_periodic_support (m : ℕ) (A : Set ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hper : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → (n + m ∈ A ↔ n ∈ A)) (hpos : ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ a ∈ A) : A.Infinite
declarations.docstring: A support with a positive member and a positive period on positive indices contains an infinite arithmetic progression, whatever its membership at zero.

declarations.name: irrational_erdosSupportSeries_positivePeriodic
declarations.signature: theorem irrational_erdosSupportSeries_positivePeriodic (b m : ℕ) (A : Set ℕ) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hm : 0 < m) (hper : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → (n + m ∈ A ↔ n ∈ A)) (hpos : ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ a ∈ A) : Irrational (erdosSupportSeries b A)
declarations.docstring: **`thm:periodic-support`** (#257 long record). For `b ≥ 2`, `m ≥ 1` and a support `A` with a positive member and `n + m ∈ A ↔ n ∈ A` for every positive `n`, the series `∑_{a ∈ A} 1/(b^a - 1)` is irrational. The hypotheses concern positive indices only, and the infinitude of `A` is derived.

declarations.name: row_weight_floor
declarations.signature: theorem row_weight_floor (n d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) : ⌊(4 : ℝ)^n / ((2 : ℝ)^d-1)⌋ = (truncatedMersenneWeight n d : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: The natural quotient is exactly the paper's real floor.

declarations.name: row_weight_at_middle
declarations.signature: theorem row_weight_at_middle {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) : truncatedMersenneWeight n n = 2^n+1

declarations.name: row_weight_above_middle
declarations.signature: theorem row_weight_above_middle {n d : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hnd : n < d) (hd : d ≤ 2*n) : truncatedMersenneWeight n d = 2^(2*n-d)

declarations.name: sum_two_pow_add_one
declarations.signature: private theorem sum_two_pow_add_one (n : ℕ) : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (2 : ℕ)^i)+1 = 2^n

declarations.name: upper_row_sum
declarations.signature: theorem upper_row_sum {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) : ∑ d ∈ Finset.Ico n (2*n+1), truncatedMersenneWeight n d = 2^(n+1)
declarations.docstring: The full upper half of a quotient row has exact mass 2^(n+1).

declarations.name: rowFullCarry
declarations.docstring: Full-support carry K(2n), in the paper's integer coordinate.

declarations.name: rowDeviation
declarations.signature: def rowDeviation (n : ℕ) (D : Finset ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: Delta for a selected prefix. This applies in particular to the integer greedy take set; the identity itself needs no greediness hypothesis.

declarations.name: paper_master_identity
declarations.signature: theorem paper_master_identity {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (D : Finset ℕ) (hD : D ⊆ Finset.Ico 2 n) : rowDeviation n D = rowFullCarry n + ∑ d ∈ (Finset.Ico 2 n) \ D, (truncatedMersenneWeight n d : ℤ)
declarations.docstring: Exact whole master identity, stronger than the stated n>=6 greedy-row case.

declarations.name: paper_master_identity_floors
declarations.signature: theorem paper_master_identity_floors {n : ℕ} (hn : 6 ≤ n) (D : Finset ℕ) (hD : D ⊆ Finset.Ico 2 n) : ((2 : ℤ)^(2*n-1) - (2 : ℤ)^n - ∑ d ∈ D, ⌊(4 : ℝ)^n / ((2 : ℝ)^d-1)⌋) - (2 : ℤ)^n = ((2 : ℤ)^(2*n-1) - ∑ d ∈ Finset.Ico 2 (2*n+1), ⌊(4 : ℝ)^n / ((2 : ℝ)^d-1)⌋) + ∑ d ∈ (Finset.Ico 2 n) \ D, ⌊(4 : ℝ)^n / ((2 : ℝ)^d-1)⌋
declarations.docstring: Paper coordinates with literal real floors and both separate target offsets.

declarations.name: rowRealError
declarations.signature: noncomputable def rowRealError (n : ℕ) (D : Finset ℕ) : ℝ

declarations.name: scaled_correction_bounds
declarations.signature: private theorem scaled_correction_bounds {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : 0 < (4 : ℝ)^n*mersenneCorrectionTail (n-1) ∧ (4 : ℝ)^n*mersenneCorrectionTail (n-1) < 8/3

declarations.name: row_real_error_bounds
declarations.signature: theorem row_real_error_bounds {n : ℕ} (hn : 6 ≤ n) (D : Finset ℕ) (hD : D ⊆ Finset.Ico 2 n) : 0 < rowRealError n D ∧ rowRealError n D < (n : ℝ)+2/3 ∧ |rowRealError n D| < 2*(n : ℝ)+2

declarations.name: constant_split
declarations.signature: private theorem constant_split {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) : erdosBorweinMersenneConstant = 1 + (∑ d ∈ Finset.Ico 2 n, mersenneWeight d) + mersenneTail (n-1)

declarations.name: row_real_decomposition
declarations.signature: theorem row_real_decomposition {n : ℕ} (hn : 6 ≤ n) (D : Finset ℕ) (hD : D ⊆ Finset.Ico 2 n) : (rowDeviation n D : ℝ) = (4 : ℝ)^n * ((∑ d ∈ (Finset.Ico 2 n) \ D, mersenneWeight d) - (erdosBorweinMersenneConstant-3/2)) + rowRealError n D

declarations.name: paper_real_quotient_core
declarations.signature: theorem paper_real_quotient_core {n : ℕ} (hn : 6 ≤ n) (D : Finset ℕ) (hD : D ⊆ Finset.Ico 2 n) : ∃ eta : ℝ, (rowDeviation n D : ℝ) = (4 : ℝ)^n * ((∑ d ∈ (Finset.Ico 2 n) \ D, mersenneWeight d) - (erdosBorweinMersenneConstant-3/2)) + eta ∧ 0 < eta ∧ eta < (n : ℝ)+2/3 ∧ |eta| < 2*(n : ℝ)+2
declarations.docstring: The decomposition, strict error bound and both error-retaining margins.

declarations.name: row_constant_eq_tail
declarations.docstring: The constant also has the paper's sum-from-rank-two definition.

declarations.name: paper_real_quotient_margins
declarations.signature: theorem paper_real_quotient_margins {n : ℕ} (hn : 6 ≤ n) (D : Finset ℕ) (hD : D ⊆ Finset.Ico 2 n) (H : ℝ) : ((H+(2*(n : ℝ)+2))/(4 : ℝ)^n < |(∑ d ∈ (Finset.Ico 2 n) \ D, mersenneWeight d) - (erdosBorweinMersenneConstant-3/2)| → H < |(rowDeviation n D : ℝ)|) ∧ (H < |(rowDeviation n D : ℝ)| → (H-(2*(n : ℝ)+2))/(4 : ℝ)^n < |(∑ d ∈ (Finset.Ico 2 n) \ D, mersenneWeight d) - (erdosBorweinMersenneConstant-3/2)|)
declarations.docstring: Literal sufficient and necessary thresholds from the paper.

declarations.name: rowRoundingError
declarations.signature: noncomputable def rowRoundingError (n : ℕ) (D : Finset ℕ) : ℝ

declarations.name: row_rounding_error_bounds
declarations.signature: theorem row_rounding_error_bounds (n : ℕ) (D : Finset ℕ) (hD : ∀ d ∈ D, 1 ≤ d) : 0 ≤ rowRoundingError n D ∧ rowRoundingError n D ≤ D.card ∧ (D.Nonempty → rowRoundingError n D < D.card)

declarations.name: deviation_error_margins
declarations.signature: theorem deviation_error_margins (delta a eta H B : ℝ) (heq : delta = a+eta) (hb : |eta| < B) : (H+B < |a| → H < |delta|) ∧ (H < |delta| → H-B < |a|)
declarations.docstring: Sufficient and necessary separation margins keep the additive error.

declarations.name: greedy_half_value
declarations.signature: private theorem greedy_half_value (hm : (1/2 : ℝ) ∈ mersenneAchievementSet) : erdosSupportSeries 2 (greedyMersenneSupport (1/2 : ℝ)) = (1/2 : ℝ)

declarations.name: half_mem_iff_centered_bound
declarations.signature: theorem half_mem_iff_centered_bound : (1/2 : ℝ) ∈ mersenneAchievementSet ↔ ∀ N : ℕ, (mobiusCenteredHalfCarry (greedyMersenneSupport (1/2 : ℝ)) N : ℝ) ≤ 2*Real.sqrt (N : ℝ)+4
declarations.docstring: The pointwise centered bound has the paper's constant four, including N=0.

declarations.name: half_mem_iff_cofinal_exact_rows
declarations.docstring: No consistency is required between exact finite quotient rows.

declarations.name: half_mem_iff_cofinal_terminal_strip
declarations.docstring: Square truncations supply the original terminal-only strip, with no compatibility assumption added to its converse.

declarations.name: half_mem_iff_cofinal_omitted_exponents
declarations.signature: theorem half_mem_iff_cofinal_omitted_exponents : (1/2 : ℝ) ∈ mersenneAchievementSet ↔ ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ n : ℕ, K ≤ n ∧ 0 < n ∧ n ∉ greedyMersenneSupport (1/2 : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: Literal positive omitted-exponent formulation used in the paper.

declarations.name: six_membership_conditions
declarations.signature: theorem six_membership_conditions : ((1/2 : ℝ) ∈ mersenneAchievementSet ↔ ∀ N : ℕ, (mobiusCenteredHalfCarry (greedyMersenneSupport (1/2 : ℝ)) N : ℝ) ≤ 2*Real.sqrt (N : ℝ)+4) ∧ ((1/2 : ℝ) ∈ mersenneAchievementSet ↔ ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ n : ℕ, K ≤ n ∧ 0 < n ∧ n ∉ greedyMersenneSupport (1/2 : ℝ)) ∧ ((1/2 : ℝ) ∈ mersenneAchievementSet ↔ CofinalExactLocalMersenneHalfRows) ∧ ((1/2 : ℝ) ∈ mersenneAchievementSet ↔ GreedyHalfCarryCofinalStripReturn) ∧ ((1/2 : ℝ) ∈ mersenneAchievementSet ↔ HalfCarryCofinalTerminalOnlyStrip) ∧ ((1/2 : ℝ) ∈ mersenneAchievementSet ↔ (∀ n : ℕ, greedyMersenneRemainder (1/2 : ℝ) n ≤ mersenneTail n) ∧ ¬ ExistsFatalHalfGap)
declarations.docstring: All six assertions in long `prop:collapsed-list`, retaining the literal remainder inequality and its no-fatal-gap formulation in the final clause.

declarations.name: terminalPaperCarry
declarations.signature: def terminalPaperCarry (A : Set ℕ) (M : ℕ) : ℤ
declarations.docstring: The paper's terminal carry, with its sum reindexed from `j = 2, ..., M` to `j = 0, ..., M - 2`.

declarations.name: terminalPaperCarry_eq_integerHalfCarry
declarations.signature: theorem terminalPaperCarry_eq_integerHalfCarry (A : Set ℕ) (M : ℕ) : terminalPaperCarry A M = integerHalfCarry A (M - 1)
declarations.docstring: The literal `K_A(M)` is the existing affine carry at index `M - 1`.

declarations.name: exists_infinite_positive_support_half_of_terminalScaledVanishing
declarations.signature: theorem exists_infinite_positive_support_half_of_terminalScaledVanishing (S : HalfTerminalOnlyScaledVanishingSequence) : ∃ A : Set ℕ, 0 ∉ A ∧ A.Infinite ∧ erdosSupportSeries 2 A = (1 : ℝ) / 2
declarations.docstring: Exact short `res:terminalhalf`: scaled terminal vanishing produces an infinite support contained in the positive integers whose Mersenne subseries has value exactly `1/2`.

declarations.name: paper_terminalhalf
declarations.signature: theorem paper_terminalhalf (M : ℕ → ℕ) (A : ℕ → Set ℕ) (hM : ∀ j, 1 ≤ M j) (hlim : Filter.Tendsto M Filter.atTop Filter.atTop) (hA : ∀ j n, n ∈ A j → 2 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ M j) (herr : Filter.Tendsto (fun j ↦ |(terminalPaperCarry (A j) (M j) : ℝ)| / (2 : ℝ) ^ M j) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) : ∃ B : Set ℕ, 0 ∉ B ∧ B.Infinite ∧ erdosSupportSeries 2 B = (1 : ℝ) / 2
declarations.docstring: Literal set-valued finite approximants from short `res:terminalhalf`.

declarations.name: paper_achievement_set_topology
declarations.signature: theorem paper_achievement_set_topology : Continuous positiveMersenneDigitValue ∧ Set.range positiveMersenneDigitValue = mersenneAchievementSet ∧ IsCompact mersenneAchievementSet ∧ IsClosed mersenneAchievementSet ∧ Perfect mersenneAchievementSet ∧ IsTotallyDisconnected mersenneAchievementSet ∧ IsNowhereDense mersenneAchievementSet ∧ volume mersenneAchievementSet = 1
declarations.docstring: Paper display of `prop:achievement-set-topology`: `𝒜` is compact -- explicitly as the continuous image of the binary-sequence Cantor space `ℕ → Fin 2` under `positiveMersenneDigitValue` -- hence closed; it is also perfect, totally disconnected and nowhere dense, with Lebesgue measure exactly `1`.

declarations.name: paper_no_finite_support_has_value_half
declarations.signature: theorem paper_no_finite_support_has_value_half (A : Set ℕ) (hfinite : A.Finite) (hzero : 0 ∉ A) : erdosSupportSeries 2 A ≠ (1 : ℝ) / 2
declarations.docstring: Paper display of `record:257bm-i10`: a finite sum of reciprocals of the odd integers `2^a - 1` has odd denominator in lowest terms, so it cannot equal `1/2`.

declarations.name: paper_half_representing_support_infinite
declarations.signature: theorem paper_half_representing_support_infinite (A : Set ℕ) (hzero : 0 ∉ A) (hvalue : erdosSupportSeries 2 A = (1 : ℝ) / 2) : A.Infinite
declarations.docstring: The consequence the paper draws in the same environment: a support representing `1/2` must be infinite.

declarations.name: prod_dvd_of_pairwise_coprime
declarations.signature: theorem prod_dvd_of_pairwise_coprime {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {M : ℕ} (S : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℕ) (hcop : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j ∈ S, i ≠ j → Nat.Coprime (f i) (f j)) (hdvd : ∀ i ∈ S, f i ∣ M) : (∏ i ∈ S, f i) ∣ M
declarations.docstring: Pairwise coprime divisors of `M` have a product dividing `M`.

declarations.name: card_filter_mod_mem_mul
declarations.signature: theorem card_filter_mod_mem_mul {a b : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (A B : Finset ℕ) : ((Finset.range (a * b)).filter (fun m => m % a ∈ A ∧ m % b ∈ B)).card = ((Finset.range a).filter (fun x => x ∈ A)).card * ((Finset.range b).filter (fun y => y ∈ B)).card
declarations.docstring: Two coprime residue conditions are jointly free over one full period.

declarations.name: card_filter_forall_mod_mem_prod
declarations.signature: theorem card_filter_forall_mod_mem_prod {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (S : Finset ι) (K : ι → ℕ) (Rs : ι → Finset ℕ) (hK : ∀ i ∈ S, 0 < K i) (hcop : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j ∈ S, i ≠ j → Nat.Coprime (K i) (K j)) : ((Finset.range (∏ i ∈ S, K i)).filter (fun m => ∀ i ∈ S, m % K i ∈ Rs i)).card = ∏ i ∈ S, ((Finset.range (K i)).filter (fun x => x ∈ Rs i)).card
declarations.docstring: Over one full period `∏_{i ∈ S} K_i`, residue conditions at pairwise coprime moduli are jointly free.

declarations.name: card_filter_forall_mod_mem
declarations.signature: theorem card_filter_forall_mod_mem {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (S : Finset ι) (K : ι → ℕ) (Rs : ι → Finset ℕ) (hK : ∀ i ∈ S, 0 < K i) (hcop : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j ∈ S, i ≠ j → Nat.Coprime (K i) (K j)) {M : ℕ} (hdvd : (∏ i ∈ S, K i) ∣ M) : ((Finset.range M).filter (fun m => ∀ i ∈ S, m % K i ∈ Rs i)).card * (∏ i ∈ S, K i) = M * ∏ i ∈ S, ((Finset.range (K i)).filter (fun x => x ∈ Rs i)).card
declarations.docstring: The paper's independence of the parent groups, as an exact count: over any period divisible by `∏_{i ∈ S} K_i`, residue conditions at pairwise coprime moduli multiply.

declarations.name: half_card_le_card_filter_le
declarations.signature: theorem half_card_le_card_filter_le {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (Ω : Finset α) (Sg : Finset ℕ) (Av : ℕ → Finset α) (r : ℕ) (hrpos : 0 < r) (hA : ∀ p ∈ Sg, Av p ⊆ Ω) (hmarg : ∀ p ∈ Sg, ((Av p).card : ℝ) = (Ω.card : ℝ) * (1 / (p : ℝ))) (hpair : ∀ p ∈ Sg, ∀ p' ∈ Sg, p ≠ p' → ((Av p ∩ Av p').card : ℝ) = (Ω.card : ℝ) * ((1 / (p : ℝ)) * (1 / (p' : ℝ)))) (hmu : 4 * (r : ℝ) ≤ ∑ p ∈ Sg, 1 / (p : ℝ)) : (Ω.card : ℝ) / 2 ≤ (((Ω.filter (fun k => r ≤ (Sg.filter (fun p => k ∈ Av p)).card)).card : ℕ) : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: The paper's conditional Chebyshev step, over an arbitrary finite sample set: if the events `A p`, `p ∈ Sg`, have frequencies `1/p` and pairwise frequencies `(1/p)(1/p')`, and their expected number `∑ 1/p` is at least `4r`, then at least half the sample points carry at least `r` of them.

declarations.name: condTags

declarations.name: crt_count
declarations.signature: theorem crt_count {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : S ⊆ insert T.parent T.tagIndex) (c : ℕ) : ((((Finset.range T.period).filter (fun k => ∀ a ∈ S, a ∣ T.L * k + c)).card : ℕ) : ℝ) = (T.period : ℝ) * (1 / ((∏ a ∈ S, a : ℕ) : ℝ))
declarations.docstring: The paper's sampling count for one parent group: at any family of its own primes the divisibility events `a ∣ L k + c` are jointly free over one period.

declarations.name: crt_count_one
declarations.signature: theorem crt_count_one {a : ℕ} (ha : a ∈ insert T.parent T.tagIndex) (c : ℕ) : ((((Finset.range T.period).filter (fun k => a ∣ T.L * k + c)).card : ℕ) : ℝ) = (T.period : ℝ) / (a : ℝ)

declarations.signature: theorem crt_count_two {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ∈ insert T.parent T.tagIndex) (hb : b ∈ insert T.parent T.tagIndex) (hab : a ≠ b) (c : ℕ) : ((((Finset.range T.period).filter (fun k => a ∣ T.L * k + c ∧ b ∣ T.L * k + c)).card : ℕ) : ℝ) = (T.period : ℝ) / ((a : ℝ) * (b : ℝ))

declarations.name: crt_count_three
declarations.signature: theorem crt_count_three {a b d : ℕ} (ha : a ∈ insert T.parent T.tagIndex) (hb : b ∈ insert T.parent T.tagIndex) (hd : d ∈ insert T.parent T.tagIndex) (hab : a ≠ b) (had : a ≠ d) (hbd : b ≠ d) (c : ℕ) : ((((Finset.range T.period).filter (fun k => a ∣ T.L * k + c ∧ b ∣ T.L * k + c ∧ d ∣ T.L * k + c)).card : ℕ) : ℝ) = (T.period : ℝ) / ((a : ℝ) * ((b : ℝ) * (d : ℝ)))

declarations.name: tagCount_eq_condTags
declarations.signature: theorem tagCount_eq_condTags {r n : ℕ} (hn : ∀ d ∈ T.L.divisors, (d ∣ n ↔ d ∣ r)) : T.toParentTagData.tagCount n = ((T.condTags r).filter (fun p => p ∣ n)).card
declarations.docstring: "Since `d ∣ N + r` is equivalent to `d ∣ r`", the paper's `Z_q(n)` counts exactly the tag primes of `𝓘_q` whose divisor part divides `r`.

declarations.name: succSet
declarations.docstring: The paper's success event at offset `r`, over one period of the sampling `N = L k`: `q ∣ N + r` and `Z_q(N + r) ≥ r`.

declarations.name: parentSuccess

declarations.name: period_div_two_parent_le_card_succSet
declarations.signature: theorem period_div_two_parent_le_card_succSet {r : ℕ} (hr : r ∈ T.L.divisors) (hmu : 4 * (r : ℝ) ≤ ∑ p ∈ T.condTags r, 1 / (p : ℝ)) : (T.period : ℝ) / (2 * (T.parent : ℝ)) ≤ (((T.succSet r).card : ℕ) : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: "Thus success has conditional probability at least `1/2`."

declarations.name: card_parentSuccess_ge
declarations.signature: theorem card_parentSuccess_ge (G : Finset ℕ) (hG : G ⊆ T.L.divisors) (hmu : ∀ r ∈ G, 4 * (r : ℝ) ≤ ∑ p ∈ T.condTags r, 1 / (p : ℝ)) : (G.card : ℝ) * ((T.period : ℝ) / (2 * (T.parent : ℝ))) ≤ (((T.parentSuccess G).card : ℕ) : ℝ)
declarations.docstring: "The event `E_q` of success for some `r ∈ G` consequently satisfies `ℙ_L(E_q) ≥ |G|/(2q)`": for a fixed parent the events at distinct offsets are disjoint, because `1 ≤ r ≤ L < q`.

declarations.name: condTags_filter_mod_period

declarations.name: success_mod_period
declarations.signature: theorem success_mod_period (G : Finset ℕ) (m : ℕ) : ((∃ r ∈ G, T.parent ∣ T.L * (m % T.period) + (T.L + r) ∧ r ≤ ((T.condTags r).filter (fun p => p ∣ T.L * (m % T.period) + (T.L + r))).card) ↔ (∃ r ∈ G, T.parent ∣ T.L * m + (T.L + r) ∧ r ≤ ((T.condTags r).filter (fun p => p ∣ T.L * m + (T.L + r))).card))
declarations.docstring: The paper's "different parent groups depend on disjoint prime coordinates": the success event of one parent depends on the sample only through its residue modulo that parent's own period.

The numerical conditions (`B ≥ H²`, `4/D ≤ ∑ 1/q ≤ 5/D`, `4d/H ≤ S_{q,d} ≤ 5d/H`) are carried as hypotheses of the individual estimates below, not as fields.
